target_text: ètu era ne'e, dhèu se'e hia yesus ninu èi anggor dhu pab'ali rare le dènge èi na'i dhu pèd'u, sèna ka bisa taha rarii. ka yesus camuci, hèia juku eele.

source_text: when they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu se'e paku yesus asa aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia sordad'u se ère lot, sèna ka nèti rèngu, cee ka dhu abhu mèdha-papake na.

source_text: and they sat and watched him there.
target_text: ka ra madhèdi madhenge yesus ètu era ne'e.

source_text: they set up over his head the accusation against him written, this is jesus, the king of the jews.
target_text: ra suri kahèi ètu papa èci, peka na, ne'e ne yesus, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi ka ra paku papa ne re dedha kètu yesus, sèna ka dhèu re'a nga tao ka rèngu huku ne.

source_text: then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, ra paku pamadhe parapo dhèu dua kahèi. ca dhèu re bèka g'ana yesus, aa èci hari re bèka kariu na.

source_text: those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu kako re sèra, laladhe ne. hèia ra pakapengo hèb'a ra, ho lalangu ne.

source_text: and saying, you who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! if you are the son of god, come down from the cross!
target_text: dhèu se'e rodhe ne, peka na, eeh! èu peka na, èu bisa paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, ho èèna na patitu hari ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o, si? ladhe èu tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, na, papuru ngi'u mu nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna.

source_text: likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the pharisees, and the elders, said,
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra. ra pahahe yesus, aku rèngu na,

source_text: he saved others, but he can't save himself. if he is the king of israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.
target_text: nèngu ne pamamuri le dhèu leo, te ngaa na bisa boe patabuli eele ngi'u nèngu unu na. nèngu mesa na peka na, nèngu dhèu aae isra'el! ladhe sèmi èèna, be'a risi na puru ka nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna. ladhe ji'i ngèdhi ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna, ji'i heka parcaya nèngu kèna.

source_text: he trusts in god. let god deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘i am the son of god. '
target_text: ladhe nèngu ne tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua, hud'i laa, ‘na maena mi ama lamatua. de ladhe lamatua d'èi ne, hud'i laa lamatua ka dhu pamamuri ne. '

source_text: the robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.
target_text: dhèu parapo dhèu dua se, pahahe ne sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.
target_text: èle èèna ka, maroga kiu-kiu saguru nare era ne'e, karèi nèti lod'o titu mera toke d'ai hake tèlu nihia.

source_text: about the ninth hour jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, eli, eli, lima sabachthani? that is, my god, my god, why have you forsaken me?
target_text: d'ai hake tèlu, hèia yesus pa'oo pake lii aram, na, eli! eli! lema sabaktani? sasoa na, ama lamatua ja'a! lamatua ja'a! nga tao ka ama soro kabodho ho tèke eele ja'a mesa-mesa ku sèmi ne'e ne?

source_text: some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, this man is calling elijah.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu dètu ètu sèra, tadèngi lii na sèmi èèna, hèia ra papeka, mi nanene ku laa. na paroa elia, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu uru sèra!

source_text: immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.
target_text: ka ca dhèu rai la'e nare ula, cèb'u asa d'ara èi anggor manyilu. hèia na èki mi suu tatea èci, ka j'ole asa hèb'a yesus sèna ka na camuci.

source_text: the rest said, let him be. let's see whether elijah comes to save him.
target_text: te ngaa cahag'e hari peka na, èdhi ladhe sèku, teko-teko elia mai pamamuri ne, do aad'o?

source_text: jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.
target_text: ka yesus pa'oo hari dènge lii mèdhu, hèia na madhe.

source_text: behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. the earth quaked and the rocks were split.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, abhu bèla dhu bhèla aae kadhoe pa'abhe kama luri mola-mèci ama lamatua. lèke dènge yesus ma'ète a'ae èèna, bèla dhu bhèla aae ne mae, cèri mi dua, nèti dedha toke haha. hèia rai opo, toke hadhu aae-hadhu aae mae sèg'i bagi mi dua.

source_text: the tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;
target_text: ro'a-ro'a dhèu madhe bhoke kahèi. aa dhèu unu ama lamatua dhu madhe le, abhu dhu na pamamuri hari.

source_text: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.
target_text: ropa yesus mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na, hèia dhèu madhe sèra bhodho mai nèti d'ara ro'a, ka lasi asa yerusalem. ètu era ne'e dhèu ae rèdhi si.

source_text: now the centurion and those who were with him watching jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, truly this was the son of god!
target_text: ètu golgota, abhu komedhaa dènge sordad'u na dhu j'aga ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha yesus èèna. ropa ladhe rèdhi rai opo, dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i se'e, rèngu madha'u titu kèna. ka ra papeka, na, ira ii! dhèu ne'e ne, tare'a-re'a ana lamatua!

source_text: many women were there watching from afar, who had followed jesus from galilee, serving him.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu bhèni pèri-pèri dhèu dhu laladhe mamadhe yesus nèti kaj'èu. rèngu se'e ka dhu madhutu ne nèti galilea, te rèngu ka dhu lalau-lalo'o ne karèi nèti uru.

source_text: among them were mary magdalene, mary the mother of james and joses, and the mother of the sons of zebedee.
target_text: dhèu bhèni se'e, nuka maria nèti rae magdala, maria èci hari nuka ina yakobis dènge yusuf, aa dènge dhèu èmu sabadeus nuka ina nèti yakobis dènge yohanis.

source_text: when evening had come, a rich man from arimathaea named joseph, who himself was also jesus' disciple, came.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu kaja èci nèti rae arimatea, ngara na yusuf. nèngu ne dhu nèbhu le madhutu a'aj'a yesus. lod'o mamadhe yesus lèke hari jumat. asa bèli èèna, lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. nèti èèna ka, ropa lod'o oe cèna, hèia yusuf tenge j'ara ho neo papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: this man went to pilate and asked for jesus' body. then pilate commanded the body to be given up.
target_text: hèia la'e asa gubernur pilatus, sèna ka manèngi papuru ngi'u aae yesus. ka gubernur paredha, sèna ka ngi'u aae yesus saraka mi yusuf.

source_text: joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth
target_text: ka yusuf la'e asa golgota, hèia na papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia na hutu pabe'a-be'a ngi'u aae ne dènge bèla hiu dhu kab'ua.

source_text: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.
target_text: tèu èèna, dhèu heka pae rare ro'a èci ètu ledhe hadhu, sèna ka tao tèke ro'a hia yusuf dènge a'ari na, ladhe d'ai lod'o rèngu madhe. de yusuf si nedhe rèti ngi'u aae yesus ne, lasi paj'unu asa ro'a deo na. ka ètu hèb'a ro'a ne, ra saguru dènge hadhu kabela aae cue, ho ra bèdho pabe'a-be'a hèb'a ro'a ne. èle èèna ka yusuf si lèpa.

source_text: mary magdalene was there, and the other mary, sitting opposite the tomb.
target_text: lod'o èèna, maria nèti magdala, dènge maria dhu leo èci madhutu d'ai era èèna kahèi. ra madhèdi patangara dènge ro'a ne.

source_text: now on the next day, which was the day after the preparation day, the chief priests and the pharisees were gathered together to pilate,
target_text: asa bèli èèna, lèke dènge lod'o ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi. hèia kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu parisi lasi paraga dènge gubernur.

source_text: saying, sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘after three days i will rise again. '
target_text: ra peka, ama. ji'i sanèd'e era, lod'o dhèu kapod'e-kabèli èèna mamuri era, na peka, na, ‘ja'a madhe tare'a, te ngaa èle tèlu lod'o, ja'a mamuri hari. '

source_text: command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘he is risen from the dead; ' and the last deception will be worse than the first.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama paredha ku sordad'u sèra, ho ra j'aga paie-iie ro'a èèna d'ai tèlu lod'o. dènge j'ara ne'e, ana madhutu na bani boe mana'u rèti ngi'u aae na, sèna ka ra monya peka na, nèngu mamuri hari. te ladhe rèngu kapod'e-kabèli sèmi èèna, risi eele nèti mamonya rèngu uru sèra, lod'o dhu ra peka na, nèngu ne nuka kristus.

source_text: pilate said to them, you have a guard. go, make it as secure as you can.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, hèia gubernur dhaa, aku nèngu na, be'a kahèi! te ngaa miu dènge dhèu madhenga kahèi. be'a risi miu pua si, ho lasi j'aga paie-iie ro'a nèi.

source_text: so they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.
target_text: èle ka lasi asa era èèna, rèti dènge dhèu madhenga ra. d'ai era ne'e, ra segel madhe babèdho ro'a ne. hèia ra pua dhèu sèra madhenga, sèna ka dhèu leo baku mai rare ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: now after the sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, mary magdalene and the other mary came to see the tomb.
target_text: ka ètu d'ara hari migu mad'ae aae era, maria nèti magdala, dènge maria dhu leo èci, lasi asa ro'a yesus.

source_text: behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.
target_text: kaca'a la rai opo kapai titu kèna. ana pajuu ama lamatua ca dhèu puru mai nèti sorga, hèia na loli eele hadhu aae dhu saguru ro'a. ka na madhèdi ètu dedha hadhu ne.

source_text: his appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.
target_text: rèhu ana pajuu ne kale'e sèmi kaha'a bela, aa mèdha-papake na pudhi mèu.

source_text: for fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.
target_text: dhèu madhenga se, madha'u bia toke ra karèbha, ka rèngu bisa boe kalau-karèto, nuka sèmi dhèu madhe sa.

source_text: the angel answered the women, don't be afraid, for i know that you seek jesus, who has been crucified.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu nèti sorga ne, lii dènge dhèu bhèni se'e, aku nèngu na, miu baku madha'u! ja'a ke'a miu se mai tenge yesus, dhèu dhu ra paku pamadhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna.

source_text: he is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. come, see the place where the lord was lying.
target_text: te ngaa nèngu aad'o heka ètu era ne'e. te na mamuri hari le, sama sèmi dhu na peka le uru èèna. maso mai, sèna ka mèdhi unu mi era dhu ra paj'unu ngi'u aae na. era ne ngaa-ngaa aad'o heka!

source_text: go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘he has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into galilee; there you will see him. ' behold, i have told you.
target_text: de pamèri lèpa ka! lami lolo dènge ana madhutu na, peka na, yesus mamuri hari le. la'e uuru le asa galilea. rèngu hud'i lasi paraga uuru ku dènge ne ètu nèi, sèmi dhu uru èèna, na moa mema mi rèngu. parcaya la. lèpa ka, lami lole ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne!

source_text: they departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.
target_text: hèia bhèni se rai li'u lasi, tèke eele era ne'e. ra madha'u, te ngaa ra karej'e-karae kahèi. ka ra pamèri-mèri lèpa, lasi peka j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra mi ana madhutu yesus.

source_text: as they went to tell his disciples, behold, jesus met them, saying, rejoice! they came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.
target_text: te ngaa ropa d'ai talora j'ara, kabèdhi la yesus mai paraga dènge ra. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, saloom! ropa ladhe rèdhi, hèia lasi padètu-dètu, liku rare haga na, dènge pahaha iisi ra mi yesus.

source_text: then jesus said to them, don't be afraid. go tell my brothers that they should go into galilee, and there they will see me.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii, peka na, baku madha'u! lami peka dènge ana madhutu ja'a, sèna ka ra lasi mate ja'a ètu galilea nèi.

source_text: now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.
target_text: lod'o dhèu bhèni se ètu talora j'ara era, dhèu madhenga se lèpa le asa kota. rèngu lasi lole ngaa dhu j'aj'i se mi kètu agama yahudi sèra.

source_text: when they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,
target_text: hèia kètu agama yahudi rare lii èci dènge dhèu heka ad'a sèra, sèna ka b'ae doi ae-ae mi dhèu j'aga ho ra hutu hèb'a.

source_text: saying, say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.
target_text: kètu agama yahudi sèra peka, na, ladhe dhèu karèi miu, dhaa sèmi ne'e: d'ara mèda, ropa ji'i bhèj'i luu, nge'a boe, na, ana madhutu na mai mana'u rèti ngi'u aae na.

source_text: if this comes to the governor's ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.
target_text: aa ladhe gubernur tadèngi, mage miu madha'u, te ji'i ka dhu ator dènge ne.

source_text: so they took the money and did as they were told. this saying was spread abroad among the jews, and continues until today.
target_text: hèia dhèu madhenga se rare doi. aa ra tao madhutu dad'èi kètu agama se'e. nèti èèna ka, toke d'ai sange ne'e dhèu-dhèu yahudi parcaya era lii lolo kapod'e-kabèli ne.

source_text: but the eleven disciples went into galilee, to the mountain where jesus had sent them.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii lolo nèti dhèu bhèni se'e, hèia ana madhutu yesus dhèu canguru èci, lasi paraga dènge yesus asa propensi galilea, ètu ledhe èci, madhutu lii moa na.

source_text: when they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.
target_text: ropa ra ladhe rèdhi ne, ka ra pahaha iisi mi nèngu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu kahèi dhu d'ara ra kajari era.

source_text: jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, all authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
target_text: hèia na ara mai padètu-dètu dènge ra, ka na lii, ama lamatua pangèd'u le koasa mi ja'a, sèna ka ja'a paredha aa'i-aa'i ètu sorga, aa dènge aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the father and of the son and of the holy spirit,
target_text: de miu lami asa mia-mia, miu hud'i peka-padhai ku dènge dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ra, lii lolo be'a ja'a ne. aa miu hud'i aj'a si paie-iie, ho sèna ka rèngu j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a. aa miu hud'i sarani si ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, rèngu dhu pa'èki le dènge ama, dènge ana, aa dènge roh na dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: teaching them to observe all things that i commanded you. behold, i am with you always, even to the end of the age. amen.
target_text: aa nori si sèna ka ra tao madhutu paredha aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a peka tèke le dènge miu. sanèd'e, ee! ja'a bera-bera dènge miu toke èle rai-haha ne.

source_text: the beginning of the good news of jesus christ, the son of god.
target_text: ne'e ne, lii lolo be'a lula-nèti ana ama lamatua. ngara na yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru ka mai. lii lolo na mulai sèmi ne'e:

source_text: as it is written in the prophets, behold, i send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:
target_text: lod'o yesus sab'a mèka sasab'a na, ama lamatua pua uru dhèu èci, ngara na yohanis, la'e tao tèke j'ara hia yesus dhu mai bèli-camèd'a. lula uru èèna, ama lamatua peka le dènge dhèu nèti lii padhai na, ngara na yesaya. na suri tèke, peka na, nanene! ja'a pua le dhèu èci, ho bhoke j'ara hia èu.

source_text: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘make ready the way of the lord! make his paths straight! '
target_text: dhèu èèna la'e asa d'ara mamoo, ho na rodhe, peka na, ‘miu aa'i-aa'i mi tao pabe'a ku j'ara, sèna ka sèmi mere mamai lamatua! pamera j'ara ho soru mamai na. '

source_text: john came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins. all the country of judea and all those of jerusalem went out to him. they were baptized by him in the jordan river, confessing their sins. john was clothed with camel's hair and a leather belt around his waist. he ate locusts and wild honey.
target_text: ra pangare dhèu ne'e, yohanis, tuka sarani dhèu. era pea nèngu ètu d'ara mamoo. kodho na tao nèti rèu badha onta, dhara hake na, tao nèti ka'uri badha. nganga'a nèngu kabara dènge dhua nasu oni. lod'o èèna, dhèu ae nèti kota yerusalem dènge propensi yudea, mai paraga dènge yohanis ètu era pea na. dhèu se mai neo rèdhi yohanis, aa nanene lii holo-nori na. na peka, hua iia miu ele-ho'a nèti tatao karehe, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo miu. èle èèna miu sarani uuru ku j'aj'i mi tadha, na, miu be'a le dènge lamatua. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se'e bhoka sasala rèngu, ka yohanis sarani si ètu loko yarden.

source_text: he preached, saying, after me comes he who is mightier than i, the strap of whose sandals i am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.
target_text: ka na peka hari, bèli-camèd'a dhèu èci mai, dhu kapai risi nèti ja'a. lula ja'a ne haha d'ai seli, neo j'aj'i ana pua-paleha èèna ka, lèke boe sa hèi.

source_text: i baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the holy spirit.
target_text: ja'a ne dhodhoka sarani miu dènge èi di, te ngaa nèngu tao risi eele nèti ja'a. te na papènu d'ara miu dènge roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: in those days, jesus came from nazareth of galilee, and was baptized by john in the jordan.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, yesus la'e nèti rae nasaret ètu rai galilea, ka na paraga dènge yohanis. èle èèna ka yohanis sarani ne ètu loko yarden.

source_text: immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the spirit descending on him like a dove.
target_text: ropa yesus bhodho nèti d'ara èi mai, na ladhe, na, liru bhoke eele, ka roh ama lamatua puru mai sama sèmi koro j'aha ci'u, puru mai asa yesus.

source_text: a voice came out of the sky, you are my beloved son, in whom i am well pleased.
target_text: kaca'a la, ra tadèngi lii ama lamatua nèti dedha-liru, peka na, èu ne, ana pasue ja'a, èu pakarej'e taruu d'ara ja'a.

source_text: immediately the spirit drove him out into the wilderness.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, roh ama lamatua jajuku yesus asa d'ara mamoo la'e.

source_text: he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by satan. he was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.
target_text: na pea dènge badha hui ètu èèna, èpa nguru lod'o. ka dhèu aae nidhu mai dadugu tenge j'ara sèna ka yesus madhutu nèngu, te ngaa tao nare boe. èle èèna ka, ana pajuu nèti ama lamatua puru mai lalau-lalo'o ne.

source_text: now after john was taken into custody, jesus came into galilee, preaching the good news of god's kingdom,
target_text: lod'o dhu kèpe rare yohanis tuka sarani pamaso asa d'ara bèdho, nèbhu boe ka yesus pakèd'i la'e propensi galilea. la'e lole lii lolo be'a nèti ama lamatua ètu nèi.

source_text: and saying, the time is fulfilled, and god's kingdom is at hand! repent, and believe in the good news.
target_text: ka na peka, mi nanene! lod'o ama lamatua d'ai kèna! limuri ne, dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, na, ama lamatua nèd'u le paredha karèi nèti uru ka. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i tèke eele ka tatao karehe sèra, ho lèpa madhutu ama lamatua. hèia parcaya ka lii holo-nori nèngu kahèi.

source_text: passing along by the sea of galilee, he saw simon and andrew, the brother of simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, yesus kako re sebhe dano galilea, ka nèdhi dhèu dua, ngara ra simon dènge ari na anderias. sasab'a rèngu bèli-bèli èèna, j'ala i'a.

source_text: jesus said to them, come after me, and i will make you into fishers for men.
target_text: ka yesus paroa nare dua ra, peka na, we! mai madhutu ja'a! miu tema tenge i'a, te ngaa ja'a neo aj'a miu, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu tenge samanga.

source_text: immediately they left their nets, and followed him.
target_text: ropa ra nanene rare, hèia ra tèke eele j'ala rèngu, ka lasi dènge madhutu ne.

source_text: going on a little further from there, he saw james the son of zebedee, and john his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako hari ciki, ka nèdhi ana-ana sabadeus, a'a ngara na yakobis, aa ari ngara na yohanis. dua ra lalau paie pèku ètu dedha koha.

source_text: immediately he called them, and they left their father, zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.
target_text: ka yesus paroa dua ra, peka na, mai we! madhutu ja'a! ropa ra tadèngi rare lii yesus, ka dua ra tèke eele ama ra, dènge dhèu sab'a sa ètu dedha koha, lasi dènge ka madhutu yesus.

source_text: they went into capernaum, and immediately on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na dhèu èpa sèra lasi d'ai kota kapernaum. lod'o èèna, lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi. ka yesus la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na lole lii holo-nori ama lamatua ètu èèna.

source_text: they were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.
target_text: dhèu ae sèra malaa, nanene lii padhai na, lula nèngu ne'a mèu lii dhu nèngu lole, risi nèti mese-mese agama yahudi.

source_text: immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu dhèu èci dhu nidhu tao. dhèu ne'e la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i kahèi. kaca'a laa na pakèce, peka na,

source_text: saying, ha! what do we have to do with you, jesus, you nazarene? have you come to destroy us? i know who you are: the holy one of god!
target_text: we! yesus, dhèu nasaret! ngaa unu èu dènge ji'i! èu mai ho pa'ele iie ji'i, do? ji'i tadhe èu. èu ne'e ka dhu mai nèti ama lamatua. èu ne'e dhèu dhu dènge boe sasala-sasigo.

source_text: jesus rebuked him, saying, be quiet, and come out of him!
target_text: ka yesus jèke ne, hutu hèb'a èu na! rai eele nèti dhèu ne'e!

source_text: the unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
target_text: kaca'a laa nidhu tèku ngi'u dhèu ne'e, sama sèmi dhèu dhu pèd'a rèdha. ka na rai eele nèti dhèu ne'e, dènge lii pakèce.

source_text: they were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, what is this? a new teaching? for with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!
target_text: hèia dhèu ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i sèra, malaa-maloha. ka ra padhue èci dènge èci, eea! ngaa ka ne'e? ne'e ne, lii holo-nori dhu hiu, do? lii padhai lii mone heka ne, ele madha, nga! na paredha nidhu se, ka ra kalua kahèi, madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: the report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of galilee and its surrounding area.
target_text: hèia dhèu palolo lème era, ètu d'ara rae-rae propensi galilea.

source_text: immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of simon and andrew, with james and john.
target_text: lod'o rèngu lèpa nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, hèia yesus dènge ana madhutu na, lasi asa èmu simon dènge anderias.

source_text: now simon's wife's mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.
target_text: ina dhèu èmu simon pèd'a maringi-sagoro, ka dhu j'unu. ropa yesus dènge ana madhutu na d'ai d'ara èmu èèna, dhèu mai peka dènge ne, bhèni heka ne, pèd'a.

source_text: he came and took her by the hand and raised her up. the fever left her immediately, and she served them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus la'e ladhe bhèni heka ne. hèia na kèpe kacui-aai na, ho pamadhèdi ne. kaca'a laa papèd'a maringi-sagoro èèna èle dènge. hèia bhèni heka ne kèd'i la'e lalau nganga'a-nganginu hia si.

source_text: at evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.
target_text: ropa lod'o cèna, dhèu pakako rèti asa yesus a'ari rèngu dhu pèd'a, dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu nidhu tao, sèna ka na puri-pa'èle si.

source_text: all the city was gathered together at the door.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ca kabarai mai pakaboko pènu tao cèci ètu madha èmu èèna.

source_text: he healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. he didn't allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.
target_text: èi papèd'a ra rupa-rupa, te ngaa yesus puri-pa'èle aa'i mèu-mèu si. hèia na lalèta eele nidhu ae nèti dhèu sèra. yesus hia boe tebho nidhu se'e padhai lii, lula ra tadhe ne.

source_text: early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.
target_text: bèli èèna mad'ae aae era, ako maroga, yesus kèd'i ka la'e asa era èci dhu nee-nee, ka na manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua.

source_text: simon and those who were with him searched for him.
target_text: ropa simon si kèd'i, rèdhi heka yesus, ka lasi tenge ne.

source_text: they found him and told him, everyone is looking for you.
target_text: ra paraga dènge yesus, ka ra peka, ama, dhèu canau mai tenge ama ku.

source_text: he said to them, let's go elsewhere into the next towns, that i may preach there also, because i came out for this reason.
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa lii rèngu, aku nèngu na, èèna be'a kahèi. te ngaa be'a risi lati uru asa rae-rae leo, ho ja'a aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua. te èèna sasab'a-la'a ja'a na.

source_text: he went into their synagogues throughout all galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
target_text: èle èèna ka, rèngu kako palème era ètu propensi galilea, ho lole lii lolo be'a ama lamatua. ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, na babège-lalèta eele nidhu nèti dhèu sèra.

source_text: a leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, if you want to, you can make me clean.
target_text: dhèu èci dhu lèke papèd'a kusta mai paraga dènge yesus, ka na patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus. na manèngi, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! sue ku ja'a laa. tao pa'èle ku papèd'a ja'a ne. ja'a ke'a, na, ama bisa pa'èle papèd'a ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu madenge heka dènge ja'a.

source_text: being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, i want to. be made clean.
target_text: nèti lii roma iisi na, ka d'ara yesus roe, ka na j'ole kacui-aai ho kèpe ne. hèia na peka, tare'a! ja'a bisa! èu èle kèna!

source_text: when he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.
target_text: kaca'a laa, papèd'a èèna ele dènge. ka dhèu èèna pèd'a heka.

source_text: he strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus pua dhèu èèna lèpa dènge pasanèd'e ne, peka na,

source_text: and said to him, see that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which moses commanded, for a testimony to them.
target_text: mu nanene! èu èle le, te ngaa baku lole dènge cee-cee! èu hud'i madhutu ku lii paredha musa uru èèna. de lamu uru ku asa ama agama, ho na parisa ngi'u mu. sèna ka ne'a èi papèd'a èu na ele le, do dhae. èle èèna ka, heka èu hia mèdha èci sèmi tadha makasi, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a èu èle le tare'a-re'a.

source_text: but he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. people came to him from everywhere.
target_text: masi ka yesus kai baku peka dènge cee-cee, te ngaa ropa la'e d'ai li'u, ka na lolo lème dènge dhèu. èle èèna ka, dhèu ae neo paraga dènge yesus. te ngaa, lula lii dhèu èèna, ka yesus bisa boe pad'elo iisi na asa d'ara kota. nèti èèna ka, yesus pea dhoka ètu era mau èci ètu li'u kota. te ngaa dhèu mai paraga dènge ne nèti mia-mia.

source_text: when he entered again into capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.
target_text: èle pèri-pèri lod'o, hèia yesus lèpa hari asa kapernaum. ka ra papeka d'ai mia-mia, peka na, yesus d'ai le èmu.

source_text: immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu mai nèti mia-mia. lula dhèu ae seli, ka ètu d'ara èmu pènu risi, toke d'ai hèb'a èmu. èle èèna ka, yesus lole dènge ra dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.
target_text: ètu talora na padhai lii era, dhèu èpa jèru dhèu karuku èci neo asa madha yesus.

source_text: when they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. when they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.
target_text: te ngaa, lula dhèu ae d'ai seli, ka rèngu abhu boe sasanga ho rèti dhèu èèna asa madha yesus. hèia ca'e lasi asa kolo èmu, bhoke eele rèu èmu re dedha kètu yesus. ropa ra bhoke rare rèu èmu, hèia ra papuru dhèu karuku èena dènge dhèpi na.

source_text: jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, son, your sins are forgiven you.
target_text: ropa yesus ladhe nèdhi si, nèngu ne'a le dhèu se'e parcaya tare'a-re'a nèngu. ka na padhai lii dènge dhèu karuku ne, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! ja'a saku eele le sasala èu!

source_text: but there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,
target_text: ètu èèna kahèi, abhu pèri-pèri mese agama yahudi. ropa ra tadèngi rare lii padhai lii yesus, ka d'ara ngangee rèngu be'a boe.

source_text: why does this man speak blasphemies like that? who can forgive sins but god alone?
target_text: hèia ra papeka, boo! dhèu ne'e bani titu kèna, padhai lii sèmi nèi! dhodhoka ama lamatua di, dhu dènge hak ho saku eele sasala dhèu. te ngaa dhèu ne'e tao ngi'u na èci èèna ka dènge ama lamatua. nèngu pakarehe kolongara ama lamatua!

source_text: immediately jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, why do you reason these things in your hearts?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le ngangee rèngu. hèia na peka, heh! miu baku pangee sèmi èèna.

source_text: which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘your sins are forgiven; ' or to say, ‘arise, and take up your bed, and walk'? but that you may know that the son of man has authority on earth to forgive sins-he said to the paralytic-
target_text: mia dhu be'a risi? ladhe ja'a peka mi dhèu karuku ne, ‘sasala èu saku eele le, ' miu me'a boe, na, j'aj'i do aad'o. te ngaa ladhe ja'a peka, ‘kèd'i ka! nedhe dhèpi èu, ho lèpa ka. ' ladhe na kèd'i ho miu ladhe mèdhi kahèi, heka miu me'a kèna, ja'a ne dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. aa ja'a dènge koasa kahèi, ho saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu! èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii dènge dhèu karuku èèna, peka na,

source_text: i tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.
target_text: èu nanene, ee! èu èle le ne! kèd'i ka, nedhe dhèpi èu ho lamu ka.

source_text: he arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified god, saying, we never saw anything like this!
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare, cag'ag'a laa dhèu ne kèd'i titu. na nedhe dhèpi na, hèia la'e ka asa li'u. dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra rèdhi dènge musi madha ra. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra malaa-maloha, ka ra peka, ira ii! èdhi heka tèdhi ka! ama lamatua tare'a-re'a kapai d'ai seli!

source_text: he went out again by the seaside. all the multitude came to him, and he taught them.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus la'e hari asa sebhe dano galilea. ka dhèu ae titu kèna mai paraga dènge ne, hèia na lole dad'èi ama lamatua mi rèngu.

source_text: as he passed by, he saw levi the son of alphaeus sitting at the tax office. he said to him, follow me. and he arose and followed him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu èci ngara na lewi, ana nèti alpius. sasab'a na roro doi bea. lod'o yesus kako re èèna ka ladhe nèdhi lewi. ka na peka dènge ne, wee! mai madhutu ja'a! ropa tadèngi lii yesus ne, lewi kèd'i dènge ka la'e madhutu ne.

source_text: he was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si ra'a ètu d'ara èmu lewi, pa'èci dènge angalai lewi dhèu roro doi bea sèra. abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu leo madhèdi ra'a dènge rèngu. madhutu ngangee dhèu yahudi, dhèu se'e dhèu karehe. nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu madhèdi ra'a se abhu dhèu ae kahèi dhu d'èi nanene lii padhai lii yesus.

source_text: the scribes and the pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu pèri-pèri mese agama nèti partei parisi dhu rèdhi yesus madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge tuka roro doi bea, dènge dhèu karehe sèra. ka ra karèi ana madhutu yesus, peka na, nga tao ka mese miu madhèdi na'a-ninu dènge dhèu roro doi bea dènge dhèu dhu laku-laku boe sèra?

source_text: when jesus heard it, he said to them, those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. i came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.
target_text: yesus tadèngi lii karèi rèngu èèna, ka na dhaa, peka na, dhèu pèd'a mema parluu dote, te ngaa dhèu dhu pèd'a boe, parluu boe dote. mamai ja'a ne sèna ka lalau dhèu dhu laku-laku boe. te ja'a mai boe ho uri dhèu dhu rasa ngi'u na mola.

source_text: john's disciples and the pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, why do john's disciples and the disciples of the pharisees fast, but your disciples don't fast?
target_text: ca tèka, dhèu nèti partei agama parisi puasa. rèngu rèdhi ana madhutu yohanis tuka sarani, puasa kahèi. te ngaa rèdhi boe ana madhutu yesus puasa sèmi rèngu. hèia dhèu rèngu mai paraga dènge yesus, ka ra karèi, aku rèngu na, ama. ji'i puasa sama sèmi ana madhutu yohanis kahèi. te, nga tao ka, ana madhutu ama puasa boe?

source_text: jesus said to them, can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? as long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can't fast.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, mema miu me'a le, ladhe abhu pesta kab'i, dhèu dhu abhu nèru sèra puasa boe, ka ra'a toke bècu. ladhe mone dhu kab'i èèna era, dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra'a-rinu.

source_text: but the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.
target_text: te ladhe d'ai lod'o ho ra kèpe rèti dhèu mone dhu kab'i èèna, ka mone aanga-angalai na sèra d'ara susa, heka ra puasa kèna.

source_text: no one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, bèla hiu baku kalape mi kodho dhui. te ladhe base, na, bèla hiu èèna karuku, hèia kodho èèna asa ka mae aae.

source_text: no one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, miu baku edhe dhua pèd'u ètu d'ara sabha dhui. te aad'o na, sabha èèna mae, aa dhua pèd'u na bhori eele asa rai. nèti èèna ka yesus peka dènge si, baku pakihu-kee lii holo-nori nèngu dhu hiu, dènge lii holo-nori dhèu parisi dhu dhui.

source_text: he was going on the sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.
target_text: ca tèka, lèke lod'o manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, yesus si kako re j'ara ètu d'ara oka. ka ana madhutu na g'ètu rèti are gandum.

source_text: the pharisees said to him, behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the sabbath day?
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi ladhe rèdhi, ka ra karèi yesus, tasamia ka, ana madhutu èu madhutu boe j'ara-j'ara agama èdhi? rèngu se g'ètu are gandum lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a. miu baku tao sèmi èèna!

source_text: he said to them, did you never read what david did when he had need and was hungry-he, and those who were with him? how he entered into god's house at the time of abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, samia, ee? miu sanèd'e heka lii lolo daud. tèu èèna, abyatar j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. lod'o èèna, daud dènge dhèu madhutu na aa'i-aa'i ra manganga bia. ka ra maso asa d'ara paleo ama lamatua, hèia ra'a roti dhu ama agama hia le mi lamatua. madhutu atora agama èdhi, dhèu dhu bisa ra'a roti èèna, dhoka ama-ama agama di; dhèu leo bisa boe. daud dènge ana madhutu na sèra, ra'e rare roti èèna, te ngaa dhèu èci sa peka boe, na, daud si sala.

source_text: he said to them, the sabbath was made for man, not man for the sabbath.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lole hari dènge rèngu, miu baku bhèlu! lamatua hia lod'o a'oro sasab'a hia èdhi dhèu rai-haha. lamatua paj'aj'i boe èdhi dhèu rai-haha, ho madhutu dhoka atora lod'o a'oro sasab'a di.

source_text: therefore the son of man is lord even of the sabbath.
target_text: ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. ja'a ne ka dhu peka ho dhèu sab'a, do aad'o, lèke dènge lod'o a'oro sasab'a.

source_text: he entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus lèpa hari la'e asa èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. d'ai nèi, ka yesus paraga dènge dhèu èci dhu ai na roe cabèka.

source_text: they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day, that they might accuse him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu patangi-tenge sasala yesus. ra ma'u yesus, neo re'a na puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a, do aad'o.

source_text: he said to the man whose hand was withered, stand up.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa dhèu dhu ai roe cabèka èèna, aku nèngu na, mai ku! titu ku mi madha ja'a ne.

source_text: he said to them, is it lawful on the sabbath day to do good or to do harm? to save a life or to kill? but they were silent.
target_text: ka na karèi dhèu ae ètu sèra sa, aku nèngu na, madhutu atora agama èdhi, èdhi bisa tao ngaa lod'o a'oro sasab'a? tao madha j'ara dhu be'a, do karehe? tao pabe'a dhèu, do pamadhe dhèu? te ngaa dhèu sèra èci sa bani boe bhoke hèb'a.

source_text: when he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, stretch out your hand. he stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus d'ara pèd'a, lula rèngu madhutu dhoka ad'a di, tao boe madha-dhilu mi dhèu ai roe cabèka ne. yesus nasa, ka na ladhe lème dhèu sèra. hèia na peka mi dhèu ai roe cabèka, aku nèngu na, j'ole kacui-aai èu mai sa ne'e! ka dhèu èèna soro kacui-aai asa yesus la'e. kabèdhi laa, èle dènge papèd'a na.

source_text: the pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the herodians against him, how they might destroy him.
target_text: ropa dhèu parisi ladhe rèdhi yesus pa'èle kacui-aai dhèu èèna lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a, aa'i-aa'i ra kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. ka lasi padhue dènge dhèu partei politik herodes, ho tenge j'ara neo pamadhe yesus.

source_text: jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from galilee, from judea, from jerusalem, from idumaea, beyond the jordan, and those from around tyre and sidon. a great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus dènge ana madhutu na lasi asa sebhe dano galilea. te ngaa, lula dhèu ae sèra re'a le ngaa dhu nèngu tao, ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i mai nèti rae-rae ho madhutu ne. rèngu mai nèti propensi galilea, propensi yudea, aa propensi idumea. abhu kahèi dhu mai nèti kota yerusalem, kota sidon dènge kota tirus. abhu kahèi cahag'e dhu mai nèti cabèka dhimu loko yarden. aa'i-aa'i sèra neo mai paraga dènge ne.

source_text: he spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn't press on him.
target_text: taga dhèu dhu mai sèra ae seli, ka yesus pua ana madhutu na lasi tenge koha cue hia nèngu. na neo padhai lii dènge dhèu ae sèra nèti dedha koha, sèna ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa ladhe rèdhi rèhu na, aa tadèngi lii padhai lii na hèi.

source_text: for he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.
target_text: ca hari ni, na puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a ae titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae mai paseti èci dènge èci, neo g'ag'e yesus.

source_text: the unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, you are the son of god!
target_text: ropa dhèu dhu nidhu tao sa ladhe rèdhi yesus, ka ra bèbha d'ai rai ètu madha yesus. hèia ra taraa, aku rèngu na, èu ne mema tare'a ana ama lamatua!

source_text: he sternly warned them that they should not make him known.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kai rèngu, aku nèngu na, miu baku ale dènge dhèu èci sa hèi, ja'a ne cee!

source_text: he went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako la'e asa kolo ledhe èci. na paroa pèri-pèri dhèu dhu nèngu d'èi. ka dhèu se mai madhutu ne.

source_text: he appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach
target_text: èle èèna ka, na hag'e nare dhèu canguru dua. ka na peka, ja'a pili miu ho madhutu taruu ja'a, j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a. ja'a neo pua miu, lami lole lii lolo be'a ama lamatua mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi ja'a neo hia miu koasa, sèna ka miu bisa babège-lalèta nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: simon to whom he gave the name peter; james the son of zebedee; and john, the brother of james, whom he called boanerges, which means, sons of thunder; andrew; philip; bartholomew; matthew; thomas; james, the son of alphaeus; thaddaeus; simon the zealot; and judas iscariot, who also betrayed him. then he came into a house.
target_text: ngara dhèu canguru dua sa, nuka: simon dhu yesus pangare na, petrus, yakobis, yohanis, yakobis dènge ari na, yohanis ne, dua ra ana sabadeus. yesus pangare rèngu dua ra, ngara na ‘boanerges', dhu sasoa na ‘sama sèmi d'oro'. anderias, pelipus, bertolomeos, mateos, tomas, yakobis ana alpius, tadius, simon dhu madhutu partei politik selot, dènge yudas iskariot dhu èèna na pahie eele yesus.

source_text: the multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra puru hari nèti kolo ledhe deo na. ka lasi asa d'ara èmu èci. dhèu ae titu kèna mai oke rare ne, ka na bisa boe na'a-ninu.

source_text: when his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, he is insane.
target_text: rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia ra papeka, aku rèngu na, miu ladhe ku yesus! ne'a heka lalau iisi na. ropa a'ari na tadèngi lii palolo dhèu, ka ra mai neo rare ne.

source_text: the scribes who came down from jerusalem said, he has beelzebul, and, by the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.
target_text: lod'o èèna, mese-mese agama nèti yerusalem mai peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku rèngu na, heh! pasa dhilu miu! baku madhutu yesus. te dhèu aae nidhu, dhu ra paroa ngara na baalsebul, maso asa d'ara yesus, ka hia ne koasa, ho bata-magèla nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: he summoned them and said to them in parables, how can satan cast out satan?
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi nare lii padhue rèngu èèna, heia na paroa nare rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ka na peka, lèke boe dènge ngangee dhèu! tasamia ka dhèu aae nidhu bisa babège ngi'u mesa na! ?

source_text: if a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
target_text: ladhe ètu d'ara paredha dhèu aae èci, ana kabarai sèra èci patao-palaha dènge èci, paredha dhèu aae èèna taha nèbhu boe.

source_text: if a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi ètu d'ara èmu, ladhe isi èmu èci patao dènge èci, isi èmu èèna mae-manyèla!

source_text: if satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can't stand, but has an end.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge nidhu. ladhe èci pamusu dènge èci, rèngu mae-manyèla kahèi. sèmi èèna na, heka rèngu laho kao-kao.

source_text: but no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.
target_text: ladhe dhèu parapo neo mai parapo èmu dhèu èra èci, na hud'i èki-karadhe uuru ku lamatua èmu na, heka bau nèti mèdha-panyau kèna.

source_text: most certainly i tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka mema dènge miu: ama lamatua sadia saku eele sasala dhèu. ladhe dhèu padhai lii karehe mi dedha dhèu leo, ama lamatua bisa saku eele sasala na era.

source_text: but whoever may blaspheme against the holy spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.
target_text: te ngaa lii padhai lii karehe mi dedha roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, ama lamatua saku eele boe sasala nèngu, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e!

source_text: -because they said, he has an unclean spirit.
target_text: yesus peka sèmi èèna, lula dhèu sèra peka na, dhèu èèna, nidhu tao.

source_text: his mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ina dènge ari yesus sèra mai tenge ne. d'ai èmu dhu yesus madhèdi ètu d'ara na, rèngu lasi boe asa d'ara, te ngaa ra titu ètu li'u, ka ra hia dhèu lasi paroa yesus.

source_text: a multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.
target_text: lasi, na, yesus madhèdi padhai lii dènge dhèu ae. ka dhèu sèra peka dènge ne, ama, ee! ina mu dènge a'ari mu nuka ètu li'u si. ra neo paraga dènge ama.

source_text: he answered them, who are my mother and my brothers?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, peka na, cee ka dhu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ina dènge a'ari ja'a?

source_text: looking around at those who sat around him, he said, behold, my mother and my brothers!
target_text: hèia na ladhe palème asa dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu sèra, ka na peka, miu se'e se ka dhu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ina dènge a'ari ja'a.

source_text: for whoever does the will of god is my brother, my sister, and mother.
target_text: te cee ka dhu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, rèngu sèra ka dhu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ina dènge a'ari ja'a.

source_text: again he began to teach by the seaside. a great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. all the multitude were on the land by the sea.
target_text: ca lod'o, yesus la'e hari asa dano galilea. d'ai nèi dhèu ae mai oke rare ne. ka yesus ca'e la'e madhèdi asa dedha koha cue dhu panahu. na aj'a dhèu sèra dènge lii pakasame. dhèu dhu titu ètu dedha salae sèra aa'i-aa'i nanene yesus aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: he taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,
target_text: na aj'a si lii holo-nori rupa-rupa pake lii pakasame. aku nèngu sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: listen! behold, the farmer went out to sow.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! dhèu èci la'e ceb'e hini ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: as he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.
target_text: ropa na ceb'e hini sèra, cahag'e lèke ètu sebhe j'ara. kabèdhi laa, manu-bhui mai ka ra'a aa'i.

source_text: others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.
target_text: cahag'e hari lèke ètu era rai dhu pènu dènge hadhu. hini sèra muri, te ngaa rai isi dhoka ciki oo'e di.

source_text: when the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.
target_text: ropa lod'o rea mai, ana nganga'a sèra kamale eele hèia madhe aa'i si, lula amo d'ai boe d'ara rai.

source_text: others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.
target_text: hini cahag'e lèke ètu dedha rai dhu pènu dènge j'u'u padhudhu. ropa j'u'u sèra muri, hèlu rare ana nganga'a sèra, ka j'aj'i boe hua-hela.

source_text: others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.
target_text: te ngaa hini cahag'e lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi. hini sèra muri dènge sega. hua ae titu kèna. cahag'e dhu abhu d'ai tèlu nguru hari, cahag'e èna nguru hari, aa cahag'e d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: he said, whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.
target_text: de ladhe cee dènge ro'a dhilu, na, nanene paie!

source_text: when he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.
target_text: ca tèka, yesus mesa na. hèia ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua dènge pèri-pèri dhèu dhu tadèngi le lii holo-nori na, mai paraga dènge ne. ka ra karèi sasoa nèti lii pakasame èèna.

source_text: he said to them, to you is given the mystery of god's kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, lula miu tare'a-re'a neo me'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua, ja'a neo peka dènge miu. te ngaa mi dhèu leo, ja'a pake lii pakasame.

source_text: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them. '
target_text: tatao dhèu leo sèra sama sèmi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke, peka na, ‘rèngu rèdhi le, te ngaa ro'o boe re'a. rèngu tadèngi le, te ngaa ro'o boe tèke ètu d'ara. ladhe sèmi èèna, hud'i rèngu sène. ra parcaya ia ka lamatua, sèna ka lamatua saku eele ia ka sasala ra. '

source_text: he said to them, don't you understand this parable? how will you understand all of the parables?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge dhèu sèra sasoa lii pakasame hini èèna, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu me'a boe sasoa nèti lii upama deo na, carui risi hari miu me'a sasoa lii pakasame dhu leo.

source_text: the farmer sows the word.
target_text: de sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu dhu ceb'e hini èèna, nuka dhèu dhu lole lii holo-nori ama lamatua.

source_text: the ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.
target_text: hini dhu lèke ètu sebhe j'ara ka manu-bhui mai ra'a aa'i, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua. te ngaa nèbhu boe, dhèu aae nidhu mai parame rare lii holo-nori nèti d'ara dhèu èèna.

source_text: these in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.
target_text: aa hini dhu lèke ètu dedha hadhu, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu nanene, ka na sèmi nare lii holo-nori èèna dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: they have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. when oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.
target_text: te ngaa lii holo-nori ne, taha nèbhu boe ètu d'ara dhèu èèna. ropa nèngu paraga j'aj'èra lula na sèmi nare lii ne'e, na tèke eele.

source_text: others are those who are sown among the thorns. these are those who have heard the word,
target_text: aa hini dhu lèke ètu talora j'u'u dhu padudhu, èci èèna ka dènge lii holo-nori ama lamatua dhu dhèu nanene.

source_text: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èèna bhute dhoka dènge rupa-rupa madha j'ara rai-haha dhu pakarej'e ngi'u na. nèti èèna ka, j'ara se'e seti eele lii holo-nori ama lamatua nèti d'ara nèngu, ka j'aj'i heka ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.
target_text: te ngaa hini dhu lèke ètu dedha rai hèu mèngi, nuka sèmi dhèu dhu pasa dhilu ho nanene lii holo-nori ama lamatua dènge karej'e-karae. tatao nèngu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme. dhèu ne'e tao j'ara-j'ara dhu pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, sama sèmi hini dhu nèti hua-hela. abhu kahèi d'ai tèlu nguru hari, cahag'e d'ai èna nguru hari, aa abhu kahèi dhu d'ai cangasu hari.

source_text: he said to them, is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? isn't it put on a stand?
target_text: nèti dedha koha, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na. na peka hari lii upama èci, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ee! miu mèdhi le, do dhae? dhèu suru rare labhu, ka saguru eele hari dènge soe! ka ra tèke asa ro'a koi la'e! aad'o, sina ma? te ladhe sèmi èèna, tèdhi boe saraa nèngu. dhèu hud'i tao labhu ètu era dhu dedha, sèna ka dhèu rèdhi saraa nèngu.

source_text: for there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.
target_text: ngaa dhu dhèu pahuni deo ne'e, bèli-camèd'a dhèu rèdhi aa'i. te ngaa dhu dhèu re'a boe lod'o deo ne'e, bèli-camèd'a dhèu re'a aa'i.

source_text: if any man has ears to hear, let him hear.
target_text: de ladhe cee dhu dènge ro'a dhilu, na, nanene paie!

source_text: he said to them, take heed what you hear. with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.
target_text: nanene paie-iie! ladhe miu tenge sasala dhèu, na, dhèu leo tenge sasala miu kahèi. sèmi èèna kahèi, ama lamatua tenge sasala miu. te ngaa na tao bia risi hari nèti èèna.

source_text: for whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn't have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci neo tenge tare'a-re'a dad'èi lamatua, nèngu asa d'èlu-mèu. te ngaa ladhe dhèu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi lamatua, nèngu j'aj'i asa goa.

source_text: he said, god's kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, paredha ama lamatua asa tabha kapai, sama sèmi hini dhu dhèu ceb'e ètu d'ara oka na.

source_text: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn't know how.
target_text: nèngu ceb'e nare, ka la'e bhèj'i. tao heka ai hèb'a mi hini sèra. te ngaa hini sèra muri, ka asa kapai.

source_text: for the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.
target_text: hini se muri unu ra. mulai ti rèu, hela, toke d'ai huri.

source_text: but when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.
target_text: ropa kasere nare nganga'a dhu ètu d'ara oka mami, dhèu unu oka heka la'e puu-g'ètu kèna. sèmi èèna kahèi, paredha ama lamatua. lamatua ka dhu ad'u-ue aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: he said, how will we liken god's kingdom? or with what parable will we illustrate it?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus padhai lii hari, ja'a peka hari lii upama èci sèmi ne'e ka: miu ladhe sèku, dhèu dhu j'aj'i unu lamatua sèra. uru èèna ciki di, nèbhu-nèbhu j'aj'i ae.

source_text: it's like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,
target_text: èèna sama sèmi lamusi aj'u dhu ana iiki-iiki.

source_text: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.
target_text: ladhe èdhi sèla lamusi èèna, na muri mai, j'aj'i aj'u dhu kapai aae. manu-bhui nèti mia-mia mai tèka tenge mamaho, dènge tao rèd'a ètu kolo aj'u èèna.

source_text: with many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
target_text: j'ara-j'ara a'aj'a yesus madhutu rare'a dhèu.

source_text: without a parable he didn't speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.
target_text: ladhe na aj'a dhèu leo, na pake lii pakasame. te ngaa ladhe na aj'a ana madhutu na, nèngu peka aa'i-aa'i sasoa lii pakasame sèra.

source_text: on that day, when evening had come, he said to them, let's go over to the other side.
target_text: d'ai lod'o nihia na, yesus aj'a dhèu nèti dedha koha era. hèia na pua ana madhutu na sèra, peka na, mai èdhi pakèd'i lati asa cabèka dano.

source_text: leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. other small boats were also with him.
target_text: ka ra ca'e koha èci dènge yesus. ra pakèd'i tèke eele dhèu ae sèra ètu èèna. te ngaa dhèu cahag'e ca'e koha leo madhutu yesus si.

source_text: a big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled. he himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, teacher, don't you care that we are dying?
target_text: lod'o èèna, yesus pasaluu kètu na mi nanèlu, ka bhèj'i luu ètu hui koha. nèbhu boe ka, ngèlu aae mai. naha kapai, ka èi tao sabhori oe pènu koha yesus si. nèti èèna ka, ana madhutu yesus sèra madha'u bia. hèia ra parèi ne, ama! kèd'i ku laa! èdhi oe molo kèna! te ngaa ama pusi-pahae boe!

source_text: he awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, peace! be still! the wind ceased and there was a great calm.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii parèi ra, ka na kèd'i, hèia na kai ngèlu, peka na, mau ka! ka na paredha naha, aku nèngu na, mera ka! hèia ngèlu mau, aa naha mera dènge ka.

source_text: he said to them, why are you so afraid? how is it that you have no faith?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus jèke ana madhutu na, peka na, nga tao ka miu madha'u sèmi èèna? miu parcaya ja'a, do aad'o?

source_text: they were greatly afraid and said to one another, who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u dènge malaa, ka èci peka dènge èci, te dhèu ngaa ne? ka bisa ngèlu dènge naha, madhutu lii paredha nèngu?

source_text: they came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the gadarenes.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra d'ai cabèka dano galilea. era èèna, ngara na garasa.

source_text: when he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs. he lived in the tombs. nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains, because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. nobody had the strength to tame him. always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones. when he saw jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu mone èci dhu nidhu tao, ka na huj'u. dhèu huj'u ne pea ètu era padhane dhèu madhe. mèu-mèda na kako ca'e-puru ledhe ètu èèna, dènge pake boe mèdha-papake. na pa'oo-parodha ma'ète boe, aa na nare hadhu ho tuku iisi na toke d'ai nu'a. na èra titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu èci sa bisa boe èki ne. masi ka ra èki dènge rate bèsi èèna ka, bisa boe kahèi. pèri-pèri hari, dhèu uj'u haga-ai na kahèi, pake rate dènge kanau bèsi, te ngaa na pama'ète aa'i si. dhèu ne èra bia, nèti èèna ka, èci sa taha boe ne. ropa yesus dènge ana madhutu na puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu huj'u èèna ladhe nèdhi rèngu nèti kaj'èu. hèia na kalua nèti era padhane dhèu madhe, ka na mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus.

source_text: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, what have i to do with you, jesus, you son of the most high god? i adjure you by god, don't torment me. for he said to him, come out of the man, you unclean spirit!
target_text: ropa ladhe nèdhi rèhu dhèu ne'e, hèia yesus peka, na, hee, nidhu bhelu! kalua pakaj'èu nèti dhèu ne'e. èle èèna ka, dhèu èèna pajèka, aku nèngu na, weh! èu neo tao ngaa mi ja'a? ja'a ke'a èu ne yesus, ana nèti ama lamatua dhu koasa risi eele. ja'a manèngi èu baku paj'èra ja'a!

source_text: he asked him, what is your name? he said to him, my name is legion, for we are many.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi ne, ngara èu cee? na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ngara ja'a legion, lula ji'i ae titu kèna, sama sèmi ca kaboko sordad'u!

source_text: he begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.
target_text: èle èèna ka, nidhu sèra peka re dhèu huj'u èèna, ho manèngi yesus, sèna ka baku pua rèngu kalua nèti d'ara rae ne.

source_text: now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.
target_text: kaj'èu boe nèti èèna, abhu hahi ca oka dhu dhèu madhenge. ele boe hahi sèra dua riho ngi'u. dhu tenge nganga'a ètu sebhe ledhe.

source_text: all the demons begged him, saying, send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.
target_text: ka nidhu sèra manèngi yesus, aku rèngu na, hia ji'i maso asa d'ara hahi sèra.

source_text: at once jesus gave them permission. the unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. the herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, hèia yesus d'èi kahèi. ka nidhu sèra kalua nèti d'ara dhèu èèna, ka lasi asa d'ara hahi sèra. hèia hahi sèra rai paj'ala, ka lasi asa sebhe tèbhi, ka ra manahu asa d'ara dano, hèia madhe aa'i si.

source_text: those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. the people came to see what it was that had happened.
target_text: ropa dhèu j'aga hahi sèra ladhe rèdhi madha j'ara dhu j'aj'i èèna, ra madha'u titu kèna. ka rai lasi peka palème dènge dhèu ètu d'ara rae-rae dhu dètu ètu era èèna. nèbhu boe dhèu canau-kateme mai neo re'a.

source_text: they came to jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.
target_text: dhèu sèra mai paraga dènge yesus, ka ra ladhe la'a, na, dhèu dhu nidhu tao èèna, madhèdi ètu èèna kahèi. dhèu èèna pake le mèdha-papake. kahadhu na mase'a le. rèdhi sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu sèra madha'u. lula rèngu re'a le, ladhe dhèu cee dhu bisa babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu huj'u èèna, nèngu tare'a-re'a dhèu èra risi.

source_text: those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra lasi peka palème ètu mia-mia, aku rèngu na, ji'i ngèdhi le dènge madha, dhèu huj'u ne èle le. sèmi èèna kahèi hahi dhu madhe ètu d'ara dano.

source_text: they began to beg him to depart from their region.
target_text: ka dhèu kabarai èèna mai manèngi ho yesus tèke eele ka rai rèngu.

source_text: as he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.
target_text: ropa yesus neo ca'e hari asa dedha koha, ka dhèu dhu èle nèti huj'u dhu nidhu tao èèna manèngi yesus, sèna ka nèngu madhutu ne kahèi.

source_text: he didn't allow him, but said to him, go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kai. ka na peka dènge dhèu èèna, aku nèngu na, be'a risi èu lèpa ka asa èmu, ho peka dènge a'ari èu, ngaa dhu ama lamatua tao le mi dedha èu. peka dènge si, mema ama lamatua sue èu titu kèna.

source_text: he went his way, and began to proclaim in decapolis how jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia dhèu èèna pakèd'i la'e palème rae-rae nèti canguru kota, dhu ngara na ‘dekapolis'. na lole ngaa dhu yesus tao le mi dedha nèngu. dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi lii lolo na, malaa aa'i mèu-mèu, aku rèngu na, mema lèke tare'a!

source_text: when jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.
target_text: èle ka, yesus si pakèd'i hari dènge koha asa cabèka dano. ropa ra puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae mai lingu rare yesus.

source_text: behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet
target_text: dhèu èci mai, ngara na yairus. nèngu ne, kètu èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi ètu kota èèna. ropa nèngu nèdhi yesus, ka mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus.

source_text: and begged him much, saying, my little daughter is at the point of death. please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.
target_text: ka na pamako, peka na, ama, ee! ana bhèni ja'a, heka canguru dua tèu, pèd'a oe madhe. mai lati ku asa èmu ja'a, sèna ka puri-pa'èle ne nèti papèd'a na.

source_text: he went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e dènge ka, madhutu yairus asa èmu na. te ngaa ètu d'ara kakako rèngu, dhèu ae titu kèna, ka ra seti ne nèti haa, nèti dhimu.

source_text: a certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,
target_text: ètu talora dhèu ae sèra, abhu dhèu bhèni èci dhu pèd'a dhèu bhèni. papèd'a ne loe boe canguru dua tèu kèna.

source_text: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,
target_text: mèdha-panyau dènge doi-dhari dhèu bhèni ne'e, èle aa'i mèu-mèu ho b'ae dote. te ngaa papèd'a na èle boe, asa na hoe.

source_text: having heard the things concerning jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes. for she said, if i just touch his clothes, i will be made well. immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.
target_text: bhèni ne tadèngi ae le dhèu palolo ngaa dhu yesus tao. nèti èèna ka, na mai pasuki asa talora dhèu ae sèra, ho na padètu dènge yesus. na pangee, na, sad'i ja'a gai lèke sebhe kodho na di, tatu papèd'a ja'a èle. ropa na gai lèke sebhe kodho yesus, kabèdhi laa raa bhèni ne tèja eele dènge. hèia na rasa, na be'a le.

source_text: immediately jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, who touched my clothes?
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, yesus rasa a'èra kalua nèti d'ara ngi'u na. ka na kabib'a asa kabodho, ho ladhe asa dhèu ae sèra, ka na karèi, peka na, nèti miu se, cee ka dhu gai lèke kodho ja'a?

source_text: his disciples said to him, you see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘who touched me? '
target_text: ka ana madhutu na dhaa, aku rèngu na, ama, ladhe ku laa. dhèu ae paseti sèmi ne'e. nga tao ka ama karèi, peka na, ‘cee ka dhu gai kodho ja'a? '

source_text: he looked around to see her who had done this thing.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ladhe pala-lème, neo ne'a cee ka dhu gai lèke sebhe kodho na.

source_text: but the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.
target_text: ropa yesus karèi sèmi èèna, hèia bhèni èèna madha'u bia. èle èèna ka, na mai patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus, ka na mangaku, ama! ja'a ka dhu gai lèke sebhe kodho ama ku deo na.

source_text: he said to her, daughter, your faith has made you well. go in peace, and be cured of your disease.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mi bhèni ne, aku nèngu na, lula èu parcaya ja'a dènge d'ara kateme, nèti èèna ka, èu èle le. lamu ka èmu, dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: while he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler's house, saying, your daughter is dead. why bother the teacher any more?
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii era, hèia dhèu èci mai nèti èmu yairus, aku nèngu na, ira ii! ana mu madhe le. de baku paj'èra ia ka ama mese. nèngu la'e ia ka sa nèi.

source_text: but jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, don't be afraid, only believe.
target_text: te ngaa yesus pusi boe dènge lii padhai lii dhèu ne'e. ka na peka dènge yairus, èu baku madha'u, ee! parcaya mi ama lamatua di.

source_text: he allowed no one to follow him except peter, james, and john the brother of james.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e dènge ka, tèke eele ana madhutu na cahag'e. nèti dhoka petrus, yakobis dènge yohanis.

source_text: he came to the synagogue ruler's house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.
target_text: ropa d'ai èmu yairus, rèngu rèdhi dhèu jau oob'a-jau oob'a, aa tadèngi cahag'e tangi d'ara pèd'a.

source_text: when he had entered in, he said to them, why do you make an uproar and weep? the child is not dead, but is asleep.
target_text: yesus maso asa d'ara, ka na karèi si, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu maruru dènge tangi sèmi ne'e? ana ne'e madhe boe! nèngu dhoka bhèj'i di.

source_text: they ridiculed him. but he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.
target_text: dhèu ètu sèra tadèngi yesus peka sèmi èèna, ka ra mari pakapengo hèb'a dènge ne. hèia na pua dhèu sèra kalua aa'i nèti d'ara kama ana dhu madhe èèna. ka na paroa ina-ama ana bhèni ne, dènge ana madhutu na dhèu tèlu sèra, maso asa d'ara.

source_text: taking the child by the hand, he said to her, talitha cumi! which means, being interpreted, girl, i tell you, get up!
target_text: hèia yesus kèpe kacui-aai ana dhu madhe ne, ka na padhai lii pake lii rèngu, lii aram, aku nèngu na, talita kum! sasoa na, ana bhèni! kèd'i ka!

source_text: immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. they were amazed with great amazement. he strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.
target_text: kabèdhi laa, ana dhu madhe èèna mamuri hari. hèia na kèd'i titu, ka na kako. hèia yesus peka dènge ina na, aku nèngu na, hia ana ne'e na'a-ninu! dhèu ae ètu sèra dhu rèdhi j'ara dhu j'aj'i ne, ra malaa titu kèna. hèia yesus kai si, peka na, mage mi peka dènge dhèu èci sa, ja'a ka dhu pamamuri hari ana ne.

source_text: he went out from there. he came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, lèpa hari asa rae na, nasaret.

source_text: when the sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, where did this man get these things? and, what is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a dhèu yahudi. hèia yesus la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ho na aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua ètu èèna. lod'o èèna, dhèu ae lasi manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa ra tadèngi yesus aj'a lii holo-nori ama lamatua, hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra malaa, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne mèu samia ne! na dènge koasa kahèi! tasamia ka na sèmi èèna, ee?

source_text: isn't this the carpenter, the son of mary and brother of james, joses, judah, and simon? aren't his sisters here with us? so they were offended at him.
target_text: nèngu ne'e dhoka tuka aj'u di. èdhi tadhe ina na, maria. sèmi èèna kahèi ari na, yakobis, yoses, yudas dènge simon, dènge ari na dhèu bhèni sèra. rèngu dènge èdhi pea ca rae. dhèu se'e ngee ètu d'ara rèngu na, rèngu mèu risi nèti yesus. nèti èèna ka, ra d'èi heka nanene ne.

source_text: jesus said to them, a prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.
target_text: ka yesus peka, mema tare'a! dhèu pakab'ua risi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua nèti rae leo. te ngaa ra pakab'ua boe dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu nèti rae nèngu.

source_text: he could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.
target_text: d'ara dhèu sèra adhu sèmi hadhu, ka ra parcaya boe lii padhai lii yesus. nèti èèna ka, na malaa, hèia na pake boe koasa na. ka na puri-pa'èle dhoka dhèu pèri di, ètu èèna.

source_text: he marveled because of their unbelief. he went around the villages teaching.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus kako palème asa rae-rae dhu padètu ètu sèra, ho aj'a dhèu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua.

source_text: he called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.
target_text: na paroa nare ana madhutu na dhèu canguru dua sèra, ka na pua rèngu lasi dua-dua ho lole lii lolo be'a nèti ama lamatua. na hia si koasa kahèi, ho babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu.

source_text: he commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse, but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.
target_text: na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu baku mèti mèdha ae ètu d'ara kakako miu. baku mèti nganga'a, doi, dènge tas. mèti dhoka tatea, salapa ètu haga, dènge kodho ètu ua di.

source_text: he said to them, wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.
target_text: ladhe cee dhu sèmi rare miu ètu èmu ra, miu pea dhoka ètu èèna di, toke d'ai pakèd'i hari.

source_text: whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. assuredly, i tell you, it will be more tolerable for sodom and gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu lami asa era èci, hèia dhèu ètu sèra sèmi rare boe miu, aa ra d'èi boe nanene lii padhai lii miu, tèke eele era èèna. aa peka mi dhèu sèra, na, ‘miu mo'o boe nanene, si! de bèli-camèd'a sèmi mere pala mi! '

source_text: they went out and preached that people should repent.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lasi lole lii lolo be'a. ra peka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i hud'i ele ho'a nèti sasala-sasigo ra, ka lèpa ho mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: they cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.
target_text: ka ra babège eele nidhu nèti d'ara dhèu. ra pasuti èi lèngi mi kètu dhèu pèd'a, aa sabaj'a ho pa'èle si nèti papèd'a. ka ra èle dènge.

source_text: king herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, john the baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ètu mia-mia tadhe aa'i le yesus. dhèu aae herodes tadèngi le lii lolo lula-nèti koasa yesus kahèi. dhèu palolo ètu mia-mia, aku rèngu na, yohanis tuka sarani èèna, mamuri hari le ètu d'ara ngi'u yesus! nèti èèna ka, na bisa tao tadha malaa sèra.

source_text: but others said, he is elijah. others said, he is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu cahag'e hari peka, aku rèngu na, aad'o! ne'e ne, elia dhu mamuri hari d'ara ngi'u yesus. aa dhèu cahag'e hari, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo hari nèti uru sèra.

source_text: but herod, when he heard this, said, this is john, whom i beheaded. he has risen from the dead.
target_text: ropa dhèu aae herodes tadèngi nare lii lolo dhèu se'e lula-nèti yesus, ka na dhaa, peka na, èèna yohanis tuka sarani, dhu ca hari ni ja'a hia dhèu pare pamadhe le, te ngaa na mamuri hari!

source_text: for herod himself had sent out and arrested john and bound him in prison for the sake of herodias, his brother philip's wife, for he had married her. for john had said to herod, it is not lawful for you to have your brother's wife.
target_text: dhèu aae herodes pua sèmi èèna, lula nèngu lii langu dènge yohanis. lii lolo na sèmi ne'e ka: dhèu aae herodes leo nare dhèu èmu ari na, pelipus, ngara na herodias. aa te ngaa pelipus dènge herodias dhae pa'ia mèka. nèti èèna ka, yohanis kai pahari-pahari, peka na, ama dhèu aae baku leo dènge dhèu èmu ari mu. te èèna sisu ad'a èdhi dhèu yahudi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa herodes leo nare bhèni ne'e kahèi. hèia na pua dhèu lasi kèpe rare yohanis, ho pamaso ne asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn't,
target_text: lula yohanis kai pèri hari le, hèia bhèni ne tèka d'ara dènge ne, ka na neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa lake nare mèka, te herodes dhu pamaso le yohanis asa d'ara bèdho la'e.

source_text: for herod feared john, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. when he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.
target_text: ka na pua sordad'u sèra madhenge paie ne ètu d'ara bèdho. herodes madha'u dènge yohanis. na ne'a tare'a, yohanis ne dhèu dhu ama lamatua pua mai. aa yohanis ne dhèu d'ara mola. herodes d'èi nanene lii padhai lii yohanis kahèi. te ngaa stèka-stèka, d'ara na pèd'a nanene lii padhai lii yohanis.

source_text: then a convenient day came when herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of galilee.
target_text: ka ca tèka, herodias abhu lod'o dhu be'a, sèna ka na b'ala d'ara pèd'a na. lod'o èèna, lèke dènge hari jadi herodes. ka ra nèru dhèu aae-dhèu kapai mai ra'a-sisi hari jad'i. dhèu dhu mai sèra, ama-ama dhu paredha, ama-ama sordad'u, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a ètu galilea.

source_text: when the daughter of herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased herod and those sitting with him. the king said to the young lady, ask me whatever you want, and i will give it to you.
target_text: ètu d'ara talora tatao èèna, ana bhèni herodias la'e roge. na roge be'a risi eele, ka d'ara herodes dènge dhèu dhu nèru sèra karej'e bia. nèti èèna ka, herodes paroa ne mai asa madha, ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, èu neo manèngi ngaa? èu peka ho ja'a hia.

source_text: he swore to her, whatever you ask of me, i will give you, up to half of my kingdom.
target_text: èu manèngi era paredha ja'a ne bagi dua, hia èu cabèka èèna ka, ja'a ko'o kahèi. ja'a subha dènge ngara ama lamatua!

source_text: she went out and said to her mother, what shall i ask? she said, the head of john the baptizer.
target_text: ka ana bhèni èèna la'e karèi ina na, aku nèngu na, ina, ee! madhutu ngangee ina ku, na, ja'a manèngi ngaa dhu be'a risi nèti ama ku? ka ina na dhaa, aku nèngu na, lamu asa madha ama mu ho peka dènge ne, ja'a manèngi dhoka kètu yohanis di.

source_text: she came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, i want you to give me right now the head of john the baptizer on a platter.
target_text: ka ana bhèni ne la'e asa madha herodes, ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a manèngi kètu yohanis, tao ètu d'ara dula èci hia ja'a. deo ne'e ne, kahèi!

source_text: the king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn't wish to refuse her.
target_text: ropa herodes tadèngi nare lii manèngi ana bhèni na, ka d'ara na cag'ag'a. te ngaa nèngu bisa heka ère hari lii subha nèngu deo na, lula dhèu ètu sèra tadèngi aa'i le.

source_text: immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring john's head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,
target_text: èle èèna ka, herodes paredha komedhaa sordad'u lasi poro rare kètu yohanis nèti d'ara bèdho.

source_text: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.
target_text: ropa ra poro rare, ra tao asa d'ara dula èci, ka rèti la'a asa ana bhèni èèna. na sèmi nare, hèia nèti asa ina na la'e.

source_text: when his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.
target_text: ropa ana madhutu yohanis sèra tadèngi ra poro rèti le kètu yohanis, rèngu mai nedhe rèti ngi'u nèngu lasi padhane. d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii lolo mamadhe yohanis.

source_text: the apostles gathered themselves together to jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, ana madhutu yesus dhu na pua lasi asa rae-rae ho aj'a dhèu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua sèra, lèpa hari mai, ka ra pakaboko hari dènge ne. ra lolo dènge yesus ngaa dhu rèngu tao dènge aj'a mi dhèu.
