source_text: he said to them, come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile. for there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai patangi-tenge yesus. lula dhèu ae seli eele, ka yesus dènge ana madhutu na abhu boe tebho ra'a-rinu hèi. nèti èèna ka, yesus ale dènge ana madhutu sèra, peka na, be'a risi èdhi pakèd'i nèti era ne'e lati tenge era èci dhu mau, sèna ka èdhi ae tara ciki.

source_text: they went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.
target_text: ka ra ca'e koha cue lasi asa era dhu mau, kaj'èu nèti d'ara rae.

source_text: they saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. they arrived before them and came together to him.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae ètu sèra sa, ladhe rèdhi koha rèngu kako re sebhe dano. hèia ra kalua nèti rae ka kako pamèri madhutu re dedha rai. nèti èèna ka, rèngu d'ai uuru yesus si.

source_text: jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.
target_text: ropa yesus puru nèti dedha koha, ladhe laa, na, dhèu ae dhu mate ne. dhèu se'e re'a heka tao iisi ra tasamia. nèti èèna ka, d'ara yesus sue si, te rèngu sama sèmi kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dènge boe ana madhenga. èle èèna ka, na aj'a si j'ara mamuri ama lamatua.

source_text: when it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, this place is deserted, and it is late in the day. send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.
target_text: na aj'a nèti loo nètu, toke d'ai nihia la'e. hèia ana madhutu na sèra mai padhue dènge ne, aku rèngu na, ama! hua iia ama ku pua si lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rae dhu dètu ètu era se'e. te oe mèda kèna, aa ètu era ne'e nganga'a aad'o.

source_text: but he answered them, you give them something to eat. they asked him, shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?
target_text: te ngaa yesus b'ala lii rèngu, aku nèngu na, baku tao sèmi èèna! hud'i laa, pe miu panga'a si. hèia ra karèi hari ne, ira, ee! ladhe èdhi panga'a dhèu ae sèmi ne'e, èdhi kalua doi ae bia, nga. sama sèmi gaji tuka ca tèu kateme, nga! aa èdhi tare doi sèra, nèti mia hua kèna!

source_text: he said to them, how many loaves do you have? go see. when they knew, they said, five, and two fish.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, miu lami karèi sèku dhèu sèra, teko cee dhu nèti nganga'a mèra. hèia ra lasi karèi, ka mai peka dènge ne, abhu dhoka roti lèmi bua, dènge i'a dua ngi'u di.

source_text: he commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.
target_text: hèia yesus pua dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ho madhèdi cakaboko-cakaboko ètu dedha j'u'u.

source_text: they sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.
target_text: dhèu se'e madhèdi sèmi dhu yesus pua. abhu kaboko dhu dhèu cangasu-cangasu, aa abhu kaboko dhu dhèu lèmi nguru-lèmi nguru.

source_text: he took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti lèmi bua dènge i'a dua ngi'u sèra, ka na ladhe asa dedha. na manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. èle èèna ka, nare roti lèmi bua, ka na ku'u pamae ca'èta-'èta. hèia na hia mi ana madhutu na, ho lasi papala hia dhèu dhu madhèdi sèra. na pala-bagi i'a dua ngi'u sèra kahèi.

source_text: they all ate and were filled.
target_text: ka dhèu sèra ra'a toke bècu.

source_text: they took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.
target_text: ra'a èle, hèia ana madhutu na sèra lasi pakaboko nganga'a dhu risi eele sèra, pènu canguru dua soe.

source_text: those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.
target_text: dhèu dhu ra'a sèra, dhèu mone di, lèmi riho dhèu, ige mèka bhèni dènge ana iiki.

source_text: immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.
target_text: èle ka, yesus pua ana madhutu sèra pakèd'i uuru dènge koha asa rae betsaida ètu cabèka dano. te nèngu dhae la'e mèka, ho na pua dhèu ae sèra lèpa.

source_text: after he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.
target_text: ropa dhèu sèra lèpa, na la'e asa ledhe èci ètu èèna, ho na manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: when evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land. seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them, but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out; for they all saw him and were troubled. but he immediately spoke with them and said to them, cheer up! it is i! don't be afraid.
target_text: lod'o mèda le, ka yesus puru mai. na ladhe nèdhi ana madhutu na sèra dènge koha lasi d'ai talora dano le. lula ngèlu madha mèdhu ae, ka ra tuku koha d'ai madhe. d'ara oe mèu sa, yesus heka la'e madhutu si kèna. te ngaa na kako re dedha èi. ropa na kako oe seli koha ra, ana madhutu sèra ladhe rèdhi ne, ka ra madha'u titu kèna. hèia èci karèi èci, aku rèngu na, irii! ngaa nèi? nidhu, do? hèia yesus lii dènge si, aku nèngu na, we! miu baku madha'u! te ja'a ne!

source_text: he got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;
target_text: ropa yesus ca'e la'e asa dedha koha, kabèdhi laa, ngèlu mau dènge. ana madhutu na sèra malaa bia.

source_text: for they hadn't understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
target_text: rèngu heka rèdhi kèna, yesus pake koasa na, lod'o panga'a lèmi riho dhèu èèna. te ngaa rèngu re'a iia boe koasa yesus, lula d'ara rèngu adhu sèmi hadhu.

source_text: when they had crossed over, they came to land at gennesaret and moored to the shore.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai cabèka dano, ra panahu koha ètu dae genesaret.

source_text: when they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,
target_text: ropa ra puru nèti dedha koha, dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi si. ka ra rodhe lème, aku rèngu na, ee! yesus mai le!

source_text: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was. wherever he entered-into villages, or into cities, or into the country-they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.
target_text: dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra lasi peka palème rae, nèti èèna ka, dhèu mai nèti mia-mia, jèru rèti a'ari rèngu dhu pèd'a asa yesus. sad'i ra tadèngi yesus ètu era èci, na, rame-rame nedhe rèti dhèu pèd'a mai. ra paj'unu si ètu d'ara tana lapa ètu èèna. te ra pangee, na, sad'i dhèu pèd'a sèra goi lèke sebhe kodho yesus di, èle dènge nèti papèd'a ra. ka dhèu goi lèke kodho na, hèia èle nèti papèd'a ra.

source_text: then the pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from jerusalem.
target_text: ca lod'o, dhèu partei agama parisi canau dènge mese-mese agama mai nèti kota yerusalem neo paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault. for the pharisees and all the jews don't eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders. they don't eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches. the pharisees and the scribes asked him, why don't your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?
target_text: dhèu parisi kèpe pa'èra ad'a yahudi. nuka sèmi, dhèu neo ra'a-rinu hud'i j'amo uuru ku kacui-aai madhutu atora ad'a. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe lèpa nèti d'ara pasa, hud'i diu uuru ku èi. toke mèdha dapu rèngu sèmi èru-pangala, pega, curu, galaa, cere, hud'i rase uuru ku madhutu atora ad'a, heka bisa pake ra'a-rinu kèna. ladhe dhèu yahudi cahag'e madhutu boe ad'a rèngu sèmi èèna, dhèu parisi nasa. nèti èèna ka, ra nasa ropa rèdhi ana madhutu yesus sèra ra'a-rinu j'amo boe kacui-aai madhutu atora ad'a rèngu. ka rèngu mai pasala yesus, peka na, nga tao ka ana madhutu èu se ra'a-rinu j'amo uuru boe kacui-aai? sèra sa, pasala dènge ad'a nèti bèi-baki èdhi!

source_text: he answered them, well did isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘this people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me. they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men. '
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, miu se mema padhai lii leo, tao leo! nèti uru nèka mai yesaya suri tèke le, lii padhai lii ama lamatua sèmi ne'e, ‘abhu dhèu dhu koa-kio kolongara ja'a, dhoka dènge hèb'a di, te ngaa nèti boe d'ara. tatao rèngu sèmi èèna na, lèke boe. rèngu pusi-pahae boe dad'èi ja'a, te ngaa rèngu madhutu dhoka atora dhèu rai-haha di. ' miu èci èèna kahèi.

source_text: for you set aside the commandment of god, and hold tightly to the tradition of men-the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things. he said to them, full well do you reject the commandment of god, that you may keep your tradition.
target_text: miu tèke eele le paredha ama lamatua, ho madhutu atora dhèu rai-haha. tatao miu ne, d'èlu-mèu bia!

source_text: for moses said, ‘honor your father and your mother; ' and, ‘he who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death. '
target_text: karèi nèti uuru èèna, musa peka le lii paredha ama lamatua sèmi ne'e ka, ‘pakab'ua ina-ama miu. ' aa tabha hari, peka na, ‘ladhe ana èci padhèda ama na, do ina na, hud'i ra huku pamadhe ne. '

source_text: but you say, ‘if a man tells his father or his mother, whatever profit you might have received from me is corban, ' that is to say, given to god, then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,
target_text: ama lamatua aj'a sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu aj'a leo. miu peka na, ‘ladhe dhèu èci pamoa le neo hia ngaa èci mi ama lamatua, masi ka ina dènge ama na j'èra oe madhe èèna ka, te ngaa pake boe mèdha èèna ho soru-bara si, lula nèngu moa le neo hia mi lamatua. '

source_text: making void the word of god by your tradition which you have handed down. you do many things like this.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo na ja'a peka le, miu pake heka dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa miu gati eele dènge atora miu dhu hiu. atora ae le dhu miu gati eele sèmi èèna.

source_text: he called all the multitude to himself and said to them, hear me, all of you, and understand.
target_text: hèia yesus paroa hari dhèu leo ètu sèra, ka na peka na, pasa dhilu ho nanene paie, sèna ka miu me'a.

source_text: there is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.
target_text: ngaa dhu maso asa d'ara d'èlu, pakaj'alu boe. te ngaa dhu kalua mai nèti d'ara, èèna ka dhu pakaj'alu dhèu.

source_text: if anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!
target_text: cee dènge ro'a dhilu, na, nanene.

source_text: when he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele dhèu sèra, ka lasi asa d'ara èmu èci. ka ana madhutu sèra karèi sasoa nèti lii pakasame deo na.

source_text: he said to them, are you also without understanding? don't you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can't defile him, because it doesn't go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, miu me'a boe kahèi? sasoa na sèmi ne'e ka: ngaa dhu dhèu ra'a, èèna be'a. te ngaa dhu kalua mai, karehe. èèna be'a boe. ngaa dhu èdhi ta'a, maso asa d'ara d'èlu, ho èèna na kalua hari asa li'u la'e. lii yesus èèna neo peka mi èdhi, nganga'a aa'i-aa'i, èci sa dhu luri boe.

source_text: he said, that which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.
target_text: ngaa dhu mai nèti d'ara, èèna ka dhu pa'ele iie dhèu, nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua d'èi boe pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: for from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,
target_text: te j'ara bhelu-katub'a ae ka dhu kalua nèti d'ara dhèu! nuka sèmi: ngangee karehe, tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu boe nèngu, mana'u, pamadhe dhèu,

source_text: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.
target_text: gagoo-gagehu, bersina, bhelu-katub'a, leko-monya, dhèu dhu taha nare boe d'ara, d'èi boe dhèu risi nèngu, padhai lii pamanahu dhèu, padedha iisi, tatao dhu lèke boe, dènge kètu hadhu.

source_text: all these evil things come from within and defile the man.
target_text: j'ara karehe aa'i-aa'i sèra mai nèti d'ara dhèu. sèra ka dhu pa'ele iie dhèu. ama lamatua d'èi boe dènge dhèu sèmi èèna.

source_text: from there he arose and went away into the borders of tyre and sidon. he entered into a house and didn't want anyone to know it, but he couldn't escape notice.
target_text: èle ka, yesus tèke eele era èèna, ka la'e asa kota èci, ngara na tirus. d'ai nèi, lasi asa d'ara èmu èci, lula yesus d'èi boe dhèu re'a nèngu ètu èèna. te ngaa nèngu bisa boe pahuni ngi'u.

source_text: for a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet. now the woman was a greek, a syrophoenician by race. she begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu bhèni dintiu èci dhu nèti rai finisia ètu propensi siria. ropa na tadèngi yesus ètu èèna, na mai manèngi yesus babège eele nidhu nèti ana bhèni na.

source_text: but jesus said to her, let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs.
target_text: te ngaa yesus core lii èci, peka na, ana-ana hud'i ra'a uuru ku, ho sisa na, ra core hia busa kèna. dènge lii pacele èèna, yesus hud'i soru-bara uuru ku dhèu yahudi nèngu, heka dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: but she answered him, yes, lord. yet even the dogs under the table eat the children's crumbs.
target_text: te ngaa bhèni èèna b'ala, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a ama. te ngaa busa mate le ètu ro'a mei. nèngu abhu kahèi nganga'a dhu bèbhe nèti d'ara pega ana iiki sèra. madhutu bhèni èèna, lod'o ana ra'a, na, busa na'a kahèi. masi ka yesus soru-bara dhèu unu na, te ngaa nèngu hud'i soru-bara dhèu leo kahèi.

source_text: he said to her, for this saying, go your way. the demon has gone out of your daughter.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii dhaa bhèni ne, hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, tare'a! lii padhai lii èu èèna, mola-mola na kèna! lèpa ka! te nidhu rai le nèti ana èu.

source_text: she went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne la'e ka. na d'ai èmu, ana na dhu bhèj'i luu. nidhu kalua le.

source_text: again he departed from the borders of tyre and sidon, and came to the sea of galilee through the middle of the region of decapolis.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si pakèd'i nèti kota tirus, kako lasi madhutu nebhe dhasi re kota sidon. nèti era èèna, rèngu lasi taruu d'ai dano galilea. hèia ra lasi asa rai èci dhu dènge canguru kota, dhu ra biasa pangare na, ‘dekapolis'.

source_text: they brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. they begged him to lay his hand on him.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu dhèu èci dhu lii aad'o aa katele-katipa. angalai na lere rèti ne asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus tao ai mi kètu na, sèna ka na èle.

source_text: he took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.
target_text: hèia yesus tèke eele dhèu ae sèra, ka la'e mesa na dènge dhèu èèna. yesus pamaso kacui-aai na asa ro'a dhilu dhèu eèna dua-dua. èle èèna ka, na tao ilu ètu kacui-aai na, ka na g'ag'e he'o dhèu ne'e.

source_text: looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, ephphatha! that is, be opened!
target_text: hèia yesus ladhe asa dedha, na ère a'ae madhera, ka na paredha, aku nèngu na, efata. sasoa na, bhoke ka!

source_text: immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.
target_text: na peka dhoka sèmi èèna di, kabèdhi laa, dhilu dhèu èèna tadèngi dènge. sèmi èèna kahèi, he'o dhu sakaa èèna, mako ka na padhai lii dènge.

source_text: he commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dua ra lasi asa era dhèu ae sèra. ka yesus kai si, aku nèngu na, nanene, ee! baku lolo dènge dhèu, peka na, ja'a ka dhu pa'èle dhèu ne'e ne. masi ka na kai si, te ngaa dhèu se'e lasi lolo palème d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: they were astonished beyond measure, saying, he has done all things well. he makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi lii lolo èèna, malaa bia. ra papeka isi-aanga ra, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne'e, dhèu di, nga! nèngu tao pabe'a aa'i mèu-mèu. dhèu katele bisa tadèngi, aa dhèu lii aad'o bisa padhai lii.

source_text: in those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them, i have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat. if i send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, dhèu ae mai kamue rare yesus neo nanene lii holo-nori na. dhèu sèra tèlu lod'o kèna ètu era èèna dènge yesus. nèti èèna ka, gee ra èle aa'i le. hèia yesus paroa ana madhutu na, ka na peka, ja'a rasa kasia dènge dhèu ae se'e. cahag'e mai nèti rae kaj'èu, ètu era ne'e d'ai tèlu lod'o kèna, ka nganga'a rèngu aad'o heka ciki sa. baku hia ra lèpa dènge kabake manganga. mage dhoka ra mad'ea ho bèbha ètu j'ara.

source_text: his disciples answered him, from where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?
target_text: ka ana madhutu yesus sèra dhaa, peka na, ama. era ne kaj'èu nèti rae. èdhi panga'a tare boe dhèu ae sèmi ne'e!

source_text: he asked them, how many loaves do you have? they said, seven.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, peka na, roti miu pèri bua era? ka ra dhaa peka na, ama. roti ji'i ate dhoka pidhu bua di.

source_text: he commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.
target_text: ropa nanene nare, hèia na pua dhèu ae sèra madhèdi ètu rai. ka nare roti pidhu bua sèra, hèia na sabaj'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. sabaj'a nare, hèia na pamae roti pidhu bua sèra. ka na hia ana madhutu na papala mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra.

source_text: they also had a few small fish. having blessed them, he said to serve these also.
target_text: rèngu dènge i'a pèri ngi'u kahèi. ka yesus sabaj'a hari manèngi makasi. èle èèna ka, na hia ana madhutu na papala hari mi dhèu ae sèra.

source_text: they ate and were filled. they took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over. those who had eaten were about four thousand. then he sent them away.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ele boe d'ai èpa riho sa. ra ra'a toke bècu. ra'a rare, hèia ana madhutu yesus pakaboko nganga'a sisa, ka ra ige pidhu soe hahake. èle èèna ka, yesus pua dhèu se lèpa.

source_text: immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of dalmanutha.
target_text: ropa dhèu se lèpa, yesus dènge ana madhutu na ca'e koha pakèd'i asa rae èci, ngara na dalmanuta.

source_text: the pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.
target_text: lod'o yesus si d'ai dalmanuta, dhèu partei parisi pèri-pèri mai paraga dènge yesus. ra tenge j'ara neo pamanahu ne. ra manèngi, peka na, ama. pad'elo tadha malaa, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, peka na, èu tare'a-re'a abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: he sighed deeply in his spirit and said, why does this generation seek a sign? most certainly i tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.
target_text: hèia yesus ère a'ae madhera, ka na dhaa si, peka na, ladhe ja'a madhutu lii padhai lii miu ne, ja'a manyasa! nga tao ka miu manèngi tadha malaa? baku sèmi èèna. ja'a bisa tao tadha malaa. te ngaa ja'a parluu boe pad'elo mi miu.

source_text: he left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.
target_text: hèia yesus tèke eele dhèu parisi sèra, la'e hari asa dedha koha. ka na pakèd'i dènge ana madhutu na sèra asa cabèka dano.

source_text: they forgot to take bread; and they didn't have more than one loaf in the boat with them.
target_text: ropa yesus si d'ai talora dano, hèia ana madhutu na sèra heka sanèd'e kèna, na, rèngu rèti boe nganga'a leo, dhoka roti cue di.

source_text: he warned them, saying, take heed: beware of the yeast of the pharisees and the yeast of herod.
target_text: tadèngi ra ale roti, hèia yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, miu mage-mage ku! baku lèke pangaru karehe nèti dhèu aae herodes dènge dhèu parisi. pangaru rèngu, sama sèmi ragi dhu dhèu pakihu tao roti.

source_text: they reasoned with one another, saying, it's because we have no bread.
target_text: ra tadèngi na padhai lii sèmi èèna, ka ana madhutu sèra malaa. ka ra papeka isi-aanga si, peka na, mone heka nèi, peka ngaa ne? tao-tao èdhi tèti boe roti, ka na lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: jesus, perceiving it, said to them, why do you reason that it's because you have no bread? don't you perceive yet or understand? is your heart still hardened?
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a lii padhai rèngu. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, nga tao ka miu padhue dhoka roti di! miu me'a mere boe ngaa dhu ja'a peka na, do? mema kahadhu miu kateme.

source_text: having eyes, don't you see? having ears, don't you hear? don't you remember?
target_text: miu mèdhi dènge madha le, te ngaa mo'o boe me'a! èci èèna ka dènge miu mèdhi mèka. miu tadèngi dènge ro'a dhilu le, te ngaa mo'o boe nanene. èci èèna ka dènge miu tadèngi mèka. miu bhèlu le, do?

source_text: when i broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up? they told him, twelve.
target_text: roti lèmi bua dhu ja'a pamae kore ka hia dhèu lèmi riho sèra ra'a, si? ca hari ni, miu pakaboko mere roti dhu risi sèra pèri soe? ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, canguru dua soe, ama.

source_text: when the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up? they told him, seven.
target_text: ka na karèi hari, aku nèngu na, miu sanèd'e era lod'o ja'a pamae kore roti pèri bua sèra, ka hia dhèu èpa riho ra'a sa, do aad'o? miu pakaboko mere sisa pèri soe hahake? ka ra dhaa, na, pidhu, ama.

source_text: he asked them, don't you understand yet?
target_text: hèia na peka, na, mema tare'a! miu mèdhi dènge madha le. te ngaa, nga tao ka miu me'a mèka koasa ja'a kapua nèti mia?

source_text: he came to bethsaida. they brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.
target_text: ropa yesus si d'ai rae betsaida, dhèu rèti dhèu bèdhu èci mai asa yesus. ra manèngi sèna ka yesus pa'èle musi madha dhèu bèdhu ne.

source_text: he took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. when he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.
target_text: ka yesus kadhèi nare kacui-aai dhèu ne, ka dua ra lasi asa li'u rae. èle èèna ka, yesus sabhuu ilu mi musi madha dhèu ne, hèia na g'ag'e. ka na karèi, peka na, samia? èu mèdhi le, do dhae?

source_text: he looked up, and said, i see men, but i see them like walking trees.
target_text: ka dhèu èèna padoa kètu, ka na ladhe sa g'ana-kariu, hèia na dhaa, peka na, oo! ja'a kèdhi dhèu kako rango-rango era, nuka sèmi ana aaj'u dhu kako.

source_text: then again he laid his hands on his eyes. he looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.
target_text: hèia yesus caro hari kacui-aai na ca tèka mi musi madha dhèu ne'e. ka na ladhe patae hari, ho neo ne'a, na, musi madha na be'a le, do dhae. ne'e ne, heka nèdhi dènge mèu kèna.

source_text: he sent him away to his house, saying, don't enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.
target_text: ka yesus pua na lèpa, te ngaa pasanèd'e ne, aku nèngu na, èu lamu ka, te ngaa madhutu j'ara leo. re ia ka betsaida.

source_text: jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of caesarea philippi. on the way he asked his disciples, who do men say that i am?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si kako palème rae-rae ètu kaisarea pilipi. ètu talora j'ara, yesus karèi ana madhutu na, peka na, madhutu lii lolo dhèu, na, ja'a ne, cee?

source_text: they told him, john the baptizer, and others say elijah, but others, one of the prophets.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, dhèu cahag'e peka, na, èu ne, yohanis tuka sarani dhu madhe le, te ngaa mamuri hari. abhu cahag'e peka na, èu ne, elia, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru sèra. aa abhu cahag'e hari peka na, ama ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu leo.

source_text: he said to them, but who do you say that i am? peter answered, you are the christ.
target_text: ka yesus karèi hari rèngu, madhutu a'abhu miu, ja'a ne, cee? petrus dhaa, peka na, ama ne, kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka.

source_text: he commanded them that they should tell no one about him.
target_text: hèia yesus pasanèd'e si, aku nèngu na, baku lolo mi cee-cee kahèi, ee!

source_text: he began to teach them that the son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus mulai peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. bèli-camèd'a ja'a abhu j'aj'èra ae titu kèna, lula dhèu heka-dhèu heka yahudi, kètu agama yahudi, dènge mese agama sèra, aa'i-aa'i ra sèmi rare boe ja'a. ho èèna na, ra pamadhe ja'a, te ngaa d'ai camèd'a, na, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: he spoke to them openly. peter took him and began to rebuke him.
target_text: yesus peka boe dènge pahuni, hèia petrus ère ne asa karasa na, ka na kai, aku nèngu na, ama, baku padhai lii sèmi èèna! ja'a ko'o boe dhèu tao ama ku sèmi èèna.

source_text: but he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked peter, and said, get behind me, satan! for you have in mind not the things of god, but the things of men.
target_text: lii padhai lii petrus èèna, madhutu boe dad'èi ama lamatua. hèia yesus kabib'a, ka ladhe asa ana madhutu dhu leo sèra. ka na nasa dènge petrus, aku nèngu na, weh! èèna lii dhèu aae nidhu! èu pakaj'èu nèti ne'e! èu madhutu dhoka dad'èi dhèu rai-haha di. madhutu boe dad'èi ama lamatua!

source_text: he called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus paroa dhèu ae sèra ho mai pakaboko dènge ana madhutu na. ka na aj'a si, peka na, dhèu dhu neo madhutu ja'a, hud'i taha taruu bèli-bèli. nèngu hud'i tèke eele dad'èi na, ho madhutu dad'èi lamatua di. masi ka dhèu neo pamadhe ne, te ngaa nèngu hud'i taha taruu kahèi, nuka sèmi dhèu pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha nèngu unu na ho la'e asa era ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: for whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the good news will save it.
target_text: te dhèu dhu mamuri dhoka lalau ngi'u aae na di, bèli-camèd'a mamuri nèngu ele iie d'ara! te ngaa dhèu dhu sadia madhe lula madhutu ja'a, aa lula na peka-padhai j'ara mamuri ama lamatua, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri dhu ma'ète boe dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: for what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?
target_text: mi nanene, ee! ladhe èu abhu aa'i isi rai-haha ne, te ngaa ama lamatua core eele èu, a'oto na ngaa?

source_text: for what will a man give in exchange for his life?
target_text: masi ka èu bau mèti aa'i kakaja rai-haha ne, te ngaa bisa boe pasilu dènge samanga èu.

source_text: for whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the son of man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his father's glory with the holy angels.
target_text: sanèd'e paie! dhèu ètu rai-haha limuri ne, bhelu-katub'a rupa-rupa. rèngu pusi-pahae boe madhutu ama lamatua. de cee dhu makae madhutu ja'a, do makae madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a, bèli-camèd'a ja'a makae kahèi mangaku nèngu ètu madha ama lamatua. te ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, bèli-camèd'a mai hari nèti sorga, palere dènge ana pajuu ama lamatua sèra. ji'i puru mai dènge dadedha ama ku, heka dhèu re'a mèu kèna, ja'a ne cee.

source_text: he said to them, most certainly i tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see god's kingdom come with power.
target_text: miu baku bhèlu lii padhai lii ja'a ne. abhu nèti miu cahag'e dhu madhe mèka, pe mèdhi ama lamatua nèd'u paredha dènge koasa kapai.

source_text: after six days jesus took with him peter, james, and john, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.
target_text: èle èna lod'o, hèia yesus gale nèti petrus, yakobis, yohanis, lasi asa ledhe èci dhu dhèu pea boe. ropa d'ai ledhe èèna, rèngu ladhe, na, yesus leko-leo.

source_text: his clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.
target_text: aa mèdha-papake na pudhi kale'e. abhu mèka mèdha dhu pudhi sèmi èèna ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: elijah and moses appeared to them, and they were talking with jesus.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, rèngu rèdhi yesus padhai lii dènge elia dènge musa.

source_text: peter answered jesus, rabbi, it is good for us to be here. let's make three tents: one for you, one for moses, and one for elijah. for he didn't know what to say, for they were very afraid.
target_text: ka petrus si madha'u bia. hèia petrus malaa, ka na padhai lii ore leli. hèia na peka dènge yesus, aku nèngu na, ama! èdhi ètu era ne'e, be'a titu kèna! hua iia risi, ji'i tao paleo tèlu bua, cue hia ama, cue hia musa, aa cue hari hia elia.

source_text: a cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, this is my beloved son. listen to him.
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, ra'i-liru puru mai sarimu nare si. hèia ra tadèngi lii èci nèti ra'i-liru èèna, peka na, mi nanene! yesus ne, ana pasue ja'a. miu nanene paie ne!

source_text: suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except jesus only.
target_text: ropa tadèngi lii èèna, petrus si laladhe palème, te ngaa rèdhi heka dhèu leo ètu èèna. ate dhoka yesus mesa na.

source_text: as they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the son of man had risen from the dead.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra puru nèti ledhe èèna. ka yesus kai si, peka na, ngaa dhu miu mèdhi deo na, baku lolo dènge dhèu èci sa. ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, hud'i madhe uuru ku. ho lod'o d'ai ja'a mamuri hari, na, miu heka lolo dènge dhèu leo kèna.

source_text: they kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the rising from the dead meant.
target_text: rèngu tèke pa'èra lii moa èèna ètu d'ara ra. ra ale boe dènge dhèu èci sa. te ngaa tèlu ra pakarèi isi-aanga, na padhai lii ngaa ne, peka na, ‘nèngu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe'? tasamia, ee?

source_text: they asked him, saying, why do the scribes say that elijah must come first?
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, peka na, mese agama sèra peka na, ‘elia hud'i mai uru ku, heka kristus mai kèna. ' te ngaa madhutu ama, tare'a, do aad'o?

source_text: he said to them, elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. how is it written about the son of man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, mema tare'a. elia hud'i mai uuru ku, ho bhoke j'ara hia kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru ka. te ngaa tasamia? miu me'a mèka ngaa dhu suri rare le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, lula-nèti dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a? dhu suri rare le, peka na, ladhe lod'o na mai, dhèu paj'èra ne, toke ra pamadhe ne.

source_text: but i tell you that elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu pasa paie dhilu miu! elia mai le. te ngaa dhèu paj'èra ne madhutu dad'èi rèngu. èèna lèke dènge ngaa dhu baki-baki èdhi sèra suri tèke le karèi nèti uuru ka.

source_text: coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.
target_text: ropa yesus dènge ana madhutu na, dhèu tèlu sèra, paraga hari dènge ana madhutu leo sèra, ka ladhe rèdhi dhèu ae pakaboko ètu èèna. dhèu ae sèra mai ho ra neo nanene ana madhutu yesus dhu leo sèra pab'ala lii dènge mese agama ètu èèna.

source_text: immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae sèra ladhe rèdhi yesus, ka ra cag'ag'a, te rèngu neo laa, na, yesus ètu ledhe era. hèia ra rai mai soru ne.

source_text: he asked the scribes, what are you asking them?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi si, peka na, miu pab'ala lii ngaa na?

source_text: one of the multitude answered, teacher, i brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;
target_text: dhèu èci nèti talora dhèu ae sèra ara sa madha, ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, mu nanene ku laa! ja'a mai kèti ana mone ja'a dhu pèd'a, ho ama ku puri-pa'èle ne. nèngu lii aad'o, bisa boe padhai lii, lula nidhu tao ne.

source_text: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. i asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren't able.
target_text: ladhe nidhu maso asa d'ara ngi'u na, na hake ngi'u ana ne mi rai. ho hèb'a na horo karaka, na na'e ngutu na kico-kico sèna. ho ngi'u na patèku sèmi aj'u. ja'a manèngi le ana madhutu ama ku babège eele nidhu èèna. te ngaa ra bisa boe.

source_text: he answered him, unbelieving generation, how long shall i be with you? how long shall i bear with you? bring him to me.
target_text: ropa na nanene nare, hèia yesus jèke si, peka na, heh! miu seli-kolane! ja'a aj'a miu pahari-pahari, te ngaa miu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa. miu parcaya èra boe mi ja'a! ja'a mate miu nèbhu sange mia hari ku? mèti ana èèna asa ne'e mai!

source_text: they brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.
target_text: hèia ra sa'u rèti ana èèna asa madha yesus. te ngaa ropa nidhu ladhe nèdhi yesus, na kalabhe ana ne mi rai, ka ana ne bèbhe kapod'e ètu rai, aa hèb'a na horo karaka.

source_text: he asked his father, how long has it been since this has been happening to him? he said, from childhood.
target_text: ka yesus karèi ama na, nèngu sèmi ne'e ne, pèri lod'o kèna? ka ama na dhaa, karèi nèti ana iiki ka mai.

source_text: often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. but if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.
target_text: nidhu èèna nèbhu ae le neo pamadhe ana ne'e. na tule ne pèri-pèri hari kèna asa d'ara ai, aa na pacène le kahèi asa d'ara èi. de ama ku sue ja'a. ladhe bisa, na, ama puri-pa'èle ku ana ja'a la.

source_text: jesus said to him, if you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, nga tao ka èu peka na ‘ladhe bisa'? ja'a bisa tao aa'i mèu-mèu, te ngaa hud'i èu parcaya uuru ku!

source_text: immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, i believe. help my unbelief!
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mone èèna dhaa dènge oe tangi, aku nèngu na, ama, mema ja'a parcaya, te ngaa pa'èra hari ku lalèka ja'a ne'e!

source_text: when jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, you mute and deaf spirit, i command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi dhèu ae mai lingu, ka na paredha nidhu èèna, aku nèngu na, heh! nidhu bhelu! kalua pakaj'èu ka nèti ana ne'e! sèna ka na bisa tadèngi aa na padhai lii kahèi. èu baku maso ia ka asa d'ara ana ne'e!

source_text: after crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. the boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, he is dead.
target_text: ropa nidhu tadèngi lii yesus, hèia na pakèce. ka na hake ana ne mi rai, ka na rèbha-rèbha sène, heka nidhu kalua nèti d'ara ana èèna kèna. ana èèna kalau heka, nuka sèmi dhu madhe le. ka dhèu ètu sèra sa peka, aku rèngu na, waa! ana ne madhe le!

source_text: but jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kèpe kacui-aai ana ne, ka na pakèd'i ne. hèia na kèd'i dènge ka.

source_text: when he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, why couldn't we cast it out?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na, tèke eele era èèna, lasi dhuli èmu cue. ètu èmu èèna, rèngu mesa ra, ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, ama! nga tao ka ji'i bisa boe babège eele nidhu èèna?

source_text: he said to them, this kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting.
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, mi nanene paie! nidhu sèra mema bhelu. de ladhe miu manèngi boe a'èra nèti lamatua, na, miu bisa boe babège eele nidhu sèmi èèna.

source_text: they went out from there and passed through galilee. he didn't want anyone to know it,
target_text: èle ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na tèke eele era èèna, lasi taruu asa propensi galilea. lod'o èèna, yesus d'èi boe dhèu re'a nèngu ètu èèna,

source_text: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, the son of man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.
target_text: lula na neo aj'a ana madhutu na di. ka na lole dènge si, nèbhu heka dhèu pahie eele ja'a dènge dhèu leo. hèia ra pamadhe ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. mema ja'a madhe, te ngaa d'ai camèd'a, ja'a mamuri hari.

source_text: but they didn't understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.
target_text: yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, te ngaa ana madhutu na sèra malaa. rèngu bani heka karèi sasoa lii padhai lii nèngu.

source_text: he came to capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, what were you arguing among yourselves on the way?

target_text: ropa ra nanene lii rodhe na, hèia dhèu sèra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, èu mau-mau ku laa! te ngaa na rodhe asa aae, peka na, yesus! ana-èpu daud, ee! sue ku ja'a laa!

source_text: jesus stood still and said, call him. they called the blind man, saying to him, cheer up! get up. he is calling you!
target_text: hèia yesus titu taha, ka na peka, mèti ku na mai sa ne'e! ka ra lasi peka dènge dhèu bèdhu èèna, peka na, èu mau-mau ka laa! te ama mese paroa èu nèi. de mai lati ka!

source_text: he, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to jesus.
target_text: ropa nanene nare, ka bartimeos pèci eele sig'i kalolo na, hèia na kèd'i titu la'e paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: jesus asked him, what do you want me to do for you? the blind man said to him, rabboni, that i may see again.
target_text: ka yesus karèi ne, peka na, èu parluu ngaa? dhèu bèdhu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, ee! ja'a manèngi ho ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: jesus said to him, go your way. your faith has made you well. immediately he received his sight and followed jesus on the way.
target_text: yesus peka hari dènge ne, lula èu parcaya, ja'a bisa tao paie musi madha èu. ne'e ne kahèi musi madha èu èle dènge! de lamu ka! ka musi madha bartimeos èle dènge. èle ka la'e madhutu yesus.

source_text: when they came near to jerusalem, to bethsphage and bethany, at the mount of olives, he sent two of his disciples
target_text: ropa ra dètu dènge kota yerusalem, ka ra dhuli uuru dua rae, ngara na betfage dènge betania, ètu sebhe ledhe saitun. ètu èèna, yesus si mate ciki oo'e di. ka na pua ana madhutu na dhèu dua lasi uuru.

source_text: and said to them, go your way into the village that is opposite you. immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. untie him and bring him.
target_text: na pua si, peka na, miu dua mi lami uuru asa d'ara rae nèi. ropa miu maso lami, miu mèdhi ana badha keled'ei ci'u, dhu ra èki ètu èèna, dhu dhèu dhae manya'e mèka. lami ho lècu eele dhari a'èki na, ho ère mèti mai asa ne'e.

source_text: if anyone asks you, ‘why are you doing this? ' say, ‘the lord needs him; ' and immediately he will send him back here.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu karèi miu, ‘nga tao ka miu ère mèti ana keled'ei ne? ' mi peka dènge si, ‘lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. ladhe pake nare, na, na hia hari mai. '

source_text: they went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana madhutu na dhèu dua sèra lasi, ka rèdhi ana keled'ei ci'u dhu èki tèke ètu madha èmu cue ètu sebhe j'ara. ra lècu eele dhari èki na, ka ra ère rèti mai.

source_text: some of those who stood there asked them, what are you doing, untying the young donkey?
target_text: ka dhèu-dhèu dhu titu ètu èèna, peka na, we! nga tao ka miu pakako mèti keled'ei dhèu?

source_text: they said to them just as jesus had said, and they let them go.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, lamatua ji'i neo pake ne. ho ladhe na pake nare, na, ji'i ngèti hari mai. ka dhèu sèra soro tèke si lasi pakako rèti ana keled'ei èèna.

source_text: they brought the young donkey to jesus and threw their garments on it, and jesus sat on it.
target_text: hèia ra rèti ana keled'ei èèna asa yesus. ka ra hèle sig'i-kalolo rèngu mi dedha keled'ei, ka yesus manya'e.

source_text: many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.
target_text: ropa oe maso d'ara kota, ka dhèu ae rare sig'i-kalolo, ka ra hèle mi dedha j'ara oka-hoo. dhèu cahag'e lasi para rèu palam ètu sebhe j'ara, ho ra tao mi talora j'ara oka-hoo. tatao sèmi èèna na, sama sèmi tadha èci dhu peka na, rèngu pakab'ua yesus.

source_text: those who went in front and those who followed cried out, hosanna! blessed is he who comes in the name of the lord!
target_text: dhèu cahag'e kako uru ètu madha yesus; aa cahag'e kako limuri. ka ra pa'oo, peka na, hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lamatua hia berkat mi dhèu dhu mai pake kolongara na, lula ama lamatua hia ne mai!

source_text: blessed is the kingdom of our father david that is coming in the name of the lord! hosanna in the highest!
target_text: hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lula lamatua neo pakèd'i hari paredha dhèu aae daud! hosana! mai ti koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua! lula lamatua madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu era dedha risi eele!

source_text: jesus entered into the temple in jerusalem. when he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to bethany with the twelve.
target_text: ropa ra d'ai d'ara kota, ka yesus si maso asa madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ka yesus ladhe palème era èmu èèna. te ngaa, lula lod'o nihia ae le, ka ra lèpa hari asa rae betania.

source_text: the next day, when they had come out from bethany, he was hungry.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, ka rèngu kalua nèti betania lasi asa yerusalem. d'ai talora j'ara ka yesus manganga.

source_text: seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.
target_text: ka na ladhe nèdhi ana aaj'u èci ètu sebhe j'ara. hua aj'u na, dhu dhèu ra'a. yesus la'e padètu ho neo ne'a aj'u na, hua do aad'o. na ladhe aj'u èèna hua boe cue sa. te mema d'ai mèka hèru hua. rèu heka mare kèna.

source_text: jesus told it, may no one ever eat fruit from you again! and his disciples heard it.
target_text: ka yesus peka mi aj'u èèna, lula èu hia boe ja'a hua, mulai ti deo ne'e, èu bisa heka hia hua èu asa dhèu leo! ana madhutu yesus sèra tadèngi na padhai lii dènge nasa sèmi èèna.

source_text: they came to jerusalem, and jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers' tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.
target_text: yesus si kako taruu asa yerusalem, d'ai nèi ka yesus maso asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ètu madha èmu èèna, dhèu tao pasa ho ra pahia koro j'aha dhu biasa dhèu pake tao korban ho ra sabaj'a. ropa yesus nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka na lalèta si asa li'u. na tule eele mei dhu ra pake ho pasilu doi sèra, aa na tule paguri eele bagu dhu ra pake pahia manu-bhui sa.

source_text: he would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.
target_text: ka yesus kai si aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka ra rèti ia ka mèdha rèngu re d'ara madha èmu èèna.

source_text: he taught, saying to them, isn't it written, ‘my house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations'? but you have made it a den of robbers!
target_text: ka na aj'a si, peka na, miu me'a le lii dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke le, peka na: ‘ja'a tao èmu ne'e, sèna ka suku aa'i-aa'i mai sabaj'a ètu ne'e. ' te ngaa miu tao èmu ne j'aj'i era pakaboko dhèu parapo.

source_text: the chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. for they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.
target_text: ropa kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra re'a rare tatao yesus sèmi èèna, ka ra nasa dènge ne. ka ra tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa ra madha'u, lula dhèu ae dhu d'èi lii holo-nori yesus.

source_text: when evening came, he went out of the city.
target_text: d'ara lod'o cèna sa, yesus si kalua hari nèti kota yerusalem lèpa lasi j'unu asa rae betania.

source_text: as they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots. peter, remembering, said to him, rabbi, look! the fig tree which you cursed has withered away.
target_text: bèli mad'ae èèna, yesus si lasi hari asa yerusalem. d'ai talora j'ara, ka ra rèdhi aj'u dhu yesus padhai lii med'a na. ka ana madhutu yesus sèra malaa, lula rèngu rèdhi aj'u èèna mango le d'ai amo. hèia petrus sanèd'e lii padhai lii yesus med'a na. ka na peka na, ama! ladhe ku! aj'u dhu ama dhoo med'a na, madhe le!

source_text: jesus answered them, have faith in god.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a, we! sad'i miu parcaya ama lamatua sèmi èèna, na, j'aj'i kahèi.

source_text: for most certainly i tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘be taken up and cast into the sea, ' and doesn't doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.
target_text: ladhe miu parcaya dènge d'ara kateme, miu bisa pua ledhe hia na pidha asa d'ara dhasi. pe lamatua pidha eele ledhe èèna, sad'i miu baku parcaya dènge d'ara cabèka. miu parcaya mi ama lamatua, hud'i dènge d'ara kateme ku.

source_text: therefore i tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.
target_text: baku bhèlu! sad'i miu parcaya dènge d'ara kateme, ngaa dhu miu manèngi, tatu ama lamatua bisa hia miu.

source_text: whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci sabaj'a, aa te ngaa na tèka d'ara era dènge dhèu leo, nèngu hud'i la'e pabe'a uuru ku dènge dhèu èèna. ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, ama miu ètu sorga heka saku eele sasala miu kèna.

source_text: but if you do not forgive, neither will your father in heaven forgive your transgressions.
target_text: ladhe abhu nèti miu dhu tèka d'ara dènge dhèu, ho mo'o boe hia abho, na, tatu ama miu ètu sorga no'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala miu kahèi.

source_text: they came again to jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi taruu. ropa d'ai yerusalem, ka ra maso hari asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa maso asa madha èmu èèna, kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka yahudi sèra mai,

source_text: and they began saying to him, by what authority do you do these things? or who gave you this authority to do these things?
target_text: ka ra karèi yesus, peka na, cee ka dhu pua èu mai tao maruru ètu ne'e med'a na? cee ka hia èu hak!

source_text: jesus said to them, i will ask you one question. answer me, and i will tell you by what authority i do these things.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a, na, rèngu neo tenge j'ara ho pamanahu ne. ka na b'ala si, peka na, ja'a neo karèi miu kahèi. miu dhaa uuru ku ja'a, heka ja'a dhaa miu kèna.

source_text: the baptism of john-was it from heaven, or from men? answer me.
target_text: ja'a neo karèi miu sèmi ne'e: miu aa'i-aa'i mi tadhe yohanis, tuka sarani èèna, sina ma? cee ka dhu pua nèngu la'e sarani dhèu? lamatua do, dhèu rai-haha?

source_text: they reasoned with themselves, saying, if we should say, ‘from heaven; ' he will say, ‘why then did you not believe him? '
target_text: ra pajiko la'e-mai, ka ra padhue, peka na, eea! nara èdhi le! ladhe èdhi dhaa, peka na, ‘ama lamatua ka dhu pua yohanis, ' na b'ala hari, peka na, ‘nga tao ka miu parcaya boe yohanis! '

source_text: if we should say, ‘from men'-they feared the people, for all held john to really be a prophet.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi bisa boe peka kahèi, na, ‘dhèu rai-haha dhu pua ne. ' te aad'o na, dhèu ae tao dènge èdhi. lula dhèu ae parcaya, yohanis èèna, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: they answered jesus, we don't know. jesus said to them, neither will i tell you by what authority i do these things.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, peka na, ji'i nge'a boe! ka yesus dhaa hari si, peka na, ladhe sèmi èèna, ja'a ko'o boe peka kahèi, cee ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: he began to speak to them in parables. a man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.
target_text: èle ka, yesus padhai lii hari dènge kètu agama yahudi, mese agama, dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi sèra. ka na lole pake lii upama èci, peka na, dhèu èci la'e tao oka ho neo sèla anggor ètu dedha rai na. ka na tao tedhe reo nare oka èèna, aa tao bak cue ho kanate èi anggor asa d'ara la'e kahèi. hèia na patitu èmu madhenga oka cue dhu dedha. èle èèna ka, na hia dhèu leo seb'a oka èèna, ho ra pabagi èi anggor. hèia na pakèd'i asa rai leo la'e.

source_text: when it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.
target_text: lod'o d'ai hèru puu-g'ètu hua anggor, ka lamatua oka pua ana paleha na èci la'e asa dhèu sab'a oka sèra, ho na manèngi pala na.

source_text: they took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.
target_text: ropa d'ai nèi, ka dhèu seb'a sèra kèpe rare, ka game ne. hèia ra pua ne lèpa dènge ai hua da'u-da'u.

source_text: again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.
target_text: ka lamatua oka pua hari ana paleha leo èci. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra dhedhe panu'a kètu na. ka ra pamakae ne, dènge magèle eele ne.

source_text: again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.
target_text: hèia lamatua oka èèna pua hari ana paleha leo èci la'e. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra hake pamadhe ne. ra tao samia èèna ka, lamatua oka pua taruu ana paleha na la'e. te ngaa dhèu seb'a sèra game cahag'e, aa pamadhe cahag'e.

source_text: therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘they will respect my son. '
target_text: ate eele dhodhoka ana mone mesa dhu pasue nèti lamatua oka. lula na abhu heka j'ara dhu leo, ka lamatua oka na pua ana d'èlu na la'e. na pajiko, peka na, ‘sèmi ja'a pua ana d'èlu ja'a la'e, na, rèngu sèmi rare dènge be'a, aa ra nanene ne. '

source_text: but those farmers said among themselves, ‘this is the heir. come, let's kill him, and the inheritance will be ours. '
target_text: hèia na pua ana na la'e. ropa dhèu seb'a sèra rèdhi ana na mai, ka ra papeka isi-aanga ra, peka na, ‘we! mi ladhe ku laa! mone heka nèi pua ana d'èlu na mai! ladhe ama na madhe, nèngu ne'e ka dhu sèmi nare aa'i-aa'i mèdha pusaka ama na. de mai ti pamadhe ne, sèna ka èdhi tare pusaka na! '

source_text: they took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra kèpe, ka ra pamadhe ne, hèia ra core eele ngi'u aae na asa li'u tedhe la'e. lii pakasame ne, d'ai sange ne'e ka.

source_text: what therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? he will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus karèi dhèu kapai sèra, peka na, madhutu ngangee miu, na, lamatua oka èèna tao dhèu seb'a sèra tasa mera mia? madhutu ngangee ja'a, tatu nèngu mai ho pamadhe aa'i dhèu seb'a sèra, sèna ka na hia dhèu leo hari seb'a oka anggor na.

source_text: haven't you even read this scripture: ‘the stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti baca le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘abhu hadhu cue dhu tuka hadhu sèra core eele le, te ngaa limuri ne, j'aj'i le hadhu padhèdi.

source_text: this was from the lord. it is marvelous in our eyes'?
target_text: ama lamatua mesa na dhu pili nare, ka na pamadhèdi hadhu ne. nèti èèna ka, èdhi ladhe, na, be'a titu kèna! '

source_text: they tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. they left him and went away.
target_text: dhèu kapai sèra re'a dènge, na, yesus padhai lii paraga, pake lii pakasame èèna. rèngu sèra sama sèmi dhèu seb'a oka anggor èèna. hèia ra tenge j'ara ho neo kèpe yesus. te ngaa ra madha'u dènge dhèu ae dhu d'èi lii holo-nori yesus. ka ra kako eele ne.

source_text: they sent some of the pharisees and the herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu kapai yahudi se pua pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dènge dhèu nèti partei herodes, lasi pakarèi dènge yesus, ho ra neo sahèdhe ne.

source_text: when they had come, they asked him, teacher, we know that you are honest, and don't defer to anyone; for you aren't partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of god. is it lawful to pay taxes to caesar, or not?
target_text: ka ra karèi ne, peka na, ama mese! ji'i nge'a, na, d'ara ama ku mola, aa d'èi boe kapod'e-kabèli. ama me'a d'ara dhèu. ama peka dad'èi lamatua dènge mola-mola, lula ama pili boe rèhu dhèu. de, ji'i neo karèi ama ku ca j'ara. madhutu atora agama yahudi, èdhi bisa b'ae bea asa dhèu aae kapai dhu paredha roma, do aad'o?

source_text: shall we give, or shall we not give? but he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, why do you test me? bring me a denarius, that i may see it.
target_text: te ngaa yesus ne'a le, na, rèngu neo sahèdhe ne, sèna ka na padhai lii lab'a paredha roma. ka yesus b'ala si, peka na, nga tao ka miu neo sahèdhe ja'a dènge lii karèi sèmi èèna! cob'a pad'elo ku mi ja'a doi pudhi cue!

source_text: they brought it. he said to them, whose is this image and inscription? they said to him, caesar's.
target_text: ka ra j'ole doi pudhi cue hia ne. hèia yesus nare, ka laladhe. ka na karèi si, peka na, rèhu dènge ngara cee ètu doi pudhi ne? ka ra dhaa, peka na, èèna dhèu aae kapai paredha roma!

source_text: jesus answered them, give to caesar the things that are caesar's, and to god the things that are god's. they marveled greatly at him.
target_text: ka yesus peka, naa, ladhe sèmi èèna, ngaa dhu unu dhèu paredha, hia asa dhèu paredha la'e. te ngaa dhu unu ama lamatua, hia asa ama lamatua la'e. ropa tadèngi rare, lii b'ala na, ka ra malaa, lula yesus peka dhu lèke. nèti èèna ka, dhèu sèra bisa heka sahèdhe ne.

source_text: some sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. they asked him, saying,
target_text: abhu partei agama dhu leo èci, ngara na partei saduki. rèngu aj'a, peka na, dhèu madhe bisa heka mamuri. ca tèka, abhu dhèu saduki pèri-pèri mai neo sahèdhe yesus.

source_text: teacher, moses wrote to us, ‘if a man's brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother. '
target_text: ka ra padhai lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama mese! musa suri tèke le hia èdhi atora, peka na: ladhe dhèu mone èci madhe tèke eele dhèu èmu na, te ngaa rèngu dènge boe kolo, na, ari dhèu mone na bisa leo nare hari bhèni balu èèna, sèna ka abhu kolo ho baku pa'ele kolongara a'a na dhu madhe èèna.

source_text: there were seven brothers. the first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.
target_text: mema musa aj'a sèmi èèna. te ngaa ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: abhu dhèu pidhu dhu pa'a'ari. mone uru leo uuru èmu, te ngaa madhe, abhu mèka kolo.

source_text: the second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. the third likewise;
target_text: ka ari na leo nare bhèni balu èèna. nèbhu boe ka ari na madhe, te ngaa abhu boe kolo kahèi. ari na ka tèlu, sèmi èèna kahèi; na leo nare bhèni balu èèna, te ngaa abhu mèka kolo, nèngu madhe.

source_text: and the seven took her and left no children. last of all the woman also died.
target_text: taruu-taruu sèmi èèna ka, d'ai ana limuri tèka madhe kahèi. nèbhu boe, hèia bhèni balu èèna madhe.

source_text: in the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? for the seven had her as a wife.
target_text: naa! ji'i neo karèi ama sèmi ne'e: dhèu bhèni èèna, leo le dènge mone dhèu pidhu! d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ho lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe, bhèni ne j'aj'i dhèu èmu cee, nèti dhèu pidhu sèra?

source_text: jesus answered them, isn't this because you are mistaken, not knowing the scriptures nor the power of god?
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, lii karèi miu sèra, tadha, na, miu me'a iia mèka isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua! miu me'a boe koasa lamatua kahèi. de miu sala titu kèna!

source_text: for when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.
target_text: mi nanene! sèmi ne'e: ètu sorga dhèu paleo boe èmu. dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua pamamuri hari, ra paleo heka èmu. sèmi èèna kahèi, ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga.

source_text: but about the dead, that they are raised, haven't you read in the book of moses about the bush, how god spoke to him, saying, ‘i am the god of abraham, the god of isaac, and the god of jacob'?
target_text: aa ja'a peka mi miu lula-nèti dhèu madhe mamuri hari, do aad'o. musa suri tèke lula-nèti ana aaj'u dhu ai na'e, te ngaa kèpu boe. miu sanèd'e lii lolo èèna, do aad'o? ropa ai na'e ana aaj'u èèna, ama lamatua peka dènge musa, na, ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èu, nuka abraham, isak, dènge yakob. toke d'ai sange ne'e, rèngu aa'i-aa'i manèngi-mangaj'i mi ja'a era. '

source_text: he is not the god of the dead, but of the living. you are therefore badly mistaken.
target_text: èdhi te'a, na, bèi-baki èdhi sèra madhe nèbhu le. te ngaa, lula ama lamatua peka nare le, na, nèngu j'aj'i lamatua rèngu era. nèti èèna ka, èdhi te'a, na, rèngu mamuri hari le. de masi ka dhèu madhe le, te ngaa ra mamuri hari. de dhèu mamuri dhu manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, te ngaa dhèu madhe aad'o, sina ma? nèti èèna ka, ladhe miu kèpe taruu a'aj'a dhu peka na, dhèu madhe mamuri heka, èèna miu sala ae!

source_text: one of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, which commandment is the greatest of all?
target_text: ètu lod'o èèna, abhu mese agama èci dhu nanene yesus padhai lii dènge dhèu nèti partei saduki sèra. madhutu a'abhu mese agama èèna, na, yesus dhaa lèke le lii karèi rèngu. hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, ama! ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: atora ad'a dènge lii paredha agama èdhi ae titu kèna. madhutu a'abhu ama, nèti lii paredha dhu mai nèti musa, mia ka dhu hua iia risi?

source_text: jesus answered, the greatest is: ‘hear, israel, the lord our god, the lord is one.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, lii paredha dhu hua iia risi, peka sèmi ne'e ka: ‘miu dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi! mi nanene paie! ama lamatua èèna, mema lamatua èdhi, aa kètu èdhi kahèi. nèngu dhoka mesa na di, lamatua leo aad'o.

source_text: you shall love the lord your god with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength. ' this is the first commandment.
target_text: de miu hud'i sue risi eele ne nèti aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i d'èi pa'èci dènge ne dènge d'ara kateme, aa tadhe mèu ne, dènge sab'a èra ho madhutu dad'èi na. '

source_text: the second is like this: ‘you shall love your neighbor as yourself. ' there is no other commandment greater than these.
target_text: aa lii paredha ka dua peka na: ‘èu hud'i sue ku dhèu leo, sama sèmi èu sue ngi'u èu unu mu. ' dua paredha se'e ka dhu hua iia risi. abhu heka lii paredha leo dhu risi eele nèti dua paredha se'e.

source_text: the scribe said to him, truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he;
target_text: ka mese agama èèna b'ala hari, peka na, tare'a! ama ku peka lèke kèna. te ama lamatua j'aj'i kètu èdhi. lamatua leo aad'o.

source_text: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.
target_text: èdhi hud'i sue risi ne, toke d'ara d'èi ho pa'èci dènge ne, tadhe mèu ne, dènge sab'a èra ho madhutu dad'èi na. èdhi hud'i sue dhèu leo kahèi sama sèmi èdhi sue ngi'u èdhi unu ti. lamatua d'èi risi eele tatao sèmi èèna, nèti èdhi madhutu dhodhoka atora agama di. tatao sèmi èèna be'a risi, nèti èdhi tèti badha ho lati tunu hia lamatua, do tèti mèdha leo hia ne.

source_text: when jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, you are not far from god's kingdom. no one dared ask him any question after that.
target_text: ropa yesus nanene nare dhèu ne dhaa sèmi èèna, ka na pangee, na, mese agama ne ne'a dènge be'a le. hèia yesus peka na, èu oe j'aj'i unu ama lamatua kèna. èle èèna ka, dhèu leo sèra bani heka pakarèi dènge yesus, lula dhèu èci sa segi boe ne.

source_text: jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, how is it that the scribes say that the christ is the son of david?
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus aj'a dhèu ae sèra ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i era. ka na karèi si, peka na, madhutu ngangee miu, na, tasamia? mese agama sèra aj'a, peka na, kristus èèna dhu lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka mai. madhutu ngangee rèngu, na, kristus èèna dhoka ana-èpu daud. te ngaa a'aj'a sèmi èèna d'ai lèke mèu mèka.

source_text: for david himself said in the holy spirit, ‘the lord said to my lord, sit at my right hand, until i make your enemies the footstool of your feet. '
target_text: lula, nèti uru ka mai, roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci pake daud ho suri, peka na, ‘ama lamatua peka le mi lamatua ja'a, na, mai ho madhèdi mi era dhu hua iia, re bab'oa g'ana ja'a. pe èèna na ja'a tao musu èu pahaha iisi, toke ra bisa boe ded'e kètu mi èu. '

source_text: therefore david himself calls him lord, so how can he be his son? the common people heard him gladly.
target_text: de èdhi te'a, na, dhèu aae daud paroa kristus èèna, peka na, ‘lamatua' na. nèti èèna ka, ladhe dhèu sèra peka, na, kristus èèna dhoka ana-èpu daud di, èèna d'ai mèka. lula nèngu èèna j'aj'i lamatua nèti daud kahèi. ropa yesus peka nare sèmi èèna, dhèu ae sèra d'èi titu kèna nanene ne.

source_text: in his teaching he said to them, beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,
target_text: ka yesus peka hari si, miu hud'i pajiko paie ku mese agama. rèngu d'èi pasia pake kodho madhera d'ai rai, lasi paraga dènge dhèu ae, sèna ka dhèu dhu rèdhi rèngu sèra, koa si, peka na, ‘ladhe ku laa! dhèu sèra, dhèu kapai! '

source_text: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts,
target_text: ladhe sèmi rèngu maso asa èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, do lasi ra'a-sisi, ra tenge era madhèdi dhu be'a risi, sèna ka dhèu ae rèdhi si.

source_text: those who devour widows' houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. these will receive greater condemnation.
target_text: de hua iia mi pajiko paie! rèngu kapod'e-kabèli bhèni balu ho parame rare èmu bhèni balu sèra. te ngaa ètu madha dhèu ae, rèngu pahuni bhabhelu ra sèra dènge j'ara titu ho sabaj'a pamadhera aae, sèna ka dhèu peka na, rèngu se dhèu mola. te ngaa limuri mai, na, ama lamatua hia huku dhu bia risi asa rèngu.

source_text: jesus sat down opposite the treasury and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. many who were rich cast in much.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus la'e madhèdi patangara dènge boaraka derma ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. na ladhe dhèu mai pamaso doi kolete asa d'ara boaraka èèna. ka na ladhe dhèu kaja sèra parèu doi ae.

source_text: a poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.
target_text: te ngaa abhu bhèni balu èci dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa mai manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na pamaso dua doi asa d'ara boaraka èèna. dua doi dhu na pamaso èèna, kab'ua ciki ood'e di.

source_text: he called his disciples to himself and said to them, most certainly i tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus gape ana madhutu na, ka na peka, mi ladhe ku bhèni balu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa nèi. na pamaso dhoka dua doi di, te ngaa nèngu hia risi eele nèti dhèu leo sèra.

source_text: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.
target_text: dhèu leo sèra hia kolete nèti doi sisa rèngu. te ngaa bhèni balu ne hia aa'i mèu-mèu doi nèngu asa lamatua.

source_text: as he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus dènge ana madhutu na sèra kalua nèti d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ropa rèngu d'ai li'u, hèia ana madhutu na èci paj'uj'u asa èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ka na peka, ama! ladhe ku èmu ne'e! ra tao rare, saraga bia. ra pagod'o rare hadhu sèra, mera titu kèna!

source_text: jesus said to him, do you see these great buildings? there will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, èmu ne mema saraga titu kèna! te nèbhu heka, dhèu paguri eele ne. ka hadhu-hadhu sèra, èci sa pamadhèdi heka ètu dedha èci.

source_text: as he sat on the mount of olives opposite the temple, peter, james, john, and andrew asked him privately,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus si lasi asa ledhe saitun, ka na madhèdi ètu era dhu patangara dènge èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. hèia petrus, yakobis, yohanis dènge anderias mai padhai lii dènge yesus.

source_text: tell us, when will these things be? what is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?
target_text: ra karèi, aku rèngu na, ama! lole hari ku, lii dhu ama ku peka dènge ji'i deo na. lod'o mia sèra sa j'aj'i? aa tadha-tadha na, samia?

source_text: jesus, answering, began to tell them, be careful that no one leads you astray.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, sad'i miu pajiko paie-iie, sèna ka baku lèke tipu.

source_text: for many will come in my name, saying, ‘i am he! ' and will lead many astray.
target_text: te ladhe èèna na, dhèu ae mai tèb'a kakara, ho ra peka na, ‘ja'a ne kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua moa nèti uru ka mai. ' aa ra leko-monya dhèu ae.

source_text: when you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don't be troubled. for those must happen, but the end is not yet.
target_text: ladhe miu mèdhi dhèu pamusu, do tadèngi lii lolo dhèu papara-pakèj'i dènge pakasiro ètu mia-mia, miu baku madha'u kahèi. sèra sa hud'i j'aj'i uuru ku. te ngaa lod'o èle rai-haha èèna dhae d'ai mèka.

source_text: for nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. there will be earthquakes in various places. there will be famines and troubles. these things are the beginning of birth pains.
target_text: dhèu nèti ca suku mai pamusu dènge suku leo, rai èci mai pamusu dènge rai leo. ètu mia-mia, j'aj'i rai opo dènge kabake-manganga. sèra sa j'aj'i tadha sama sèmi dhèu bhèni èci dhu kabake pèd'a neo nara iisi.

source_text: but watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. you will be beaten in synagogues. you will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.
target_text: de hua iia, na, miu mage-mage! te èèna na dhèu mai kèpa miu, ho ra nuni asa dhèu paredha agama dhu pama'ète lii agama. aa ra game miu ètu d'ara èmu-èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. ho èèna na rèti miu asa madha dhèu dhu dènge koasa, lula miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa be'a kahèi, ne'e ne miu abhu tebho ho peka kolongara ja'a mi rèngu.

source_text: the good news must first be preached to all the nations.
target_text: te dhèu unu ama lamatua hud'i lasi uuru ku lole lii lolo be'a ja'a mi suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, heka lod'o èle rai-haha ne d'ai kèna.

source_text: when they lead you away and deliver you up, don't be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. for it is not you who speak, but the holy spirit.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ladhe ra èki rèti miu asa era pama'ète lii langu, miu baku madha'u, peka na, ‘èèna na ja'a neo padhai lii ngaa? do, ja'a neo dhaa ngaa? ' ladhe d'ai lod'o èèna, miu padhai lii madhutu ngaa dhu roh mola-mèci ama lamatua peka dènge miu.

source_text: brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.
target_text: ètu d'ara èmu cue, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na a'ari nèngu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu ana dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na ama d'èlu na tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe abhu ina-ama dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na ana d'èlu rèngu tenge j'ara ho pamadhe si.

source_text: you will be hated by all men for my name's sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
target_text: de èèna na, dhèu d'èi boe miu, taga miu madhutu ja'a. te ngaa dhèu cee dhu bisa taha toke d'ai èle lod'o èèna, tatu ama lamatua hia mamuri mi nèngu.

source_text: but when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not let the reader understand, then let those who are in judea flee to the mountains,
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, èèna na, abhu dhèu èci dhu bhelu-katub'a risi eele mai. ho na mai maso ka titu ètu era laluri ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, dhu madhutu iia-iia na, nèngu bisa boe ètu era èèna, ho na pahera era èèna. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua tèke eele era èèna. ladhe miu mèdhi le sèmi èèna, na, mi pajiko paie-iie! cee dhu baca lii ne'e, pajiko paie kahèi! èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra, dètu ae le. ladhe mèdhi sèmi èèna, na, dhèu-dhèu ètu propensi yudea lega-rai asa kolo ledhe lasi.

source_text: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.
target_text: rèngu hud'i rai pamèri-mèri, sèna ka baku abhu j'aj'èra. ladhe dhèu mai le asa li'u, lèpa ia ka rare mèdha asa d'ara èmu.

source_text: let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu ètu d'ara oka, baku lèpa èmu rare mèdha-papake.

source_text: but woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!
target_text: dhu j'èra risi, dhèu bhèni dhu dènge babia, dènge ina dhu pasusu ana rara iisi hiu, lula rèngu rai rare boe.

source_text: pray that your flight won't be in the winter.
target_text: de hua iia risi miu sabaj'a, sèna ka lod'o j'aj'èra sèra baku lèke dènge hèru èj'i lai.

source_text: for in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which god created until now, and never will be.
target_text: te j'aj'èra lod'o èèna, bia titu kèna! mulai nèti ama lamatua tao rai-haha, toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu rèdhi mèka j'aj'èra dhu bia sèmi èèna. j'aj'èra bia sèmi èèna, lod'o limuri, j'aj'i heka hari.

source_text: unless the lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.
target_text: ladhe ama lamatua pab'ab'e boe lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu mamuri. te ngaa, taga ama lamatua sue dhèu dhu na hag'e nare sèra, ka na pab'ab'e lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra sèra.

source_text: then if anyone tells you, ‘look, here is the christ! ' or, ‘look, there! ' don't believe it.
target_text: ladhe lod'o d'ai na, miu tadèngi dhèu mai peka, aku rèngu na, ‘ladhe ku! kristus ètu ne'e! ' aa dhèu leo hari peka, aku rèngu na, ‘aad'o! kristus ètu nèi! ' miu baku nanene kahèi!

source_text: for false christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.
target_text: te ladhe èèna na, dhèu mai ho tèb'a kakara, peka na, ‘ja'a ne, kristus! ' aa cahag'e hari peka na, ‘ja'a ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. ' èèna na ra tao tadha malaa ae-ae dènge koasa nidhu, ho kapod'e-kabèli dhèu. rèngu patangi-tenge j'ara sèna ka dhèu unu ama lamatua lèke tipu kahèi!

source_text: but you watch. behold, i have told you all things beforehand.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu pajiko paie-iie! mema lod'o j'aj'èra bia èèna d'ai mèka, te ngaa ja'a pasanèd'e uuru miu!

source_text: but in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka hari dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe èle lod'o j'aj'èra sèra, na, ‘madha lod'o j'aj'i maroga, aa hèru heo heka.

source_text: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.
target_text: hua hètu-hua hètu bèbha nèti dedha-liru mai, aa koasa-koasa ètu dedha-liru j'aj'i kaco-balo. '

source_text: then they will see the son of man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
target_text: èle èèna, heka dhèu ladhe rèdhi ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne. èèna na ja'a mai dènge ra'i-liru nèti dedha. hèia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ladhe rèdhi a'èra dènge dadedha ja'a.

source_text: then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.
target_text: ka ja'a paredha ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga, ho puru lasi oru-kaboko dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a hag'e kore nèti mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne; nèti suu haa d'ai suu dhimu, nèti suu badae toke d'ai suu balèu.

source_text: now from the fig tree, learn this parable. when the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, ja'a kore upama nèti ana aaj'u. ladhe rèu na mulai karara, èèna tadha hèru hadhu dètu le!

source_text: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe miu mèdhi lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra sèra j'aj'i, sama sèmi lii peka ja'a deo na, èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, mamai ja'a dètu ae le.

source_text: most certainly i say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.
target_text: ne'e ne ja'a peka dènge miu kèna! nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri se, èèna na abhu cahag'e dhu dhae madhe mèka, te lod'o-lod'o dhu pènu dènge j'aj'èra na d'ai le.

source_text: heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.
target_text: masi ka liru dènge rai-haha ne ele, te ngaa lii holo-nori ja'a ele boe, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: but of that day or that hour no one knows-not even the angels in heaven, nor the son, but only the father.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii, peka na, dhèu èci sa re'a boe lod'o do jam dhu ja'a mai hari. ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga sèra re'a boe kahèi. ja'a mesa ku, ke'a boe kahèi. dhoka ama ku mesa na di, dhu ne'a.

source_text: watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don't know when the time is.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu aa'i-aa'i mi hud'i pajiko paie, lula miu me'a boe lod'o d'ai na.

source_text: it is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a laku tèke eele miu kèna, te ngaa èèna na ja'a mai hari. sama sèmi dhèu dhu la'e tèke eele èmu nèngu, ho la'e asa rai kaj'èu. na pua ana-ana nèngu j'aga paie èmu. aa na bagi hia si sasab'a. ka na paredha ana madhenga èmu, sèna ka na j'aga paie, toke d'ai nèngu lèpa hari.

source_text: watch therefore, for you don't know when the lord of the house is coming-whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;
target_text: miu hud'i j'aga mèda-mèu kahèi, lula miu me'a boe lod'o mia ja'a mai hari, sama sèmi ana madhenga èmu ne'a boe lod'o lamatua èmu na lèpa. lèpa lod'o nihia, talora mèda, oe mèu, lod'o rea, do lod'o nètu; miu me'a boe jam èèna.

source_text: lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping.
target_text: mage dhoka na mai sahèka, te abhu miu dhu bhèj'i luu era.

source_text: what i tell you, i tell all: watch!
target_text: de, ngaa dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne'e, ja'a peka lème dènge dhèu leo kahèi, ‘miu hud'i pajiko paie, ho mi soru mamai ja'a. ' d'ai sange ne'e ka, lamatua yesus padhai lii lula-nèti lod'o-lod'o j'aj'èra dhèu rai-haha, dènge ana madhutu na sèra ètu ledhe saitun.

source_text: it was now two days before the passover and the feast of unleavened bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him. for they said, not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.
target_text: èle èèna ka, kètu agama yahudi dènge mese agama sèra tenge j'ara neo kèpe yesus dènge mau-mau. te rèngu neo pamadhe ne. te ngaa ètu d'ara padhue èèna, ra peka na, taha ku! baku parai kèpe ne, lula lod'o kalela dètu le. mage dhoka dhèu ae sèra patao dènge èdhi. rèngu padhai lii sèmi èèna, lula dii dua lod'o ka, d'ai lod'o kalela dhèu yahudi, dhu biasa ra peka na, ‘paska' dènge ‘pesta roti dhu pake boe ragi'. kalela se pasanèd'e rèngu lod'o bèi-baki ra kalua nèti rai masir.

source_text: while he was at bethany, in the house of simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard-very costly. she broke the jar and poured it over his head.
