source_text: what is this word that he said, ‘you will seek me, and won't find me; ' and ‘where i am, you can't come'?
target_text: a'abhu na tasamia, ka na peka, na, ‘miu neo tenge ja'a, te ngaa paraga boe. ' aa, ‘ja'a laku asa era èci dhu miu bisa boe madhutu. '?

source_text: now on the last and greatest day of the feast, jesus stood and cried out, if anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!
target_text: d'ai lod'o oe èle kalela, dhu j'aj'i lod'o kapai risi èèna, hèia yesus kèd'i titu, ka na rodhe, peka na, nanene, ee! cee ka dhu koko-kamango, na, hud'i laa na mai asa ja'a ho ninu!

source_text: he who believes in me, as the scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.
target_text: cee dhu parcaya ja'a, na, mai sèna ka minu! te ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu suri tèke le, peka na, ‘èi dhu nèti mamuri, èèna na hae mai nèti d'ara dhèu-dhèu parcaya. ' ka rèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu bisa soru-bara dhèu leo, sèna ka ra abhu mamuri dhu lèke kahèi.

source_text: but he said this about the spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. for the holy spirit was not yet given, because jesus wasn't yet glorified.
target_text: yesus padhai lii lula-nèti roh ama lamatua, lula dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus abhu roh èèna. te ngaa lod'o yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, rèngu dhae sèmi rare mèka roh èèna, lula ama lamatua dhae hia mèka. ama lamatua mema hia mèka, lula na ded'e mèka padedha-dedha yesus.

source_text: many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, this is truly the prophet.
target_text: dhèu ae-ae ètu sèra nanene lii padhai yesus ne. hèia abhu dhu peka, na, tatu dhèu ne, dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, dhu na padhadha mema karèi nèti uru ka!

source_text: others said, this is the christ. but some said, what, does the christ come out of galilee?
target_text: abhu cahag'e dhu peka na, aad'o! nèngu ne, nuka kristus dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u karèi nèti uru ka mai! te ngaa cahag'e hari pab'ala, peka na, bisa boe! te kristus èèna, dhèu galilea boe. tare'a, si?

source_text: hasn't the scripture said that the christ comes of the offspring of david, and from bethlehem, the village where david was?
target_text: te sasuri ama lamatua suri, na, kristus èèna, ana-èpu nèti dhèu aae daud. ètu d'ara sasuri leo kahèi dhu suri, peka na, nèngu ne, dhèu betlehem, rae dhèu aae daud. sèmi èèna ka, si?

source_text: so a division arose in the multitude because of him.
target_text: ka dhèu se mulai pahag'a lula yesus.

source_text: some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu neo kèpe ne, te ngaa ca dhèu sa goi boe ne.

source_text: the officers therefore came to the chief priests and pharisees; and they said to them, why didn't you bring him?
target_text: èle ka, dhèu-dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhu mai neo kèpe yesus, lèpa asa kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu parisi sèra. hèia dhèu kapai se karèi, aku rèngu na, nga tao ka miu mèti boe ne mai?

source_text: the officers answered, no man ever spoke like this man!
target_text: hèia dhèu se dhaa, na, ira ii! ji'i dhae paraga ngèdhi mèka dènge dhèu èci sa dhu padhai lii sama sèmi dhèu nèi!

source_text: the pharisees therefore answered them, you aren't also led astray, are you?
target_text: ka dhèu parisi se karèi, aku rèngu na, heh! miu se lèke le tipu, si?

source_text: have any of the rulers or any of the pharisees believed in him?
target_text: sanèd'e! te nèti ji'i dhèu-dhèu parisi, do, ama-ama abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu lèka ne. tare'a, si? ladhe dhèu kapai parcaya boe, na, tasamia ka miu se lèka nèngu?

source_text: but this multitude that doesn't know the law is cursed.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae dhu neo parcaya ne, re'a boe atora ama lamatua. bèli-camèd'a rèngu dui rare huku dhu bia nèti ama lamatua!

source_text: nicodemus he who came to him by night, being one of them said to them,
target_text: te ngaa ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu parisi ca dhèu, ngara na nikodemus. nèngu ne'e ka dhu la'e asa yesus re mèda, ho padhai lii dènge ne. ka na karèi dhèu se'e, peka na,

source_text: does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?
target_text: tasamia? madhutu atora agama, èdhi pama'ète uru ku lii langu dhèu, do? do, èdhi hud'i nanene uuru ku lii lolo na, sèna ka te'a mèu dhèu ne tao ngaa, heka pama'ète lii langu na kèna?

source_text: they answered him, are you also from galilee? search and see that no prophet has arisen out of galilee.
target_text: hèia ra jèke ne, aku rèngu na, èu ne, dhèu galilea èci èèna ka dènge nèngu, do? parisa paie-iie uuru ku sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua! baca paie-iie sèna ka me'a mèu, na, abhu boe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu mai nèti galilea!

source_text: everyone went to his own house,
target_text: ka ra pacèri, èci-èci lèpa asa èmu ra.

source_text: but jesus went to the mount of olives.
target_text: te ngaa yesus la'e asa ledhe saitun.

source_text: now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. he sat down and taught them.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, nèngu la'e asa madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. dhèu ae mai pakaboko ètu madha nèngu. ka na madhèdi aj'a-nori si.

source_text: the scribes and the pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. having set her in the middle,
target_text: lod'o èèna, kèpe rare bhèni ca dhèu dhu talora na ad'u-ue j'ara makae. ka pèri-pèri mese agama dènge dhèu parisi ère rèti bhèni ne asa yesus. hèia ra laka-seti bhèni ne titu ètu madha rèngu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: they told him, teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.
target_text: ka ra peka dènge yesus, aku rèngu na, ama mese. kèpe ngare bhèni ne dhu talora nèngu dhu ad'u-ue j'ara makae.

source_text: now in our law, moses commanded us to stone such women. what then do you say about her?
target_text: ètu d'ara atora musa, abhu paredha èci dhu peka na, ‘dhèu dhu ad'u-ue j'ara makae dènge dhèu èmu na boe, hud'i abhu hahuku pèci toke madhe. ' de madhutu ama mese, na, tasamia?

source_text: they said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. but jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
target_text: dhèu se sèku ne, sèna ka abhu j'ara ho pèci sasala asa yesus ho pamanahu ne. yesus lii boe, te ngaa madhèdi pasaboti suri rai, pake suu kolo ai na.

source_text: but when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, he who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.
target_text: dhèu se loe boe karèi nèngu. hèia na titu, ka padhai lii, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. ladhe nèti miu abhu dhu tao mèdhi mèka sasala, na, nèngu ka dhu bisa pèci uuru ku, sèna ka huku bhèni ne'e.

source_text: again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.
target_text: ka na madhèdi pasaboti hari, hèia suri hari rai.

source_text: they, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.
target_text: ropa dhèu se tadèngi lii padhai na, rèngu j'aj'i makae. lula rèngu re'a ètu d'ara ra, rèngu ad'u-ue sasala kahèi. ka lasi ka èci-èci, mulai nèti dhèu heka toke d'ai ana ngèru, tèke eele dhodhoka yesus dènge bhèni ne ètu era èèna.

source_text: jesus, standing up, saw her and said, woman, where are your accusers? did no one condemn you?
target_text: hèia yesus titu hari, ka na karèi, eea! mia lasi? abhu heka ca dhèu sa ètu ne'e ho pèci sasala mi èu, do?

source_text: she said, no one, lord. jesus said, neither do i condemn you. go your way. from now on, sin no more.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o, ama. ka yesus lii dènge dhèu ne, peka na, ja'a neo boe huku èu kahèi. lèpa ka, te ngaa sanèd'e. tao ia ka sasala!

source_text: again, therefore, jesus spoke to them, saying, i am the light of the world. he who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.
target_text: ka yesus tuhu hari lii padhai dènge dhèu ae se, peka na, ja'a ne, nuka sèmi saraa hia dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. dhèu dhu madhutu ja'a mamuri boe ètu d'ara maroga, te ngaa na pea ètu d'ara saraa dhu nèti mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: the pharisees therefore said to him, you testify about yourself. your testimony is not valid.
target_text: abhu pèri-pèri dhèu parisi dhu pab'ala, peka na, weh! èu mesa mu neo j'aj'i sakasii nèti ngi'u èu unu mu, do? bisa boe sèmi èèna! te madhutu atora èdhi, hud'i dhèu leo ku dhu j'aj'i sakasii hia dhèu èci, bisa boe nèngu unu na. de ji'i ngo'o boe sèmi, aa ngo'o boe parcaya.

source_text: jesus answered them, even if i testify about myself, my testimony is true, for i know where i came from, and where i am going; but you don't know where i came from, or where i am going.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e. hud'i laa ja'a j'aj'i sakasii mi ngi'u ja'a mesa ku, te lii padhai ja'a ne, lèke. lula ja'a mesa ku ke'a mola-mola ja'a ne mai nèti mia, aa neo laku asa mia. miu me'a boe ja'a mai nèti mia, aa me'a boe neo laku asa mia kahèi.

source_text: you judge according to the flesh. i judge no one.
target_text: miu nile dhèu madhutu a'abhu dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ja'a madhutu boe a'abhu dhèu rai-haha ho nile dhèu èci sa.

source_text: even if i do judge, my judgment is true, for i am not alone, but i am with the father who sent me.
target_text: ladhe ja'a nile dhèu, a'uku dhu ja'a pake, lèke mola-mola. te ja'a mesa ku boe dhu nile dhèu, te ngaa ja'a tao aa'i-aa'i sama-sama dènge ama ku dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: it's also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.
target_text: baku bhèlu. te dhu suri tèke ètu atora agama miu, peka na, ‘ladhe abhu dhèu dua j'aj'i sakasii dhu padhue j'ara dhu sama, èèna lèke tare'a. '

source_text: i am one who testifies about myself, and the father who sent me testifies about me.
target_text: de ja'a mesa ku boe dhu j'aj'i sakasii mi ngi'u ja'a unu ku. te ama ku dhu pua ja'a, j'aj'i sakasii kahèi dhu padhai lii lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: they said therefore to him, where is your father? jesus answered, you know neither me nor my father. if you knew me, you would know my father also.
target_text: hèia dhèu se karèi, aku rèngu na, te ama èu èèna, ètu mia? ka yesus b'ala, peka na, miu se tadhe iie boe ja'a. miu tadhe boe kahèi ama ku. te ladhe miu tadhe iie ja'a, tatu miu tadhe ne kahèi.

source_text: jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i se, yesus peka-padhai lod'o nèngu aj'a-nori dhèu ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, padètu dènge era rèngu kaboko doi kolete. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu kèpe ne, lula d'ai mèka lod'o na.

source_text: jesus said therefore again to them, i am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. where i go, you can't come.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, bèli-camèd'a ja'a tèke eele miu, ho laku asa era leo. miu èèna na patangi-tenge ja'a, te ngaa mèdhi boe, te miu dhu dènge boe hak sèna ka lami asa era èèna. aa ladhe miu madhe, miu pasae sasala miu era.

source_text: the jews therefore said, will he kill himself, because he says, ‘where i am going, you can't come'?
target_text: hèia ama dhèu yahudi sèra pakarèi iisi-aanga ra, peka na, na padhai lii ngaa, nèi? neo pamadhe iisi na, do? te na peka, na, ‘miu bisa boe lami asa era èèna. '

source_text: he said to them, you are from beneath. i am from above. you are of this world. i am not of this world.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge dhèu se'e, aku nèngu na, miu nèti rai-haha. te ngaa ja'a mai nèti dedha-liru. miu dhèu nèti rai-haha ne, te ngaa ja'a nèti boe rai-haha ne.

source_text: i said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that i am he, you will die in your sins.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, deo na ja'a peka dènge miu, na, bèli-camèd'a ladhe miu madhe, miu pasae sasala-sasigo miu era. de ladhe miu parcaya boe, na, ja'a ne, kristus, dhu ama lamatua pua mai, ladhe miu madhe, tatu miu pasae sasala miu era.

source_text: they said therefore to him, who are you? jesus said to them, just what i have been saying to you from the beginning.
target_text: ka ra karèi, peka na, weeh! te èu ne, cee? yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhu peka mema karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: i have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. however, he who sent me is true; and the things which i heard from him, these i say to the world.
target_text: abhu j'ara ae dhu ja'a bisa peka lula-nèti miu. sasala miu ae kahèi. te ngaa ja'a pad'elo boe j'ara sèra. te dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, ladhe na padhai lii, ne'a dhoka peka dhu mola di. aa ja'a peka dènge dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tadèngi nèti nèngu di.

source_text: they didn't understand that he spoke to them about the father.
target_text: dhu nèngu padhue-padhai, nuka ama na ètu sorga. te ngaa dhèu se re'a rare boe sasoa lii padhai na.

source_text: jesus therefore said to them, when you have lifted up the son of man, then you will know that i am he, and i do nothing of myself, but as my father taught me, i say these things.
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, pe ladhe miu ded'e ka ja'a, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, heka miu me'a kèna, na, ja'a ne, kristus. aa ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa madhutu dad'èi ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa ja'a aj'a-nori dhoka j'ara-j'ara dhu ama ètu sorga aj'a-nori le ja'a.

source_text: he who sent me is with me. the father hasn't left me alone, for i always do the things that are pleasing to him.
target_text: dhu pua-paleha ja'a bera-bera dènge ja'a taruu. nèngu tèke eele nèdhi boe ja'a mesa-mesa ku, lula ja'a loe boe sab'a madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: as he spoke these things, many believed in him.
target_text: ropa yesus peka j'ara se'e, dhèu ae parcaya nèngu.

source_text: jesus therefore said to those jews who had believed him, if you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus peka dènge dhèu-dhèu yahudi dhu parcaya nèngu, na, ladhe miu mamuri pa'èki taruu dènge lii holo-nori ja'a, aa aj'a taruu nèti ja'a, na, miu bisa j'aj'i ana madhutu ja'a dhu lèke.

source_text: you will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.
target_text: miu bisa me'a mèu j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke. dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke sèra ka dhu patabuli miu, sèna ka miu j'aj'i ia ka ènu.

source_text: they answered him, we are abraham's offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. how do you say, ‘you will be made free'?
target_text: ka dhèu se pab'ala, aku rèngu na, hee! ji'i se, j'aj'i boe ènu dhèu! te ji'i se, ana-èpu abraham! de, nga tao ka èu peka, na, èèna na ji'i bebas?

source_text: jesus answered them, most certainly i tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke. te dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu d'ara sasala, j'aj'i sama sèmi ènu dhu dhoka madhutu dad'èi sasala di.

source_text: a bondservant doesn't live in the house forever. a son remains forever.
target_text: te ngaa dhu tema, sèmi ne'e: ènu se abhu boe pala nèti lamatua èmu na. te dhoka ana lamatua èmu di dhu abhu pala taruu ètu èèna.

source_text: if therefore the son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
target_text: de ja'a, nuka ana ama lamatua ne, ladhe saku eele sasala-sasigo miu, na, miu bebas, aa j'aj'i heka ènu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo. dènge j'ara ne, miu madhutu heka dad'èi sasala, aa tare'a-re'a bebas!

source_text: i know that you are abraham's offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
target_text: ja'a ke'a le miu se, ana-èpu abraham. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa miu loe boe patangi-tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ja'a, lula mo'o boe sèmi mere a'aj'a ja'a. te ètu d'ara miu, abhu heka era tatèka lii holo-nori ja'a.

source_text: i say the things which i have seen with my father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.
target_text: ja'a peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a kèdhi le, dhu ama ku paj'uj'u le dènge ja'a. aa miu tao madhutu j'ara-j'ara dhu miu tadèngi le nèti ama-ama miu.

source_text: they answered him, our father is abraham. jesus said to them, if you were abraham's children, you would do the works of abraham.
target_text: dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ji'i se, ana-èpu abraham! ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu j'aj'i tare'a-re'a ana-èpu abraham, miu hud'i madhutu j'ara mamuri nèngu.

source_text: but now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which i heard from god. abraham didn't do this.
target_text: te ngaa abraham tao boe bhabhelu sama sèmi dhu miu tao! te miu loe boe tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe ja'a. aa te ngaa ja'a ne, dhu peka dènge miu j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, dhu ja'a tadèngi nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: you do the works of your father. they said to him, we were not born of sexual immorality. we have one father, god.
target_text: tatao miu se mema beda boe nèti tatao ama miu. te ngaa rèngu pab'ala, aku rèngu na, heh! ji'i se, ana d'èlu! baku peka na ji'i se, ana ama aad'o! te ama ji'i, èci di, nuka ama lamatua!

source_text: therefore jesus said to them, if god were your father, you would love me, for i came out and have come from god. for i haven't come of myself, but he sent me.
target_text: hèia, aku yesus na, ladhe ama lamatua tare'a-re'a j'aj'i ama miu, tatu miu sue ja'a. te ja'a mai nèti nèngu, nèti èèna ka ja'a ka ne'e ne. ja'a mai ne madhutu boe dad'èi ja'a mesa ku. te ngaa ja'a mai, lula nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: why don't you understand my speech? because you can't hear my word.
target_text: nga tao ka miu dhane mere boe lii padhai ja'a? ele boe, lula miu mema mo'o boe nanene!

source_text: you are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. he was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn't stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. when he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.
target_text: miu se, ca ropa dènge dhèu aae nidhu. te miu d'èi madhutu dad'èi na! karèi nèti uru j'ara ka, nèngu d'èi dhoka pamadhe dhèu. nèngu lab'a j'ara dhu lèke, lula na tule eele j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke! ladhe na kapod'e-kabèli, mema sasab'a na kèna. te nèngu ne, tuka kapod'e-kabèli, aa baki nèti leko-monya!

source_text: but because i tell the truth, you don't believe me.
target_text: ja'a ne'e ka dhu lole j'ara dhu lèke. te ngaa miu parcaya boe ja'a.

source_text: which of you convicts me of sin? if i tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
target_text: pangee sèku! nèti miu se, cee ka dhu bisa pad'elo bukti, peka na, ja'a ne ad'u-ue sasala? malaa, nga! ladhe ja'a peka lèke, nga tao ka miu mo'o boe lèka ja'a?

source_text: he who is of god hears the words of god. for this cause you don't hear, because you are not of god.
target_text: dhèu dhu j'aj'i nèti ama lamatua nanene lii holo-nori na. te ngaa miu se j'aj'i boe nèti ama lamatua, nèti èèna ka miu mo'o boe nanene ja'a.

source_text: then the jews answered him, don't we say well that you are a samaritan, and have a demon?
target_text: ama-ama dhèu yahudi b'ala, peka na, lii padhai ji'i lèke tare'a-re'a. te ji'i dhu peka le, na, èu ne, dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa dhèu samaria. èu ne nidhu tao!

source_text: jesus answered, i don't have a demon, but i honor my father and you dishonor me.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a nidhu tao boe. ja'a pakab'ua ama ku ètu sorga, te ngaa miu mo'o boe pakab'ua ja'a.

source_text: but i don't seek my own glory. there is one who seeks and judges.
target_text: ja'a padedha boe iisi ho pad'elo kolo-karisi ja'a. te ngaa abhu èci dhu neo pad'elo dadedha ja'a. hud'i laa nèngu ka dhu pama'ète, na, lii padhai ja'a ne lèke, do aad'o.

source_text: most certainly, i tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.
target_text: lii holo-nori ja'a, lèke tare'a. de dhèu dhu nanene aa tao madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a, madhe boe.

source_text: then the jews said to him, now we know that you have a demon. abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘if a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death. '
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii ne, hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se peka dènge ne, aku rèngu na, limuri ne ji'i nge'a le èu dhèu huj'u, lula nidhu tao le èu. te abraham, madhe. dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua uru-uru sèra, madhe le kahèi. te ngaa aku èu, na, ‘dhèu dhu nanene dènge madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a, madhe boe. ' mema èu ne tare'a-re'a huj'u le!

source_text: are you greater than our father abraham, who died? the prophets died. who do you make yourself out to be?
target_text: do, èu ne pangee, na, èu ne kapai risi nèti abraham dhu madhe le? do, èu kapai risi nèti dhèu-dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua dhu madhe sèra? èu ngee, na, èu ne, cee?

source_text: jesus answered, if i glorify myself, my glory is nothing. it is my father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our god.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, ladhe ja'a ka dhu padedha iisi, dhèu ro'o boe sèmi rare. madhutu iia-iia, na, ja'a boe ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha iisi, te ngaa dhu ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha nuka ama ku. nèngu ne'e ka dhu miu mangaku, na, nèngu j'aj'i ama lamatua miu.

source_text: you have not known him, but i know him. if i said, ‘i don't know him, ' i would be like you, a liar. but i know him and keep his word.
target_text: te ngaa miu tadhe boe ne. dhu tadhe mèu ka ja'a ne. ladhe ja'a peka na ja'a tadhe boe ne, ja'a leko-monya, sama sèmi miu. te ngaa ja'a tadhe mèu ne, aa ja'a tao madhutu lii holo-nori na kahèi.

source_text: your father abraham rejoiced to see my day. he saw it and was glad.
target_text: d'ara baki miu abraham karej'e titu kèna, lod'o na tatae neo nèdhi mamai ja'a. nèngu mema nèdhi le, ka na karej'e-karae.

source_text: the jews therefore said to him, you are not yet fifty years old! have you seen abraham?
target_text: ama-ama dhèu yahudi se b'ala ne, aku rèngu na, umur èu dhae d'ai mèka lèmi nguru tèu sa hèi! te ngaa èu peka na, mèdhi le abraham. tare'a, do?

source_text: jesus said to them, most certainly, i tell you, before abraham came into existence, i am.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a! te dhae rara iisi mèka abraham, ja'a dhu mema-mema le.

source_text: therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.
target_text: ka dhèu se rare hadhu ho neo pèci ne, lula na tao iisi sama sèmi ama lamatua. te ngaa yesus kako mau-mau kalua nèti madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: as he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.
target_text: hèia yesus si kako taruu. ka na ladhe nèdhi dhèu bèdhu ca dhèu, dhu bèdhu karèi nèti ina na nara iisi nèngu.

source_text: his disciples asked him, rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?
target_text: hèia ana-ana madhutu na karèi, aku rèngu na, ama mese! cee ka tao sasala, ka dhèu ne bèdhu? nèti nèngu mesa na, do, nèti ina-ama na?

source_text: jesus answered, this man didn't sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of god might be revealed in him.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, peka na, dhèu bèdhu ne tao boe sala. aa ina-ama na aad'o kahèi. rara iisi na sèmi ne'e, ho hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra ladhe rèdhi tatao ama lamatua dhu be'a mi dedha nèngu.

source_text: i must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. the night is coming, when no one can work.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a. de èdhi hud'i tenge j'ara, sèna ka pakako sasab'a na, lod'o saraa era. te ladhe maroga mai, dhèu bisa heka sab'a.

source_text: while i am in the world, i am the light of the world.
target_text: ropa ja'a ètu rai-haha ne era, ja'a nuka sèmi saraa dhu d'elo hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: when he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man's eyes with the mud,
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, ka na paru'e ilu mi rai. hèia na madhèdi pasaboti, ho pakihu rai ne j'aj'i kabheca. ka na lame musi madha dhèu ne dènge kabheca deo na.

source_text: and said to him, go, wash in the pool of siloam which means sent. so he went away, washed, and came back seeing.
target_text: hèia na peka, na, lamu asa kolam siloam, sèna ka riu rèhu èu. ètu d'ara lii ibrani, siloam, sasoa na, ‘nèti mai'. ka dhèu bèdhu ne la'e, ka riu rèhu na. ropa na lèpa hari mai, nèngu bisa nèdhi le!

source_text: therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, isn't this he who sat and begged?
target_text: hèia rae lesa dènge dhèu dhu rèdhi ne, dhu tema manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu, ra pakarèi èci dènge èci, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, dhèu bèdhu dhu tema madhèdi ho kanata ai manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu, sina ma?

source_text: others were saying, it is he. still others were saying, he looks like him. he said, i am he.
target_text: dhèu cahag'e dhaa, peka na, oo! nèngu ka! dhèu cahag'e hari, peka na, aad'o! nèngu ne, rèhu na oe sèmi dhèu èèna! te ngaa dhèu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o! ja'a èèna ka, ne'e ne! dhu uru èèna bèdhu!

source_text: they therefore were asking him, how were your eyes opened?
target_text: ka dhèu se karèi ne, peka na, tasamia ka èu bisa ladhe mèdhi?

source_text: he answered, a man called jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘go to the pool of siloam and wash. ' so i went away and washed, and i received sight.
target_text: hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! dhèu dhu ngara yesus èèna, pakihu kabheca ka lame mi musi madha ja'a. ka na pua ja'a, aku nèngu na, ‘lamu asa kolam siloam, ho riu rèhu èu ètu nèi. ' hèia ja'a tao madhutu sèmi èèna. nèti èèna ka, ja'a bisa ladhe kèdhi le!

source_text: then they asked him, where is he? he said, i don't know.
target_text: èle ka dhèu se karèi ne, peka na, dhèu èèna, ètu mia? ka na dhaa, ke'a boe, mia la'e!

source_text: they brought him who had been blind to the pharisees. it was a sabbath when jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ropa yesus pakihu rai j'aj'i kabheca, ka puri-pa'èle dhèu bèdhu ho bisa ladhe nèdhi èèna, lèke dènge lod'o a'ae sasab'a dhèu yahudi. ka lere rèti dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu, asa madha dhèu-dhèu partei agama parisi.

source_text: again therefore the pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. he said to them, he put mud on my eyes, i washed, and i see.
target_text: ka dhèu parisi se karèi ne, èu lolo ku laa! tasamia ka èu bisa ladhe mèdhi? dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e. dhèu èèna tao kabheca mi musi madha ja'a. ka laku riu rèhu. hèia limuri ne, ja'a bisa kèdhi le.

source_text: some therefore of the pharisees said, this man is not from god, because he doesn't keep the sabbath. others said, how can a man who is a sinner do such signs? so there was division among them.
target_text: ka abhu dhèu parisi cahag'e, peka na, dhèu dhu puri-pa'èle èu èèna, mai boe nèti ama lamatua. ji'i nge'a, lula nèngu sisu atora nèti lod'o a'ae sasab'a. aa abhu cahag'e hari, peka na, tasamia ka dhèu dhu ad'u-ue sasala bisa tao tadha-tadha malaa sèmi sèra? ka rèngu patao-palaha èci dènge èci toke ra pahag'a.

source_text: therefore they asked the blind man again, what do you say about him, because he opened your eyes? he said, he is a prophet.
target_text: hèia ra karèi hari dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu, aku rèngu na, madhutu a'abhu èu, dhèu dhu puri-pabe'a musi madha èu ne, dhèu sèmi ngaa sa? dhèu ne b'ala, peka na, madhutu a'abhu ja'a, dhèu èèna ca dhèu nèti dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua.

source_text: the jews therefore didn't believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,
target_text: te ngaa ama-ama dhèu yahudi se ro'o boe lèka, na, dhèu ne uru èèna bèdhu, ka limuri ne bisa nèdhi le. hèia ra pua dhèu lasi paroa ina-ama na mai.

source_text: and asked them, is this your son, whom you say was born blind? how then does he now see?
target_text: ropa ina-ama na mai d'ai madha si, hèia ama-ama se karèi, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne, ana miu, do? tare'a, do aad'o, nèngu ne dhu bèdhu mema karèi nèti mera iisi ne? tasamia ka limuri ne nèngu bisa ladhe nèdhi?

source_text: his parents answered them, we know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
target_text: ka ina-ama dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu ne, mema ana ji'i. aa na bèdhu karèi nèti ngara iisi ne.

source_text: but how he now sees, we don't know; or who opened his eyes, we don't know. he is of age. ask him. he will speak for himself.
target_text: te ngaa ji'i nge'a boe, na pake ngaa ka musi madha na bisa nèdhi sèmi ne'e. cee ka dhu puri-pa'èle musi madha na, ji'i nge'a boe kahèi. nèngu kapai le, de karèi ne, te nèngu bisa lolo unu na!

source_text: his parents said these things because they feared the jews; for the jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.
target_text: dua ra padhai lii sèmi èèna, lula rèngu madha'u dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi. lula re'a, na, ama-ama dhèu yahudi se dhu rare le lii èci, peka na, ladhe abhu dhèu mangaku, na, yesus ne, nuka kristus, na, babège eele dhèu sèra nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a èdhi dhèu yahudi.

source_text: therefore his parents said, he is of age. ask him.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ina-ama dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, nèngu kapai le. de karèi ne.

source_text: so they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, give glory to god. we know that this man is a sinner.
target_text: hèia ra paroa hari dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu. ka ra karèi ne, sèmi ne'e! èu hud'i peka ku mola-mola ètu madha ama lamatua, sèna ka j'aga paie kolongara na. te ji'i nge'a, na, yesus ne, dhèu bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: he therefore answered, i don't know if he is a sinner. one thing i do know: that though i was blind, now i see.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, ama si baku nasa! te ja'a ke'a boe, na, nèngu èèna, dhèu bhelu, do aad'o. dhu ja'a ke'a mola-mola, nuka, uru èèna ja'a bèdhu, te ngaa limuri ne ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: they said to him again, what did he do to you? how did he open your eyes?
target_text: hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, te na tao èu tasamia? tasamia na bhoke musi madha èu?

source_text: he answered them, i told you already, and you didn't listen. why do you want to hear it again? you don't also want to become his disciples, do you?
target_text: dhèu ne dhaa, na, eee! te deo na ja'a lole le, te ngaa miu mo'o boe nanene. tasamia ka miu neo ja'a lolo hari? ele boe ama si neo j'aj'i ana madhutu na, do?

source_text: they insulted him and said, you are his disciple, but we are disciples of moses.
target_text: ka ra padhai pa-aape ne, hèia ra peka, hud'i laa èu ka j'aj'i ana madhutu na! te ji'i se, ana madhutu musa.

source_text: we know that god has spoken to moses. but as for this man, we don't know where he comes from.
target_text: ji'i nge'a ama lamatua ka dhu padhai lii dènge musa. te ngaa nge'a boe dhèu èèna bhodho nèti ro'a mia.

source_text: the man answered them, how amazing! you don't know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
target_text: ka dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu na, dhaa, ja'a malaa, nga! miu me'a boe nèngu mai nèti mia. aa te ngaa nèngu ka dhu bhoke pamèu musi madha ja'a, ka ja'a bisa kèdhi.

source_text: we know that god doesn't listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of god and does his will, he listens to him.
target_text: èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti te'a, na, ama lamatua parluu boe nanene lii dhèu bhelu, si? te ngaa ama lamatua nanene dhèu d'ara mola, dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi na.

source_text: since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.
target_text: karèi nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha toke d'ai sange ne'e, abhu mèka lii lolo èci sa hèi, lula-nèti dhèu dhu puri-pabe'a dhèu bèdhu karèi rara iisi ne, ho nèngu bisa nèdhi.

source_text: if this man were not from god, he could do nothing.
target_text: de ladhe yesus mai boe nèti ama lamatua, tatu nèngu bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa, sina ma?

source_text: they answered him, you were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us? then they threw him out.
target_text: hèia ra b'ala, aku rèngu na, wee! èu ne, dhèu bhelu karèi ina mu nara iisi èu! èu ngee, na, èu bisa aj'a hari ji'i, do? ka ra babège eele dhèu ne nèti èmu sabaj'a rèngu.

source_text: jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, do you believe in the son of god?
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi rèngu babège eele dhèu dhu uru èèna bèdhu nèti èmu sabaj'a ra, hèia na la'e tenge dhèu ne, toke abhu. ka na peka, tasamia! èu parcaya dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a ne, do?

source_text: he answered, who is he, lord, that i may believe in him?
target_text: ka dhèu ne karèi hari ne, aku nèngu na, ama, te nèngu èèna cee? peka ku laa, sèna ka ja'a bisa parcaya ne.

source_text: jesus said to him, you have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.
target_text: hèia yesus peka, na, èu paraga le dènge ne. nèngu èèna, nuka ja'a ne, dhu padhai lii dènge èu ne.

source_text: he said, lord, i believe! and he worshiped him.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama, ja'a parcaya! hèia na patitu kètu urutuu pahaha iisi mi yesus.

source_text: jesus said, i came into this world for judgment, that those who don't see may see; and that those who see may become blind.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, mamai ja'a asa rai-haha ne, sèna ka pad'elo sasala-sasigo dhèu, ho dhèu bèdhu bisa ladhe rèdhi, aa dhèu dhu rèdhi bisa j'aj'i bèdhu.

source_text: those of the pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, are we also blind?
target_text: ètu era èèna abhu dhèu parisi pèri-pèri, dhu tadèngi lii padhai yesus. hèia ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, tasamia! ji'i se bèdhu boe, sina ma?

source_text: jesus said to them, if you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘we see. ' therefore your sin remains.
target_text: yesus b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ladhe musi madha miu bèdhu, abhu boe dhu pasala miu. te ngaa lula miu peka, na, miu bisa mèdhi, nèti èèna ka miu pasae sasala miu era.

source_text: most certainly, i tell you, one who doesn't enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.
target_text: yesus padhai lii pake lii pakasame, peka na, dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. abhu kahib'i-kalèbho dènge oka ra. ladhe dhèu maso boe re hèb'a oka, te ngaa ca'e re kolo oka, na, te'a le, nèngu ne, dhèu mana'u.

source_text: but one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe maso re hèb'a oka, nuka dhèu madhenga dhu piara kahib'i-kalèbho sèra.

source_text: the gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
target_text: dhèu j'aga hèb'a oka, tadhe dhèu madhenga kahib'i-kalèbho, hèia na bhoke babèdho hia nèngu. kahib'i-kalèbho se tadhe lii dhèu madhenga badha kahèi. ka ropa dhèu madhenga ne paroa ngara ra èci-èci, kahib'i-kalèbho se madhutu ne asa li'u.

source_text: whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
target_text: ladhe dhèu madhenga ne neo nèti si asa mia, nèngu kako uuru. kahib'i-kalèbho se madhutu ne re limuri, lula ra tadhe lii na.

source_text: they will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don't know the voice of strangers.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu kahib'i-kalèbho tadhe boe, na, rèngu madhutu boe ne. te ngaa ra rai pakaj'èu, lula rèngu tadhe boe lii dhèu leo.

source_text: jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn't understand what he was telling them.
target_text: masi ka yesus lole lii pakasame ne hia dhèu se'e, te ngaa re'a boe sasoa na.

source_text: jesus therefore said to them again, most certainly, i tell you, i am the sheep's door.
target_text: ka yesus peka tabha hari dènge dhèu sèra, aku nèngu na, dhu ja'a lole dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. ja'a ne nuka sèmi hèb'a oka kahib'i-kalèbho.

source_text: all who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn't listen to them.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mai uuru nèti ja'a, rèngu sama sèmi dhèu mana'u. masi ka rèngu loe boe paroa, te ngaa kahib'i-kalèbho se nanene boe lii rèngu.

source_text: i am the door. if anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.
target_text: aa ja'a ne èci èèna ka dènge hèb'a oka èèna. ladhe abhu dhèu neo maso re ja'a, ama lamatua neo patabuli ne nèti koasa sasala-sasigo na. èèna sama sèmi nèngu la'e asa era ama lamatua, maso re ja'a dhu j'aj'i hèb'a oka. aa dhèu dhu maso re ja'a, nèngu neo asa mia èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe, dènge abhu na'a-ninu dhu be'a.

source_text: the thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. i came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
target_text: dhèu mana'u re'a dhoka tao maruru di, te rèngu mai ho mana'u, pamadhe dhèu, aa pa'ele iie mamuri dhèu. te ngaa ja'a kèti mamuri dhu hua iia titu kèna, te mamai ja'a ne, sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri mera-milu, aa unu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: i am the good shepherd. the good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
target_text: ja'a kahèi nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu be'a. te dhèu madhenga dhu be'a, sadia saraka ngi'u na toke madhe, sèna ka kahib'i-kalèbho na bisa mamuri.

source_text: he who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn't own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. the wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu sab'a dhu lamatua boe nèti kahib'i-kalèbho sèra, ropa nèdhi busa hui mai, na rai pakaj'èu, tèke eele kahib'i-kalèbho se. hèia busa hui ne kadhi nare kahib'i-kalèbho, ka rèngu cahag'e rai paceb'a.

source_text: the hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn't care for the sheep.
target_text: dhèu sab'a èèna rai, lula nèngu dhoka sab'a tenge doi di. na pusi-pahae boe j'aga paie-iie kahib'i-kalèbho sèra.

source_text: i am the good shepherd. i know my own, and i'm known by my own;
target_text: lèke tare'a! ja'a ne nuka sèmi dhèu madhenga badha dhu be'a. ja'a tadhe hua iia kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a sèra. aa rèngu tadhe ja'a kahèi.

source_text: even as the father knows me, and i know the father. i lay down my life for the sheep.
target_text: èèna, èci èèna ka dènge ama ku ètu sorga tadhe ja'a, aa ja'a tadhe nèngu kahèi. ja'a sadia kore le ho soro iisi ja'a toke madhe, sèna ka kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a bisa mamuri.

source_text: i have other sheep which are not of this fold. i must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. they will become one flock with one shepherd.
target_text: abhu kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a dhu leo era, dhu dhae kaboko kore mèka sèna ka pa'èci dènge kahib'i-kalèbho ètu se'e se. ja'a hud'i eo pa'oru kore si mi ca era kahèi. ropa rèngu tadèngi lii ja'a, rèngu tadhe dènge. hèia ra mai pa'èci, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ca kaboko dhu dènge dhèu madhenga èci.

source_text: therefore the father loves me, because i lay down my life, that i may take it again.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama ku ètu sorga sue ja'a. te ja'a dhu sadia le soro iisi ja'a toke madhe, sèna ka ja'a bisa mamuri hari.

source_text: no one takes it away from me, but i lay it down by myself. i have power to lay it down, and i have power to take it again. i received this commandment from my father.
target_text: abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu laka-seti ja'a ho madhe, te ngaa ja'a mesa ku soro iisi la'a toke madhe. ja'a dènge hak ho soro ngi'u ja'a, aa dènge hak kahèi sèna ka kore hari. paredha ne, dhu ja'a sèmi kore le nèti ama ku ètu sorga.

source_text: therefore a division arose again among the jews because of these words.
target_text: lula dhèu se tadèngi lii padhai yesus sèmi èèna, ka dhèu yahudi se pab'ala hari isi-aanga ra.

source_text: many of them said, he has a demon and is insane! why do you listen to him?
target_text: abhu dhèu ae nèti rèngu dhu peka na, dhèu ne, huj'u! aa nidhu tao ne! nga tao ka miu d'èi nanene ne?

source_text: others said, these are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. it isn't possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e peka na, ne'e ne nèti boe lii padhai dhèu huj'u, sina ma? lii padhai sèmi se'e se, kalua boe nèti d'ara hèb'a nidhu! aa nidhu sèra bisa boe kahèi puri-pa'èle musi madha dhèu bèdhu, si?

source_text: it was the feast of the dedication at jerusalem.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu yahudi neo tao kalela agama rèngu. lod'o be'a ne, lèke dènge hèru pacuhi. pesta ne, pasanèd'e dhèu yahudi lod'o dhu dhèu leo mai pakaj'alu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua ètu kota yerusalem, ka ra pamèu ne sèna ka ringi hari ca tèka.

source_text: it was winter, and jesus was walking in the temple, in solomon's porch.
target_text: yesus kako palème ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne, ètu era dhu ra pangare na, ‘paleo dhèu aae soleman'.

source_text: the jews therefore came around him and said to him, how long will you hold us in suspense? if you are the christ, tell us plainly.
target_text: hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi mai lingu rare ne, ka ra peka, eeh! ji'i se mate toke d'ai pèri lod'o hari, ho nge'a? ladhe èu ne, nuka kristus, na, peka mola-mola.

source_text: jesus answered them, i told you, and you don't believe. the works that i do in my father's name, these testify about me.
target_text: yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhu peka mema le, te ngaa miu mo'o boe lèka. aa te ngaa j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tao, aa'i-aa'i madhutu paredha ama ku di. j'ara se'e se ka dhu pad'elo, na, ja'a ne, cee.

source_text: but you don't believe, because you are not of my sheep, as i told you.
target_text: te ngaa miu mo'o boe lèka ja'a, lula miu se kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a boe.

source_text: my sheep hear my voice, and i know them, and they follow me.
target_text: te kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a dhu tare'a sèra, tadhe lii ja'a. rèngu madhutu ja'a, aa ja'a tadhe rèngu kahèi.

source_text: i give eternal life to them. they will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
target_text: ja'a hia si mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, aa rèngu cèri eele boe nèti ama lamatua kahèi. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa parame rare si nèti ja'a.

source_text: my father who has given them to me is greater than all. no one is able to snatch them out of my father's hand.
target_text: ama ku ètu sorga ka dhu pangèd'u rèngu mi ja'a. nèngu èra risi aa'i mèu-mèu. nèti èèna ka, abhu boe ca dhèu sa hèi, dhu bisa parame rare si nèti nèngu.

source_text: i and the father are one.
target_text: te ama ku dènge ja'a ne, èci.

source_text: therefore the jews took up stones again to stone him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se rare hari hadhu, neo pèci pamadhe yesus.

source_text: jesus answered them, i have shown you many good works from my father. for which of those works do you stone me?
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a pad'elo le j'ara dhu be'a ae-ae nèti ama ku. miu pake j'ara be'a mia, ho neo pèci pamadhe ja'a?

source_text: the jews answered him, we don't stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself god.
target_text: hèia dhèu se dhaa, peka na, ji'i pèci boe èu lula èu tao j'ara be'a. te ngaa ji'i huku èu dènge j'ara pèci pake hadhu, lula èu pahahe ama lamatua. te èu dhoka dhèu rai-haha di, te ngaa tao iisi mu nuka sèmi ama lamatua! seli-kolane, nga!

source_text: jesus answered them, isn't it written in your law, ‘i said, you are gods'?
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, peka na, tasamia? ètu d'ara atora agama dhu miu mèd'u, dhu suri na, ‘ja'a peka mema, na, miu ama-ama se, dewa'.

source_text: if he called them gods, to whom the word of god came and the scripture can't be broken,
target_text: èdhi te'a le, na, aa'i-aa'i dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, lèke, aa bisa boe core eele. ama lamatua mesa na dhu peka le dhèu sèra, na, rèngu se, ‘dewa'.

source_text: do you say of him whom the father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘you blaspheme, ' because i said, ‘i am the son of god'?
target_text: de tasamia ka miu bisa peka, na, ja'a ne pahahe ama lamatua lula ja'a peka, na, ja'a ne ana ama lamatua? maso boe asa d'ara kahadhu, si! te ama ètu sorga ka dhu paj'uj'u ja'a aa pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: if i don't do the works of my father, don't believe me.
target_text: sèmi ne'e. ladhe ja'a pakako boe sasab'a-la'a ama ku, na, miu baku parcaya ja'a.

source_text: but if i do them, though you don't believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the father is in me, and i in the father.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a pakako taruu sasab'a ama ku. de masi ka miu lèka boe ja'a, te ngaa miu hud'i sèmi mere ku tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao. dènge sèmi èèna, miu bisa me'a kahèi, na, ama ku dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. aa ja'a pa'èki dènge nèngu kahèi.

source_text: they sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.
target_text: ka dhèu se sèku kèpe ne hari, te ngaa na tabhèli eele nèti kacui-aai rèngu.

source_text: he went away again beyond the jordan into the place where john was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.
target_text: hèia yesus la'e hari asa cabèka loko yarden, ètu era dhu uru èèna yohanis sarani dhèu. ka na pea taha ètu nèi.

source_text: many came to him. they said, john indeed did no sign, but everything that john said about this man is true.
target_text: dhèu ae mai tenge ne. hèia ra peka, aku rèngu na, yohanis tao nèdhi boe tadha malaa. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu nèngu lole lula-nèti yesus ne, lèke tare'a-re'a!

source_text: many believed in him there.
target_text: ka dhèu ae ètu nèi parcaya yesus.

source_text: now a certain man was sick, lazarus from bethany, of the village of mary and her sister, martha. it was that mary who had anointed the lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother lazarus was sick.
target_text: abhu dhèu èci, ngara na lasarus. nèngu pea ètu rae betania, sama-sama dènge a'a na bhèni dhèu dua, maria dènge marta. maria ne'e, ka dhu pakose haga lamatua yesus dènge èi hèu mèngi, ka pamèu pake rèu kètu na. ca lod'o, ka lasarus pèd'a aae.

source_text: the sisters therefore sent to him, saying, lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.
target_text: ka ana hèni na dhèu dua se pa'adhu lii moa hia yesus, aku rèngu na, lasarus, angalai ama èèna, pèd'a aae.

source_text: but when jesus heard it, he said, this sickness is not to death, but for the glory of god, that god's son may be glorified by it.
target_text: ropa yesus tadèngi lii moa ne, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, èi papèd'a ne nèti boe mamadhe. ama lamatua neo pake j'ara ne'e ho pad'elo dadedha na. sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a, nuka ana ama lamatua ne.

source_text: now jesus loved martha, and her sister, and lazarus.
target_text: yesus sue marta, maria, dènge ari ra lasarus.

source_text: when therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.
target_text: lod'o na tadèngi, na, lasarus dhu pèd'a, yesus pea dua lod'o era ètu cabèka loko yarden.

source_text: then after this he said to the disciples, let's go into judea again.
target_text: ka na peka dènge ana madhutu na sèra, aku nèngu na, mai lati hari asa era pea lasarus ètu propensi yudea.

source_text: the disciples asked him, rabbi, the jews were just trying to stone you. are you going there again?
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu na pab'ala, peka na, ama mese. lai-lai ne, ama-ama dhèu yahudi sèra neo pèci pamadhe ama ètu nèi. te ngaa ama neo lamu hari asa nèi?

source_text: jesus answered, aren't there twelve hours of daylight? if a man walks in the day, he doesn't stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
target_text: ka yesus dhaa, na, baku madha'u! bèli-bèli, nèti lod'o rea toke lod'o cèna, canguru dua jam, si? ladhe kako ètu d'ara saraa, dhèu kadhunu boe. te saraa pasaraa rai-haha ho dhèu bisa ladhe rèdhi dènge be'a.

source_text: but if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn't in him.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu kako ètu d'ara maroga, na kadhunu pahari-pahari, te dènge boe saraa.

source_text: he said these things, and after that, he said to them, our friend lazarus has fallen asleep, but i am going so that i may awake him out of sleep.
target_text: yesus padhai lii èle, ka na peka, angalai èdhi lasarus bhèj'i le. te ngaa pe ja'a laku parèi ne.

source_text: the disciples therefore said, lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.
target_text: hèia ana madhutu na peka, na, ama, ladhe nèngu bhèj'i di, sasoa na, èèna na nèngu èle nèti papèd'a, si?

source_text: now jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.
target_text: ra peka sèmi èèna, lula rèngu ngee, na, yesus padhai lii lula-nèti bhèj'i dhu biasa di. aa te ngaa, yesus lole lula-nèti mamadhe lasarus.

source_text: so jesus said to them plainly then, lazarus is dead.
target_text: hèia yesus peka mola-mola dènge ra, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e. lasarus madhe le.

source_text: i am glad for your sakes that i was not there, so that you may believe. nevertheless, let's go to him.
target_text: aa te ngaa ja'a karej'e lula ja'a aad'o ètu nèi lod'o dhu na madhe mèka, sèna ka miu baku susa. te, ngaa dhu j'aj'i ne'e, èèna ka dhu tao miu bisa parcaya ja'a. mai lati ka!

source_text: thomas therefore, who is called didymus, said to his fellow disciples, let's also go, that we may die with him.
target_text: hèia tomas, dhu dhèu paroa, na, ana kembar, peka dènge ana madhutu dhu leo sèra, aku nèngu na, mai ka! be'a risi aa'i-aa'i ti lati, sèna ka madhe palere-lere dènge ne.

source_text: so when jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already. now bethany was near jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away. many of the jews had joined the women around martha and mary, to console them concerning their brother.
target_text: ka yesus si lasi asa rae betania. rae ne, kaj'èu nèti yerusalem tèlu kilometer di. ka dhèu yahudi nèti nèi, ae ka dhu mai beke, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara marta dènge maria. ropa yesus si d'ai nèi, heka re'a, na, dhèu padhane le lasarus èpa lod'o kèna.

source_text: then when martha heard that jesus was coming, she went and met him, but mary stayed in the house.
target_text: ka lod'o marta tadèngi, na, yesus mai le, hèia la'e paraga dènge yesus. te ngaa maria mate ètu èmu.

source_text: therefore martha said to jesus, lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn't have died.
target_text: hèia marta lii dènge yesus, peka na, ama, ee! ladhe ama ètu ne'e, tatu ari ja'a madhe boe.

source_text: even now i know that whatever you ask of god, god will give you.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a parcaya kahèi, sad'i ama manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti ama lamatua, tatu abhu.

source_text: jesus said to her, your brother will rise again.
target_text: ka yesus lii dènge ne, peka na, marta! èèna na, ari mu mamuri hari.

source_text: martha said to him, i know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
target_text: marta padhai lii, peka na, ja'a ke'a, pe d'ai lod'o èle rai-haha ne, ladhe ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu madhe aa'i-aa'i, nèngu pamamuri hari kahèi ari ja'a.

source_text: jesus said to her, i am the resurrection and the life. he who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.
target_text: hèia yesus peka na, ja'a ka dhu hia dhèu madhe mamuri hari. ja'a ka dhu hia dhèu, mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. de dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, abhu mamuri èèna, masi ka nèngu madhe.

source_text: whoever lives and believes in me will never die. do you believe this?
target_text: ka dhèu dhu unu mamuri dhu lèke èèna, aa parcaya ja'a, bèli-camèd'a madhe boe, te ngaa mamuri taruu. marta, èu parcaya lii padhai ja'a ne, do?

source_text: she said to him, yes, lord. i have come to believe that you are the christ, god's son, he who comes into the world.
target_text: hèia marta dhaa, na, oo, ama! ja'a parcaya, na, èu ne, nuka kristus, dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u mema karèi nèti uru ka. aa èu ne, ana ama lamatua dhu na padhadha tèke hia mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: when she had said this, she went away and called mary, her sister, secretly, saying, the teacher is here and is calling you.
target_text: ropa marta padhai lii nare, hèia na lèpa asa èmu na. ka na paroa ari na maria, sèna ka dua ra mesa-mesa ra. ka na peka, na, ama mese mai le. nèngu neo paraga dènge èu.

source_text: when she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him. now jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where martha met him. then the jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, she is going to the tomb to weep there.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia maria la'e dènge ka tenge yesus. ropa dhèu yahudi dhu beke dènge maria ètu d'ara èmu, rèdhi nèngu kèd'i sahèka, ka rai li'u la'e, hèia lasi madhutu ne re limuri. te rèngu pangee, na, maria la'e tangi asa ro'a lasarus. lod'o èèna, yesus si d'ai mèka d'ara rae. nèngu ètu era dhu marta paraga dènge ne.

source_text: therefore when mary came to where jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn't have died.
target_text: ropa maria la'e d'ai era èèna, ka ladhe nèdhi yesus. hèia na patitu kètu urutuu ètu madha yesus. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, ama! sèmi ama ètu ne'e, tatu ari ja'a madhe boe.

source_text: when jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,
target_text: ropa yesus nèdhi maria tangi, aa dhèu yahudi dhu madhutu ne tangi kahèi, ka yesus nasa aa d'ara na susa.

source_text: and said, where have you laid him? they told him, lord, come and see.
target_text: hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, miu padhane ne ètu mia? ra dhaa, peka na, mai, ama! sèna ka mèdhi unu mu.

source_text: jesus wept.
target_text: hèia yesus tangi.

source_text: the jews therefore said, see how much affection he had for him!
target_text: ka dhèu yahudi se papeka, aku rèngu na, ladhe ku laa. na sue lasarus titu kèna!

source_text: some of them said, couldn't this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e dhu papeka na, dhèu ne'e ne ka dhu hia dhèu bèdhu bisa nèdhi. nga tao ka nèngu bisa boe tenge j'ara, sèna ka lasarus baku madhe?

source_text: jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.
target_text: ka d'ara yesus susa. hèia la'e padètu-dètu asa ro'a dhu ra padhane lasarus. ro'a ne dhu ra katange le dènge hadhu aae cue.

source_text: jesus said, take away the stone. martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.
target_text: hèia yesus pua dhèu ètu sèra, peka na, loli eele ku hadhu nèti hèb'a ro'a ne! te ngaa marta, ana hèni dhèu madhe ne, peka, aku nèngu na, irii, ama! na madhe èpa lod'o kèna! tatu hèu le.

source_text: jesus said to her, didn't i tell you that if you believed, you would see god's glory?
target_text: ka yesus pasanèd'e ne, aku nèngu na, sanèd'e lii ja'a deo na, si? ja'a dhu peka mema le, na, ladhe èu tare'a-re'a parcaya ja'a, pe mèdhi dadedha ama lamatua.

source_text: so they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. jesus lifted up his eyes and said, father, i thank you that you listened to me.
target_text: hèia pèri-pèri dhèu loli eele hadhu nèti hèb'a ro'a ne. ka yesus ladhe asa dedha-liru, hèia na peka, ama! ja'a manèngi makasi, lula ama nanene ja'a.

source_text: i know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around i said this, that they may believe that you sent me.
target_text: ja'a ke'a karèi nèti uru ka, na, ama nanene taruu ja'a. te ngaa doe ne ja'a peka sèmi ne'e, sèna ka dhèu-dhèu dhu titu ètu ne'e, bisa re'a, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: when he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, lazarus, come out!
target_text: ropa peka nare, hèia na paroa dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, lasarus! kalua ka!

source_text: he who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. jesus said to them, free him, and let him go.
target_text: ka dhèu madhe ne kalua nèti d'ara ro'a. kacui-aai dènge haga na pa'èki era dènge bèla hutu dhèu madhe. aa abhu bèla dhu pahutu rèhu na kahèi. yesus pua dhèu ètu sèra, peka na, bhoke eele bèla hutu se, sèna ka na kako!

source_text: therefore many of the jews who came to mary and saw what jesus did believed in him.
target_text: ropa laladhe rèdhi tatao yesus ne, dhèu yahudi dhu beke dènge maria, ae ka dhu parcaya yesus.

source_text: but some of them went away to the pharisees and told them the things which jesus had done.
target_text: te ngaa abhu cahag'e kahèi dhu lasi paraga dènge dhèu nèti partei parisi, sèna ka peka tatao yesus ne dènge rèngu.

source_text: the chief priests therefore and the pharisees gathered a council, and said, what are we doing? for this man does many signs.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia kètu agama yahudi sèra, dènge dhèu parisi pakaboko ho padhue. ra pakarèi, peka na, dhèu ne'e ne, tao tadha malaa rupa-rupa! de èdhi tao ne tasamia hari?

source_text: if we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi soro tèke ne, bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i sanao-maena nèngu j'aj'i dhèu aae rèngu. dènge j'ara ne'e, èèna na sordad'u roma sèra mai paguri eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i èdhi dènge palaho isi kabarai èdhi.

source_text: but a certain one of them, caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, you know nothing at all,
target_text: tèu èèna, kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. na peka, na, goa, ee! miu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.
target_text: te ladhe dhèu èci madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i, èèna be'a risi hia miu. te ladhe aad'o, na, sordad'u roma mai, pamadhe aa'i mèu-mèu isi kabarai èdhi dhèu yahudi ne!

source_text: now he didn't say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that jesus would die for the nation,
target_text: lii kayafas ne mai boe nèti d'ara nèngu unu na. te ama lamatua pake hèb'a na, lula nèngu ka kètu kapai risi agama d'ara tèu èèna. nèti èèna ka, kayafas peka tèke, na, bèli-camèd'a yesus madhe pala dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of god who are scattered abroad.
target_text: aa te ngaa, dhu lèke ka, yesus madhe boe hia dhèu yahudi mesa ra di, te ngaa pala dhèu unu ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i dhu pale-lème ètu rai-haha ne. nèngu èèna na oru nare si j'aj'i mi suku ca nau-ca nadha.

source_text: so from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.
target_text: lula lii padhai kayafas ne'e ka, karèi nèti lod'o èèna, ama-ama dhèu yahudi tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe yesus.

source_text: jesus therefore walked no more openly among the jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called ephraim. he stayed there with his disciples.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus la'e heka asa madha dhèu ae ètu talora ama-ama dhèu yahudi. nèngu dènge ana-ana madhutu na lasi asa d'ara kota èci, ngara na efraim, padètu dènge d'ara mamoo. ka ra pea taha ètu èèna.

source_text: now the passover of the jews was at hand. many went up from the country to jerusalem before the passover, to purify themselves.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dètu le dènge lod'o kalela paska agama yahudi. dhu tema le, d'ai lod'o sèmi èèna, dhèu ae nèti rae-rae mai pakaboko ètu kota yerusalem ho madhutu kalela paska ètu èèna. dhèu se d'ai uru, ho pamèu iisi madhutu atora agama.

source_text: then they sought for jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, what do you think-that he isn't coming to the feast at all?
target_text: ae ka nèti rèngu patangi-tenge yesus ètu èèna. ropa ra titu ètu madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ka ra pakarèi, peka na, madhutu a'abhu miu, tasamia? yesus mai madhutu pesta kalela paska ne, do aad'o?

source_text: now the chief priests and the pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.
target_text: te ngaa kètu agama yahudi sèra, dènge dhèu parisi paredha, peka na, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu re'a yesus ètu mia, na, peka dènge ji'i! aa te ngaa rèngu neo kèpe ne.

source_text: then, six days before the passover, jesus came to bethany, where lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
target_text: di èna lod'o ka, d'ai lod'o kalela paska, ka yesus si mai hari asa rae betania. lasarus si pea ètu èèna. nèngu ka dhu madhe, dhu yesus pamamuri hari le.

source_text: so they made him a supper there. martha served, but lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.
target_text: hèia rèngu pananasu, sèna ka mèda none yesus na'a-ninu dènge rèngu. marta lalau mei. aa lasarus madhèdi na'a-ninu mei èci dènge yesus.

source_text: therefore mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed jesus' feet and wiped his feet with her hair. the house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.
target_text: hèia maria nare èi hèu mèngi asli ca boto dhu kab'ua. ka na pasuti mi haga yesus. hèia na roso haga yesus pake rèu kètu nèngu. ka hèu mèngi ne pale-lème aa'i d'ara èmu èèna.

source_text: then judas iscariot, simon's son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,
target_text: te ngaa ana madhutu yesus èci, ngara na yudas iskariot, dhu èèna na pahie yesus, ka'ugu aku nèngu na,

source_text: why wasn't this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?
target_text: wee! nga tao ka nèngu pahie boe èi hèu mèngi ne? te kab'ua na nuka sèmi gaji dhèu èci d'ara ca tèu. be'a risi pahie, sèna ka kab'ua na pabagi mi dhèu unu aad'o sèra!

source_text: now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.
target_text: aa te ngaa yudas peka sèmi ne'e ne lula boe nèti nèngu sue dhèu-dhèu unu aad'o. te ngaa lula nèngu, dhèu mana'u. nèngu ne dhu tèke doi yesus si, te ngaa ae ka dhu huni nare nèti d'ara kas.

source_text: but jesus said, leave her alone. she has kept this for the day of my burial.
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa bhèni ne tao sèmi ne'e. te nèngu dhu tèke èi hèu mèngi ne, sèna ka lalau ngi'u aae ja'a ho ra padhane ja'a.

source_text: for you always have the poor with you, but you don't always have me.
target_text: dhèu unu aad'o dhu bera-bera dènge miu. te ngaa ja'a ne bèli-camèd'a aad'o heka ètu talora miu.

source_text: a large crowd therefore of the jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for jesus' sake only, but that they might see lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
target_text: èle èèna, dhèu yahudi ae ka dhu re'a, na, yesus ètu rae betania. ka dhèu se mai neo rèdhi ne, aa neo rèdhi lasarus kahèi. te rèngu tadèngi le, na, yesus pamamuri hari le lasarus nèti mamadhe.

source_text: but the chief priests conspired to put lazarus to death also,
target_text: te ngaa kètu-kètu agama padhue ho neo pamadhe lasarus.

source_text: because on account of him many of the jews went away and believed in jesus.
target_text: te dhèu yahudi ae dhu tadèngi le lii palolo lula-nèti lasarus ne, ka dhèu se parcaya yesus. rèngu se ro'o heka nanene ama-ama dhèu yahudi.

source_text: on the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. when they heard that jesus was coming to jerusalem,
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhèu ae dhu mai madhutu kalela paska ètu kota yerusalem, tadèngi, na, yesus neo mai asa era ne'e kahèi.

source_text: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, hosanna! blessed is he who comes in the name of the lord, the king of israel!
target_text: ka lasi pare rèu palam ho pake soru mamai yesus, sama sèmi nèngu ne, dhèu aae-dhèu kapai. hèia ra pa'oo aa'i-aa'i ra, aku rèngu na, hosana! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua! te lamatua paj'uj'u d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu aae isra'el, dhu nèti kolongara lamatua!

source_text: jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. as it is written,
target_text: ka yesus abhu badha keled'ei èni ci'u, hèia na manya'e. se'e se j'aj'i nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na,

source_text: don't be afraid, daughter of zion. behold, your king comes, sitting on a donkey's colt.
target_text: miu dhèu kota yerusalem, baku madha'u! miu dhèu kota ‘sion' se, ladhe ku asa nèi! te dhèu aae miu nuka mai nèi! nèngu mai manya'e keled'ei èni ci'u.

source_text: his disciples didn't understand these things at first, but when jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus re'a mèka sasoa nèti j'ara se'e se. te ngaa bèli-camèd'a, ropa yesus mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na, aa ama lamatua ded'e ne padedha-dedha, rèngu heka sanèd'e j'ara-j'ara dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lula-nèti nèngu ne. rèngu sanèd'e kahèi tatao dhèu ae se mi dedha yesus.

source_text: the multitude therefore that was with him when he called lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.
target_text: lod'o yesus pamamuri hari lasarus nèti mamadhe, hèia na paroa ne kalua nèti ro'a dhèu madhe èèna, abhu dhèu ae dhu sama-sama dènge yesus. de limuri ne rèngu lolo palème lula-nèti ngaa dhu uru èèna rèngu rèdhi dènge musi madha ra.

source_text: for this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ropa yesus padètu dènge yerusalem, dhèu ae mai soru ne lula rèngu tadèngi le, na, nèngu ka dhu tao tadha malaa èèna.

source_text: the pharisees therefore said among themselves, see how you accomplish nothing. behold, the world has gone after him.
target_text: ka dhèu-dhèu parisi peka, na, peeh! ladhe ku laa! dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, parai-oru ho neo madhutu ne! bèli-camèd'a èdhi ka dhu j'èra! ladhe j'aj'i ka sèmi èèna, èdhi tao tasamia hari?

source_text: now there were certain greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.
target_text: abhu dhèu yunani pèri-pèri dhu mai asa kota yerusalem palere-lere dènge dhèu leo, ho neo madhutu kalela paska ètu èèna. ètu èèna, rèngu neo pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: therefore, these came to philip, who was from bethsaida of galilee, and asked him, saying, sir, we want to see jesus.
target_text: hèia dhèu se mai paraga dènge pelipus, dhu rae nèngu ka betsaida ètu propensi galilea. ra manèngi, aku rèngu na, ji'i neo paraga dènge yesus.

source_text: philip came and told andrew, and in turn, andrew came with philip, and they told jesus.
target_text: ka pelipus la'e peka dènge anderias. hèia dua ra lasi peka dènge yesus.

source_text: jesus answered them, the time has come for the son of man to be glorified. most certainly i tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. but if it dies, it bears much fruit.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, lod'o ja'a d'ai kèna. ja'a hud'i madhe ku, heka ama lamatua neo ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a kèna. tare'a sèmi èèna! èdhi pakasame ku dènge hini èci. ladhe èdhi sèle hini ca lamusi, na, hini ne ele iie uuru ku dènge j'ara boho ètu d'ara rai, heka na muri mai, hèia na hia hua-hela ae-ae kèna. ladhe sèmi boe èèna, hini èèna cue dhoo-dhoo di.

source_text: he who loves his life will lose it. he who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
target_text: dhèu dhu pahae boe dad'èi ama lamatua, lula nèngu sue ae mamuri na ètu rai-haha ne, èèna na mamuri na ele iie d'ara. te ngaa dhèu dhu sadia tèke eele mamuri rai-haha na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe.

source_text: if anyone serves me, let him follow me. where i am, there my servant will also be. if anyone serves me, the father will honor him.
target_text: dhèu dhu neo sab'a hia ja'a, nèngu hud'i madhutu ja'a taruu. ja'a ètu mia, na, dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a ètu èèna kahèi. te ladhe abhu dhèu dhu sab'a hia ja'a, èèna na ama ku ètu sorga pakab'ua nèngu.

source_text: now my soul is troubled. what shall i say? ‘father, save me from this time'? but i came to this time for this cause.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, d'ara ja'a susa titu kèna. te ngaa ja'a neo peka ngaa hari? ja'a hud'i manèngi ku, peka na, ‘ama! patabuli ja'a, sèna ka ja'a baku madhe ku d'ara lai-lai ne, ' do? bisa boe! ja'a manèngi boe sèmi èèna, lula nèngu pua ja'a mai sèna ka madhe.

source_text: father, glorify your name! then a voice came out of the sky, saying, i have both glorified it and will glorify it again.
target_text: de dhu ja'a manèngi ka, ‘ama. hud'i laa ja'a madhutu dad'èi ama ku, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara ama. ' hèia lii èci nèti dedha-liru peka na, ja'a ded'e padedha-dedha le kolongara ja'a. aa ja'a neo ded'e padedha-dedha hari kolongara ja'a.

source_text: therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. others said, an angel has spoken to him.
target_text: ka dhèu ae dhu titu ètu sèra sa, tadèngi lii ne'e kahèi, hèia ra peka na, ira ii! d'oro nga! cahag'e hari peka na, aad'o! ana pajuu lamatua èci nèti sorga padhai lii dènge ne.

source_text: jesus answered, this voice hasn't come for my sake, but for your sakes.
target_text: te ngaa yesus padhai lii dènge rèngu, aku nèngu na, lii deo na, lii hia miu, hia boe ja'a.

source_text: now is the judgment of this world. now the prince of this world will be cast out.
target_text: limuri ne, dhèu ètu rai-haha ne hud'i lasi asa madha ama lamatua, sèna ka na pama'ète lii langu rèngu. lamatua neo babège eele kahèi dhèu bhelu dhu paredha ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: and i, if i am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.
target_text: ladhe dhèu ded'e ka ja'a ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, pe ja'a ère kore dhèu aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka ra parcaya ja'a.

source_text: but he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
target_text: na padhai lii sèmi ne'e, ho peka j'ara mamadhe na.

source_text: the multitude answered him, we have heard out of the law that the christ remains forever. how do you say, ‘the son of man must be lifted up'? who is this son of man?
target_text: ka dhèu ètu sèra karèi, aku rèngu na, ji'i tadèngi ngèdhi le nèti atora lamatua, dhu peka na, èèna na kristus mamuri taruu. kristus dènge dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a, èci èèna ka, do? de, nga tao ka èu peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a dhèu neo paca'e dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a èèna ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha? ' te nèngu ne, cee?

source_text: jesus therefore said to them, yet a little while the light is with you. walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn't overtake you. he who walks in the darkness doesn't know where he is going.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, na, nèbhu heka saraa ja'a, d'elo heka miu. de lod'o ja'a dènge miu era, miu hud'i mamuri mola ku, sèna ka bhabhelu-katub'a baku hutu nare saraa dhu ètu d'ara miu. te dhèu dhu kako ètu d'ara maroga, ne'a boe la'e asa mia.

source_text: while you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light. jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.
target_text: lod'o saraa ja'a ne era, miu hud'i parcaya ku ja'a, sèna ka miu j'aj'i mi dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara saraa, ho me'a, na, miu neo lami mia. ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia la'e tèke eele dhèu se'e, sèna ka nèngu mesa-mesa na.

source_text: but though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn't believe in him,
target_text: masi ka yesus tao le tadha malaa ae-ae ètu madha dhèu ae, te ngaa ro'o boe parcaya ne.

source_text: that the word of isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: lord, who has believed our report? to whom has the arm of the lord been revealed?
target_text: ne'e ne palèke dènge lii yesaya, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua, dhu suri peka na, lamatua! abhu boe dhèu dhu parcaya lii padhai ji'i! te masi ka lamatua pad'elo le koasa, te ngaa dhèu sèra ladhe rèdhi boe ngaa-ngaa!

source_text: for this cause they couldn't believe, for isaiah said again:
target_text: nèti èèna ka, limuri ne dhèu yahudi cahag'e parcaya boe lamatua, lèke sèmi dhu yesaya suri tèke ètu era leo d'ara sasuri na, peka na,

source_text: he has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and i would heal them.
target_text: ama lamatua pabèdhu le d'ara ra, sèna ka baku rèdhi ngaa-ngaa. na soro tèke d'ara ra adhu sèmi hadhu, sèna ka baku re'a mèu. soro tèke si sèmi èèna, sèna ka baku ra lèpa tenge ja'a, aa ja'a tao boe pabe'a si.

source_text: isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.
target_text: yesaya peka sèmi ne'e, lula nèdhi le dadedha yesus, ka na lole mema lula-nèti yesus ne.

source_text: nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the pharisees they didn't confess it, so that they wouldn't be put out of the synagogue,
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu kahèi dhèu ae dhu parcaya yesus. mesa boe dhèu biasa di, te abhu kahèi ama-ama dhèu yahudi dhu parcaya ne. te ngaa rèngu mangaku boe yesus ètu madha dhèu ae, lula ra madha'u, mage dhèu parisi babège eele si nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a ra.

source_text: for they loved men's praise more than god's praise.
target_text: ama-ama yahudi se pusi-pahae boe ho lamatua koa si, lula rèngu d'èi risi abhu koa-kad'iri nèti dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: jesus cried out and said, whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.
target_text: ka yesus padhai lii dènge lii mèdhu, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, nèngu parcaya boe ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa nèngu parcaya kahèi dhèu dhu pua ja'a mai.

source_text: he who sees me sees him who sent me.
target_text: te dhèu dhu ladhe nèdhi ja'a, na, nèngu ladhe nèdhi kahèi dhèu dhu pua-paleha ja'a.

source_text: i have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
target_text: ja'a mai sèna ka j'aj'i nuka sèmi saraa ètu rai-haha ne. ho hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ja'a mamuri boe ètu d'ara maroga.

source_text: if anyone listens to my sayings and doesn't believe, i don't judge him. for i came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu nanene lii holo-nori ja'a, te ngaa madhutu boe, na, ja'a pama'ète boe hahuku na. te mamai ja'a asa rai-haha ne, neo boe pama'ète hahuku dhèu, te ngaa ja'a neo patabuli si nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: he who rejects me, and doesn't receive my sayings, has one who judges him. the word that i spoke will judge him in the last day.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tule eele ja'a, aa d'èi boe sèmi lii holo-nori ja'a, pe na paraga dènge hakim. te d'ai èle rai-haha ne, lii holo-nori dhu ja'a lole kèdhi sèra, ka dhu pama'ète hahuku mi dedha rèngu èci-èci.

source_text: for i spoke not from myself, but the father who sent me gave me a commandment, what i should say and what i should speak.
target_text: lula ja'a dhae padhai lii kèdhi mèka pake kolongara ja'a mesa ku. te ngaa ja'a padhai lii kèti kolongara ama ku ètu sorga. te nèngu ka dhu pua ja'a. aa nèngu ka dhu paredha ja'a, sèna ka ja'a padhai lii ngaa.

source_text: i know that his commandment is eternal life. the things therefore which i speak, even as the father has said to me, so i speak.
target_text: ja'a ke'a kahèi, na, lii paredha na hia mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe. nèti èèna ka, lii padhai ja'a madhutu mola-mola ngaa dhu ama ku pua ja'a padhai lii.

source_text: now before the feast of the passover, jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
target_text: lod'o kalela paska dhae d'ai mèka, yesus ne'a le, na, d'ai le lod'o ho nèngu tèke eele rai-haha ne, aa la'e hari asa ama na ètu sorga. nèngu sue titu kèna dhèu unu na ètu rai-haha ne, toke na saraka mamuri na kateme aae hia mi rèngu.

source_text: during supper, the devil having already put into the heart of judas iscariot, simon's son, to betray him,
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae nidhu dadugu-rariu le yudas, ana simon iskariot, sèna ka pahie eele yesus. ka yudas dhu pama'ète le, sèna ka ad'u-ue madha j'ara èèna, ropa yesus si madhèdi ra'a-rinu ètu d'ara kalela paska.

source_text: jesus, knowing that the father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from god and was going to god,
target_text: yesus ne'a mema le, na, ama lamatua pua-paleha nèngu mai asa rai-haha ne, de nèbhu heka nèngu lèpa hari la'e asa ama lamatua. aa nèngu ne'a kahèi, na, ama na ètu sorga pangèd'u aa'i le ngaa-ngaa mi nèngu.

source_text: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. he took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.
target_text: hèia yesus kèd'i nèti mei, ka na tao eele kodho li'u na. nare bèla èci, ho èki mi lalole na.

source_text: then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples' feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
target_text: ka na bhori èi asa d'ara bokor iiki cue. hèia na rase haga ana madhutu na sèra. ropa na rase pamèu nare haga dhèu èci, na seka pamango pake bèla dhu pa'èki ètu lalole na.

source_text: then he came to simon peter. he said to him, lord, do you wash my feet?
target_text: na rase haga si èci-èci. ropa d'ai simon petrus, ka simon petrus karèi, aku nèngu na, ama neo rase haga ja'a kahèi, do?

source_text: jesus answered him, you don't know what i am doing now, but you will understand later.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, deo ne'e ne, èu dhae me'a mèka ngaa dhu ja'a tao ne. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, èu heka me'a kèna.

source_text: peter said to him, you will never wash my feet! jesus answered him, if i don't wash you, you have no part with me.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasisu, aku nèngu na, ama baku tao sèmi èèna! ja'a ko'o boe ama rase haga ja'a. hèia yesus peka na, ladhe ja'a rase pamèu boe haga èu, na, èu bisa boe pa'èki dènge ja'a.

source_text: simon peter said to him, lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!
target_text: ka simon petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe sèmi èèna, mesa boe haga di. te ngaa ama rase kacui-aai dènge kètu ja'a kahèi!

source_text: jesus said to him, someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. you are clean, but not all of you.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ne, aku nèngu na, dhèu dhu diu le èi, parluu dhoka rase haga di. te ngi'u na mèu le. mema tare'a d'ara miu mèu le, te ngaa miu aa'i mi boe.

source_text: for he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, you are not all clean.
target_text: yesus peka sèmi ne'e, lula ne'a le cee ka dhu neo pahie ne. nèti èèna ka, na peka na, miu aa'i mi boe dhu mèu.

source_text: so when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, do you know what i have done to you?
target_text: ropa yesus pamèu nare haga si, hèia na silu hari kodho na, ka madhèdi hari asa mei. ka na karèi ana madhutu na, aku nèngu na, tasamia? ropa ja'a rase haga miu, miu me'a sasoa nèti dhu ja'a tao ne, do aad'o?

source_text: you call me, ‘teacher' and ‘lord. ' you say so correctly, for so i am.
