target_text: miu tema paroa ja'a ne, ‘ama mese' aa ‘lamatua'. èèna lèke kèna, lula mema hud'i sèmi èèna ku.

source_text: if i then, the lord and the teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another's feet.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe mese dènge lamatua miu ne, rase le haga miu nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha sa, na, tasamia hari dènge miu? miu hud'i lalau-lalo'o isi-aanga mi èci dènge èci; conto nuka: miu hud'i èci dènge èci rase haga mi.

source_text: for i have given you an example, that you should also do as i have done to you.
target_text: te ja'a tao le j'ara ne, sèna ka miu madhutu. ladhe ja'a tao tasamia, na, miu hud'i tao sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: most certainly i tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.
target_text: ja'a peka tare'a-re'a dènge miu. ca dhèu ènu bisa boe risi nèti lamatua na. aa ca dhèu pajuu-paleha bisa boe risi nèti dhèu dhu pua nèngu.

source_text: if you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
target_text: lula miu dhu me'a le j'ara se'e, miu oto ladhe miu tao madhutu.

source_text: i don't speak concerning all of you. i know whom i have chosen; but that the scripture may be fulfilled, ‘he who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me. '
target_text: ja'a padhai lii boe lula-nèti miu aa'i-aa'i mi. ja'a tadhe mèu dhèu dhu ja'a hag'e kore. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa j'ara ne hud'i j'aj'i ku, sama sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na, ‘dhèu dhu madhèdi na'a-ninu pa'èci dènge ja'a, soro kabodho mi ja'a le. '

source_text: from now on, i tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that i am he.
target_text: ja'a peka mema dènge miu, ho ladhe abhu dhèu dhu la'e tèke eele ja'a, na, miu bisa parcaya kèna, na, ja'a ne, kristus.

source_text: most certainly i tell you, he who receives whomever i send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.
target_text: ja'a peka dènge miu tare'a-re'a kèna, dhèu cee dhu bhoke d'ara na ho sèmi nare dhèu dhu ja'a pua, na, nèngu kahèi sèmi nare ja'a. aa cee ka dhu sèmi nare ja'a dènge be'a, na, nèngu sèmi nare kahèi dhèu dhu pua-paleha ja'a.

source_text: when jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, most certainly i tell you that one of you will betray me.
target_text: yesus padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, hèia d'ara na mulai susa. ka na lii, aku nèngu na, dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke tare'a. ca dhèu nèti miu, èèna na pahie eele ja'a.

source_text: the disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.
target_text: ropa tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia ana-ana madhutu na palaladha èci dènge èci, te rèngu malaa. re'a boe na, cee ka dhu nèngu peka.

source_text: one of his disciples, whom jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against jesus' chest.
target_text: ètu era ne'e abhu ca dhèu dhu yesus sue nuka ja'a, yohanis dhu suri sasuri ne. ja'a dhu madhèdi ètu baboa yesus.

source_text: simon peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, tell us who it is of whom he speaks.
target_text: hèia simon petrus pangètu kètu, ho ja'a karèi yesus, cee ka dhu na peka èèna.

source_text: he, leaning back, as he was, on jesus' chest, asked him, lord, who is it?
target_text: ka ja'a eso padètu dènge yesus, ho karèi ne, dhèu dhu ama peka ne, cee?

source_text: jesus therefore answered, it is he to whom i will give this piece of bread when i have dipped it. so when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to judas, the son of simon iscariot.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a neo kore roti ca'èta, ho cèb'u asa d'ara mago ne. èèna na ja'a hia mi dhèu dhu ja'a peka deo na. ka yesus cèb'u nare roti ne asa d'ara mago, hèia na j'ole asa yudas, ana simon iskariot.

source_text: after the piece of bread, then satan entered into him. then jesus said to him, what you do, do quickly.
target_text: ropa sèmi nare roti ne, hèia dhèu aae nidhu maso asa d'ara yudas. ka yesus peka dènge ne, èu neo tao ngaa, na, tao ka lai-lai. pamata ia ka.

source_text: now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu leo dhu madhèdi ètu sèra re'a rare boe, nga tao ka yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna.

source_text: for some thought, because judas had the money box, that jesus said to him, buy what things we need for the feast, or that he should give something to the poor.
target_text: lula yudas dhu tèke doi-dhari, ka abhu dhu pangee, na, yesus pua yudas, peka na, lamu hèli ngaa dhu èdhi parluu, sèna ka tao pesta paska. aa abhu kahèi dhu pangee, na, yesus pua yudas, lamu hia doi d'ai ciki sa, mi dhèu unu boe ngaa-ngaa sèra.

source_text: therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. it was night.
target_text: ropa yudas sèmi nare roti ne, hèia la'e dènge ka. lod'o nèngu kalua èèna, dhu mèda le.

source_text: when he had gone out, jesus said, now the son of man has been glorified, and god has been glorified in him.
target_text: ropa yudas la'e, hèia yesus padhai lii, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. d'ai lod'o kèna, ho ama lamatua ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. aa nèti j'ara ne'e, dhèu rèdhi dadedha ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: if god has been glorified in him, god will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.
target_text: lula ja'a pa'èki dènge ama lamatua, aa pad'elo dadedha na, nèti èèna ka na ded'e padedha-dedha ja'a. na pamata heka.

source_text: little children, i will be with you a little while longer. you will seek me, and as i said to the jews, ‘where i am going, you can't come, ' so now i tell you.
target_text: ana aa'i-aa'i! masi ka ja'a sue miu titu kèna, te ngaa nèbhu heka ja'a pa'ana-lalu eele miu. èèna na miu patangi-tenge ja'a, te ngaa mèdhi boe. lii dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, èci èèna ka dènge dhu ja'a lole dènge ama dhèu yahudi sèra, na, ‘ja'a laku asa era èci dhu miu bisa mèka madhutu. '

source_text: a new commandment i give to you, that you love one another. just as i have loved you, you also love one another.
target_text: ja'a hia miu lii paredha hiu èci, nuka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, sama sèmi ja'a sue miu. de miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci kahèi.

source_text: by this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.
target_text: ladhe miu pasue sèmi èèna, dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa re'a, na, miu se, ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: simon peter said to him, lord, where are you going? jesus answered, where i am going, you can't follow now, but you will follow afterwards.
target_text: ka simon petrus karèi, peka na, te ama neo lamu mia? hèia yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ja'a laku asa era èci dhu èu bisa mèka lamu. te ngaa lod'o limuri ku, heka èu lamu kèna.

source_text: peter said to him, lord, why can't i follow you now? i will lay down my life for you.
target_text: petrus karèi hari, peka na, ama! nga tao ka ja'a bisa mèka laku hèi? te ja'a dhu pa'èra iisi le ho madhe pala ama!

source_text: jesus answered him, will you lay down your life for me? most certainly i tell you, the rooster won't crow until you have denied me three times.
target_text: yesus dhaa, peka na, tare'a, do? èu neo soro mamuri èu sèna ka madhe pala ja'a? dhu lèke ka sèmi ne'e: manu dhae kokotoo mèka, te ngaa èu pasili le tèlu hari, peka na, èu tadhe boe ja'a.

source_text: don't let your heart be troubled. believe in god. believe also in me.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, d'ara miu baku susa. parcaya mi ama lamatua, aa parcaya mi ja'a kahèi.

source_text: in my father's house are many homes. if it weren't so, i would have told you. i am going to prepare a place for you.
target_text: ètu èmu ama ku abhu kama ae-ae. ladhe era d'ai boe, tatu ja'a peka le dènge miu. ne'e ne, ja'a neo laku sadia tèke era hia miu ètu nèi.

source_text: if i go and prepare a place for you, i will come again and will receive you to myself; that where i am, you may be there also.
target_text: ladhe ja'a laku aa sadia kore era pea hia miu, pe ja'a lèpa hari mai kore miu ho lati pea asa nèi. dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe ja'a ètu mia, na, miu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: you know where i go, and you know the way.
target_text: miu me'a le j'ara asa era dhu ja'a neo laku.

source_text: thomas said to him, lord, we don't know where you are going. how can we know the way?
target_text: te ngaa tomas karèi, peka na, ama! ji'i nge'a boe ama neo lamu mia. de tasamia ka ji'i nge'a j'ara ho la'a asa nèi?

source_text: jesus said to him, i am the way, the truth, and the life. no one comes to the father, except through me.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, abhu boe j'ara leo dhu bisa nèti dhèu asa ama ètu sorga. dhodhoka re ja'a mesa-mesa ku. te ja'a ne ka j'ara asa ama lamatua. ja'a ne ka kapua mamola. aa ja'a ne'e ka dhu hia dhèu mamuri dhu lèke.

source_text: if you had known me, you would have known my father also. from now on, you know him and have seen him.
target_text: ladhe miu tadhe mèu ja'a, na, miu tadhe ama ku kahèi. de karèi nèti deo ne'e ne, miu tadhe nèngu le, dènge mèdhi ne kahèi.

source_text: philip said to him, lord, show us the father, and that will be enough for us.
target_text: pelipus manèngi, peka na, ama mese! pad'elo ku ama mu dènge ji'i! te èèna d'ai le.

source_text: jesus said to him, have i been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, philip? he who has seen me has seen the father. how do you say, ‘show us the father'?
target_text: hèia yesus peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, pelipus. ja'a sama-sama dènge miu nèbhu nare sange ne'e, te ngaa miu tadhe iia mèka ja'a, do? te dhèu dhu nèdhi le ja'a, èèna sama sèmi nèngu nèdhi le ama ku. de, nga tao ka deo na èu peka na, ‘pad'elo ku ama mu dènge ji'i'?

source_text: don't you believe that i am in the father, and the father in me? the words that i tell you, i speak not from myself; but the father who lives in me does his works.
target_text: tasamia kèna? lod'o ja'a peka na, ja'a pa'èki dènge ama, aa ama pa'èki dènge ja'a, èu parcaya ja'a, do aad'o? lii padhai dhu ja'a peka dènge miu sèra, mai boe nèti ja'a mesa ku, te ngaa mai nèti ama ku. aa na pake ja'a sèna ka sab'a taruu sasab'a-la'a na.

source_text: believe me that i am in the father, and the father in me; or else believe me for the very works' sake.
target_text: parcaya la mi ja'a ropa ja'a peka na, ja'a dhu pa'èki dènge ama ku, aa nèngu pa'èki dènge ja'a kahèi. te ngaa ladhe miu bisa boe parcaya sèmi èèna, na, parcaya la ja'a, lula miu mèdhi le j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a tao.

source_text: most certainly i tell you, he who believes in me, the works that i do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because i am going to my father.
target_text: lii padhai ja'a se, lèke! te dhèu dhu parcaya ja'a, èèna na nèngu bisa tao j'ara dhu ja'a tao kahèi. te ngaa, lula ja'a laku asa ama ku, ka ngaa dhu dhèu tao sèra, kapai risi nèti dhu ja'a tao.

source_text: whatever you will ask in my name, i will do it, that the father may be glorified in the son.
target_text: miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a, unu hak pake kolongara ja'a. de ladhe miu sabaj'a sad'i manèngi ngaa èèna ka, pake la kolongara ja'a, pe èèna na ja'a tao hia miu. dènge j'ara ne, ja'a ded'e ama ku padedha-dedha, sèna ka hud'i laa dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a.

source_text: if you will ask anything in my name, i will do it.
target_text: ja'a peka hari ca tèka: miu sabaj'a ho sad'i manèngi ngaa èèna ka, pake kolongara ja'a, èèna na ja'a tao hia miu.

source_text: if you love me, keep my commandments.
target_text: yesus peka tabha hari, aku nèngu na, ladhe miu sue ja'a, na, miu tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra.

source_text: i will pray to the father, and he will give you another counselor, that he may be with you forever: the spirit of truth, whom the world can't receive, for it doesn't see him and doesn't know him. you know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ama ku, sèna ka, lod'o ja'a dènge heka miu, na, nèngu hia miu ca dhèu era sarai-maena, sèna ka pad'elo j'ara hia miu. nèngu ne, nuka roh lamatua, dhu aj'a-nori miu ngaa dhu lèke. dhèu cahag'e ètu rai-haha ne ro'o boe sèmi rare ne, lula rèngu bisa boe ladhe rèdhi nèngu, aa tadhe boe nèngu. te ngaa miu tadhe ne, lula na pa'èki dènge miu. aa na muri ètu d'ara miu. èèna na, nèngu dènge miu taa-taa.

source_text: i will not leave you orphans. i will come to you.
target_text: dènge sèmi èèna, ja'a tèke eele boe miu mesa mi, nuka sèmi ana lalu-eela. te ngaa sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a ja'a lèpa hari mai asa miu.

source_text: yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. because i live, you will live also.
target_text: nèbhu heka, dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne rèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa miu mèdhi ja'a. lula ja'a mamuri hari, miu abhu mamuri dhu lèke kahèi.

source_text: in that day you will know that i am in my father, and you in me, and i in you.
target_text: aa ladhe lod'o ja'a mamuri hari, miu me'a mèu, na, ja'a pa'èki dènge ama ku; miu pa'èki dènge ja'a; aa ja'a pa'èki dènge miu kahèi.

source_text: one who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. one who loves me will be loved by my father, and i will love him, and will reveal myself to him.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèmi rare, aa tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra, na, nèngu ka dhu sue ja'a. aa ama ku sue kahèi dhèu dhu sue ja'a. ja'a sue dhèu èèna kahèi, aa pad'elo iisi ja'a dènge ne.

source_text: judas not iscariot said to him, lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?
target_text: ètu era ne, abhu dhèu èci, ngara na yudas. nèngu ne, yudas iskariot boe. ropa na tadèngi lii padhai yesus, hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, ama neo pad'elo iisi mi ji'i. te ngaa tasamia ka ama pad'elo boe iisi mi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne?

source_text: jesus answered him, if a man loves me, he will keep my word. my father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.
target_text: yesus dhaa, na, sèmi ne'e. dhèu dhu sue ja'a, nuka dhèu dhu tao madhutu lii holo-nori ja'a. ama ku sue nèngu kahèi. ka ja'a dènge ama ku mamuri d'ara èci dènge ne.

source_text: he who doesn't love me doesn't keep my words. the word which you hear isn't mine, but the father's who sent me.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu sue boe ja'a, nèngu madhutu boe lii holo-nori ja'a kahèi. aa'i-aa'i dhu miu tadèngi nèti ja'a, mai boe nèti ja'a, te ngaa mai nèti ama ku dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: i have said these things to you while still living with you.
target_text: ne'e ne ja'a bera-bera dènge miu era. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka tèke j'ara se'e dènge miu.

source_text: but the counselor, the holy spirit, whom the father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that i said to you.
target_text: te ngaa èèna na, ama ku pua mai ca dhèu era sarai-maena, nuka roh mola-mèci na. roh ne'e ka dhu gati ja'a ètu rai-haha ne. sasab'a na, nuka: aj'a-nori miu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra, dènge pasanèd'e miu j'ara-j'ara dhu ja'a padhue-padhai le dènge miu.

source_text: peace i leave with you. my peace i give to you; not as the world gives, i give to you. don't let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
target_text: pe, ladhe d'ai lod'o ja'a laku, ja'a tao d'ara miu ho mamuri padame dènge mera-milu. dhoka ja'a mesa ku dhu bisa tao d'ara mera-milu sèmi èèna. aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu rai-haha ne bisa boe tao rare d'ara miu mera-milu sèmi èèna. de miu baku susa, aa baku madha'u.

source_text: you heard how i told you, ‘i am going away, and i will come back to you. ' if you loved me, you would have rejoiced because i said ‘i am going to my father; ' for the father is greater than i.
target_text: miu tadèngi mèdhi le, dhu ja'a peka dènge miu, na, ‘ja'a tèke eele miu, te ngaa èèna na mai hari. ' d'ara miu baku susa. te ladhe miu sue ja'a, na, d'ara miu karej'e-karae, lula ja'a laku asa ama ku. ama ku kapai risi nèti ja'a ne.

source_text: now i have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.
target_text: sanèd'e, te ja'a dhu peka mema le dènge miu. dènge j'ara ne'e, ladhe j'ara se j'aj'i ku, na, miu bisa parcaya ja'a.

source_text: i will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.
target_text: nèbhu heka, ja'a padhai lii heka dènge miu. te dhèu aae nidhu dhu mai le. nèngu nèd'u paredha ètu rai-haha ne, te ngaa koasa na lèke boe ja'a.

source_text: but that the world may know that i love the father, and as the father commanded me, even so i do. arise, let's go from here.
target_text: masi ka nidhu ne mai, te ngaa ja'a sab'a taruu madhutu paredha ama ku. ne'e ne ka dhu pad'elo dènge dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, na, ja'a sue ama ku titu kèna. de mai lati ka!

source_text: i am the true vine, and my father is the farmer.
target_text: yesus padhai lii, peka na, nanene! miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. ja'a ne sama sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua. te ngaa ja'a ne, aj'u anggor dhu lèke! aa ama ku nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a oka.

source_text: every branch in me that doesn't bear fruit, he takes away. every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
target_text: de ladhe dhèu peka na, nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a, te ngaa sab'a boe ngaa-ngaa, ama ku core eele ne, sama sèmi dhèu sab'a oka dhu pare eele aa'i dadana dhu hua boe. te ngaa dhèu dhu pa'èki pa'èra dènge ja'a, ama ku pamèu kaj'alu ètu d'ara dhèu èèna, nuka sèmi dhèu sab'a oka poro pabab'a dadana, sèna ka hua na asa ae.

source_text: you are already pruned clean because of the word which i have spoken to you.
target_text: lii holo-nori ja'a se'e, bisa le pamèu d'ara miu, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu sab'a oka dhu pamèu dadana anggor.

source_text: remain in me, and i in you. as the branch can't bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.
target_text: miu hud'i pa'èki taruu ku dènge ja'a, sama sèmi ja'a pa'èki dènge miu. te dadana dhu pare eele le nèti laa na, bisa boe hua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. miu bisa boe tao ngaa èci sa dhu be'a, ladhe miu pa'èki taruu boe dènge ja'a.

source_text: i am the vine. you are the branches. he who remains in me and i in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
target_text: ja'a sama sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua. miu nuka sèmi dadana nèngu. de dhèu dhu pa'èki taruu dènge ja'a, aa ja'a pa'èki dènge nèngu kahèi, na, nèngu èci èèna ka dènge dadana dhu hua ae-ae. te, ladhe miu pa'èki taruu boe dènge ja'a, miu bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa dhu be'a.

source_text: if a man doesn't remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.
target_text: dhèu dhu pa'èki boe taruu dènge ja'a, nèngu cakaraa dadana èci dhu guna heka. dadana sèmi èèna, dhèu poro eele, sèna ka pamango eele ne. hèia pakaboko ho core asa d'ara ai, tunu pakèpu si.

source_text: if you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe miu pa'èki pa'èra-èra dènge ja'a taruu, aa lii holo-nori ja'a pea taruu ètu d'ara miu, na, ngaa dhu miu manèngi mi ama lamatua, na tao hia miu.

source_text: in this my father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.
target_text: ladhe miu tao j'ara dhu be'a ae-ae, sama sèmi dadana èci dhu hua ae-ae, èèna ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha ama lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pad'elo kahèi, na, miu ana madhutu ja'a.

source_text: even as the father has loved me, i also have loved you. remain in my love.
target_text: sèmi mia ama sue ja'a, sèmi èèna kahèi ja'a sue miu. miu hud'i pa'èki ku pa'èra-èra dènge ja'a, sèna ka ja'a bisa pad'elo dènge miu sasue ja'a.

source_text: if you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as i have kept my father's commandments and remain in his love.
target_text: ladhe miu tao madhutu lii paredha ja'a sèra, na, miu pa'èki taruu dènge ja'a, hèia ja'a bisa pad'elo sasue ja'a mi dedha miu. èèna nuka sèmi ja'a tao madhutu lii paredha ama ku, hèia na pad'elo sasue na taruu mi dedha ja'a.

source_text: i have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, ja'a peka dènge miu j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra, sèna ka d'ara miu karej'e-karae, sama sèmi d'ara ja'a. te madhutu dad'èi ja'a, d'ara miu hud'i karej'e dhu dènge boe too-lane!

source_text: this is my commandment, that you love one another, even as i have loved you.
target_text: lii paredha ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci, sama sèmi ja'a sue miu.

source_text: greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
target_text: ladhe dhèu èci sadia madhe sèna ka angalai na bisa mamuri, nèngu tatu sue tare'a-re'a angalai na. abhu boe sasue dhu risi eele hari sèmi èèna.

source_text: you are my friends if you do whatever i command you.
target_text: ladhe miu madhutu paredha ja'a taruu, miu j'aj'i angalai ja'a.

source_text: no longer do i call you servants, for the servant doesn't know what his lord does. but i have called you friends, for everything that i heard from my father, i have made known to you.
target_text: ja'a paroa heka miu, na, ‘ana pua-paleha' ja'a. te ana pua-paleha èci, ne'a iia boe dad'èi lamatua na. te ngaa ja'a paroa miu, na, ‘angalai' ja'a, lula ja'a bhoke patalele le aa'i-aa'i dhu ama ku peka le dènge ja'a.

source_text: you didn't choose me, but i chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the father in my name, he may give it to you.
target_text: miu pili boe ja'a. te ngaa ja'a ka dhu pili kore aa ded'e miu ho pakako sasab'a ne. de miu hud'i lami tao j'ara be'a ae-ae dhu taha nare nèbhu. èèna nuka sèmi aj'u anggor ca kapua dhu hua na be'a taruu. ladhe miu tao ka sèmi èèna, na, ngaa dhu miu manèngi mi ama ku, tatu na tao hia miu.

source_text: i command these things to you, that you may love one another.
target_text: de dhu ja'a paredha miu sèmi ne'e ka: miu hud'i pasue ku èci dènge èci.

source_text: if the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
target_text: yesus lii tabha hari, na, ladhe dhèu ètu rai-haha ne d'èi boe miu, na, sanèd'e, te karèi nèti uru ka rèngu d'èi boe ja'a.

source_text: if you were of the world, the world would love its own. but because you are not of the world, since i chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
target_text: ladhe miu sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, tatu ra sue miu. te ngaa miu sama boe dènge rèngu. te ja'a dhu hag'e kore le miu, sèna ka cèri eele miu nèti rèngu. nèti èèna ka rèngu d'èi boe miu.

source_text: remember the word that i said to you: ‘a servant is not greater than his lord. ' if they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. if they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
target_text: baku bhèlu dhu ja'a peka kore le dènge miu, na, ‘ca dhèu ana pua-paleha risi boe nèti lamatua na. ' de ladhe rèngu paj'èra ja'a, tatu ra paj'èra miu kahèi. ladhe rèngu nanene ka lii holo-nori ja'a, na, rèngu nanene miu kahèi.

source_text: but they will do all these things to you for my name's sake, because they don't know him who sent me.
target_text: èèna na ra paj'èra miu, lula miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. te rèngu tadhe boe nèngu dhu pua ja'a kahèi.

source_text: if i had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhae padhai lii kèdhi mèka dènge rèngu, aa pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke mi rèngu, na, ra pangee taruu, na, rèngu dènge boe sala ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa ja'a mai le, aa padhai dènge rèngu sèmi èèna. de ladhe rèngu tao sala, na, rèngu abhu boe j'ara ho peka na, ‘wee! ji'i se nge'a boe, na, dhu ji'i tao sèra, sala. '

source_text: he who hates me, hates my father also.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi boe ja'a, nèngu d'èi boe ama ku kahèi.

source_text: if i hadn't done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn't have had sin. but now they have seen and also hated both me and my father.
target_text: ja'a tao kèdhi le tadha malaa rupa-rupa ètu katanga madha ra, dhu dhèu leo tao rèdhi mèka. ladhe ja'a tao boe j'ara sèra sa, rèngu sala boe kahèi ladhe ro'o boe sèmi rare ja'a. aa te ngaa rèngu dhu rèdhi le tadha malaa dhu ja'a tao sèra. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa rèngu d'èi boe ja'a, aa d'èi boe ama ku ètu sorga kahèi.

source_text: but this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘they hated me without a cause. '
target_text: te ngaa j'ara se'e se dhu j'aj'i le, sèna ka madhutu ngaa dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara atora ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ‘rèngu d'èi boe ja'a. aa te ngaa nanasa rèngu se'e dènge boe kolo-kapua. '

source_text: when the counselor has come, whom i will send to you from the father, the spirit of truth, who proceeds from the father, he will testify about me.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu era sarai-maena èèna neo mai. nèngu èèna, nuka roh dhu tao miu me'a mèu ngaa dhu lèke. na mai nèti ama ku. ladhe ja'a laku le asa ama ku, pe ja'a hia roh na mai asa miu. na lole dènge miu lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: you will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
target_text: èèna na miu peka dènge dhèu lula-nèti ja'a kahèi, lula miu bera-bera dènge ja'a karèi nèti uru j'ara ka.

source_text: i have said these things to you so that you wouldn't be caused to stumble.
target_text: ja'a peka le j'ara se'e dènge miu, sèna ka miu baku pakaj'èu nèti ja'a.

source_text: they will put you out of the synagogues. yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to god.
target_text: èèna na dhèu yahudi sèra babège eele miu nèti d'ara èmu sabaj'a ra. mesa boe j'ara ne'e di, te bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o na, ladhe dhèu pamadhe miu, ra pangee, na, rèngu tao j'ara dhu lèke hia ama lamatua.

source_text: they will do these things because they have not known the father nor me.
target_text: rèngu tao miu sèmi èèna, lula rèngu tadhe iia boe ja'a. aa rèngu tadhe boe ama ku kahèi.

source_text: but i have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that i told you about them. i didn't tell you these things from the beginning, because i was with you.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a peka le j'ara se'e dènge miu, sèna ka lèpa lod'o limuri ladhe j'aj'i, miu bisa sanèd'e, na, ja'a dhu peka mema le. te ngaa ja'a peka uuru mèka dènge miu, lula ja'a bera-bera dènge miu era.

source_text: but now i am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘where are you going? '
target_text: yesus aj'a tabha hari, peka na, limuri ne, ja'a neo lèpa asa nèngu dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. te ngaa abhu boe nèti miu ca dhèu sa dhu karèi, na, ‘ama neo lamu mia? '

source_text: but because i have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.
target_text: lula ja'a dhu peka le dènge miu, nèti èèna ka d'ara miu susa.

source_text: nevertheless i tell you the truth: it is to your advantage that i go away; for if i don't go away, the counselor won't come to you. but if i go, i will send him to you.
target_text: te ngaa, ngaa dhu ja'a peka dènge miu ne, lèke tare'a. ladhe ja'a laku, na, miu abhu babe'a na. te ladhe ja'a laku boe, dhèu era sarai-maena èèna mai boe pad'elo j'ara hia miu. te ngaa ladhe ja'a laku, na, ja'a hia ne mai dènge miu.

source_text: when he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;
target_text: pe ladhe na mai, na bhoke ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, ka re'a, na, d'ara dènge tatao ra, sala. na pamako si, sèna ka rèngu madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. aa na pasanèd'e rèngu, na, ladhe lamatua pama'ète lii langu ra, peka na, rèngu se sala, do sala boe.

source_text: about sin, because they don't believe in me;
target_text: dhèu era sarai-maena èèna pad'elo sasala ra, lula rèngu lèka boe ja'a.

source_text: about righteousness, because i am going to my father, and you won't see me any more;
target_text: nèngu pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke kahèi. lula ja'a lèpa asa ama ku, èèna na miu mèdhi heka ja'a. nèti èèna ka, dhèu era sarai-maena ne mai gati ja'a.

source_text: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.
target_text: nèngu peka kahèi, na, ama lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhèu dènge mola, lula lamatua dhu pama'ète nare le lii langu dhèu aae nidhu, dhu paredha rai-haha ne.

source_text: i still have many things to tell you, but you can't bear them now.
target_text: abhu j'ara ae era dhu ja'a neo peka dènge miu, te ngaa ne'e ne miu dhae bisa mèka me'a.

source_text: however, when he, the spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. he will declare to you things that are coming.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe roh dhu pad'elo j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke èèna mai ka, nèngu pad'elo j'ara sèna ka miu bisa me'a j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke. nèngu padhai lii boe nèti d'ara na mesa, te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu na tadèngi sèra mai nèti ama ku. nèngu neo peka dènge miu kahèi, ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i.

source_text: he will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.
target_text: nèngu neo ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha, lula na neo bhoke patalele aa'i hia miu, j'ara dhu lèke lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: all things that the father has are mine; therefore i said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu unu ama ku, unu ja'a kahèi. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka deo na, roh lamatua èèna na bhoke patalele aa'i mèu-mèu j'ara dhu lèke lula-nèti ja'a, aa pad'elo dènge miu.

source_text: a little while, and you will not see me. again a little while, and you will see me.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai, peka na, nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe kahèi, miu mèdhi hari ja'a.

source_text: some of his disciples therefore said to one another, what is this that he says to us, ‘a little while, and you won't see me, and again a little while, and you will see me; ' and, ‘because i go to the father'?
target_text: ka ana madhutu na cahag'e papeka èci dènge èci, aku rèngu na, a'abhu ama èèna, ngaa kèna? ka peka na, ‘nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe kahèi, miu mèdhi hari ja'a. ' aa, nga tao ka na padhai lii, na, ‘lula ja'a neo laku asa ama ku'?

source_text: they said therefore, what is this that he says, ‘a little while'? we don't know what he is saying.
target_text: hèia ra pakarèi, peka na, a'abhu na ngaa, dhu peka na, ‘nèbhu heka'? èdhi te'a boe sasoa na.

source_text: therefore jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that i said, ‘a little while, and you won't see me, and again a little while, and you will see me'?
target_text: te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a rèngu neo karèi ne ca j'ara. hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, deo na ja'a peka na, ‘nèbhu heka, miu mèdhi heka ja'a. te ngaa nèbhu boe, miu mèdhi hari ja'a kahèi. ' miu pakarèi sèmi èèna, si?

source_text: most certainly i tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. you will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
target_text: be'a kahèi, ladhe miu neo me'a sèmi èèna. ja'a neo peka dènge miu kahèi sèmi ne'e: èèna na miu tangi dènge d'ara susa, te ngaa dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne karej'e-karae. masi ka d'ara miu susa, te ngaa èèna na d'ara miu karej'e-karae hari.

source_text: a woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. but when she has delivered the child, she doesn't remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.
target_text: j'ara ne sama sèmi bhèni ca dhèu kabake pèd'a d'ai lod'o neo nara iisi. d'ara na rasa bia, lula d'ai lod'o j'aj'èra na kèna. te ngaa ladhe nara iisi nare, na, j'aj'èra na ele. te d'ara na karej'e, lula abhu dhèu hiu èci dhu mai asa rai-haha.

source_text: therefore you now have sorrow, but i will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge miu. ne'e ne miu tangi dènge d'ara susa. te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ja'a mai paraga hari dènge miu, ka d'ara miu j'aj'i hari karej'e-karae. aa ladhe j'ara ne j'aj'i, abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa bhabhae rare d'ara karae miu.

source_text: in that day you will ask me no questions. most certainly i tell you, whatever you may ask of the father in my name, he will give it to you.
target_text: aa ladhe j'ara sèmi sèra j'aj'i, miu pakarèi heka ngaa-ngaa dènge ja'a. tare'a! ja'a peka hari dènge miu kèna, na, sad'i miu manèngi ngaa èèna ka nèti ama ku, pake kolongara ja'a, èèna na nèngu tao sèmi èèna hia miu.

source_text: until now, you have asked nothing in my name. ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
target_text: toke d'ai sange ne'e, miu dhae manèngi mèka ngaa-ngaa pake kolongara ja'a. de manèngi la, sèna ka miu abhu. dènge j'ara ne, d'ara miu bisa karej'e tare'a-re'a.

source_text: i have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. but the time is coming when i will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the father.
target_text: yesus padhai lii tabha hari, peka na, toke d'ai sange ne'e, ja'a tema aj'a-nori miu pake lii pakasame. te ngaa bèli-camèd'a d'ai lod'o na, ja'a aj'a miu pake heka lii pakasame. te ja'a neo peka mola-mola lula-nèti ama ku.

source_text: in that day you will ask in my name; and i don't say to you that i will pray to the father for you,
target_text: ladhe lod'o èèna d'ai, na, miu mesa mi dhu sabaj'a ho manèngi mi ama ku pake kolongara ja'a. baku dhoka ja'a mesa ku di dhu sabaj'a hia miu.

source_text: for the father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that i came from god.
target_text: te ama ku sue miu, lula miu sue ja'a. aa miu me'a mèu, na, ama lamatua ka dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: i came from the father and have come into the world. again, i leave the world and go to the father.
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a tèke eele ama ku, ho mai pea taha ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a neo tèke eele rai-haha ne, ho laku pea pa'èci hari dènge ne.

source_text: his disciples said to him, behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.
target_text: tadèngi rare sèmi ne'e, hèia ana madhutu yesus se lii, aku rèngu na, de ne'e ne, ama padhai lii mola-mola kèna, aa aj'a-nori pake heka lii pakasame.

source_text: now we know that you know all things, and don't need for anyone to question you. by this we believe that you came from god.
target_text: ji'i nge'a, na, ama dhu me'a aa'i mèu j'ara-j'ara. dhèu parluu heka sèku ama dènge karèi ngaa-ngaa, lula ama dhu me'a uru le ngaa dhu ra neo karèi, aa lii dhaa na tasa mera mia. j'ara ne peka dènge ji'i, na, ama mai nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: jesus answered them, do you now believe?
target_text: hèia yesus karèi, aku nèngu na, tare'a, do? limuri ne, miu lèka ja'a, do?

source_text: behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. yet i am not alone, because the father is with me.
target_text: sèmi ne'e. nèbhu boe, mulai ciki-diki ne, miu aa'i-aa'i mi rai paceb'a. ca dhèu-dhèu ka rai tèke eele ja'a mesa-mesa ku, ho la'e lu'u. masi ka sèmi èèna, ja'a mesa ku boe, lula ama ku bera-bera dènge ja'a.

source_text: i have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. in the world you have trouble; but cheer up! i have overcome the world.
target_text: ja'a peka tèke le j'ara se dènge miu, sèna ka d'ara miu mera-milu, lula miu dhu pa'èki dènge ja'a. te bèli-camèd'a dhèu ètu rai-haha ne pasusa dènge paj'èra miu. te ngaa pa'èra d'ara miu, lula ja'a segi aa'i le koasa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne!

source_text: jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, father, the time has come. glorify your son, that your son may also glorify you; even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare, hèia na ladhe asa dedha-liru, ka sabaj'a, peka na: ama pasue. lod'o d'ai kèna ho ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. ja'a ne, ana ama. ama dhu pangèd'u ja'a hak, sèna ka lalau-lalo'o dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. ama hia hak ne, sèna ka ja'a hia mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u mai ho j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. de ne'e ne, ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha ho pad'elo dadedha ama.

source_text: this is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true god, and him whom you sent, jesus christ.
target_text: j'ara abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, sèmi ne'e: dhèu hud'i tadhe ama ku, nuka ama lamatua dhu lèke. dhu leo aad'o. aa rèngu hud'i tadhe ku ja'a kahèi, nuka yesus kristus, dhu ama pua mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: i glorified you on the earth. i have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.
target_text: ja'a pad'elo le dadedha ama ètu rai-haha ne. ja'a pa'èle le sasab'a dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a.

source_text: now, father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which i had with you before the world existed.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o èdhi paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, ja'a bera-bera le dènge ama. lod'o èèna, dadedha ja'a èci èèna ka dènge dadedha ama. ne'e ne ja'a neo lèpa hari asa ama. de ja'a manèngi ho ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha, sèna ka dadedha ja'a sama sèmi uru èèna.

source_text: i revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. they were yours, and you have given them to me. they have kept your word.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii sabaj'a, peka na, ama hia le dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, j'aj'i dhèu ja'a. ja'a aj'a-nori si, ho rèngu tadhe ama. rèngu j'aj'i dhèu ama, hèia ama pangèd'u si j'aj'i unu ja'a kahèi. ka ra tao madhutu lii holo-nori ama.

source_text: now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,
target_text: limuri ne re'a le, na, j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a sèra, kapua ra nèti ama.

source_text: for the words which you have given me i have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that i came from you. they have believed that you sent me.
target_text: te ja'a aj'a kore le rèngu lii holo-nori dhu ama hia mi ja'a. rèngu sèmi rare kahèi lii holo-nori se'e. re'a kahèi, na, ja'a mai nèti ama. ka ra parcaya, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: i pray for them. i don't pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a hia rèngu. ne'e ne, ja'a sabaj'a boe hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. te ngaa ja'a sabaj'a hia dhèu-dhèu dhu ama pangèd'u mi ja'a, te rèngu se unu ama.

source_text: all things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and i am glorified in them.
target_text: te aa'i-aa'i unu ja'a, sèra sa unu ama kahèi. aa aa'i-aa'i unu ama, sèra sa unu ja'a kahèi. ka dhèu unu ja'a se, dhu ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha.

source_text: i am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and i am coming to you. holy father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
target_text: ja'a pea boe taruu ètu rai-haha ne, lula nèbhu heka ja'a lèpa hari asa ama ku. te ngaa dhèu se hud'i pea taruu ètu rai-haha ne. ama dhu mola-mèci. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama ladhe-leru si pake koasa dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a. ja'a manèngi kahèi ho rèngu pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci, nuka sèmi ja'a pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci dènge ama.

source_text: while i was with them in the world, i kept them in your name. i have kept those whom you have given me. none of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the scripture might be fulfilled.
target_text: karèi nèti ja'a ètu rai-haha ne bera-bera dènge rèngu, ja'a leru si, lula rèngu j'aj'i le dhèu ama. ja'a j'aga aa sanoro si, sèna ka rèngu pa'èki taruu dènge ama. abhu boe dhu ele. dhodhoka yudas di dhu cèri eele, madhutu ngaa dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua karèi nèti uru èèna.

source_text: but now i come to you, and i say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.
target_text: limuri ne, ja'a neo lèpa hari asa ama. ja'a peka le j'ara se'e lod'o ja'a ètu rai-haha ne era. dènge sèmi ne'e, dhèu unu ja'a se d'ara rèngu bisa karej'e-karae taruu, sama sèmi d'ara ja'a.

source_text: i have given them your word. the world hated them because they are not of the world, even as i am not of the world.
target_text: ja'a dhu peka-padhai le dènge rèngu lii holo-nori ama. dhèu leo ètu rai-haha tèka d'ara dènge dhèu unu ja'a, lula mamuri dhèu ja'a, sama boe dènge mamuri rèngu. ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi, te ja'a sama boe sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: i pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.
target_text: ladhe ja'a sabaj'a, ja'a manèngi boe ho ama more si nèti rai-haha ne. aad'o! te ngaa ja'a manèngi, ho ama j'aga si, sèna ka ra pakaj'èu nèti bhabhelu.

source_text: they are not of the world, even as i am not of the world.
target_text: rèngu sama boe dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne, èci èèna ka dènge ja'a dhu sama boe kahèi dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: sanctify them in your truth. your word is truth.
target_text: pake ngaa dhu lèke, sèna ka pamèu d'ara ra. te dhu lèke ka, lii holo-nori ama.

source_text: as you sent me into the world, even so i have sent them into the world.
target_text: ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne. ka ja'a pua-paleha rèngu kahèi sèmi èèna, sèna ka rèngu mamuri pale-lème ètu talora aae dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: for their sakes i sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.
target_text: ja'a j'aga ngi'u ja'a ho mola-mèci taruu hia mi ama. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu unu ja'a j'aga mamuri ra kahèi sèna ka mola-mèci hia mi ama. te lii holo-nori ama dhu lèke, dhu tao si ho ra saraka mamuri rèngu kateme mi ama.

source_text: not for these only do i pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii manèngi-mangaj'i na, aku nèngu na, ja'a sabaj'a, mesa boe hia mi dhèu limuri ne'e di, te ngaa hia rèngu dhu lod'o limuri dhu parcaya ja'a kahèi, lula lii padhai dhèu se'e.

source_text: that they may all be one; even as you, father, are in me, and i in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.
target_text: ama, ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa pa'èki j'aj'i mi èci, sama sèmi èdhi pa'èki j'aj'i èci. ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu j'aj'i èci dènge èdhi, ho hud'i laa dhèu rai-haha ne bisa parcaya, na, ama ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a.

source_text: the glory which you have given me, i have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,
target_text: ama pad'elo le dadedha ja'a mi dhèu sèra. ka ja'a ded'e le rèngu padedha-dedha sama sèmi ja'a. dènge jara ne'e, rèngu pa'èki j'aj'i èci, sama sèmi èdhi kahèi j'aj'i èci.

source_text: i in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.
target_text: ja'a pa'èki dènge rèngu. ama kahèi pa'èki dènge ja'a. rèngu hud'i pa'èki j'aj'i èci sèmi èèna ku, toke ra mamuri d'ara èci dènge be'a. te ladhe rèngu mamuri d'ara èci sèmi èèna, dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne re'a, na, ama dhu sue si, nuka sèmi ama sue ja'a. dènge j'ara ne, rèngu re'a kahèi, na, ama ku dhu pua ja'a.

source_text: father, i desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where i am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.
target_text: ama, ja'a d'èi sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a, bera-bera dènge ja'a. te ja'a neo, sèna ka rèngu bisa ladhe rèdhi ama ded'e ja'a padedha-dedha. te ama sue ja'a mema-mema le, lod'o èdhi dhae paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne.

source_text: righteous father, the world hasn't known you, but i knew you; and these knew that you sent me.
target_text: ama pasue dhu d'ara mola. te ngaa dhèu ètu rai-haha ne tadhe boe ama. ja'a tadhe ama. aa dhèu unu ja'a re'a kahèi, na, ama ka dhu pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: i made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and i in them.
target_text: ja'a dhu peka le dènge rèngu, ama ne, cee. aa èèna na ja'a loe boe peka dènge rèngu sèmi èèna, lula ja'a d'èi ho rèngu re'a mèu sasue ama. te sasue dhu rèngu re'a rèdhi ne'e ne, èci èèna ka dènge sasue ama mi dedha ja'a, sèna ka hud'i laa ja'a pa'èki taruu dènge rèngu.

source_text: when jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.
target_text: ropa yesus manèngi-mangaj'i nare, hèia la'e palere-lere dènge ana madhutu na. lasi asa d'ara oka cue ètu sebhe loko kidron.

source_text: now judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for jesus often met there with his disciples. judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu agama yahudi sèra dènge dhèu-dhèu nèti partei agama parisi saraka mi yudas, sordad'u dènge dhèu j'aga pèri-pèri. te nèngu neo pahie eele yesus. yudas ne'a oka ne kahèi, lula yesus pakaboko dènge ana madhutu na ètu era ne'e pèri-pèri hari le. ka yudas si lasi asa oka ne rèti dènge ob'o, labhu lantera dènge rèka.

source_text: jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, who are you looking for?
target_text: aa te ngaa yesus dhu ne'a uru le aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na j'aj'i. hèia ara la'e asa madha rèngu, ka na lii, peka na, miu tenge cee?

source_text: they answered him, jesus of nazareth. jesus said to them, i am he. judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
target_text: ka ra b'ala, na, ji'i tenge dhèu èci, ngara na yesus, nèti rae nasaret. ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ka ne'e. lod'o èèna, yudas dhu titu dènge dhèu se'e. nèngu ne'e ka dhu pahie yesus.

source_text: when therefore he said to them, i am he, they went backward and fell to the ground.
target_text: ropa yesus peka na, ja'a ka ne'e, hèia dhèu se hari kabodho, ka ra bèbha.

source_text: again therefore he asked them, who are you looking for? they said, jesus of nazareth.
target_text: ka yesus karèi hari, na, miu tenge cee? hèia dhèu se dhaa, aku rèngu na, yesus, dhèu nasaret.

source_text: jesus answered, i told you that i am he. if therefore you seek me, let these go their way,
target_text: hèia na peka dènge ra, deo na ja'a peka kore le, na, nèngu ka ja'a ne. de ladhe miu tenge ja'a, na, baku kèpe dhèu leo. hud'i si lasi.

source_text: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, of those whom you have given me, i have lost none.
target_text: nèngu padhai lii sèmi èèna, sèna ka pamèci dènge ngaa dhu nèngu peka nèdhi le, na, ama. aa'i-aa'i dhu ama pangèd'u le mi ja'a, abhu boe èci sa dhu ele.

source_text: simon peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. the servant's name was malchus.
target_text: lod'o èèna, simon petrus nèti dènge samala iiki èci. ka na bete ho neo pare dhèu. kabèdhi laa, na pare pama'ète rèu dhilu g'ana nèti dhèu èci. dhèu ne ngara na malkus. nèngu ne, ana pua-paleha nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: jesus therefore said to peter, put the sword into its sheath. the cup which the father has given me, shall i not surely drink it?
target_text: ka yesus pua petrus, aku nèngu na, we, petrus! pasaluu hari samala èu èèna asa d'ara sope la'e. te ama ku dhu peka le, na, ja'a hud'i paraga ku dènge j'aj'èra sèmi ne'e ne. de hud'i laa! èèna nuka sèmi nèngu hia ja'a galaa èci dhu isi na pèd'u-èd'u. hud'i laa ja'a kinu toke èle.

source_text: so the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the jews seized jesus and bound him,
target_text: hèia komedhaa, sordad'u dènge dhèu j'aga aa'i-aa'i ra kèpe yesus, ka ra èki ne.

source_text: and led him to annas first, for he was father-in-law to caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
target_text: ka lere rèti uuru ne asa anas. anas ne, ama dhèu èmu kayafas. tèu èèna, kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi.

source_text: now it was caiaphas who advised the jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.
target_text: kayafas ne'e ka dhu peka nèdhi le dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi, aku nèngu na, be'a risi hia miu, ladhe dhèu èci madhe pala dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: simon peter followed jesus, as did another disciple. now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with jesus into the court of the high priest;
target_text: simon petrus dhu madhutu yesus re limuri palere-lere dènge ana madhutu yesus èci, nuka ja'a, yohanis ne. lula kètu kapai risi agama yahudi tadhe ja'a, nèti èèna ka ja'a bisa maso kahèi palere-lere dènge yesus asa madha èmu na.

source_text: but peter was standing at the door outside. so the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in peter.
target_text: te ngaa petrus titu ètu li'u, padètu dènge hèb'a tedhe. hèia ja'a laku asa li'u, ho peka dènge dhèu bhèni èci dhu j'aga hèb'a tedhe ne, sèna ka kèti petrus asa d'ara.

source_text: then the maid who kept the door said to peter, are you also one of this man's disciples? he said, i am not.
target_text: hèia bhèni ne karèi petrus, aku nèngu na, wee! èu ne, ca dhèu ana madhutu dhèu nèi, si? te ngaa petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, aad'o!

source_text: now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. they were warming themselves. peter was with them, standing and warming himself.
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke dènge hèru pacuhi. nèti èèna ka, dhèu madhenga dènge ana pua-paleha sèra dhu titu manyiru ai. ka petrus la'e manyiru ai sama-sama dènge rèngu kahèi.

source_text: the high priest therefore asked jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.
target_text: lod'o èèna, kètu kapai risi dhui nèti agama yahudi parisa yesus lula-nèti a'aj'a na, aa lula-nèti ana madhutu na.

source_text: jesus answered him, i spoke openly to the world. i always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the jews always meet. i said nothing in secret.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge nèngu, aku nèngu na, ja'a peka paled'a, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa tadèngi. ja'a tema aj'a ètu era dhu biasa dhèu yahudi èdhi pakaboko, nuka ètu d'ara èmu sabaj'a èdhi, dènge ètu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. ja'a padhai lii pahuni kèdhi boe.

source_text: why do you ask me? ask those who have heard me what i said to them. behold, they know the things which i said.
target_text: nga tao ka èu karèi ja'a? karèi la dhèu-dhèu dhu nanene lii padhai ja'a. te, tatu re'a ngaa dhu ja'a peka-padhai.

source_text: when he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped jesus with his hand, saying, do you answer the high priest like that?
target_text: ropa na padhai lii sèmi èèna, dhèu j'aga èci dhu titu ètu èèna, tèb'e yesus, ka na peka na, èu baku padhai lii sèmi èèna dènge kètu kapai risi.

source_text: jesus answered him, if i have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?
target_text: ka yesus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ladhe ja'a padhai lii sale, na, pad'elo mia dhu sale nèti lii padhai deo na. te ngaa ladhe ja'a peka lèke, nga tao ka èu tèb'e ja'a?

source_text: annas sent him bound to caiaphas, the high priest.
target_text: èle ka, anas pua dhèu lere ne asa kayafas dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. lod'o lere rèti ne, yesus dhu ra èki era.

source_text: now simon peter was standing and warming himself. they said therefore to him, you aren't also one of his disciples, are you? he denied it and said, i am not.
target_text: lod'o èèna, simon petrus titu manyiru ai era. ka dhèu leo dhu ètu èèna, karèi ne, aku nèngu na, èu ne, ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu dhèu nèi, si? te ngaa petrus pasili, peka na, aad'o!

source_text: one of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear peter had cut off, said, didn't i see you in the garden with him?
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu sab'a èci nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi. nèngu ne, pa'a'ari kahèi dènge dhèu dhu petrus pare pama'ète rèu dhilu na. hèia dhèu ne karèi petrus, peka na, waa! deo na, èu ne ètu d'ara oka nèi, si? te ja'a kèdhi èu ètu nèi!

source_text: peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pasili hari, hèia manu kokotoo dènge.

source_text: they led jesus therefore from caiaphas into the praetorium. it was early, and they themselves didn't enter into the praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the passover.
target_text: d'ara mad'ae aae era, lere rèti yesus nèti kayafas asa èmu jabatan gubernur ètu benteng sordad'u roma. dhèu yahudi se maso boe asa èmu dhèu roma, te èèna pakaj'alu rèngu. te ladhe ra maso, na, rèngu bisa boe ra'a pesta paska.

source_text: pilate therefore went out to them and said, what accusation do you bring against this man?
target_text: hèia gubernur pilatus la'e asa li'u paraga dènge dhèu yahudi se. ka na karèi, aku nèngu na, miu pèci sasala ngaa mi dedha dhèu ne'e?

source_text: they answered him, if this man weren't an evildoer, we wouldn't have delivered him up to you.
target_text: hèia ra b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama. ladhe nèngu ne dhèu bhelu-katub'a boe, na, tatu ji'i mai boe asa madha ama. ngaa hari ji'i mai saraka ne asa kacui-aai ama.

source_text: pilate therefore said to them, take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law. therefore the jews said to him, it is illegal for us to put anyone to death,
target_text: ka gubernur peka dènge dhèu se, na, sèmi ne'e. hud'i laa miu ka dhu uri lii langu na, madhutu atora miu dhèu yahudi. hèia ama-ama dhèu yahudi se, peka na, bisa boe ama. ji'i dhèu yahudi dènge heka hak ho pama'ète hahuku madhe. dhoka miu dhèu paredha roma di dhu dènge hak èèna.

source_text: that the word of jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
target_text: lii padhai lii rèngu èèna, palèke dènge lii padhai dhu uru èèna yesus peka nèdhi le. te nèngu dhu peka le dènge dhèu unu na sèra, na, nèngu madhe madhutu j'ara paredha roma, nuka ra paku ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: pilate therefore entered again into the praetorium, called jesus, and said to him, are you the king of the jews?
target_text: hèia gubernur maso hari asa d'ara benteng sordad'u. ka na paroa yesus, hèia na karèi, peka na, èu ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi, do?

source_text: jesus answered him, do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?
target_text: te ngaa yesus karèi ne, aku nèngu na, ama ka peka sèmi èèna, do abhu dhèu leo ka dhu peka dènge ama lula-nèti ja'a?

source_text: pilate answered, i'm not a jew, am i? your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. what have you done?
target_text: hèia gubernur dhaa, na, eee! ja'a ne dhèu yahudi boe. ana kabarai èu mesa mu ka dhu saraka èu. ngaa hari kètu agama yahudi sèra. èu ne, tao sala ngaa? èu peka sèku!

source_text: jesus answered, my kingdom is not of this world. if my kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that i wouldn't be delivered to the jews. but now my kingdom is not from here.
target_text: ka yesus peka na, ja'a ne, dhèu aae boe nèti rai-haha ne. te ladhe ja'a j'aj'i dhèu aae sama sèmi èèna, tatu dhèu-dhèu ja'a palab'a le, ka dhèu yahudi kèpe boe ja'a. tare'a, ja'a ne dhèu aae. te ngaa ca dhèu sa ètu rai-haha ne ded'e boe ja'a.

source_text: pilate therefore said to him, are you a king then? jesus answered, you say that i am a king. for this reason i have been born, and for this reason i have come into the world, that i should testify to the truth. everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.
target_text: hèia gubernur karèi hari, peka na, de èu ne, dhèu aae, do? ka yesus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama unu mu ka dhu peka, na, ja'a ne dhèu aae. dhu lèke ka, rara iisi ja'a ne, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu aae. ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne ho j'aj'i dhèu aae, sèna ka ja'a peka-padhai j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu kèpe pa'èra j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, rèngu sèra ka dhu nanene ja'a.

source_text: pilate said to him, what is truth? when he had said this, he went out again to the jews, and said to them, i find no basis for a charge against him.
target_text: ka gubernur karèi, peka na, dhu lèke èèna, sèmi ngaa sa? ropa gubernur pilatus padhai lii nare, hèia kalua hari la'e asa dhèu yahudi sèra. ka na peka, ja'a parisa le nèngu, te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa.

source_text: but you have a custom that i should release someone to you at the passover. therefore, do you want me to release to you the king of the jews?
target_text: te ngaa miu dhu tema le, tèu mai-tèu mai lod'o d'ai pesta paska sèmi ne'e, ja'a patabuli ana bèdho ca dhèu hia miu. de tèu ne'e mo'o sèna ka ja'a patabuli dhèu aae yahudi miu, do tasamia?

source_text: then they all shouted again, saying, not this man, but barabbas! now barabbas was a robber.
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, baku patabuli dhèu èèna! patabuli barabas di! barabas ne, ca dhèu dhu bhelu titu kèna.

source_text: so pilate then took jesus and flogged him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, gubernur pilatus pua sordad'u na lasi kalabhe yesus pake gui.

source_text: the soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment. they kept saying, hail, king of the jews! and they kept slapping him.
target_text: aa sordad'u se'e rare kalai aj'u padhudhu kahèi, ho ènyu tao solo. ka ra lalilu solo ne mi kètu yesus, nuka sèmi rèngu neo ded'e dhèu aae hiu dhu pake solo dhèu aae. aa te ngaa sasoa na, ra neo pahahe ne di. hèia ra papake yesus kodho madhera èci dhu mea sanama mangèru, nuka sèmi dhèu aae biasa pake. aa ra sasei ne, peka na, tabea, dhèu aae yahudi! sordad'u se tèb'e ne g'ana-kariu kahèi.

source_text: then pilate went out again, and said to them, behold, i bring him out to you, that you may know that i find no basis for a charge against him.
target_text: ka gubernur la'e hari catèka peka dènge dhèu ae sèra, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e! ja'a kèti ne asa li'u hia miu. te ngaa miu hud'i me'a ku, na, ja'a parisa kore le, te ngaa abhu boe sasala na èci sa.

source_text: jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. pilate said to them, behold, the man!
target_text: ropa rèti yesus asa li'u, nèngu dhu pake era solo padhudhu dènge kodho madhera dhu mea sanama mangèru. hèia gubernur lii dènge dhèu ae se, peka na, ladhe ku, dhèu ne.

source_text: when therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, crucify! crucify! pilate said to them, take him yourselves and crucify him, for i find no basis for a charge against him.
target_text: ropa kètu agama dènge dhèu madhenga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i sèra ladhe rèdhi yesus, hèia ra pa'oo-parodha palere-lere, peka na, pamadhe ne! paku ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha! te ngaa gubernur peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, hud'i laa miu ka dhu mèti ne, lami pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ja'a abhu boe sasala na èci sa, dhu palèke dènge hahuku madhe.

source_text: the jews answered him, we have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the son of god.
target_text: dhèu yahudi dhaa, aku rèngu na, ji'i dènge atora nèti ama lamatua. madhutu atora ne, dhèu ne hud'i madhe ku, lula na ded'e iisi na j'aj'i ana ama lamatua.

source_text: when therefore pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.
target_text: ropa gubernur tadèngi lii padhai ra, hèia asa na madha'u.

source_text: he entered into the praetorium again, and said to jesus, where are you from? but jesus gave him no answer.
target_text: ka la'e hari asa d'ara benteng, hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, èu ne, dhèu mia? te ngaa yesus bhoka boe hèb'a.

source_text: pilate therefore said to him, aren't you speaking to me? don't you know that i have power to release you and have power to crucify you?
target_text: ka gubernur jèke yesus, peka na, eeh! nga tao ka èu b'ala boe ja'a? èu dhu me'a, si? ja'a ne, dènge koasa pamadhe èu, do, patabuli èu.

source_text: jesus answered, you would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.
target_text: hèia yesus b'ala, peka na, sèmi ne'e, ama. ladhe ama dhu dènge koasa sèmi èèna, na, lula ama abhu koasa nèti ama lamatua ètu sorga. te dhodhoka nèngu di dhu hia ama koasa èèna, sèna ka tao ngaa èci sa hia mi ja'a ne. te ngaa dhèu dhu saraka ja'a asa ama, rèngu sèra ka dhu pasae sasala bia risi.

source_text: at this, pilate was seeking to release him, but the jews cried out, saying, if you release this man, you aren't caesar's friend! everyone who makes himself a king speaks against caesar!
target_text: karèi nèti èèna ka, gubernur tenge j'ara ho patabuli yesus. te ngaa dhèu yahudi se pa'oo palere-lere, aku rèngu na, ladhe ama patabuli dhèu ne, tatu ama dhu pa'angalai boe dènge dhèu aae kapai, keser. te dhèu dhu ded'e ngi'u na j'aj'i dhèu aae, nèngu èèna lab'a keser.

source_text: when pilate therefore heard these words, he brought jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called the pavement, but in hebrew, gabbatha.
target_text: ka ropa gubernur tadèngi lii padhai dhèu se, hèia na pua rèti yesus asa li'u. ka gubernur madhèdi ètu kadera pama'ète lii, ètu era èci dhu ra pangare na, tana lapang nèti hadhu kabela. madhutu lii aram, ngara na gabata.

source_text: now it was the preparation day of the passover, at about the sixth hour. he said to the jews, behold, your king!
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge lod'o sadia kalela paska. pe d'ara lod'o titu mera sa, gubernur peka dènge dhèu yahudi sèra, aku nèngu na, ladhe ku laa! nèngu ne, dhèu aae miu!

source_text: they cried out, away with him! away with him! crucify him! pilate said to them, shall i crucify your king? the chief priests answered, we have no king but caesar!
target_text: te ngaa rèngu asa hoe pa'oo-parodha peka na, mèti ne, asa li'u mai! pamadhe ne! paku ne asa aj'u palolo-palèbha! hèia gubernur papane si, peka na, de tasamia? miu d'èi, ladhe ja'a pamadhe dhèu aae miu ne, do? ka kètu agama yahudi se b'ala, peka na, dhèu aae ji'i dhodhoka ca dhèu di, nuka keser! dhèu leo aad'o!

source_text: so then he delivered him to them to be crucified. so they took jesus and led him away.
target_text: hèia gubernur hia yesus asa sordad'u sèra, sèna ka ra paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. hèia sordad'u se sèmi rare yesus.

source_text: he went out, bearing his cross, to the place called the place of a skull, which is called in hebrew, golgotha,
target_text: ka yesus pasae aj'u palolo-palèbha na la'e asa li'u kota. lasi asa era èci dhu ngara na, era rui kètu. madhutu lii aram, era ne ngara na, golgota.

source_text: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and jesus in the middle.
target_text: d'ai era èèna, ra paku yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èci. dhèu se paku kahèi dhèu leo dhèu dua. èci re sebhe g'ana, aa ca dhèu hari re sebhe kariu yesus. ka yesus ètu talora rèngu dua ra.

source_text: pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. there was written, jesus of nazareth, the king of the jews.
target_text: ka gubernur paredha sordad'u na sèra, suri ètu papa èci, ho paku re dedha kètu yesus. ètu papa ne ra suri, peka na, yesus, dhèu nasaret. nèngu ne, dhèu aae dhèu yahudi

source_text: therefore many of the jews read this title, for the place where jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in hebrew, in latin, and in greek.
target_text: rèngu suri ètu papa ne pake tèlu lii, nuka: lii aram, lii yunani, dènge lii latin. dhèu yahudi ae ka dhu baca sasuri ne, lula era mamadhe yesus ne, padètu dènge kota yerusalem.

source_text: the chief priests of the jews therefore said to pilate, don't write, ‘the king of the jews, ' but, ‘he said, i am king of the jews. '
target_text: te ngaa kètu agama yahudi sèra ro'o boe. ka lasi peka dènge gubernur, aku rèngu na, ama! baku suri ‘dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi'! be'a risi suri laa peka na, ‘dhèu ne peka na, nèngu dhèu aae nèti dhèu yahudi. '

source_text: pilate answered, what i have written, i have written.
target_text: te ngaa gubernur dhaa, aku nèngu na, ja'a ka dhu pua si suri sèmi èèna. de hud'i ka laa!

source_text: then the soldiers, when they had crucified jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
target_text: ropa sordad'u paku rare yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, hèia ra pabagi mèdha-papake na mi èpa pala. ca dhèu sordad'u abhu ca pala. hèia rare kodho li'u na, dhu j'au boe, dhu manènu kateme nèti dedha.

source_text: then they said to one another, let's not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be, that the scripture might be fulfilled, which says, they parted my garments among them. they cast lots for my clothing. therefore the soldiers did these things.
target_text: ka ra papeka, aku rèngu na, èdhi baku ciu eele kodho na. be'a risi ère lot, sèna ka te'a, na, cee ka dhu abhu. èèna j'aj'i madhutu sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu peka na, rèngu pabagi mèdha-papake ja'a, ka ra ère lot ho abhu kodho ja'a. hèia sordad'u se tao madhutu sèmi èèna ka.

source_text: but standing by jesus' cross were his mother, his mother's sister, mary the wife of clopas, and mary magdalene.
target_text: ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi dhèu bhèni pèri-pèri dhu titu. rèngu se, nuka: ina yesus, ina iiki yesus, maria dhèu èmu klopas, dènge maria nèti rae magdala.

source_text: therefore when jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, woman, behold, your son!
target_text: yesus ladhe nèdhi ina na dhu titu ètu èèna, sama-sama dènge ja'a, yohanis, nuka ana madhutu dhu nèngu sue. ka yesus lii dènge ina na, aku nèngu na, ina. nèngu ne, ana mu.

source_text: then he said to the disciple, behold, your mother! from that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.
target_text: hèia yesus lii dènge ja'a, peka na, yohanis. nèti deo ne'e, tao laa nèngu sèmi ina èu! ka karèi nèti lod'o èèna, ina yesus pea dènge ja'a.

source_text: after this, jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, said, i am thirsty!
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus ne'a le, na, nèngu sab'a nare aa'i le sasab'a-la'a na. se'e se pamèci dènge aa'i-aa'i dhu suri ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua karèi nèti uru ka. hèia yesus peka, na, ja'a koko-kamango.

source_text: now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.
target_text: ètu era ne'e abhu èi anggor manyilu ètu d'ara g'ala iiki cue. ka sordad'u sèra rare ula ho cèb'u asa èi anggor, hèia èki mi suu aj'u ca laa, ka j'ole asa hèb'a na.

source_text: when jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, it is finished! then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
target_text: ropa yesus camuci nare, hèia na lii, aku nèngu na, èle kèna. hèia kètu na loe, ka ma'ète a'ae.

source_text: therefore the jews, because it was the preparation day, so that the bodies wouldn't remain on the cross on the sabbath for that sabbath was a special one, asked of pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.
target_text: lod'o èèna lèke hari jumat. madhutu atora agama, dhèu yahudi hud'i sadia mema d'ara lod'o èèna, sèna ka bèli èèna rèngu soru lod'o sabaj'a ra. nèti èèna ka, ro'o boe tèke eele ngi'u aae dhèu madhe, kadhoe tèke ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha lèke dènge lod'o sabaj'a. te lod'o sabaj'a èèna, lod'o be'a. de ama-ama dhèu yahudi manèngi gubernur, sèna ka pua dhèu lasi hake papadhe haga dhèu ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, rèngu madhe malai, ho dhèu bisa papuru ngi'u aae ra nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha ako lod'o aae era.

source_text: therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;
target_text: hèia sordad'u se lasi asa era èèna. ka ra hake papadhe uru haga dhèu dua sèra, dhu paku sama-sama dènge yesus.

source_text: but when they came to jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn't break his legs.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ra d'ai yesus, rèdhi, na, yesus dhu madhe le. nèti èèna ka, rèngu hake papadhe boe haga na.

source_text: however, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
target_text: te ngaa sordad'u ca dhèu nare kapoke na, hèia kèj'i d'ara karasa yesus. ka raa kalua, aa èi kalua kahèi.

source_text: he who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. he knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.
target_text: ja'a ne'e ka dhu ladhe kèdhi dènge musi madha ku. ja'a kèdhi aa'i, aa dhu ja'a suri ne lèke tare'a-re'a. te ja'a ke'a mèu ngaa dhu ja'a lolo ne lèke mola-mola, sèna ka miu bisa parcaya lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: for these things happened that the scripture might be fulfilled, a bone of him will not be broken.
target_text: j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i, lula sasuri ama lamatua dhu suri, na, rui na ca laa sa, padhe boe.

source_text: again another scripture says, they will look on him whom they pierced.
target_text: ètu era leo d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ne, suri kahèi, peka na, èèna rèngu ladhe rèdhi dhèu dhu ra kèj'i ne.

source_text: after these things, joseph of arimathaea, being a disciple of jesus, but secretly for fear of the jews, asked of pilate that he might take away jesus' body. pilate gave him permission. he came therefore and took away his body.
target_text: abhu dhèu èci ngara na yusuf, nèti rae arimatea. nèngu ana madhutu yesus kahèi. te ngaa na madhutu pahuni-pahuni, lula madha'u dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi. yusuf la'e asa gubernur pilatus, manèngi ijin sèna ka bisa nèti ngi'u aae yesus. gubernur d'èi kahèi. ka yusuf la'e papuru ngi'u aae yesus, hèia ded'e nèti.

source_text: nicodemus, who at first came to jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred roman pounds.
target_text: nikodemus la'e sama-sama dènge yusuf kahèi. nikodemus ne'e ka dhu uru èèna la'e paraga dènge yesus re mèda. na hèli rampe ae titu kèna, pe d'ai tèlu nguru tèlu kilo sa, sèna ka tao mi ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: so they took jesus' body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the jews is to bury.
target_text: hèia ra hèlu ngi'u aae yesus dènge bèla halus. ladhe hèlu ca tèka, ra tao rampe la'a. rèngu tao sèmi ne'e, madhutu ad'a dhèu yahudi ladhe padhane dhèu madhe.

source_text: now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. in the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.
target_text: kaj'èu boe nèti era yesus madhe ne, abhu oka bunga cue. ètu d'ara oka ne, dhèu heka pae rare ro'a dhèu madhe kèna. ra padhane rèdhi mèka dhèu èci sa ètu d'ara ro'a èèna.

source_text: then, because of the jews' preparation day for the tomb was near at hand, they laid jesus there.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lod'o sadia dhèu yahudi ho soru lod'o sabaj'a ra, oe èle kèna. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se tèke ngi'u aae yesus ètu d'ara ro'a èèna, te era èèna kaj'èu boe.

source_text: now on the first day of the week, mary magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
target_text: hari migu, nuka lod'o partama ètu d'ara migu èèna. mad'ae aae era, maria nèti rae magdala la'e asa ro'a yesus. d'ai era èèna, ladhe nèdhi hadhu aae dhu pake katange ro'a, hari eele nèti era na.

source_text: therefore she ran and came to simon peter and to the other disciple whom jesus loved, and said to them, they have taken away the lord out of the tomb, and we don't know where they have laid him!
target_text: hèia na rai lèpa hari la'e paraga dènge simon petrus aa dènge ja'a, nuka ana madhutu dhu yesus sue, ka na peka, dhèu mana'u rèti le lamatua èdhi nèti ro'a na! te'a boe rèngu tèke ne ètu mia!

source_text: therefore peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.
target_text: ka ja'a dènge petrus rai la'a asa era ro'a èèna.

source_text: they both ran together. the other disciple outran peter and came to the tomb first.
target_text: ji'i rai palere-lere, te ngaa ja'a malai risi, ka d'ai uuru ro'a èèna.

source_text: stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn't enter in.
target_text: te ngaa laku boe asa d'ara ro'a, dhoka patigi nèti li'u di. ètu d'ara ro'a, ja'a ladhe kèdhi bèla halus dhu ra pake hèlu mi ngi'u aae yesus.

source_text: then simon peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. he saw the linen cloths lying,
target_text: te ngaa ropa petrus d'ai, la'e dènge asa d'ara. nèdhi bèla halus dhu ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.
target_text: nèdhi kahèi lesu dhu ra pahutu kètu yesus. te ngaa lesu ne dhu lèpe ètu era leo nèti bèla halus ne.

source_text: so then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.
target_text: hèia ja'a, dhu d'ai uuru ro'a, maso madhutu kahèi asa d'ara. ropa ladhe kèdhi aa'i-aa'i se, ka ja'a parcaya lii padhadha dhu uru èèna yesus peka mema, na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: for as yet they didn't know the scripture, that he must rise from the dead.
target_text: te lod'o èèna, ji'i dhu j'aj'i ana madhutu na, dhae nge'a mèka sasoa nèti isi sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, dhu suri mema, peka na, kristus hud'i mamuri hari ku nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: so the disciples went away again to their own homes.
target_text: èle ka, ji'i dua mi lèpa.

source_text: but mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. so as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,
target_text: te ngaa maria titu era ètu li'u ro'a èèna. nèngu tangi taruu. ka na patigi asa d'ara ro'a ne, aa na tangi era.

source_text: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of jesus had lain.
target_text: ladhe nèdhi ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga dhèu dua. ana pajuu se, pake mèdha-papake pudhi. dua ra madhèdi ètu era dhu ca lod'o ni dhèu paj'unu ngi'u aae yesus. ca dhèu madhèdi re era kètu, aa èci hari dhu madhèdi re era haga.

source_text: they asked her, woman, why are you weeping? she said to them, because they have taken away my lord, and i don't know where they have laid him.
target_text: ana pajuu se karèi maria, aku rèngu na, nga tao ka èu tangi? hèia maria dhaa, peka na, ja'a tangi, lula dhèu ded'e rèti ngi'u aae lamatua ja'a. te ngaa ke'a boe ra tèke ne ètu mia.

source_text: when she had said this, she turned around and saw jesus standing, and didn't know that it was jesus.
target_text: ropa na padhai lii nare, nèngu kabib'a asa li'u. ka ladhe nèdhi ca dhèu dhu titu ètu èèna, te ngaa ne'a boe, na, dhèu ne, nuka yesus.

source_text: jesus said to her, woman, why are you weeping? who are you looking for? she, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and i will take him away.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi ne, peka na, nga tao ka èu tangi? te èu tenge cee? maria pangee, na, nèngu ne dhèu madhenga oka. ka maria pamako dhèu ne, aku nèngu na, ama. ladhe ama ka ded'e mèti ngi'u aae na, peka ku laa, ama tèke ne ètu mia. hud'i laa laku ded'e kèti ne asa era leo, sèna ka padhane ne pabe'a-be'a. sue laa, ama!

source_text: jesus said to her, mary. she turned and said to him, rabboni! which is to say, teacher!
target_text: ka yesus paroa ne, peka na, maria. hèia na kabèli ladhe asa yesus, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, raboni! lii aram, sasoa na, mese ja'a!

source_text: jesus said to her, don't hold me, for i haven't yet ascended to my father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘i am ascending to my father and your father, to my god and your god. '
target_text: yesus peka dènge ne, baku g'ag'e ku ja'a, te ja'a dhae ca'e mèka laku asa ama ku ètu sorga. te ngaa lamu uuru ku peka dènge angalai ja'a sèra, na, ‘ja'a neo ca'e laku asa ama ku. nèngu èèna, ama miu kahèi. nèngu èèna, ama lamatua ja'a. de nèngu, ama lamatua miu kahèi. '

source_text: mary magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the lord, and that he had said these things to her.
target_text: èle ka, maria, dhèu magdala èèna, la'e lolo dènge ana madhutu yesus sèra, peka na, ja'a paraga le dènge lamatua èdhi, yesus! ka na peka dènge rèngu lii moa yesus.

source_text: when therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the jews, jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, peace be to you.
target_text: lod'o èèna, lèke dènge hari migu, nuka lod'o partama ètu d'ara migu èèna. lod'o heka cèna kèna, ka ana madhutu yesus pakaboko. rèngu patèke babèdho èmu ne pa'èra-èra, lula rèngu madha'u dènge ama-ama dhèu yahudi. re'a rare boe, na, yesus titu ètu talora aae rèngu, ka na lii, aku nèngu na, saloom!

source_text: when he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. the disciples therefore were glad when they saw the lord.
target_text: ropa yesus padhai lii nare dènge rèngu sèmi èèna, hèia na pad'elo nu'a dhu ètu kacui-aai dènge karasa na. ana madhutu na karej'e titu kèna, ropa ladhe rèdhi lamatua rèngu.

source_text: jesus therefore said to them again, peace be to you. as the father has sent me, even so i send you.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge rèngu, na, hud'i laa miu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. sanèd'e, te ama ku pua-paleha ja'a tasamia, na, ja'a pua-paleha miu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: when he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, receive the holy spirit!
target_text: padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka na ara padètu la'e asa rèngu, hèia na tiu a'ae na mi rèngu èci-èci. hèia na padhai lii, peka na, ja'a pangèd'u miu roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. sèmi mere ne.

source_text: if you forgive anyone's sins, they have been forgiven them. if you retain anyone's sins, they have been retained.
target_text: de, ladhe miu pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, na, sasala ne ele le, te ama lamatua saku eele sasala èèna kahèi. te ngaa ladhe miu mo'o boe pabhèlu eele sasala dhèu, na, lamatua saku eele boe sasala sèra kahèi.

source_text: but thomas, one of the twelve, called didymus, wasn't with them when jesus came.
target_text: ca dhèu nèti ana madhutu yesus canguru dua sèra, ngara na tomas. ra pangare na, ‘ana kembar' kahèi. ropa yesus pad'elo iisi na dènge ana madhutu dhu leo sèra, tomas aad'o.

source_text: the other disciples therefore said to him, we have seen the lord! but he said to them, unless i see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, i will not believe.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ropa angalai na sèra peka dènge ne, ji'i paraga le dènge lamatua èdhi, hèia tomas dhaa, na, sèmi ne'e. ja'a hud'i ladhe kèdhi ku nu'a era paku sèra ètu kacui-aai na, aa pamaso ai ja'a asa nu'a ètu d'ara karasa na. ladhe ja'a tao mèka sèmi èèna, ja'a bisa mèka parcaya, na, nèngu mamuri hari le.

source_text: after eight days, again his disciples were inside and thomas was with them. jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, peace be to you.
target_text: ca migu hari, ka ana madhutu yesus sama-sama dènge tomas ètu d'ara èmu cue. masi ka babèdho dhu patèke, te ngaa yesus maso asa d'ara, titu ètu talora aae rèngu. ka na hia lii maho'o dènge ra, peka na, saloom!
