source_text: then he said to thomas, reach here your finger, and see my hands. reach here your hand, and put it into my side. don't be unbelieving, but believing.
target_text: hèia na padhai lii dènge tomas, aku nèngu na, j'ole kacui-aai èu mai, ho g'ag'e kacui-aai ja'a ne. aa mai g'ag'e nu'a ètu d'ara karasa ja'a ne. parcaya ka, na, ja'a ne mamuri hari le! core eele ka d'ara parcaya boe èu èèna.

source_text: thomas answered him, my lord and my god!
target_text: tomas dhaa, peka na, ira ii, ama, ee! ja'a heka lèka tare'a-re'a kèna! ama ne, kètu ja'a, aa ama lamatua ja'a kahèi!

source_text: jesus said to him, because you have seen me, you have believed. blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ne, tomas! èu parcaya, na, ja'a mamuri hari le, lula èu mèdhi le ja'a dènge musi madha èu unu mu. te ngaa dhu oto risi ka, nuka dhèu dhu rèdhi boe ja'a, te ngaa ra parcaya.

source_text: therefore jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;
target_text: yesus tao tadha malaa dhu leo ae-ae kahèi, dhu ja'a suri boe ètu d'ara sasuri ne. ana madhutu na ladhe rèdhi tadha malaa se'e dènge musi madha rèngu unu ra.

source_text: but these are written that you may believe that jesus is the christ, the son of god, and that believing you may have life in his name.
target_text: te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a suri ètu d'ara sasuri ne, sèna ka miu parcaya, na, yesus ne, kristus dhu ama lamatua padhadha tèke hia mai. yesus ne, ana ama lamatua kahèi. aa ropa miu parcaya ne, miu abhu mamuri dhu lèke dhu ma'ète boe, lula miu j'aj'i dhèu unu nèngu.

source_text: after these things, jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of tiberias. he revealed himself this way.
target_text: èle pèri-pèri lod'o, ka yesus pad'elo hari iisi na ètu sebhe dano tiberias. lii lolo na, sèmi ne'e ka:

source_text: simon peter, thomas called didymus, nathanael of cana in galilee, and the sons of zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ana madhutu yesus, dhèu pidhu dhu pakaboko. rèngu se, nuka: simon petrus, tomas, dhu ra pangare ne, ‘ana kembar', natanel, nèti rae kana ètu propensi galilea, ana dhèu dua nèti sabadeus, dènge ana madhutu yesus dhu leo dhèu dua.

source_text: simon peter said to them, i'm going fishing. they told him, we are also coming with you. they immediately went out and entered into the boat. that night, they caught nothing.
target_text: simon petrus peka dènge angalai na se'e, ja'a neo laku pèku i'a. hèia angalai na se'e dhaa, aku rèngu na, oo! ji'i la'a kahèi. ka lasi asa sebhe dano. hèia ca'e koha lasi tenge i'a. te ngaa mèda èèna rèngu rara boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: but when day had already come, jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn't know that it was jesus.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, yesus titu ètu sebhe dano ne. te ngaa ana madhutu na sèra re'a boe, na, nèngu ne, yesus.

source_text: jesus therefore said to them, children, have you anything to eat? they answered him, no.
target_text: ka na pa'oo, peka na, mera i'a, do? hèia ra dhaa, peka na, mola-mèu lao! ci'u sa, aad'o hèi.

source_text: he said to them, cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some. they cast it therefore, and now they weren't able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.
target_text: ka yesus peka dènge ra, aku nèngu na, lolo sèku pèku miu asa cabèka koha èèna. pe miu abhu. ka rèngu tao madhutu kahèi. ka ra abhu i'a ae titu kèna, toke rèngu bisa boe ère rare pèku ne asa dedha koha.

source_text: that disciple therefore whom jesus loved said to peter, it's the lord! so when simon peter heard that it was the lord, he wrapped his coat around himself for he was naked, and threw himself into the sea.
target_text: aa ja'a ètu èèna kahèi. ja'a ne, ana madhutu dhu yesus sue. ka ja'a peka dènge petrus, na, ira ii! nèngu nèi, lamatua èdhi! ropa tadèngi nare lii ja'a deo na, hèia simon petrus pake hari kodho na, ka ridhu asa d'ara dano, sèna ka nangi asa dae.

source_text: but the other disciples came in the little boat for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away, dragging the net full of fish.
target_text: te koha ne kaj'èu nèti dae pe d'ai cangasu meter sa. hèia angalai na kao koha asa dae, todhe dènge pèku dhu pènu dènge i'a deo sa.

source_text: so when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.
target_text: ropa rèngu d'ai dae, hèia rèdhi ai karoo, dènge i'a dhu ra paga. aa abhu roti kahèi.

source_text: jesus said to them, bring some of the fish which you have just caught.
target_text: yesus lii dènge ra, mèti ku i'a osa miu d'ai ciki sa, dhu miu heka pèku mere deo na.

source_text: simon peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. even though there were so many, the net wasn't torn.
target_text: ka simon petrus ca'e hari asa dedha koha, ho ère pa'eta pèku ne asa dae. pèku ne dhu pènu dènge i'a aae, cangasu lèmi nguru tèlu ngi'u. masi ka i'a ae sèmi èèna, te ngaa pèku ne mae boe ciki sa hèi.

source_text: jesus said to them, come and eat breakfast! none of the disciples dared inquire of him, who are you? knowing that it was the lord.
target_text: ka yesus paroa si, aku nèngu na, mai mi'a ka! rèngu dhu re'a le, na, nèngu ne lamatua rèngu, ka ra bani boe karèi ne, na, ama ne, cee?

source_text: then jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.
target_text: hèia yesus nare roti dènge i'a, nèti hia si.

source_text: this is now the third time that jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.
target_text: ne'e ne, ka tèlu hari kèna yesus pad'elo iisi na mi ana madhutu na sèra, ropa na mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na.

source_text: so when they had eaten their breakfast, jesus said to simon peter, simon, son of jonah, do you love me more than these? he said to him, yes, lord; you know that i have affection for you. he said to him, feed my lambs.
target_text: ropa ra'a-rinu rare, yesus karèi simon petrus, aku nèngu na, hee, simon ana yohanis. tasamia? èu sue ja'a risi nèti angalai se sue ja'a, do? ka petrus dhaa, na, tare'a ama! èu dhu me'a ja'a sue èu. hèia yesus peka, na, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, madhenga paie ana kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a, sèna ka rèngu abhu ra'a-rinu.

source_text: he said to him again a second time, simon, son of jonah, do you love me? he said to him, yes, lord; you know that i have affection for you. he said to him, tend my sheep.
target_text: hèia yesus karèi hari, aku nèngu na, simon, ana yohanis. tasamia? èu sue ja'a, do? ka na dhaa, na, tare'a ama! èu dhu me'a ja'a sue èu. ka yesus peka hari dènge ne, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, ladhe-leru paie-iie kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a.

source_text: he said to him the third time, simon, son of jonah, do you have affection for me? peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, do you have affection for me? he said to him, lord, you know everything. you know that i have affection for you. jesus said to him, feed my sheep.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yesus karèi hari petrus, peka na, simon, ana yohanis. tasamia? èu ne, angalai ja'a, do? hèia d'ara petrus susa titu kèna, lula yesus karèi ne d'ai tèlu hari, peka na, èu sue ja'a, do? ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama dhu me'a aa'i j'ara. de ama dhu me'a le, na, ja'a ne angalai ama. hèia yesus peka dènge ne, ladhe sèmi èèna, na, ladhe-leru paie kahib'i-kalèbho ja'a se, sèna ka rèngu abhu ra'a-rinu.

source_text: most certainly i tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don't want to go.
target_text: èu dhane more le naneo ja'a, do? ja'a neo peka sèmi ne'e: uru èèna lod'o èu ngèru era, èu tema pake unu mu kodho dènge dhara hake, ho lamu asa mia-mia madhutu dad'èi èu. te ngaa ètu d'ara heka, èu j'ole kacui-aai ho dhèu èki, pake dhara hake èu unu mu. hèia ra ère rèti èu asa era dhu èu d'èi boe.

source_text: now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify god. when he had said this, he said to him, follow me.
target_text: lii padhai yesus ne, peka mi petrus, lula-nèti ngaa dhu j'aj'i bèli-camèd'a mi dedha nèngu. te èèna na mamadhe petrus pad'elo dadedha ama lamatua. hèia yesus lii dènge petrus, aku nèngu na, mai sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu ja'a!

source_text: then peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. this was the disciple whom jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on jesus' chest at the supper and asked, lord, who is going to betray you?
target_text: lod'o èèna, petrus kabib'a asa kabodho. ka ladhe nèdhi ja'a dhu re limuri madhutu rèngu dua ra. ja'a ne, nuka ana madhutu dhu yesus sue. ja'a dhu madhèdi ètu baboa yesus, lod'o ji'i nga'a kalela paska. ja'a ne ka dhu karèi yesus, peka na, ama! cee ka dhu neo pahie ama?

source_text: peter, seeing him, said to jesus, lord, what about this man?
target_text: ropa petrus ladhe nèdhi ja'a, hèia na karèi yesus, peka na, ama! deo na ama peka-padhai le lula-nèti ja'a ne. te ngaa tasamia dènge nèngu hari?

source_text: jesus said to him, if i desire that he stay until i come, what is that to you? you follow me.
target_text: yesus b'ala lii petrus, na, urusan èu aad'o ètu èèna. ladhe ja'a neo sèna ka nèngu mate mi era ne'e toke ja'a mai hari, na, sala ngaa? dhu lèke ka èu hud'i sanèd'e ku lii moa dhu ja'a peka deo na, nuka: mai sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu ja'a.

source_text: this saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn't die. yet jesus didn't say to him that he wouldn't die, but, if i desire that he stay until i come, what is that to you?
target_text: lula yesus padhai lii sèmi èèna, ka ana madhutu na dhu leo sèra papeka, na, yohanis ne, bèli-camèd'a madhe boe. aa te ngaa yesus padhai lii boe sèmi èèna. dhu na peka, na, urusan èu aad'o ètu èèna. ladhe ja'a neo sèna ka nèngu mate mi era ne'e toke ja'a mai hari, na, sala ngaa?

source_text: this is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. we know that his witness is true.
target_text: ana madhutu dhu yesus peka èèna, nuka ja'a ne, yohanis. ja'a ka lole se aa'i-aa'i hia miu. ja'a ka dhu kèdhi dènge musi madha ja'a unu ku. ja'a ka suri aa'i-aa'i se. ka èdhi te'a, na, ngaa dhu ja'a lole hia miu se, lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: there are also many other things which jesus did, which if they would all be written, i suppose that even the world itself wouldn't have room for the books that would be written.
target_text: abhu j'ara leo ae era dhu yesus tao. ladhe dhèu neo suri aa'i mèu-mèu, karèi nèti yesus pakako sasab'a-la'a na toke èle, ja'a ngee na buku se pènu risi rai-haha ne. d'ai sange ne'e ka, yohanis

source_text: the first book i wrote, theophilus, concerned all that jesus began both to do and to teach, until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the holy spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen. to these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about god's kingdom.
target_text: ama teofilus dhu be'a. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, lukas. ètu d'ara sasuri ja'a dhu uru èèna, ja'a suri aa'i mèu-mèu lula-nèti mamuri lamatua yesus. nuka, ngaa dhu na tao, dènge ngaa dhu na aj'a-nori, karèi nèti uru tèka. na hag'e nare dhèu pajuu-paleha na. masi ka dhèu paj'èra ne, aa ra pamadhe ne, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. ropa na kèd'i nèti mamadhe, na pad'elo iisi mi dhèu pajuu-paleha na. ra rèdhi ne padhutu-dhutu toke d'ai èpa nguru lod'o, ka ra re'a, na mamuri hari tare'a. nèngu peka dènge rèngu, na, ama lamatua sama sèmi dhèu aae dhu nèd'u paredha. ka na pua rèngu kahèi pake koasa nèti roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci. lii dhu ja'a suri ne, lole ngaa-ngaa dhu na tao nèti uru, toke d'ai na ca'e hari asa sorga. se'e se ka dhu ja'a suri kèdhi le.

source_text: being assembled together with them, he commanded them, don't depart from jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the father, which you heard from me. for john indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the holy spirit not many days from now.
target_text: ca lod'o hari, ropa yesus pa'èci dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha na ètu dedha ledhe saitun, na hia si paredha peka na, sanèd'e! uru èèna, yohanis sarani dhèu pake dhoka èi di, te ngaa ladhe miu mate hari pèri-pèri lod'o, èèna na lamatua tao ngaa dhu kapai risi eele hia miu. lula na hia miu roh na dhu mola-mèci. de baku tèke eele kota yerusalem kahèi. te ngaa miu mate mi ne'e, toke d'ai ama ku papuru roh na mi dedha miu, sèmi dhu na moa le uru èèna. aa miu tadèngi le nèti ja'a kahèi.

source_text: therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to israel?
target_text: ropa yesus pakaboko dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha na era, ra karèi ne, aku rèngu na, ama! ji'i neo karèi: ama sanèd'e era, sina ma, dhu uru èèna, kabarai èdhi isra'el paredha unu na? de ama neo patabuli èdhi nèti dhèu leo deo ne'e, do, mate hari lod'o leo?

source_text: he said to them, it isn't for you to know times or seasons which the father has set within his own authority.
target_text: hèia yesus dhaa, peka na, miu pakarèi ia ka lod'o èèna! dhoka ama ku di, dhu pama'ète j'aj'aj'i lod'o èèna na.

source_text: but you will receive power when the holy spirit has come upon you. you will be witnesses to me in jerusalem, in all judea and samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci mai maso asa d'ara miu, heka miu abhu koasa kèna. hèia miu hud'i lami palolo dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra lula-nèti ja'a. miu peka dènge dhèu ètu kota yerusalem, ètu rae aa'i-aa'i ètu propensi yudea dènge propensi samaria, taruu toke d'ai suu-suu rai-haha ne.

source_text: when he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.
target_text: ropa na padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ama lamatua paca'e yesus asa dedha-liru la'e ètu katanga madha rèngu. ra ladhe taruu, toke d'ai ra'i-liru hutu nare ne, ka rèngu rèdhi heka.

target_text: rèngu d'èi pa'èci dènge dhèu-dhèu leo dhu madhutu yesus. aa rèngu mamuri mera-milu èci dènge èci. bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu maj'èni nanene lii holo-nori nèti dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus. rèngu d'èi manèngi-mangaj'i sama-sama kahèi. aa rèngu d'èi ra'a-rinu mei èci.

source_text: fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua sèra tao tadha malaa ae-ae, ka dhèu dhu ètu sèra sa malaa dènge madha'u.

source_text: all who believed were together, and had all things in common.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus, aa'i-aa'i ra mamuri pakaboko dènge d'ara èci, ka ngaa dhu unu dhèu èci, j'aj'i unu rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra, ho ra pake sama-sama.

source_text: they sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.
target_text: abhu cahag'e pahia mèdha-panyau ra, ho ra pala-bagi doi kab'ua na mi dhèu parcaya sèra, madhutu èci-èci dhu parluu.

source_text: day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,
target_text: bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu pa'èci ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. rèngu ra'a-rinu boko-boko mue-mue dènge d'ara karej'e-karae, nèti èmu èci asa èmu èci, dènge boe ka'uu-kamuki. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra mamuri èci tulu èci, dènge boe kire-kome.

source_text: praising god and having favor with all the people. the lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.
target_text: bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra ma'ète boe koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme. dhèu leo sèra d'èi rèngu titu kèna. nèti ca lod'o asa ca lod'o ama lamatua hia mamuri mi dhèu sèra, ho ra pa'èci dènge dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua yesus. ka rèngu asa ka ae.

source_text: peter and john were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.
target_text: ca lod'o, pe d'ara hake tèlu nihia sa, petrus dènge yohanis lasi asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, ho neo sabaj'a dènge dhèu leo sèra.

source_text: a certain man who was lame from his mother's womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.
target_text: rèngu neo maso re hèb'a oka, dhu ngara na ‘hèb'a saraga'. ètu èèna, rèngu rèdhi dhèu mone karuku èci, dhu karuku nèti ina na nara iisi ne. bèli-bèli mai, na, dhèu nedhe rèti ne asa era èèna, ho na kanata kacui-aai manèngi ngaa-ngaa nèti dhèu cee dhu neo maso asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i re èèna.

source_text: seeing peter and john about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.
target_text: ropa na ladhe nèdhi petrus dènge yohanis oe maso asa d'ara, ka na kanata kacui-aai, manèngi, peka na, ama-ama, ee! sue ku ja'a laa. hia ku ja'a ngaa, do?

source_text: peter, fastening his eyes on him, with john, said, look at us.
target_text: ka dua ra ladhe kaloo ka dhèu ne'e, hèia petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, ladhe ku mai!

source_text: he listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.
target_text: hèia nèngu boti kètu na, ladhe asa rèngu dua ra, ka na pangee, na, waa! ele boe dua ra neo hia ja'a ngaa-ngaa ne.

source_text: but peter said, i have no silver or gold, but what i have, that i give you. in the name of jesus christ of nazareth, get up and walk!
target_text: te ngaa petrus peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a dènge boe doi hualaa ho hia mi èu! te, ngaa dhu ja'a unu, èèna ka dhu ja'a neo hia mi èu. de nanene paie-iie! dènge koasa yesus kristus, dhèu nasaret, ja'a pua èu kèd'i titu, ho kako!

source_text: he took him by the right hand and raised him up. immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.
target_text: hèia petrus kèpe ai g'ana dhèu karuku èèna, ka na pakèd'i patitu ne. kaca'a laa, haga dhèu ne'e be'a dènge ka, ètu d'ara ciki ood'e èèna kahèi.

source_text: leaping up, he stood and began to walk. he entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising god.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, na pasoka titu, hèia na kako la'e-mai neo ne'a, haga nèngu be'a le, do dhae. èle èèna ka, na la'e palere dènge rèngu dua ra asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i. na kako pasoa-pasoka dènge koa-kio ama lamatua.

source_text: all the people saw him walking and praising god.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèra ladhe rèdhi dhèu ne'e kako la'e-mai, aa koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: they recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the beautiful gate of the temple. they were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae sèra tadhe ne, ka ra malaa, hèia peka, aku rèngu na, nèngu ne'e ka dhèu karuku dhu madhèdi ètu hèb'a saraga, ho manèngi ngaa-ngaa èèna, sina ma? tasamia ka na j'aj'i sèmi ne'e?

source_text: as the lame man who was healed held on to peter and john, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called solomon's, greatly wondering.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu dhu èle nèti karuku èèna, madhutu petrus dènge yohanis. ka tèlu ra lasi d'ai èmu taleo cue, ngara na ‘èmu taleo dhèu aae soleman'. ètu èèna, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mai lingu rare rèngu malaa titu kèna.

source_text: when peter saw it, he responded to the people, you men of israel, why do you marvel at this man? why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?
target_text: ropa petrus nèdhi rèngu, ka na padhai lii, peka na, dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi! nga tao ka miu malaa, lula j'ara ne'e ne? nga tao ka miu ladhe kaloo ji'i? miu ngee, na, dhèu ne kako lula ji'i pake na'i, do, lula ji'i maj'èni madhutu ama lamatua? do, tasamia?

source_text: the god of abraham, isaac, and jacob, the god of our fathers, has glorified his servant jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of pilate, when he had determined to release him.
target_text: ja'a neo peka dènge miu sèmi ne'e: bèi-baki èdhi abraham, isak dènge yakob manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua. lamatua èèna ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha dhèu nèngu dhu na pili nare, nuka yesus. yesus èèna ka dhu miu tule eele ne, ka saraka ne asa gubernur pilatus. ka gubernur neo patabuli ne, te ngaa miu ka dhu palab'a, sèna ka na baku patabuli eele yesus.

source_text: but you denied the holy and righteous one and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,
target_text: te ngaa yesus, dhèu dhu sala boe. d'ara nèngu be'a. gubernur neo patabuli eele dhèu dhu sala boe ne, te ngaa miu aa'i-aa'i mi lab'a ne. aa dhu bhelu risi hari ka, miu dadugu-rariu ne, sèna ka na patabuli hia miu dhèu bhelu-katub'a èci dhu pamadhe nèdhi dhèu.

source_text: and killed the prince of life, whom god raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.
target_text: miu ka dhu pamadhe yesus! aa te ngaa nèngu ka dhu hia èdhi mamuri. mema tare'a nèngu madhe le, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. nèngu ka dhu ji'i ladhe ngèdhi le dènge musi madha ji'i.

source_text: by faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.
target_text: miu tadhe dhèu karuku ne. nèngu èra le, te ngaa ji'i boe ka dhu puri-pa'èle ne. ji'i se dènge boe koasa ngaa-ngaa. koasa èèna mai nèti yesus. dhèu ne'e ne èra, lula nèngu parcaya lamatua yesus. yesus ka dhu pa'èle ne, ètu katanga madha miu aa'i-aa'i mi.

source_text: now, brothers, i know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! limuri ne, ja'a ke'a le, miu dènge dhèu aae-dhèu kapai miu, tao bhelu mi dedha yesus, te ngaa miu me'a boe ngaa dhu j'aj'i lèpa limuri.

source_text: but the things which god announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua peka mema nèti uru ka mai, pake dhèu nèti lii padhai nèngu, peka na, kristus, nuka dhèu dhu na hag'e nare èèna, hud'i d'ui ku j'aj'èra. ka j'aj'i le, sèmi èèna ka!

source_text: repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the lord,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i ele-ho'a, tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu, hèia lèpa asa ama lamatua, ho na saku eele aa baku ngee ia ka sasala miu sèra.

source_text: and that he may send christ jesus, who was ordained for you before,
target_text: pe ama lamatua pa'èra d'ara miu. ka na neo pua kristus dhu na hag'e nare èèna, mai hari asa miu. kristus èèna, nuka yesus, dhu na pua le mai asa miu.

source_text: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which god spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.
target_text: nèti uru ka mai, lamatua padhai lii re dhèu nèti lii padhai na, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a, ama lamatua pamola j'ara aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka j'aj'i hiu. ' yesus hud'i mate ku ètu era mola-mèci toke d'ai lod'o nèngu mai hari, ho na pahiu ngaa-ngaa aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘the lord god will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. you shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.
target_text: uru èèna, baki musa peka le dènge dhèu isra'el, aku nèngu na, ‘lamatua miu, nuka ama lamatua, bèli-camèd'a na pua dhèu èci nèti talora miu, ho j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai na, sama sèmi na pake ja'a, ho j'aj'i dhèu kèti lii padhai na. de miu hud'i pasa dhilu, sèna ka mi nanene paie, ngaa-ngaa dhu na neo peka mi miu.

source_text: it will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people. '
target_text: te ngaa dhèu cee dhu ro'o boe nanene paie, lii padhai lii dhèu èèna, èèna na cèri eele nèti dhèu unu lamatua sèra. dènge heka hak ètu talora rèngu. '

source_text: yes, and all the prophets from samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.
target_text: mesa boe baki musa di dhu peka sèmi èèna. te lamatua pake dhèu leo kahèi, j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai na. rèngu peka sèmi èèna kahèi. sama sèmi uru èèna, lamatua pake baki samuel, ho lolo j'ara-j'ara dhu limuri ne èdhi tèdhi dènge musi madha èdhi.

source_text: you are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which god made with our fathers, saying to abraham, ‘all the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring. '
target_text: ama lamatua moa tèke le, mi baki abraham, peka na, ‘bèli-camèd'a, re ana-èpu èu èci, ja'a hia mèngi-nale mi dedha suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. ' lii moa dhu ama lamatua peka le mi dhèu rèti lii padhai na, limuri ne, j'aj'i le mi dedha miu, nuka a'ari ja'a dhèu isra'el sèra.

source_text: god, having raised up his servant jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.
target_text: ama lamatua pua ana na dhu na hag'e nare èèna, ho paj'uj'u j'ara, sèna ka miu tèke eele sasala-sasigo miu. dènge sèmi èèna, na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu. lamatua pua uuru ana na mai asa miu, èle èèna, heka na pua ne asa suku leo sèra. èèna ka dhu j'aj'i mèngi-nale mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti.

source_text: as they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the sadducees came to them,
target_text: lod'o èèna, ropa petrus dènge yohanis padhai lii era dènge dhèu ètu sèra, dhèu kapai canau mai. rèngu sèra, kètu agama yahudi, dhèu nèti partei saduki, dènge komedhaa j'aga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. rèngu mai neo patao dènge petrus dènge yohanis.

source_text: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in jesus the resurrection from the dead.
target_text: dhèu sèra nasa, lula rèngu dua ra d'èi peka dènge dhèu ae, peka na, yesus mamuri hari le nèti mamadhe na. dènge j'ara èèna, nèngu bhoke j'ara hia dhèu madhe sèna ka bisa mamuri hari.

source_text: they laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.
target_text: ka ra paredha dhèu rèngu lasi kèpe dua ra. te ngaa, lula lod'o oe cèna kèna, ka ra pamaso taha si asa d'ara bèdho. ho bèli èèna, heka ra neo parisa si kèna.

source_text: but many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.
target_text: te ngaa ètu talora dhèu dhu d'èi nanene dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus sèra, ae ka dhu mangaku, na, lii aj'a-nori rèngu sèra lèke tare'a. nèti èèna ka dhèu parcaya asa tabha ae, pe d'ai lèmi riho dhèu sa.

source_text: in the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in jerusalem.
target_text: asa bèli èèna, dhèu kapai yahudi sèra pakaboko ètu kota yerusalem, nuka dhèu paredha, dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a yahudi, dènge mese agama yahudi sèra.

source_text: annas the high priest was there, with caiaphas, john, alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.
target_text: kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, dhu ngara na hanas, ètu èèna kahèi. dhèu kapai leo, sèmi kayafas, yohanis, aleksander, dènge a'ari leo sèra nèti kètu kapai risi agama yahudi ètu èèna kahèi.

source_text: when they had stood peter and john in the middle of them, they inquired, by what power, or in what name, have you done this?
target_text: ropa ra tesa aa'i, ka ra paredha dhèu lasi rare petrus dènge yohanis, ho rèti mai asa madha ama-ama dhèu kapai se'e. ropa rèngu mai, ka ra karèi si, peka na, tasamia ka miu bisa puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku? miu pake koasa nèti cee? aa cee ka dhu pua miu ka miu bani tao j'ara èèna?

source_text: then peter, filled with the holy spirit, said to them, you rulers of the people and elders of israel,
target_text: hèia roh ama lamatua pa'èra d'ara petrus, ka na dhaa, aku nèngu na, ama-ama! miu ka dhèu kapai, dènge dhèu heka kabarai isra'el! baku nasa ladhe ji'i ako malaa ciki.

source_text: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,
target_text: ji'i ladhe, na, ama-ama si neo tao lii langu, lula ji'i puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku èci. aa miu neo me'a ji'i pake koasa nèti cee?

source_text: may it be known to you all, and to all the people of israel, that in the name of jesus christ of nazareth, whom you crucified, whom god raised from the dead, this man stands here before you whole in him.
target_text: de ja'a neo peka sèmi ne'e: tatu ama si sanèd'e era dhèu nasaret, dhu ngara na yesus. nèngu èèna, kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u mema nèti uru ka mai. te ngaa miu paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. de ja'a d'èi sèna ka ama si dènge dhèu isra'el aa'i-aa'i mi me'a, na, ji'i puri-pa'èle dhèu karuku èèna, pake dhodhoka koasa yesus.

source_text: he is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner. '
target_text: yesus ne'e ka dhu ra suri tèke le ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, ‘abhu hadhu cue dhu tuka core eele; te ngaa limuri mai, hadhu èèna j'aj'i hadhu padhèdi. '

source_text: there is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!
target_text: ètu palème rai-haha ne, ama lamatua bhoke boe j'ara leo dhu bisa patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi. dhodhoka j'ara èci di, nuka yesus. abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu bisa hia mamuri mi èdhi.

source_text: now when they saw the boldness of peter and john, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. they recognized that they had been with jesus.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu sèra sa re'a, na, petrus dènge yohanis se, dhoka dhèu biasa di, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu re'a boe baca-suri. te ngaa dhèu sèra malaa dènge babani dua ra, lula rèngu padhai lii dhu dènge boe pahuni-pahuni. tabha hari, ra re'a, na, dhèu dua se, dhèu pa'èci nèti yesus.

source_text: seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, hèb'a dhèu se kutu mèno, toke ra padhai lii heka ae-ae, lula dhèu dhu èle nèti karuku èèna, titu dhii-dhii patoo madha dènge madha.

source_text: but when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra pua dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus dhèu dua sèra, aku rèngu na, dua mi lami ku asa li'u ciki. ka ra padhue ho neo tenge j'ara aapa.

source_text: saying, what shall we do to these men? because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in jerusalem, and we can't deny it.
target_text: ka ra padhue-padhai, peka na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! èdhi hud'i tao dhèu dua se samia? te dhèu yerusalem aa'i-aa'i ra re'a le, na, rèngu dua se ka dhu tao tadha malaa deo na. èdhi pasili tare heka, lula bukti nèngu abhu le!

source_text: but so that this spreads no further among the people, let's threaten them, that from now on they don't speak to anyone in this name.
target_text: de hua iia èdhi tenge j'ara, sèna ka lii ne'e baku ra lolo palème asa mia-mia la'e. be'a risi èdhi pamadha'u si, sèna ka ra baku aj'a ia ka j'ara mamuri yesus. ladhe ra nanene boe, na, re'a mema!

source_text: they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of jesus.
target_text: hèia ra paroa dua ra maso hari asa d'ara, ka ra peka dènge si, aku rèngu na, miu ladhe unu mi, ee! miu bisa heka lolo, do, aj'a-nori dhèu leo lula-nèti yesus!

source_text: but peter and john answered them, whether it is right in the sight of god to listen to you rather than to god, judge for yourselves,
target_text: te ngaa petrus dènge yohanis b'ala, peka na, cob'a ama-ama si pajiko ku laa. mia dhu be'a risi? madhutu paredha ama si, do, madhutu paredha ama lamatua?

source_text: for we can't help telling the things which we saw and heard.
target_text: te ji'i ngèdhi le dènge musi madha ji'i, aa tadèngi le dènge ro'a dhilu ji'i madha j'ara ae. de tasamia ji'i kutu hèb'a, ho baku lolo dènge dhèu leo!

source_text: when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified god for that which was done.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhèdi pama'ète lii langu èèna, kai hari rèngu. ka ra patalale eele dua si, lula ra re'a heka j'ara ho huku si. rèngu madha'u kahèi, mage dhoka dhèu ae ètu li'u sèi pagama. te dhèu ae sèra koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua, lula dhèu karuku èèna èle le.

source_text: for the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.
target_text: dhèu èèna karuku èpa nguru risi tèu le, ka heka bisa kako kèna.

source_text: being let go, they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.
target_text: ropa ra patabuli eele petrus dènge yohanis, dua ra lèpa lasi asa angalai rèngu. hèia dua ra lole aa'i-aa'i ngaa dhu kètu agama yahudi dènge dhèu kapai leo sèra kai rèngu ho baku palolo.

source_text: when they heard it, they lifted up their voice to god with one accord and said, o lord, you are god, who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare lii lolo èèna, ka angalai rèngu aa'i-aa'i sèra pakaboko dènge d'ara èci, ho ra manèngi-mangaj'i, peka na, ama lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi eele. ama dhu paj'aj'i dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, dènge isi ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: who by the mouth of your servant david, said, ‘why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
target_text: uru-uru sèra, roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci pake le baki daud ho j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai na, sèna ka suri mema lula-nèti dhèu lab'a yesus, peka na, ‘dhèu nèti rai leo sèra nasa lula lii lai-ngèlu; dhèu se'e tao lèke boe, ho tao lii langu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua.

source_text: the kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers plot together, against the lord, and against his christ. '
target_text: dhèu aae rai-haha sèra pakaboko ho neo pamusu lab'a ama lamatua; sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu kapai sèra rare lii èci neo lasi lab'a ama lamatua dènge kristus, nuka dhèu dhu lamatua paj'uj'u mema karèi nèti uru ka mai. '

source_text: for truly, both herod and pontius pilate, with the gentiles and the people of israel, were gathered together against your holy servant jesus, whom you anointed,
target_text: ka ngaa dhu baki daud suri na, limuri ne j'aj'i le. aa sasoa na led'a le. ètu kota ne'e, dhèu aae herodes, gubernur pontius pilatus, dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a isra'el, dènge dhèu kapai suku leo sèra, pakaboko le. rèngu pare'a lii ho lab'a yesus, dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le.

source_text: to do whatever your hand and your counsel foreordained to happen.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi te'a aa'i le j'ara sèra lèke mola-mola dènge dad'èi lamatua, madhutu ngaa dhu lamatua peka tèke nèti uru ka.

source_text: now, lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
target_text: lamatua, èu me'a rèngu dhoka padhai lii neo pamadha'u ji'i di. de ji'i manèngi ho lamatua hia ji'i d'ara bani. sèna ka ladhe ji'i la'a padhue-padhai asa dhèu ètu mia-mia lii lolo be'a lamatua lula-nèti yesus, d'ara ji'i madha'u boe.

source_text: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy servant jesus.
target_text: ji'i manèngi lamatua hia ji'i koasa kahèi, sèna ka ji'i bisa puri-pa'èle dhèu pèd'a. ji'i manèngi kahèi koasa ho tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa, sèna ka dhèu re'a, koasa èèna mai nèti dhèu mola-mèci dhu lamatua pua mai, nuka yesus. lamatua, d'ai sange èèna ka lii sabaj'a ji'i.

source_text: when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. they were all filled with the holy spirit, and they spoke the word of god with boldness.
target_text: ropa ra manèngi-mangaj'i rare, ka èmu dhu rèngu sabaj'a na gaged'o. hèia rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra abhu roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. èle èèna ka, rèngu kalua, lasi lole lii lolo be'a ama lamatua, dènge d'ara bani.

source_text: the multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.
target_text: èle èèna, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya yesus sèra, mamuri d'ara èci, aa mamuri pasue èci dènge èci. abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu mèu-moke, aa rèngu biasa pahia-paj'ola. dhèu dhu dènge mèdha-panyau, na uri ho ra pake sama-sama.

source_text: with great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the lord jesus. great grace was on them all.
target_text: ka lamatua hia koasa mi dhèu pajuu-paleha na, ho ra lole mi dhèu, peka na, lamatua yesus mamuri hari nèti mamadhe na. aa rèngu ka dhu rèdhi dènge musi madha unu ra. ka lamatua udhu-bhori berkat hia rèngu.

source_text: for neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold, and laid them at the apostles' feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.
target_text: nèti rèngu se, abhu kahèi dhu pahia rai, do èmu ra. ho kab'ua na, ra hia mi dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua sèra. ra pake ho hia mi dhèu dhu parluu. nèti èèna ka, rèngu kura boe ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: joses, who by the apostles was also called barnabas which is, being interpreted, son of encouragement, a levite, a man of cyprus by race, having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles' feet.
target_text: conto sèmi yusuf. nèngu ne, ana-èpu lewi, nèti pulu siprus. dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua se pangare na ‘barnabas', dhu sasoa na, ‘dhèu dhu d'èi pa'èra d'ara dhèu leo'. la'e pahie rai na ca kasib'i. ka nèti mai kab'ua na hia dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua sèra.

source_text: but a certain man named ananias, with sapphira his wife, sold a possession,
target_text: te ngaa lod'o èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu èci, ngara na ananias, dènge dhèu èmu na, safira. rèngu dua ra pahie rai ra ca kasib'i kahèi.

source_text: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles' feet.
target_text: te ngaa dua ra pare'a ho huni kab'ua rai èèna cahag'e. pahie rare, ka ananias la'e peka dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus sèra, aku nèngu na, ji'i heka pahie ngare rai ji'i ca kasib'i kèna. de ji'i neo hia kab'ua na asa ama lamatua.

source_text: but peter said, ananias, why has satan filled your heart to lie to the holy spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?
target_text: te ngaa petrus tao dènge ne, peka na, ananias! nga tao ka èu huni doi kab'ua rai èèna cahag'e? d'ara èu mema karehe, lula èu madhutu dad'èi dhèu aae nidhu. èu bani kapod'e-kabèli roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci!

source_text: while you kept it, didn't it remain your own? after it was sold, wasn't it in your power? how is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? you haven't lied to men, but to god.
target_text: sèmi ne'e! rai na unu èu. de èu neo pahia, do aad'o, èèna na madhutu dad'èi èu. ladhe èu pahia le, èu neo hia doi kab'ua na aa'i-aa'i, do aad'o, èèna na madhutu dad'èi èu kahèi. te ngaa tasamia ka èu bisa tao sèmi ne'e? èu neo pagoa ji'i dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa abhu boe dhèu dhu bisa leko-monya lamatua!

source_text: ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. great fear came on all who heard these things.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi petrus padhai lii sèmi èèna, cag'ag'a laa ananias bèbhe, ka madhe dènge. nèti èèna ka, dhèu dhu tadèngi lii ne'e, madha'u titu kèna.

source_text: the young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.
target_text: hèia ana ngèru dhèu pèri mai, ka ra pahutu ngi'u ananias, ka nedhe rèti lasi padhane.

source_text: about three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.
target_text: pe d'ai tèlu jam sa, dhèu èmu ananias mai. te ngaa na ne'a boe ngaa dhu j'aj'i deo na.

source_text: peter answered her, tell me whether you sold the land for so much. she said, yes, for so much.
target_text: hèia petrus karèi ne, peka na, tasamia, ina? miu pahie le rai èèna, kab'ua sange ne'e ka, do? ka na dhaa, peka na, tare'a, ama. kab'ua nèngu sange èèna ka.

source_text: but peter asked her, how is it that you have agreed together to tempt the spirit of the lord? behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.
target_text: hèia petrus tao dènge ne, peka na, tasamia ka èu dènge dhèu èmu mu pame'a ho neo cob'a roh lamatua? mu ladhe, ee! dhèu dhu heka padhane dhèu èmu èu sèra, lèpa hari mai le. ciki ood'e hari na, rèngu nedhe rèti hari ngi'u èu, ho lasi padhane ètu karasa dhèu èmu èu.

source_text: she fell down immediately at his feet and died. the young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii padhai lii petrus, cag'ag'a laa dhèu bhèni ne bèbhe, ka madhe dènge ètu era èèna. ropa ana-ana ngèru sèra maso hari asa d'ara èmu, ladhe rèdhi bhèni ne madhe le. ka j'èru rèti ka ngi'u bhèni ne, lasi padhane ètu karasa dhèu èmu na.

source_text: great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu parcaya yesus sèra madha'u. dhèu-dhèu leo dhu tadèngi lii lolo nèti mamadhe ananias dènge safira, madha'u kahèi.

source_text: by the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. they were all with one accord in solomon's porch.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus sèra tao ae tadha-tadha malaa. ka dhèu ae sèra ladhe rèdhi. dhèu pajuu-paleha sèra biasa lasi asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i lamatua. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pakaboko dènge d'ara èci ètu d'ara èmu taleo dhèu aae soleman.

source_text: none of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae ka dhu koa dhèu unu lamatua yesus sèra. te ngaa dhèu leo cahag'e bani boe maso pakaboko dènge rèngu ètu èmu èèna.

source_text: more believers were added to the lord, multitudes of both men and women.
target_text: te dhèu dhu parcaya yesus, bhèni-mone, asa tabha ae.

source_text: they even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as peter came by, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.
target_text: lula tadha malaa ae dhu j'aj'i èèna, ka dhèu ae rèti dhèu pèd'a lasi ho ra pamadhèdi mi dedha dhèpi ètu sebhe j'ara. te ra pangee, peka na, ladhe petrus dènge yohanis kako re era ne'e, sad'i mamaho ra lèke rèngu di, dhèu pèd'a se èle dènge nèti papèd'a rèngu.

source_text: the multitude also came together from the cities around jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu ae mai taruu nèti rae-rae ètu sebhe kota yerusalem. rèti dènge dhèu-dhèu pèd'a, ka dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua se puri-pa'èle si aa'i-aa'i ra. rèngu rèti dhèu-dhèu dhu nidhu tao kahèi, ka dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua se babège eele aa'i nidhu-nidhu sèra.

source_text: but the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him which is the sect of the sadducees, and they were filled with jealousy
target_text: lula tatao dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus sèra, nèti èèna ka kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, dènge angalai nèngu nèti partei saduki sèra, tèka d'ara.

source_text: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ra kèpa dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus sèra, ka ra pamaso si asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: but an angel of the lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,
target_text: te ngaa mèda èèna kahèi, ana pajuu lamatua èci mai nèti sorga asa d'ara bèdho èèna, ka na bhoke eele babèdho. hèia na lere nèti si asa li'u. ka na peka, aku nèngu na,

source_text: go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.
target_text: lami dènge ka asa d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. lami peka aa'i dènge dhèu-dhèu ètu nèi, sèna ka ra madhutu j'ara mamuri dhu hiu nèti lamatua yesus.

source_text: when they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. but the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.
target_text: bèli mad'ae èèna, ako maroga era, rèngu madhutu ka lii paredha nèti ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga deo na. ka ra maso asa d'ara madha èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, hèia ra aj'a-nori dhèu-dhèu ètu sèra. nèbhu boe, hèia kètu kapai risi agama yahudi dènge angalai na sèra mai palere dènge dhèu kapai dènge dhèu heka-dhèu heka ad'a isra'el. rèngu pakaboko ho parisa lii langu nèti dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus sèra. hèia ra pua dhèu lasi rare petrus si nèti d'ara bèdho, ho ra parisa lii langu ra.

source_text: but the officers who came didn't find them in the prison. they returned and reported,
target_text: te ngaa ropa rèngu d'ai èmu bèdho, petrus si aad'o heka ètu d'ara. ka ana j'aga sèra lèpa hari lasi peka dènge dhèu kapai sèra.

source_text: we found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!
target_text: ra peka na, ama-ama si, baku nasa. ropa ji'i d'ai èmu bèdho, ji'i ladhe, na, babèdho dhu patèke. aa dhèu j'aga sèra titu ètu era èèna. te ngaa ropa ji'i pua ra goe babèdho ho ji'i la'a asa d'ara, ji'i ngèdhi boe dhèu èci sa ètu d'ara.

source_text: now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, hèia kètu agama yahudi sèra, dènge kapala j'aga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i, aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i malaa, aa sèmi dhèu dhu ele ngangee sa.

source_text: one came and told them, behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.
target_text: nèbhu boe, hèia dhèu èci mai peka, aku nèngu na, ama-ama si, nanene ku laa! dhèu dhu miu bèdho sèra, ètu li'u si, ra titu ho aj'a-nori dhèu ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne!

source_text: then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, ka kapala j'aga èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i èèna paroa dhèu j'aga pèri-pèri ho lasi kèpe hari petrus dènge angalai na sèra. te ngaa dhèu j'aga sèra madha'u, lula dhèu dhu nanene lii padhai-padhue petrus sèra, ae seli. ra pajiko, na, mage dhoka dhèu ae sèra patao-palaha, ho ra pèci si. nèti èèna ka, ropa rèngu kèpe hari petrus si, ra bani boe pake j'ara sakaa.

source_text: when they had brought them, they set them before the council. the high priest questioned them,
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra lere rèti petrus si asa era pama'ète lii langu. ka kètu kapai risi agama mulai karèi si,

source_text: saying, didn't we strictly command you not to teach in this name? behold, you have filled jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man's blood on us.
target_text: peka na, ji'i kai le miu, sèna ka aj'a ia ka dhèu lula-nèti dhèu dhu neo tao j'ara mamuri hiu èèna, sina ma! te ngaa miu palab'a! miu pusi-pahae boe dènge lii paredha ji'i, te ngaa miu tao madhutu dad'èi miu di! miu lami aj'a-nori palème dhèu ètu kota yerusalem ne. èèna sama dènge miu core sasala mi dedha ji'i, peka na, ji'i se ka dhu pua dhèu lasi pamadhe yesus.

source_text: but peter and the apostles answered, we must obey god rather than men.
target_text: hèia petrus kèd'i titu j'aj'i dhèu dhu padhai lii nèti angalai na sèra. ka na dhaa, peka na, ama-ama! ladhe abhu paredha nèti dhèu rai-haha dhu palab'a dènge dad'èi ama lamatua, ji'i ngo'o boe madhutu. te ngaa ji'i madhutu dhoka paredha ama lamatua di!

source_text: the god of our fathers raised up jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.
target_text: dhèu dhu bhoke j'ara mamuri hiu èèna, nuka yesus. nèngu èèna ka dhu miu paku pamadhe ètu dedha aj'u palolo-palèbha. nèti uru ka mai, bèi-baki èdhi manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua. ama lamatua èèna ka dhu pamamuri hari yesus nèti mamadhe na!

source_text: god exalted him with his right hand to be a prince and a savior, to give repentance to israel, and remission of sins.
target_text: limuri ne, ama lamatua ded'e le yesus j'aj'i ai g'ana na. ka yesus nèd'u le paredha sama sèmi dhèu aae kapai. nèngu bhoke le j'ara, sèna ka lamatua patabuli eele dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. na neo hia j'ara mi èdhi dhèu isra'el se'e, sèna ka èdhi ae eele nèti sasala èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, d'ara ama lamatua pacuhi, ho na ige heka sasala èdhi dhèu isra'el.

source_text: we are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the holy spirit, whom god has given to those who obey him.
target_text: te èdhi tèdhi le dènge musi madha èdhi, yesus mema madhe tare'a, te ngaa na mamuri hari kahèi. limuri ne roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka le dènge dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri yesus.

source_text: but they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.
target_text: tadèngi rare lii padhai lii petrus sèmi èèna, ka dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu era pama'ète lii langu èèna nasa titu kèna, ka ra neo pamadhe dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua sèra.

source_text: but one stood up in the council, a pharisee named gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.
target_text: te ngaa ètu talora rèngu, abhu kahèi dhèu èci dhu madhèdi parisa lii, ngara na gamaliel. dhèu ae pakab'ua ne, lula nèngu ne mese dhu d'èlu-mèu nèti partei agama parisi. ropa petrus padhai lii nare, ka dhèu sèra neo pamadhe ne, hèia gamaliel kèd'i titu, ka na pua dhèu ho lere taha petrus si asa li'u.

source_text: he said to them, you men of israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.
target_text: ropa petrus si d'ai li'u, ka gamaliel padhai lii dènge ama-ama ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, a'ari ti! èdhi hud'i pajiko paie ku! mage dhoka èdhi malai ae tao bhabhelu mi dedha dhèu se'e. èdhi hud'i pangee madhera.

source_text: for before these days theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. he was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.
target_text: ele boe miu sanèd'e era, dhèu dhu ngara na teudas. nèngu madhe nèbhu le, te ngaa lod'o na mamuri era, na ded'e ngi'u na j'aj'i dhèu kapai, pe d'ai dhèu èpa ngasu sa madhutu nèngu. te ngaa ropa ra pamadhe ne, ana-ana madhutu na paj'ala asa haa asa dhimu. toke d'ai sange ne'e, dhèu rèdhi heka rèngu. ra rai aa'i mèu-mèu le!

source_text: after this man, judas of galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. he also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.
target_text: aa miu sanèd'e hari ku lii lole èci. uru èèna, lèke lod'o dhèu paredha ige dhèu ètu d'ara kabarai. abhu dhèu èci, ngara na yudas, nèti propensi galilea. dhèu ae madhutu nèngu kahèi. te ngaa ra pamadhe ne kahèi. hèia ana-ana madhutu na rai paj'ala kahèi, ka d'ai sange ne'e tèdhi heka dhèu èci sa.

source_text: now i tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. for if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.
target_text: de a'ari! madhutu ngangee ja'a, baku pamadhe dhèu se'e. hud'i rèngu sène. te a'aj'a dènge kakako rèngu, ladhe mai nèti dhèu rai-haha, na, nèbhu boe, ele unu na.

source_text: but if it is of god, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against god!
target_text: te ngaa ladhe a'aj'a rèngu tare'a-re'a nèti ama lamatua, miu taha mere boe. nèti èèna ka, miu pajiko paie ku. mage dhoka miu palab'a dènge ama lamatua. tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra lèka, ka ra madhutu lii gamaliel.

source_text: they agreed with him. summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of jesus, and let them go.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra paroa hari dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua sèra, ka ra pua dhèu ho hake si. hèia ra kai si, ho baku ale-ale ia ka kolongara yesus. ka ra patabuli si.

source_text: they therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for jesus' name.
target_text: hèia dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua se tèke eele era pama'ète lii langu èèna. ra pangee, na, masi ka kolongara rèngu ele iie lula madhutu lamatua yesus, te ngaa rèngu karej'e kahèi, lula rèngu hud'i abhu j'aj'èra sèmi èèna. nèti èèna ka, d'ara rèngu karej'e titu kèna.

source_text: every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching jesus, the christ.
target_text: bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu lasi aj'a-nori dhèu, peka na, dhèu dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u nare nèti uru ka mai, nuka yesus di. ka ra peka padhue taruu, nèti ca èmu d'ai ca èmu, sèmi èèna kahèi ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i.

source_text: now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the hellenists against the hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu dhu parcaya yesus asa tabha ae. te ngaa rèngu pake dua lii. dhèu yahudi cahag'e, pake lii aram. aa cahag'e hari, pake lii yunani. nèbhu boe ka, j'aj'i lii langu ètu talora dua kaboko dhèu se'e. dhèu dhu pake lii yunani, d'ara be'a boe dènge dhèu dhu pake lii aram. ra peka na, ne'e ne, lèke boe! ladhe miu papala nganga'a bèli-bèli, miu bia cabèka. bhèni balu ji'i abhu boe nganga'a.

source_text: the twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, it is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of god and serve tables.
target_text: lula èèna ka, dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua dhèu canguru dua, pakaboko dhèu dhu parcaya lamatua yesus aa'i-aa'i ra. ka ra peka, aku rèngu na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! ladhe ji'i ae eele nèti sasab'a ji'i, ho lalau dhoka nganga'a-nginu miu di, bisa kahèi, te ngaa, lèke boe! lula ji'i se hud'i aj'a-nori taruu lii holo-nori lamatua.

source_text: therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the holy spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
target_text: de madhutu ngangee ji'i, sèmi ne'e ka. be'a risi, hag'e mere dhèu pidhu nèti talora miu. tenge dhèu dhu kolongara be'a, dhu d'èlu-mèu, aa roh lamatua ator mamuri na. ladhe mi pili mere dhèu sèmi sèra, pe ji'i ded'e si, ho ra lalau nganga'a-nginu.

source_text: but we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.
target_text: ladhe sèmi èèna, ji'i abhu tebho ae ho manèngi-mangaj'i aa aj'a lii holo-nori lamatua.

source_text: these words pleased the whole multitude. they chose stephen, a man full of faith and of the holy spirit, philip, prochorus, nicanor, timon, parmenas, and nicolaus, a proselyte of antioch,
target_text: hèia dhèu se'e sèmi rare kahèi lii padhai lii petrus si. ka hag'e rare dhèu pidhu, nuka: dhèu èci, ngara na stefanus. nèngu ne parcaya tare'a-re'a lamatua yesus, dènge roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci pake nèngu. aa angalai nèngu na, nuka: pelipus, prokorus, nikanor, timon, permenas, dènge nikolas, nèti kota antiokia. nèngu dhèu yahudi boe, te ngaa na maso agama yahudi.

source_text: whom they set before the apostles. when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
target_text: hèia lere rèti dhèu pidhu dhu ra pili rare sèra, asa madha dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua. ka ra bane ai dènge manèngi-mangaj'i hia si, ho ded'e si j'aj'i dhèu ladhe-leru bhèni balu ana-lalu, sèna ka aa'i-aa'i ra abhu pala dhu pamera.

source_text: the word of god increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in jerusalem. a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
target_text: èèna ka, dhèu tadèngi lii holo-nori lamatua ètu mia-mia. hèia dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus, asa tabha ae ètu kota yerusalem. aa ama agama yahudi sèra, ae kahèi dhu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua yesus.

source_text: stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama lamatua hia berkat ae mi stefanus. na hia stefanus koasa kahèi, ho na tao tadha-tadha malaa dènge j'ara-j'ara kapai, sèna ka dhèu ae rèdhi unu ra.

source_text: but some of those who were of the synagogue called the libertines, and of the cyrenians, of the alexandrians, and of those of cilicia and asia arose, disputing with stephen.
target_text: ètu era èèna, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi dhu mai nèti rai-rai kaj'èu, nuka: kota kirene, kota aleksandria, propensi kilikia, dènge propensi asia. uru èèna, rèngu j'aj'i ènu dhèu leo, te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu ka lamatua rèngu patabuli si. èle èèna ka, dhèu se'e pakaboko ètu yerusalem. rèngu tema le lasi asa èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhu ra patitu unu ra. èmu manèngi-mangaj'i èèna, ra pangare ne, ‘j'aj'i heka ènu'. ropa ra tadèngi lii padhai lii stefanus, dhèu se d'èi boe, ka ra pab'ala dènge ne.

source_text: they weren't able to withstand the wisdom and the spirit by which he spoke.
target_text: stefanus ne, dhèu d'èlu-mèu, lula nèngu padhai lii pake koasa roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se'e segi boe nèngu.

source_text: then they secretly induced men to say, we have heard him speak blasphemous words against moses and god.
target_text: ka ra tenge j'ara aapa mi dedha stefanus. ra lasi b'ae dhèu ho j'aj'i sakasii leko-monya, peka na, ji'i tadèngi, na, dhèu ne'e padhai lii pahaha musa dènge ama lamatua!

source_text: they stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,
target_text: rèngu dadugu dhèu, toke d'ai dhèu heka ad'a yahudi dènge mese agama sèra tadèngi kahèi. ka ra nasa. nèti èèna ka, lasi kèpe rare stefanus, hèia ra nuni ne asa era pama'ète lii langu agama.

source_text: and set up false witnesses who said, this man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.
target_text: sakasii leko-monya rèngu sèra, ue lii langu ho pamanahu stefanus, peka na, dhèu ne loe boe padhai lii pakarehe èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i. aa na peka pa'ele iie lii paredha ama lamatua, dhu musa papuru mi èdhi.

source_text: for we have heard him say that this jesus of nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which moses delivered to us.
target_text: ji'i tadèngi kahèi, na peka, na, yesus, dhèu nasaret, neo sag'e eele èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ne. aa nèngu ne neo pa'ele iie atora ad'a dhu baki musa tao tèka hia èdhi.

source_text: all who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhèdi ètu era pama'ète lii langu agama èèna ladhe kaloo stefanus, lula rèhu na sama sèmi rèhu ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga.

source_text: the high priest said, are these things so?
target_text: hèia kètu kapai risi agama yahudi karèi stefanus, peka na, dhèu se'e galaa èu ne, lèke do aad'o?

source_text: he said, brothers and fathers, listen. the god of glory appeared to our father abraham when he was in mesopotamia, before he lived in haran, and said to him, ‘get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which i will show you. '
target_text: ka stefanus b'ala, aku nèngu na, ama-ama, aa a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu nanene ku ja'a. uru-uru sèra, bèi-baki èdhi abraham dhae tèke eele mèka rai èta-èsu na. te ngaa ama lamatua dhu kapai risi pad'elo iisi na mi nèngu. lamatua hia ne paredha, peka na, ‘pakèd'i nèti rai èta-èsu èu; tèke eele a'ari èu. lamu ka asa era èci, dhu bèli-camèd'a ja'a paj'uj'u hia èu! ' hèia na pakèd'i ka nèti rai èta-èsu na, ètu rai mesopotamia, la'e asa kota haran.

source_text: then he came out of the land of the chaldaeans and lived in haran. from there, when his father was dead, god moved him into this land where you are now living.
target_text: hèia na tèke eele rai dhèu kasdim, ka la'e pea ètu kota haran. ropa ama d'èlu na madhe, ka ama lamatua lere ne asa rai ne'e ne, dhu ama-ama a'ari pea toke d'ai sange ne'e ne.

source_text: he gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama lamatua hag'e boe rai ca kasib'i sa hia ne ho j'aj'i rai pusaka na. te ngaa ama lamatua moa tèke le, na, nèngu hia rai ne'e, j'aj'i rai pusaka ana-èpu na. te ngaa lod'o èèna, abraham dènge mèka ana.

source_text: god spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.
target_text: ka ama lamatua peka dènge ne, ‘bèli-camèd'a ana-èpu èu lasi pea ètu rai dhèu. ho dhèu rai èèna ènyi si, aa tao rèngu j'aj'i ènu, dènge paj'èra si toke d'ai èpa ngasu tèu.

source_text: ‘i will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage, ' said god, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place. '
target_text: ho ladhe èle èpa ngasu tèu èèna, ja'a huku dhèu kabarai dhu tao ana-èpu èu j'aj'i ènu sèra. hèia ana-èpu èu tèke eele rai èèna, ho rèngu mai asa era ne'e ne, sèna ka ra manèngi makasi mi ja'a. '

source_text: he gave him the covenant of circumcision. so abraham became the father of isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. isaac became the father of jacob, and jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.
target_text: padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka na hia tadha lii moa ne dènge j'ara suna ana mone, j'aj'i tadha dhu sasoa na, abraham j'aj'i le dhèu unu ama lamatua. èle èèna ka, ropa ana na, isak, d'ai umur aru lod'o, hèia na suna ne. aa isak suna ana na, yakob kahèi. aa yakob suna ana-ana mone na, dhèu canguru dua sèra, ladhe umur rèngu d'ai aru lod'o. rèngu aa'i-aa'i sèra, bèi-baki èdhi dhèu yahudi.

source_text: the patriarchs, moved with jealousy against joseph, sold him into egypt. god was with him
target_text: ca tèka, bèi-baki èdhi sèra d'ara pèd'a dènge ari ra yusuf, ka ra pahie eele ne ka j'aj'i ènu ètu rai masir nèi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua tèke eele boe ne.

source_text: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before pharaoh, king of egypt. he made him governor over egypt and all his house.
target_text: nèti èèna ka lamatua patabuli eele ne nèti j'aj'èra nèngu. ama lamatua hia ne d'èlu-mèu, ka ne'a j'ara ae-ae, ka dhèu aae masir sue ne. nèti èèna ka, na ded'e ne j'aj'i gubernur ètu rai masir. aa na nèd'u koasa kahèi ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae.

source_text: now a famine came over all the land of egypt and canaan, and great affliction. our fathers found no food.
target_text: hèia tèu manganga lèke rai masir dènge rai kana'an. tèu-tèu manganga mad'èu èèna, bia titu kèna. nèti èèna ka dhèu ètu mia-mia j'èra d'ai seli. sèmi èèna kahèi, bèi-baki èdhi abhu heka nganga'a.

source_text: but when jacob heard that there was grain in egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.
target_text: te ngaa baki yakob tadèngi lii, na, ètu rai masir abhu nganga'a. ka na pua ana-ana na sèra, nuka bèi-baki èdhi, ho lasi hèli nganga'a ètu rai masir.

source_text: on the second time joseph was made known to his brothers, and joseph's family was revealed to pharaoh.
target_text: hèli rare, hèia ra lèpa. ropa oe èle nganga'a sèra, ka ama ra pua hari lasi hèli nganga'a ètu masir. lod'o èèna ka, heka yusuf bhoke d'ara, peka na, nèngu ne ari d'èlu rèngu. ka na patadha a'ari na sèra dènge dhèu aae masir.

source_text: joseph sent and summoned jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.
target_text: èle èèna ka, yusuf manèngi ama na dènge a'ari na aa'i-aa'i lasi pea asa rai masir. rèngu dhu lasi asa nèi, aa'i-aa'i ra pidhu nguru lèmi dhèu.

source_text: jacob went down into egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;
target_text: de baki yakob pidha asa nèi, toke d'ai bèi-baki èdhi sèra madhe ètu masir.

source_text: and they were brought back to shechem and laid in the tomb that abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of hamor of shechem.
target_text: ka nèbhu aae ku, heka rèti rui bèi-baki èdhi sèra lèpa hari asa rae sikem ètu rai kana'an. ka ra tèke rui sèra ètu era dhu uru èèna baki abraham hèli nare nèti ana-èpu hemor.

source_text: but as the time of the promise came close which god had sworn to abraham, the people grew and multiplied in egypt,
target_text: stefanus tuhu hari lii, peka na, se'e se j'aj'i, lula ama lamatua moa tèke le, na, èèna na limuri hari nèngu neo hia rai pusaka mi baki abraham ètu era èèna. ropa oe d'ai lod'o dhu ama lamatua moa èèna, èdhi dhèu yahudi tabha ae titu kèna ètu rai masir nèi.

source_text: until there arose a different king who didn't know joseph.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae hiu èci paredha ètu nèi. te ngaa nèngu tadhe boe yusuf.

source_text: the same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn't stay alive.
target_text: dhèu aae ne'e ènyi ruri dhèu èdhi sèra. aa na bhelu titu kèna dènge bèi-baki èdhi. na laka-seti rèngu ho core eele ana rèngu dhu rara iisi hiu, sèna ka madhe.

source_text: at that time moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to god. he was nourished three months in his father's house.
target_text: lod'o èèna, d'ai lod'o ina musa nara iisi ne. musa kabèb'u titu kèna! ina dènge ama na madhutu boe lii paredha dhèu aae. ra piara pahuni ne, toke d'ai tèlu hèru.

source_text: when he was abandoned, pharaoh's daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.
target_text: ropa rèngu bisa heka pahuni ne ètu d'ara èmu, ka ra panangi eele ne. te ngaa ana bhèni dhèu aae masir rage nare ne, ka sa'u nèti asa èmu, ka na ladhe-leru ne sèmi ana d'èlu nèngu.

source_text: moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the egyptians. he was mighty in his words and works.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu rai masir aj'a aa'i ne dènge mamèu ra, toke d'ai na j'aj'i dhèu d'èlu-mèu. nèngu ne d'èlu-mèu ètu d'ara lii padhai, aa ètu d'ara sab'a-la'a.

source_text: but when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of israel.
target_text: ropa musa d'ai umur èpa nguru tèu, hèia na neo patadha dènge dhèu isra'el nèngu sèra.

source_text: seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the egyptian.
target_text: ropa na la'e, ka na nèdhi dhèu masir èci dhu game dhèu isra'el ca dhèu. ka na sarii dhèu isra'el èèna, aa na hake pamadhe dhèu masir èèna.

source_text: he supposed that his brothers understood that god, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn't understand.
target_text: te musa ngee, na, dhèu nèngu sèra re'a le, na, ama lamatua pua ne ho patabuli rèngu nèti j'aj'èra ra. te ngaa rèngu re'a mèka.

source_text: the day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘sirs, you are brothers. why do you wrong one another? '
target_text: bèli èèna, musa la'e hari ladhe dhèu isra'el na sèra. ka na rage dhèu dua pagama. aa na neo padame dhèu dua se, peka na, ‘weh! miu dua mi se, pa'a'ari. nga tao ka miu dua mi patao? '

source_text: but he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘who made you a ruler and a judge over us?
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu game angalai na, dhaa, aku nèngu na, ‘cee ka dhu ded'e èu j'aj'i kètu ji'i! aa cee ka dhu paj'uj'u èu, ho j'aj'i mi dhèu j'ue lii langu ji'i?

source_text: do you want to kill me as you killed the egyptian yesterday? '
target_text: èu ngee, na, èu bisa pamadhe hari ja'a, sama sèmi èu pamadhe dhèu masir med'a na? '

source_text: moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of midian, where he became the father of two sons.
target_text: ropa musa tadèngi nare lii ne'e, hèia na rai eele nèti rai masir, la'e pea ètu rai dhèu median. na leo-èmu ètu èèna, ka ra abhu ana mone dhèu dua.

source_text: when forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the lord appeared to him in the wilderness of mount sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.
target_text: d'ai èpa nguru tèu, hèia musa la'e asa d'ara mamoo èci, padètu dènge ledhe èci, ngara na ledhe sinai. ètu èèna, ana pajuu ama lamatua èci puru mai nèti sorga, ka pad'elo iisi na nèti d'ara ai dhu heo ètu ana aaj'u iiki ca kapua. ai na'e ana aaj'u èèna, te ngaa kèpu boe.

source_text: when moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. as he came close to see, the voice of the lord came to him,
target_text: ladhe nèdhi sèmi èèna, ka musa loo-loo sène. ka na la'e padètu ho neo ne'a, ngaa ka ne. kabèdhi laa, na tadèngi ama lamatua padhai lii nèti d'ara ai, peka na,

source_text: ‘i am the god of your fathers: the god of abraham, the god of isaac, and the god of jacob. ' moses trembled and dared not look.
target_text: ‘ja'a ne, ama lamatua nèti bèi-baki èu! lamatua nèti baki abraham, baki isak, dènge baki yakob. ' tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka na madha'u toke d'ai isi karèbha. aa na bani heka doa kètu ho ladhe ana aaj'u dhu ai na'e èèna.

source_text: the lord said to him, ‘take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua peka hari, aku nèngu na, ‘we, musa! era dhu èu titu ne, era luri. bhoke eele salapa èu!

source_text: i have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in egypt, and have heard their groaning. i have come down to deliver them. now come, i will send you into egypt. '
target_text: baku pangee, na, ja'a bhèlu eele le dhèu isra'el unu ja'a ètu masir sèi. aad'o! ja'a sanèd'e si era. ja'a ke'a j'aj'èra rèngu. ja'a tadèngi le lii roma iisi rèngu manèngi sasue. de ja'a neo puru ho patabuli eele si. mai ku asa ne'e! ja'a neo pua èu lèpa hari asa masir nèi. '

source_text: this moses whom they refused, saying, ‘who made you a ruler and a judge? '-god has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.
target_text: dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, ka lamatua dhu pad'elo iisi nèti d'ara ai èèna, na paredha musa ho lèpa hari asa masir. lamatua paj'uj'u nèngu ho patabuli eele dhèu isra'el nèti d'ara j'aj'èra rèngu. musa ne ka dhu uru èèna dhèu karèi, peka na, ‘cee ka dhu ded'e èu j'aj'i kètu ji'i? ' te ngaa ne'e ne, lamatua ka dhu ded'e ne!

source_text: this man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in egypt, in the red sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, musa lèpa hari asa rai masir. ètu nèi, na tao tadha-tadha malaa ae. ka na kalua eele dhèu isra'el nèti masir. nèti si kako re dhasi mea, ka ra kako palème d'ara mamoo d'ai èpa nguru tèu.

source_text: this is that moses who said to the children of israel, ‘the lord our god will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. '
target_text: ka musa peka dènge dhèu isra'el, aku nèngu na, ‘èèna na lamatua ded'e dhèu èci nèti talora miu, ho na paj'aj'i ne dhèu nèti lii padhai nèngu, sama sèmi na ded'e nare ja'a. '

source_text: this is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on mount sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,
target_text: musa pa'èci dènge dhèu isra'el èdhi sèra ètu d'ara mamoo. nèngu èèna ka dhu j'aj'i kalete mi bèi-baki èdhi dènge ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga. te ana pajuu èèna ka dhu nèti lii holo-nori ama lamatua asa musa. sèra sa ka dhu pad'elo j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. lii holo-nori sèra ka dhu lamatua papuru ètu ledhe sinai.

source_text: to whom our fathers wouldn't be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to egypt,
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa bèi-baki èdhi sèra ro'o boe nanene musa. aa ra tule eele ne, ho ra neo lèpa hari asa rai masir.

source_text: saying to aaron, ‘make us gods that will go before us, for as for this moses who led us out of the land of egypt, we don't know what has become of him. '
target_text: ka ra lasi rarange harun, aku rèngu na, ‘ari mu musa ka dhu pakalua eele èdhi nèti rai masir. te ngaa èdhi te'a heka nèngu ètu ro'a mia. de ji'i manèngi èu tao mèdha sogo-tagu èci hia èdhi, sèna ka mèdha sogo-tagu èèna lere èdhi. '

source_text: they made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.
target_text: ka ra tao ka mèdha sogo-tagu èci, rupa sèmi ana sapi ci'u. èle èèna ka, ra para badha hia mèdha sogo-tagu èèna. ka ra ra'a-sisi rame-rame, lula rèngu karej'e nèti mèdha sogo-tagu dhu rèngu tao unu ra.

source_text: but god turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, o house of israel?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua soro kabodho hia si. ka ra mulai sogo-tagu ka mèdha dedha-liru, sèmi madha lod'o, hèru, dènge hua-hètu. te ngaa lamatua soro tèke si sèmi èèna. èèna na lèke sèmi lii dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua suri tèke, peka na, ‘weh! miu dhèu isra'el sèra! d'ara èpa nguru tèu, miu kako palème d'ara mamoo. aa miu para badha sèra, neo sogo-tagu mi ja'a, do, neo sogo-tagu mi cee?

source_text: you took up the tabernacle of moloch, the star of your god rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so i will carry you away beyond babylon. '
target_text: miu koa-kio boe ja'a! bèli-bèli miu sogo-tagu dhoka mèdha sogo-tagu miu sèra di. miu maso-kalua taruu d'ara èmu mèdha sogo-tagu nidhu, ngara na molok. miu biasa sogo-tagu nidhu hua-hètu èci kahèi, ngara na refan. de miu d'èi dhoka sogo-tagu mèdha pa'ue-ai miu. nèti èèna ka, limuri mai ja'a bhabhoo miu lami asa cabèka babel nèi. '

source_text: our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;
target_text: stefanus padhai lii taruu, peka na, ama lamatua paj'uj'u rupa nèti era manèngi-mangaj'i èci mi musa. hèia musa si patitu paleo manèngi-mangaj'i èci, dhu tao nèti ka'uri badha dènge bèla, sama sèmi rupa dhu lamatua pad'elo le. ka dhèu isra'el sèra mai sabaj'a mi ama lamatua ètu era èèna. ho ladhe rèngu pidha nèti ca'era asa era leo lasi, na, ra sag'e eele paleo manèngi-mangaj'i èèna, aa ra èki nèu ne, aa ra jèru rèti asa era hiu. ètu era hiu, ra patitu hari paleo èèna.

source_text: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom god drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of david,
target_text: limuri mai, lod'o yosua si pamusu dènge dhèu rai leo ètu rai kana'an, ama lamatua babège eele si. ka na pabagi rai kana'an èèna hia bèi-baki èdhi. lod'o rèngu parame rare rai èèna, rèngu rèti paleo manèngi-mangaj'i lamatua asa era èèna. paleo èèna titu taruu ètu èèna, toke d'ai lod'o dhèu aae daud nèd'u paredha.

source_text: who found favor in the sight of god, and asked to find a habitation for the god of jacob.
target_text: dhèu aae daud manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, sama sèmi baki yakob si. ka daud pakarej'e d'ara lamatua, hèia lamatua hia nèngu berkat. ka na manèngi ho lamatua paj'uj'u nèngu sèna ka patitu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i dhu hiu.

source_text: but solomon built him a house.
target_text: te ngaa ana nèti daud, ngara na soleman ka dhu patitu èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i lamatua èèna.

source_text: however, the most high doesn't dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,
target_text: te ngaa èdhi te'a, na, ama lamatua pea boe ètu d'ara èmu dhu dhèu rai-haha tao, lula uru èèna, dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua èci suri tèke le, peka na,

source_text: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. what kind of house will you build me? ' says the lord. ‘or what is the place of my rest?
target_text: ‘dedha-liru èèna, kadera era ja'a madhèdi paredha. aa rai-haha èèna, era hue haga ja'a. de tasamia ka miu bisa tao èmu èci dhu be'a hia ja'a pea ètu d'ara? bisa boe!

source_text: didn't my hand make all these things? '
target_text: lula dedha-liru, rai-haha, dènge isi aa'i-aa'i sèra, ja'a ka dhu paj'aj'i! '

source_text: you stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the holy spirit! as your fathers did, so you do.
target_text: hèia stefanus tuhu hari lii padhai na, ka na jèke si, aku nèngu na, miu dhèu kètu hadhu! miu se, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua, dènge dhèu dhu nanene boe nèngu. miu dhèu dhu palab'a dènge ama lamatua, èci èèna ka dènge bèi-baki miu dhu soro kabodho asa ne! ka limuri ne, miu neo hari palab'a dènge roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, do?

source_text: which of the prophets didn't your fathers persecute? they killed those who foretold the coming of the righteous one, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.
target_text: bèi-baki miu sèra ka dhu paj'èra taruu dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra. miu peka ku! dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua mia ka dhu rèngu paj'èra boe? aad'o, sina ma! uru èèna dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua peka mema, aku rèngu na, limuri mai ama lamatua pua dhèu nèngu dhu mola-mèci. te ngaa bèi-baki miu pamadhe dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua sèra. ka miu tenge j'ara kahèi ho hia dhèu leo pamadhe dhèu mola-mèci nèti lamatua.

source_text: you received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn't keep it!
target_text: aa ana pajuu ama lamatua nèti sorga sèra dhu rèti mai atora ad'a dhu lamatua neo hia mi èdhi, te ngaa miu pusi-pahae boe.

source_text: now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
target_text: ropa dhèu dhu pama'ète lii langu sèra nanene rare lii padhai lii stefanus, ka re'a mema, na, nèngu pasala si. ka ra kadhi ngutu aa tèka d'ara.

source_text: but he, being full of the holy spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of god, and jesus standing on the right hand of god,
target_text: te ngaa roh mola-mèci lamatua sab'a ètu d'ara stefanus. na doa kètu ka ladhe asa dedha-liru. ètu nèi, na ladhe nèdhi dadedha ama lamatua, dènge nèdhi kahèi lamatua yesus titu ètu sebhe g'ana na ètu era dhu kab'ua risi.

source_text: and said, behold, i see the heavens opened and the son of man standing at the right hand of god!
target_text: hèia stefanus padhai lii, peka na, sèmi ne'e ku, ama aa'i-aa'i. ja'a kèdhi liru bhoke eele, aa dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a titu ètu era hua iia, re sebhe g'ana ama lamatua.

source_text: but they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi sèmi èèna, hèia dhèu pama'ète lii langu sèra hutu ro'a dhilu ra. ka ra jèke ne, sèna ka kai stefanus baku bhoke hèb'a. ka ra mangamok neo game ne.

source_text: they threw him out of the city and stoned him. the witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named saul.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ra nuni-pa'oro ne rèti asa li'u kota. d'ai nèi, ka sakasii sèra bhoke eele kodho li'u ra, ho ra hia mi ana mone ngèru èci nèd'u. ngara na saulus, dhu j'aj'i dhèu dadugu-rariu dhèu. èle èèna ka, ra tabhie stefanus dènge hadhu.

source_text: they stoned stephen as he called out, saying, lord jesus, receive my spirit!
target_text: ropa ra tabhie, hèia stefanus pa'oo, peka na, lamatua yesus! lod'o ja'a d'ai kèna. sèmi more ku samanga ja'a!

source_text: he kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, lord, don't hold this sin against them! when he had said this, he fell asleep.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na bèbhe-lèpe urutuu, ka na pa'oo hari dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, ama! baku hia si d'ui sasala ne'e! hèia na ma'ète a'ae dènge ka.

source_text: saul was consenting to his death. a great persecution arose against the assembly which was in jerusalem in that day. they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of judea and samaria, except for the apostles.
