target_text: aa saulus ètu èèna kahèi, ka nèngu d'èi ra pamadhe stefanus kahèi.

source_text: devout men buried stephen and lamented greatly over him.
target_text: lod'o stefanus madhe, abhu pèri-pèri dhèu dhu mamuri d'ara d'èi dènge lamatua. lasi rare ngi'u aae stefanus ho ra padhane. ka ra tangi ne. nèti lod'o èèna, ka dhèu paj'èra dhèu unu lamatua yesus ètu kota yerusalem, toke d'ai rèngu j'èra bia. èle èèna ka, rèngu rai pahag'a lasi asa propensi yudea dènge propensi samaria. rèngu aa'i-aa'i rai, te ngaa tèke eele dhoka dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus di ètu yerusalem.

source_text: but saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.
target_text: te ngaa saulus tenge j'ara taruu ho pa'èle dhèu unu yesus sèra. na tenge si ètu mia-mia. na maso-kalua èmu dhèu ho na tenge si. sad'i abhu dhèu mone, do dhèu bhèni, na kèpe si, ho na cèlu si asa d'ara bèdho.

source_text: therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.
target_text: masi ka ra paj'èra dhèu unu yesus sèra ho ra rai asa haa asa dhimu, te ngaa rèngu loe boe peka-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus asa mia-mia.

source_text: philip went down to the city of samaria and proclaimed to them the christ.
target_text: conto sèmi, ca tèka, pelipus la'e asa d'ara kota èci ètu propensi samaria, ho peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, na, yesus, nuka kristus, dhu ama lamatua paj'uj'u nèti uru ka mai.

source_text: the multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.
target_text: ropa dhèu ae ladhe rèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu na tao, ka ra pakaboko ho nanene paie ngaa dhu pelipus peka-padhai.

source_text: for unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. they came out, crying with a loud voice. many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.
target_text: conto sèmi, ètu èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu-dhèu dhu nidhu tao. nidhu sèra rai eele dhèu se'e dènge pakii-pakèce. dhèu karuku dènge dhèu haga roe cabèka, èle dènge nèti papèd'a.

source_text: there was great joy in that city.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu-dhèu ètu d'ara kota èèna karej'e titu kèna.

source_text: but there was a certain man, simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of samaria, making himself out to be some great one,
target_text: ètu kota èèna, abhu dhèu èci dhu pake na'i, ngara na simon. nèbhu le na pake na'i ètu talora dhèu samaria sèra. ka na padedha iisi na, peka na, ja'a dhèu èra!

source_text: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, this man is that great power of god. they listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.
target_text: ka nèti kota èèna, ana iiki do dhèu kapai, dhèu mone do bhèni, palolo dhoka dhèu ne'e di, aku rèngu na, dhèu ne'e ele-madha, nga! ngaa-ngaa dhu na tao ne, mai nèti koasa ama lamatua! lula nèngu pake na'i, nèti uru ka mai dhèu ae lèka ne.

source_text: but when they believed philip preaching good news concerning god's kingdom and the name of jesus christ, they were baptized, both men and women.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, rèngu nanene pelipus aj'a rèngu j'ara paredha ama lamatua. aa na peka j'ara ho rèngu rèti kolongara yesus, sèna ka rèngu bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. ropa ra tadèngi rare sèmi èèna, dhèu ae parcaya, ka j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. bhèni-mone aa'i-aa'i sèra j'aj'i sèmi èèna. nèti èèna ka, ra abhu sarani.

source_text: simon himself also believed. being baptized, he continued with philip. seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.
target_text: te ngaa simon parcaya kahèi, ka manèngi j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua yesus. ka ra sarani ne. hèia na madhutu pelipus asa mia-mia. ropa nèdhi tadha-tadha malaa dhu pelipus tao, hèia na pangètu kètu na, peka na, ira ii! sèmi ne'e ne, risi eele!

source_text: now when the apostles who were at jerusalem heard that samaria had received the word of god, they sent peter and john to them,
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua yesus dhu ètu yerusalem sèra, tadèngi, na, dhèu ae parcaya le lii lolo be'a lamatua ètu propensi samaria. ka ra manèngi petrus dènge yohanis lasi asa nèi.

source_text: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the holy spirit; for as yet he had fallen on none of them. they had only been baptized in the name of christ jesus. then they laid their hands on them, and they received the holy spirit.
target_text: ropa dua ra d'ai nèi, rèngu heka re'a kèna, dhèu ètu nèi abhu mèka roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. rèngu dhoka abhu sarani pake kolongara yesus di. hèia petrus dènge yohanis bane ai mi dhèu sèra, ka ra manèngi-mangaj'i sèna ka dhèu samaria sèra sèmi rare roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci kahèi. ka dhèu se'e abhu dènge roh kahèi.

source_text: now when simon saw that the holy spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles' hands, he offered them money,
target_text: lod'o èèna, simon ladhe nèdhi rèngu dua ra bane ai mi dhèu se'e, ka dhèu sèra sèmi rare roh lamatua. hèia na j'ole doi asa petrus dènge yohanis, dènge lii manèngi, peka na,

source_text: saying, give me also this power, that whomever i lay my hands on may receive the holy spirit.
target_text: ama-ama! miu hia ku ja'a koasa èèna. sèna ka ladhe ja'a bane ai mi dhèu, na, ra abhu roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci kahèi.

source_text: but peter said to him, may your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of god with money!
target_text: te ngaa petrus jèke ne, aku nèngu na, ja'a dhoo èu dènge doi èu! èu ngee, na, èu bisa hèli koasa roh mola-mèci dènge doi dhari, do? aad'o! dhèu bisa boe hèli roh lamatua!

source_text: you have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn't right before god.
target_text: èu dènge boe hak mi roh lamatua, lula d'ara èu mola boe. èu dhoka tenge-tenge j'ara di.

source_text: repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask god if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.
target_text: èu hud'i ae eele ku nèti sasala-sasigo èu sèra. hua iia èu sabaj'a ho teko-teko lamatua saku eele ngangee aapa èu.

source_text: for i see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.
target_text: ja'a ke'a, na, d'ara èu aapa, aa j'ara karehe ae dhu èki èu!

source_text: simon answered, pray for me to the lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.
target_text: ka simon manèngi dua si, peka na, ama-ama! ladhe sèmi èèna, miu dua mi sabaj'a ku hia ja'a, sèna ka lii dhoo dhu miu peka èèna, baku lèke ja'a.

source_text: they therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the lord, returned to jerusalem, and preached the good news to many villages of the samaritans.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia petrus dènge yohanis lole aa'i lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus, aa ra lole lii holo-nori ama lamatua ètu d'ara kota èèna. hèia rèngu lèpa hari asa yerusalem. ra kako re rae-rae ètu propensi samaria, ho lole lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus mi dhèu ètu rae sèra.

source_text: then an angel of the lord spoke to philip, saying, arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from jerusalem to gaza. this is a desert.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga pua pelipus, peka na, lamu ku madhutu j'ara asa balèu. madhutu j'ara dhui, dhu nèti kota yerusalem la'e asa rai gasa.

source_text: he arose and went; and behold, there was a man of ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under candace, queen of the ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to jerusalem to worship. he was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet isaiah.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare lii paredha èèna, ka na pakèd'i dènge ka. lod'o nèngu kako ètu j'ara èèna, ladhe nèdhi dhèu èci. dhèu èèna, pegawi kapai nèti rai etiopia. nèngu ne ka dhu ladhe-leru mèdha-panyau dhèu aae bhèni, ngara na kandake. pegawi èèna heka sabaj'a nare ètu yerusalem, ka na lèpa èmu ca'e kareta. ropa pelipus nèdhi ne, nèngu madhèdi baca ètu dedha kareta. na baca sasuri dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya.

source_text: the spirit said to philip, go near, and join yourself to this chariot.
target_text: èle èèna ka, roh lamatua pua pelipus la'e padètu asa kareta èèna, sèna ka na paraga dènge dhèu èèna.

source_text: philip ran to him, and heard him reading isaiah the prophet, and said, do you understand what you are reading?
target_text: ropa na dètu, ka na tadèngi, na, dhèu èèna baca sasuri yesaya. ka pelipus karèi ne, peka na, ama! ama ku me'a, do aad'o, ngaa dhu ama baca èèna?

source_text: he said, how can i, unless someone explains it to me? he begged philip to come up and sit with him.
target_text: ka dhèu ne dhaa, peka na, aad'o, ja'a ke'a boe. hud'i abhu ku dhèu dhu peka-padhai dènge ja'a, heka ja'a ke'a kèna. ca'e mai ho madhèdi dènge ja'a.

source_text: now the passage of the scripture which he was reading was this, he was led as a sheep to the slaughter. as a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn't open his mouth.
target_text: sasuri dhu na baca èèna, sèmi ne'e ka, ra nuni rèti ne, sama sèmi nuni kahib'i-kalèbho, ho neo roro ne. nèngu j'aj'i sama sèmi ana kahib'i-kalèbho dhu dhèu g'ute rèu ne, te ngaa nèngu mau-mau sène, na kabee boe. hèb'a na kutu mèno, aa na kalua boe lii ca lamusi sa.

source_text: in his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. who will declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth.
target_text: ka ra lalangu ne, ra j'ue lii langu na lèke boe. lod'o èèna, ra pamadhe ne, masi ka nèngu dènge boe sasala-sasigo. de èdhi peka ngaa hari lula-nèti ana-èpu na?

source_text: the eunuch answered philip, who is the prophet talking about? about himself, or about someone else?
target_text: ropa na baca nare, hèia na karèi pelipus, peka na, tasamia, ee? sasuri yesaya ne, lèke mi nèngu, do, lèke mi dhèu leo?

source_text: philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this scripture, preached to him about jesus.
target_text: ka pelipus aj'a ne lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus. na lolo nèti lii sasuri yesaya, ho pad'elo j'ara madhutu yesus.

source_text: as they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, behold, here is water. what is keeping me from being baptized?
target_text: lod'o rèngu ètu d'ara kakako era, rèngu rage loko èci dènge èi. ka dhèu èèna peka dènge pelipus, aku nèngu na, ama. ladhe ku èi ka nèi. ladhe èu ngee, na, cadhui boe, mai puru lati, ho èu sarani ku ja'a.

source_text: he commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.
target_text: hèia pegawi èèna, paredha ho patitu kareta. ka dua ra puru asa d'ara èi èèna, ka pelipus sarani ne.

source_text: when they came up out of the water, the spirit of the lord caught philip away, and the eunuch didn't see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.
target_text: ropa ra kalua mai nèti d'ara èi, kabèdhi laa roh lamatua ded'e nèti pelipus asa era leo. ka dhèu èèna nèdhi heka pelipus. hèia pegawi kapai èèna lèpa dènge d'ara karej'e-karae.

source_text: but philip was found at azotus. passing through, he preached the good news to all the cities until he came to caesarea.
target_text: ka pelipus cèu ètu rae èci, ngara na asotus. nèti rae èèna, ka na la'e padhue-padhai taruu lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus. na dhuli rae-rae ètu rai èèna, toke d'ai kota kaisarea.

source_text: but saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the lord, went to the high priest
target_text: lod'o èèna, saulus paj'èra taruu dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu yesus. na tenge j'ara ho neo pamadhe si. nèti èèna ka, la'e asa kètu kapai risi agama yahudi,

source_text: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of damascus, that if he found any who were of the way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to jerusalem.
target_text: ka manèngi pèri-pèri sasuri koasa, ho nèti la'e asa ama-ama èmu manèngi-mangaj'i agama yahudi ètu kota damsik nèi. na manèngi, ladhe nèngu rage dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri yesus ètu nèi, bhèni-mone, nèngu kèpe ho èki si, sèna ka ère nèti hari si asa yerusalem.

source_text: as he traveled, he got close to damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.
target_text: ropa sèmi nare sasuri koasa sèra, ka nèngu dènge angalai na lasi asa kota damsik. ropa oe dètu dènge kota èèna, cag'ag'a laa, saraa puru nèti dedha-liru sarimu nare saulus.

source_text: he fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, saul, saul, why do you persecute me?
target_text: ka na bèbhe rai la'e. hèia na tadèngi lii èci padhai lii dènge ne, peka na, saulus! saulus! nga tao ka èu paj'èra ja'a sèmi ne'e?

source_text: he said, who are you, lord? the lord said, i am jesus, whom you are persecuting.
target_text: hèia saulus karèi, aku nèngu na, ama dhu padhai lii ne, cee ka èu? lii èèna, peka hari, ja'a ne, yesus, dhu èu paj'èra aae ne.

source_text: but rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.
target_text: kèd'i, ho lamu asa d'ara kota. d'ai nèi, pe ja'a peka dènge èu, ngaa dhu èu hud'i tao.

source_text: the men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.
target_text: aa angalai nèngu sèra tadèngi kahèi lii èèna, te ngaa rèdhi boe cee-cee. dhèu se'e malaa, ka re'a heka padhai lii ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. they led him by the hand and brought him into damascus.
target_text: hèia saulus kèd'i titu. ka na neo bhoke musi madha na, te ngaa nèdhi heka ngaa-ngaa. ka ra sarad'e rèti ne asa d'ara kota damsik.

source_text: he was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.
target_text: ètu d'ara tèlu lod'o, na bisa boe nèdhi ngaa-ngaa. aa na'a-ninu boe ngaa-ngaa kahèi.

source_text: now there was a certain disciple at damascus named ananias. the lord said to him in a vision, ananias! he said, behold, it's me, lord.
target_text: ètu d'ara kota èèna, abhu dhèu unu lamatua yesus èci, ngara na ananias. lamatua mai pad'elo iisi dènge ne, sama sèmi tanila sa. na paroa, peka na, ananias! hèia ananias dhaa, peka na, oo, lamatua!

source_text: the lord said to him, arise and go to the street which is called straight, and inquire in the house of judah for one named saul, a man of tarsus. for behold, he is praying,
target_text: lamatua peka, na, nanene ku! èu lamu tenge ku dhèu unu ja'a èci. kako lamu asa j'ara èci, dhu ngara na j'ara mola. lamu asa èmu dhèu èci, ngara na yudas. ètu èèna, karèi rèngu dhèu èci nèti kota tarsus, ngara na saulus. dhèu èèna sabaj'a era.

source_text: and in a vision he has seen a man named ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.
target_text: ja'a hia ne tanila kahèi, na, èèna na dhèu mone èci neo mai paraga dènge ne, nuka èu, ananias. de lamu ho bane ai èu mi nèngu, sèna ka na bisa nèdhi hari.

source_text: but ananias answered, lord, i have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at jerusalem.
target_text: te ngaa ananias b'ala, aku nèngu na, sèmi ne'e, lamatua! ji'i tadèngi le lii palolo lula-nèti dhèu èèna. nèngu èèna ka dhu paj'èra dhèu-dhèu unu lamatua ètu yerusalem. nèti èèna ka, dhèu bani heka bhodho baboro!

source_text: here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.
target_text: limuri ne, ji'i tadèngi hari, peka na, kètu agama yahudi sèra hia ne koasa ho mai kèpa dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus.

source_text: but the lord said to him, go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of israel.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua padhai lii hari dènge ananias, peka na, masi ka sèmi èèna, èu hud'i lamu ku! te ja'a hag'e kore nèngu le, ho na bhoke j'ara, sèna ka na lole lii lolo be'a ja'a hia dhèu kabarai leo sèra, hia dhèu aae-dhèu aae, dènge dhèu isra'el kahèi.

source_text: for i will show him how many things he must suffer for my name's sake.
target_text: aa èèna na, ja'a pad'elo dènge ne, sèna ka nèngu ne'a mema j'aj'èra tasa mera mia ka dhu bèli-camèd'a nèngu pasae, lula nèngu madhutu ja'a.

source_text: ananias departed and entered into the house. laying his hands on him, he said, brother saul, the lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the holy spirit.
target_text: tadèngi nare lii padhai lii lamatua, hèia ananias la'e ka maso asa èmu èèna. ka na bane ai na mi saulus, peka na, angalai saulus! lamatua yesus dhu pad'elo iisi mi èu ètu talora j'ara lod'o èu mai asa ne'e, nèngu èèna ka dhu pua ja'a mai paraga dènge èu ètu ne'e. na pua ja'a kahèi ho sabaj'a dènge tao kacui-aai mi dedha èu, sèna ka èu bisa mèdhi hari. aa na d'èi ho èu sèmi more roh na dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. he arose and was baptized.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, saulus rasa ngaa èci bèbhe eele nèti musi madha nèngu, sèmi nai i'a. hèia na ladhe nèdhi hari. ka na kèd'i, aa ra sarani dènge ne.

source_text: he took food and was strengthened. saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at damascus.
target_text: èle èèna ka, na na'a-ninu. ka na abhu hari a'èra. ka saulus pea hari dènge dhèu unu lamatua yesus pèri-pèri lod'o ètu kota damsik.

source_text: immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the christ, that he is the son of god.
target_text: aa la'e asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, ka na peka dènge si, aku nèngu na, mi nanene paie! mema yesus tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua.

source_text: all who heard him were amazed, and said, isn't this he who in jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? and he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!
target_text: ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra malaa dènge bingu, ropa ra tadèngi saulus padhai lii sèmi èèna. hèia ra papeka, aku rèngu na, nèngu ka dhu paj'èra dhèu unu yesus ètu yerusalem, sina ma? aa mamai ne, sèna ka na kèpe dhèu se'e ho nèti asa kètu agama yahudi sèra! na, tasamia ka ne?

source_text: but saul increased more in strength, and confounded the jews who lived at damascus, proving that this is the christ.
target_text: te ngaa saulus padhai lii taruu, aku nèngu na, yesus èèna, nuka dhèu dhu ama lamatua moa nèti uru, ho pua na mai. saulus padhai lii dènge d'èlu-mèu aa d'ara adhu, toke dhèu yahudi sèra segi boe nèngu. nèti èèna ka, a'èra saulus asa tabha kapai.

source_text: when many days were fulfilled, the jews conspired together to kill him,
target_text: nèbhu boe ka, dhèu yahudi sèra sanunu ho neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: but their plot became known to saul. they watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,
target_text: te ngaa saulus ae nare ngangee aapa rèngu èèna, dhu peka na, ra mate ne mèu-mèda ètu hèb'a-hèb'a tebho kota, ho ra neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.
target_text: ka ca tèka hari, d'ara mèda, angalai saulus pèri-pèri dhèu mai rare ne, ka ra papuru ne ètu d'ara kadhari cue, re karasa li'u tebho kota. dènge j'ara èèna ka, nèngu rai nèti kota damsik.

source_text: when saul had come to jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.
target_text: èle èèna ka, saulus la'e asa yerusalem. d'ai nèi, ka na neo pa'èci dènge dhèu unu lamatua yesus. te ngaa dhèu sèra madha'u dènge nèngu, lula ra pangee, na, nèngu dhoka sangaja di, j'aj'i dhèu parcaya dhu madhutu lamatua yesus. èle èèna na, nèngu kabèli hari ho neo kèpe rèngu.

source_text: but barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at damascus he had preached boldly in the name of jesus.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu èci, ngara na barnabas, nèngu ka dhu nèti saulus ho patadhe mi dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua ètu èèna. na lole ngaa dhu j'aj'i mi dedha saulus ètu talora j'ara. na peka, na, saulus paraga le dènge lamatua yesus kahèi. aa yesus padhai lii dènge nèngu kahèi. na lolo kahèi babani saulus padhai lii j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus mi dhèu damsik sèra.

source_text: he was with them entering into jerusalem,
target_text: ropa ra tadèngi rare barnabas peka sèmi èèna, heka ra sèmi rare saulus kèna. ka ra pea pa'èci ètu kota yerusalem. saulus bani lole lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus kahèi, sad'i dènge dhèu cee èèna ka. nèngu madha'u boe.

source_text: preaching boldly in the name of the lord jesus. he spoke and disputed against the hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.
target_text: na pakarèi dènge pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi dhu padhai lii yunani. te ngaa rèngu ro'o boe sèmi rare lii padhai lii nèngu. nèti èèna ka, ra tenge j'ara neo pamadhe ne.

source_text: when the brothers knew it, they brought him down to caesarea and sent him off to tarsus.
target_text: ropa dhèu unu lamatua yesus re'a ngangee karehe dhèu sèra, hèia lasi rare saulus rèti asa kota kaisarea. d'ai nèi, ka ra pua ne lèpa asa kota na, tarsus.

source_text: so the assemblies throughout all judea, galilee, and samaria had peace and were built up. they were multiplied, walking in the fear of the lord and in the comfort of the holy spirit.
target_text: èle èèna ka, dhèu unu lamatua yesus ètu propensi yudea, propensi galilea, dènge propensi samaria, mamuri dènge mera-milu. rèngu asa tabha ae. rèngu mamuri madhutu dad'èi lamatua. ka roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci pa'èra d'ara rèngu.

source_text: as peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at lydda.
target_text: lod'o-lod'o sèra, petrus biasa kako palème asa mia-mia, ho pa'èra d'ara dhèu unu lamatua sèra. ca lod'o ka na la'e ngad'o rèngu ètu rae lida.

source_text: there he found a certain man named aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.
target_text: ètu nèi, na paraga dènge dhèu mone èci, ngara na eneas. dhèu ne, karuku aru tèu kèna, ka na kèd'i nare heka nèti era j'unu na.

source_text: peter said to him, aeneas, jesus christ heals you. get up and make your bed! immediately he arose.
target_text: hèia petrus peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, eneas! limuri ne, lamatua yesus kristus pa'èle èu. de kèd'i ka! lalau paie era j'unu èu! nanene nare sèmi èèna, hèia na kèd'i dènge ka.

source_text: all who lived at lydda and in sharon saw him, and they turned to the lord.
target_text: ropa ladhe rèdhi eneas èle le, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rae lida dènge rae saron parcaya lamatua yesus.

source_text: now there was at joppa a certain disciple named tabitha, which when translated means dorcas. this woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu bhèni èci, ngara na tabita, pea dètu dènge nebhe dhasi ètu kota yope. madhutu lii yunani ra paroa bhèni ne, ngara na dorkas. sasoa na ‘rusa'. bhèni ne parcaya lamatua yesus. tatao bhèni ne be'a mi dedha dhèu leo, aa na tema laladhe dhèu j'èra.

source_text: in those days, she became sick and died. when they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.
target_text: lod'o èèna, tabita ne pèd'a aae, ka madhe. ka dhèu padiu ne èi. èle èèna ka, ra papake ne mèdha-papake, ka ra paj'unu ne ètu kama dedha.

source_text: as lydda was near joppa, the disciples, hearing that peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu se tadèngi, na, petrus ètu rae lida, dhu kaj'èu nèti kota yope, sèmi kako haga na ele boe ca'èta lod'o sa. ka ra pua dhèu dua lasi paroa petrus, peka na, ama! ji'i manèngi ama mai ku lai-lai asa kota yope.

source_text: peter got up and went with them. when he had come, they brought him into the upper room. all the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which dorcas had made while she was with them.
target_text: tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, ka petrus kèd'i dènge ka, la'e madhutu rèngu. d'ai nèi, ka na maso taruu asa d'ara kama tabita. ètu d'ara kama na, pènu le dènge bhèni balu dhu mai tangi. bhèni balu sèra pad'elo mi petrus kodho dènge mèdha-papake leo, dhu dorkas j'au hia rèngu, lod'o na mamuri era.

source_text: peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. turning to the body, he said, tabitha, get up! she opened her eyes, and when she saw peter, she sat up.
target_text: hèia petrus pua si kalua nèti kama. ka na patitu urutuu ho na manèngi-mangaj'i. hèia na ladhe asa dhèu madhe ne, ka na padhai lii, peka na, tabita! kèd'i ka! cag'ag'a laa, tabita bhoke musi madha na. ropa ladhe nèdhi petrus, ka na kèd'i madhèdi.

source_text: he gave her his hand and raised her up. calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
target_text: hèia petrus kèpe kacui-aai na, ho hia ne titu. ka petrus paroa bhèni balu sèra dènge dhèu-dhèu leo ètu èèna, ho na hia bhèni dhu mamuri hari ne asa rèngu.

source_text: this became known throughout all joppa, and many believed in the lord.
target_text: ka lii lole ne, dhèu lolo palème d'ara kota yope, toke d'ai dhèu ae parcaya lamatua yesus.

source_text: he stayed many days in joppa with a tanner named simon.
target_text: èle èèna ka, petrus pea pèri-pèri lod'o ètu èmu dhèu èci, ngara na simon. dhèu ne'e, tuka pamèu ka'uri badha.

source_text: now there was a certain man in caesarea, cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the italian regiment,
target_text: lod'o èèna, abhu komedhaa sordad'u roma dhèu èci, ngara na kornelis. nèngu ne, komedhaa nèti sordad'u cangasu dhèu. rèngu mai nèti kaj'èu, nèti rai italia, ka ra pea ètu kota kaisarea.

source_text: a devout man, and one who feared god with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to god.
target_text: nèngu dènge isi èmu na d'èi padètu dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa ae ka dhèu roma leo sèmi boe èèna. nèngu biasa soru-bara dhèu j'èra, aa na maj'èni sabaj'a mi ama lamatua.

source_text: at about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of god coming to him and saying to him, cornelius!
target_text: ca lod'o hari, pe d'ara hake tèlu nihia sa, na abhu tanila. na ladhe nèdhi iia-iia ana pajuu ama lamatua èci puru mai nèti sorga, ka na paroa ne, peka na, kornelis!

source_text: he, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, what is it, lord? he said to him, your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before god.
target_text: ropa kornelis ladhe nèdhi ana pajuu nèti sorga, ka na madha'u titu kèna. hèia na karèi, aku nèngu na, tasamia, ama? ka ana pajuu ne dhaa, na, lamatua tadèngi le lii manèngi-mangaj'i èu, aa na ne'a le d'ara hua iia èu mi dedha dhèu leo. ka na sanèd'e èu.

source_text: now send men to joppa, and get simon, who is also called peter.
target_text: de pua dhèu lasi asa kota yope, ho paroa rèti dhèu èci, ngara na simon petrus.

source_text: he is staying with a tanner named simon, whose house is by the seaside.
target_text: dhèu èèna manubha ètu èmu cue ètu sebhe dhasi, unu simon, tuka pamèu ka'uri badha.

source_text: when the angel who spoke to him had departed, cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.
target_text: ropa ana pajuu nèti sorga ne tèke eele kornelis, ka na paroa ana sab'a na dhèu dua, dènge sordad'u èci dhu d'èi padètu dènge lamatua kahèi.

source_text: having explained everything to them, he sent them to joppa.
target_text: kornelis lolo aa'i ngaa dhu nèngu nèdhi èèna, ka na pua si lasi asa kota yope.

source_text: now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.
target_text: ka asa bèli èèna, pe d'ara lod'o titu mera sa, dhèu paleha nèti kornelis sèra oe d'ai le yope. lod'o èèna, petrus ca'e la'e neo manèngi-mangaj'i asa kalaga dedha èmu simon.

source_text: he became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.
target_text: ropa na manèngi-mangaj'i, na rasa manganga. na mate dhèu lalau nganga'a-nginu. ropa nèngu manèngi-mangaj'i era, na abhu tanila kahèi.

source_text: he saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,
target_text: na nèdhi sèmi liru bhoka. ka hahèla-koi bhèla aae ca bèla puru mai, dhu èki re suu-suu èpa na.

source_text: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.
target_text: ètu d'ara hahèla-koi èèna, nèngu ladhe nèdhi rupa-rupa badha, nuka badha ai èpa, badha rod'o-kakara, dènge rupa-rupa manu-bhui kahèi.

source_text: a voice came to him, rise, peter, kill and eat!
target_text: hèia na tadèngi lii èci pua ne, petrus! kèd'i ka! kèj'i badha se, ho mu'a!

source_text: but peter said, not so, lord; for i have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.
target_text: te ngaa petrus dhaa, aku nèngu na, bisa boe, ama! baku sèmi èèna! te ja'a ku'a kèdhi mèka sisi badha sèmi se'e! ji'i dhèu yahudi luri sisi badha se'e aa'i-aa'i ra!

source_text: a voice came to him again the second time, what god has cleansed, you must not call unclean.
target_text: te ngaa lii ne b'ala hari, peka na, ladhe ama lamatua peka mèdha ngaa dhu mèu, èu baku peka kaj'alu!

source_text: this was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.
target_text: hahèla-koi èèna cèu tèlu hari, èle èèna ka ca'e hari asa dedha-liru la'e.

source_text: now while peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by cornelius, having made inquiry for simon's house, stood before the gate,
target_text: hèia petrus pajiko la'e-mai sasoa tanila deo na. kabèdhi laa, ana paleha kornelis sèra d'ai madha èmu simon. ra titu ètu hèb'a èmu.

source_text: and called and asked whether simon, who was also called peter, was lodging there.
target_text: ka ra lii, peka na, ji'i tenge dhèu èci dhu manubha ètu èmu ne'e. ngara na, simon petrus. ele boe ama tadhe, do?

source_text: while peter was pondering the vision, the spirit said to him, behold, three men seek you.
target_text: ropa petrus pajiko sasoa tanila na era. ka roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka dènge ne, petrus. dhèu mate èu ka haha si.

source_text: but arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for i have sent them.
target_text: de puru ho lamu ka dènge si. èu baku mage-mage ia ka. masi ka ad'a yahudi aj'a, na, dhèu yahudi hud'i madenge dènge dhèu leo, te ngaa èu baku madenge dènge rèngu, lula ja'a ka dhu pua rèngu mai rare èu.

source_text: peter went down to the men, and said, behold, i am he whom you seek. why have you come?
target_text: ka petrus puru la'e paraga dènge dhèu sèra. hèia na peka, aku nèngu na, ja'a ne'e ka dhu miu tenge. de miu parluu ngaa?

source_text: they said, cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears god, and well spoken of by all the nation of the jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.
target_text: ka ra dhaa, aku rèngu na, komedhaa sordad'u roma èci pua ji'i mai asa ne'e. nèngu èèna, komedhaa nèti cangasu sordad'u. dhèu ne d'ara mola, aa na d'èi padètu dènge ama lamatua. dhèu yahudi ae dhu re'a le babe'a dhèu ne'e. med'a na, heka ana pajuu ama lamatua puru mai nèti sorga, ho pua lamatua ji'i manèngi èu lamu asa èmu na, ho na neo nanene unu na nèti èu.

source_text: so he called them in and provided a place to stay. on the next day peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from joppa accompanied him.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, hèia petrus manèngi rèngu ho j'unu taha mèda ne ètu èèna. bèli mad'ae èèna, ra pakèd'i, lasi palere. dhèu unu lamatua yesus pèri-pèri nèti yope lasi kahèi.

source_text: on the next day they entered into caesarea. cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.
target_text: mèda èèna rèngu j'unu ètu j'ara. bèli èèna, heka rèngu d'ai kota kaisarea kèna. ropa rèngu d'ai, kornelis mate mema rèngu. na pakaboko nare le a'ari na dènge mone-aanga angalai na ètu èmu nèngu.

source_text: when peter entered, cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.
target_text: ropa petrus d'ai hèb'a èmu, kornelis mai soru ne, ka madhèdi patitu kètu urutuu ètu haga petrus, ho na pahaha iisi.

source_text: but peter raised him up, saying, stand up! i myself am also a man.
target_text: te ngaa petrus pakèd'i ne, peka na, ama! baku sèmi èèna! baku pahaha iisi mi ja'a. te ja'a ne, dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi èu kahèi.

source_text: as he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.
target_text: ropa tadèngi nare sèmi èèna, kornelis kèd'i titu dènge. ka dua ra padhai lii, kako lasi asa d'ara èmu. d'ai d'ara èmu, petrus nèdhi dhèu ae pakaboko mate nèngu.

source_text: he said to them, you yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but god has shown me that i shouldn't call any man unholy or unclean.
target_text: na ladhe palème dhèu sèra, ka na padhai lii, peka na, a'ari aa'i-aa'i mi! miu me'a mema ad'a ji'i dhèu yahudi. madhutu ad'a ji'i, na, ji'i bisa boe pa'èci dènge dhèu leo. ngaa hari, maso asa d'ara èmu ra. te ngaa ama lamatua pad'elo le dènge ja'a, ladhe mèdha ngaa dhu nèngu peka na mèu, ja'a baku peka na mèdha èèna kaj'alu. de limuri ne, ja'a madenge heka dènge dhèu leo. ja'a hud'i tao dhèu leo sama sèmi a'ari ja'a kahèi.

source_text: therefore i also came without complaint when i was sent for. i ask therefore, why did you send for me?
target_text: nèti èèna ka, lod'o miu lami paroa, ka ja'a mai dènge. ja'a pamata heka, lula lamatua peka nare le dènge ja'a sèmi èèna. miu peka ku laa. miu parluu ngaa nèti ja'a?

source_text: cornelius said, four days ago, i was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, i prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing
target_text: hèia kornelis lole aa'i mèu-mèu, aku nèngu na, èpa lod'o dhu la'e èèna, ropa lod'o nihia, ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i ètu èmu ja'a. cag'ag'a laa, dhèu mone èci titu ètu madha ja'a. mèdha-papake na heo loa-loa.

source_text: and said, ‘cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of god.
target_text: ka na paroa ja'a, aku nèngu na, ‘kornelis! lamatua tadèngi le lii manèngi èu, aa na ne'a le d'ara hua iia èu mi dedha dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: send therefore to joppa and summon simon, who is also called peter. he is staying in the house of a tanner named simon, by the seaside. when he comes, he will speak to you. '
target_text: de lod'o ne'e, pua dhèu lasi rare dhèu èci asa kota yope. ngara na, simon petrus. nèngu manubha ètu èmu cue ètu sebhe dhasi, ètu èmu tuka pamèu ka'uri badha. ngara na, simon kahèi. '

source_text: therefore i sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. now therefore we are all here present in the sight of god to hear all things that have been commanded you by god.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pua dhèu dhiu rare ama. ji'i manèngi makasi ae, lula ama mai dènge, ropa tadèngi lii paroa ji'i. nèti èèna ka, ji'i pakaboko ètu ne'e, ho neo nanene ngaa dhu ama lamatua pua ama peka dènge ji'i!

source_text: peter opened his mouth and said, truly i perceive that god doesn't show favoritism;
target_text: hèia petrus padhai lii, peka na, limuri ne, ja'a heka ke'a kèna, na, ètu madha ama lamatua, dhèu rai-haha sama èci èèna ka. lamatua ladhe boe rèhu, mia ka dhèu yahudi, aa mia ka dhèu leo.

source_text: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.
target_text: dhèu mia dhu d'ara mola, dhu maj'èni manèngi-mangaj'i mi lamatua, aa madhutu dad'èi nèngu, rèngu sèra pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: the word which he sent to the children of israel, preaching good news of peace by jesus christ-he is lord of all-
target_text: de miu me'a, ngaa dhu lamatua peka le dènge ji'i dhèu isra'el, peka na, nèngu pua le kristus, nuka yesus. ka yesus madhe ho padame dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua. aa nèngu j'aj'i kètu mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all judea, beginning from galilee, after the baptism which john preached;
target_text: miu tadèngi kahèi, ngaa dhu j'aj'i le ètu palème propensi yudea. lii lole èèna mulai nèti yohanis tuka sarani dhèu, aj'a dhèu ho ra ele-ho'a nèti sasala-sasigo rèngu. aa rèngu hud'i abhu sarani kahèi, sèna ka j'aj'i tadha, peka na, rèngu pabe'a le dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: how god anointed jesus of nazareth with the holy spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for god was with him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ama lamatua hia roh na dhu mola-mèci mi yesus, dhèu nasaret. lamatua hia koasa na mi yesus kahèi. ka yesus maso-kalua rae-rae, tao j'ara be'a mi dhèu-dhèu. aa na puri-pa'èle dhèu dhu dhèu aae nidhu paj'èra si. na tao sèmi èèna, lula ama lamatua sama-sama dènge ne taruu.

source_text: we are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the jews and in jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.
target_text: te ji'i se'e ka dhu ladhe ngèdhi unu mi, ngaa dhu na sab'a ètu kota yerusalem, aa palème kabarai yahudi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: god raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,
target_text: nèngu madhe tare'a, te ngaa asa camèd'a, ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. ka na pad'elo iisi na, ho dhèu rèdhi, sèna ka ra re'a nèngu mamuri hari tare'a-re'a le.

source_text: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by god, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae cahag'e dhu rèdhi boe ne, dhoka ji'i di. lod'o nèngu mamuri hari le, ji'i biasa nga'a-nginu dènge ne. ama lamatua paj'uj'u ji'i ho la'a lole palème lii lolo be'a yesus mi dhèu ae ètu mia-mia.

source_text: he commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by god as the judge of the living and the dead.
target_text: aa lamatua ka dhu pua ji'i la'a lole peka pasaraa mi dhèu, lula-nèti dhèu dhu na paj'uj'u nèti uru ka mai, nuka yesus. aa lamatua ded'e ne j'aj'i dhèu j'ue lii langu, ho pama'ète, na, cee ka dhu bisa mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua, aa cee aad'o. yesus èèna ka dhu j'ue lii dhèu dhu madhe le, dènge dhèu dhu mamuri era.

source_text: all the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.
target_text: nèti uru ka mai, dhèu rèti lii padhai ama lamatua aa'i-aa'i ra lole le yesus, peka na, dhèu cee dhu parcaya nèngu, na, ama lamatua sèmi nare si, aa saku eele sasala-sasigo rèngu kahèi.

source_text: while peter was still speaking these words, the holy spirit fell on all those who heard the word.
target_text: lod'o petrus padhai lii nare mèka, cag'ag'a laa, roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci maso asa d'ara dhèu se'e aa'i-aa'i ra dhu nanene lii padhai lii na.

source_text: they of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with peter, because the gift of the holy spirit was also poured out on the gentiles.
target_text: ètu èèna, abhu kahèi dhèu yahudi angalai petrus dhu mai palere dènge ne nèti kota yope asa èmu kornelis ètu kota kaisarea. ropa rèngu rèdhi dhèu ae sèra abhu roh ama lamatua, ka ra malaa, lula rèngu heka re'a kèna, na, lamatua hia roh na mi dhèu yahudi boe kahèi.

source_text: for they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying god. then peter answered,
target_text: rèngu tadèngi dhèu ètu d'ara èmu kornelis sèra padhai lii, pake lii dhu baka-leo. aa ra koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua. hèia petrus padhai lii, peka na,

source_text: can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? they have received the holy spirit just like us.
target_text: miu mèdhi unu mi! dhèu se'e se, sèmi rare le roh lamatua èci èèna ka dènge èdhi kahèi. de mai ka, sèna ka èdhi sarani si. dhèu èci sa dhu bisa heka taha rèngu.

source_text: he commanded them to be baptized in the name of jesus christ. then they asked him to stay some days.
target_text: hèia petrus pua si ho sarani kornelis dènge dhèu ètu sèra sa, ho ra j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua yesus. ka ra manèngi petrus pea dènge rèngu pèri-pèri lod'o hari. èle èèna ka, heka ra hia ne lèpa asa yerusalem.

source_text: now the apostles and the brothers who were in judea heard that the gentiles had also received the word of god.
target_text: petrus dhae lèpa mèka, te ngaa dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus dènge dhèu parcaya yesus dhu leo sèra, dhu pea ètu yerusalem, tadèngi rare le, peka na, dhèu yahudi boe sèmi rare le lii lole be'a lamatua.

source_text: when peter had come up to jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,
target_text: ropa petrus d'ai kota yerusalem, dhèu nèti partei yahudi dhu parcaya yesus mai pasala ne,

source_text: saying, you went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!
target_text: peka na, weh! èu tao samia kèna? èu me'a ad'a-tatao èdhi, do aad'o? èu ne bani titu kèna, maso asa d'ara èmu dhèu leo! aa èu mu'a-minu dènge rèngu kahèi! baku tao sèmi èèna, te rèngu madhutu mèka ad'a suna èdhi! èdhi bisa boe pa'èci dènge rèngu sèra!

source_text: but peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,
target_text: hèia petrus lole aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i le, peka na,

source_text: i was in the city of joppa praying, and in a trance i saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. it came as far as me.
target_text: lod'o ja'a ètu kota yope, ja'a laku sabaj'a, ka ja'a abhu tanila. ja'a kèdhi liru bhoka, ka hahèla-koi bhèla aae ca bèla, dhu èki re suu-suu èpa na, puru mai asa ja'a.

source_text: when i had looked intently at it, i considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.
target_text: ropa ja'a patigi asa d'ara hahèla-koi èèna, ja'a kèdhi rupa-rupa badha, nuka badha ai èpa, badha rod'o-kakara, dènge rupa-rupa manu-bhui kahèi. badha se'e se, dhu èdhi dhèu yahudi luri.

source_text: i also heard a voice saying to me, ‘rise, peter, kill and eat! '
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi lii èci pua, peka na, ‘petrus! kèd'i ka! kèj'i badha se, ho mu'a! '

source_text: but i said, ‘not so, lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth. '
target_text: te ngaa ja'a dhaa, peka na, ‘bisa boe, ama! baku sèmi èèna! te ja'a ku'a kèdhi mèka sisi badha sèmi se'e! dhèu yahudi luri sisi badha se'e aa'i-aa'i ra! '

source_text: but a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘what god has cleansed, don't you call unclean. '
target_text: te ngaa lii ne b'ala hari, peka na, ‘ladhe ama lamatua peka mèdha ngaa dhu mèu, èu baku peka na kaj'alu! '

source_text: this was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.
target_text: ja'a kèdhi hahèla-koi èèna cèu padhutu tèlu hari, ka ca'e hari asa dedha-liru la'e.

source_text: behold, immediately three men stood before the house where i was, having been sent from caesarea to me.
target_text: lod'o èèna kahèi, dhèu tèlu d'ai èmu dhu ja'a pea. rèngu nèti kaisarea mai tenge ja'a.

source_text: the spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. these six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house.
target_text: hèia roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, ‘puru ho lamu ka dènge dhèu sèra. èu baku mage-mage ia ka. èu baku madenge dènge rèngu. ' ka a'ari èdhi dhèu èna palere dènge ja'a kahèi asa kaisarea. ètu èèna, ji'i aa'i-aa'i mi maso asa d'ara èmu komedhaa sordad'u roma.

source_text: he told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘send to joppa and get simon, who is called peter,
target_text: na lolo, peka na, pèri-pèri lod'o dhu la'e èèna, nèngu nèdhi ana pajuu lamatua puru nèti sorga, titu ètu d'ara èmu na. ka na peka, aku nèngu na, ‘pua dhèu lasi asa kota yope, ho paroa mèti dhèu èci, ngara na simon petrus.

source_text: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house. '
target_text: sèna ka dhèu èèna ka dhu pad'elo mi dedha èu dènge isi èmu èu aa'i-aa'i ra, j'ara lamatua dhu hia miu mamuri, dènge saku eele sasala-sasigo miu sèra. '

source_text: as i began to speak, the holy spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a pad'elo j'ara mamuri lamatua mi dedha rèngu. ka rèngu abhu dènge ka roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, sama sèmi èdhi abhu ca hari na.

source_text: i remembered the word of the lord, how he said, ‘john indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the holy spirit. '
target_text: ropa ja'a kèdhi rèngu abhu roh lamatua kahèi, ka ja'a sanèd'e lii padhai lii lamatua yesus uru èèna, dhu peka na, ‘yohanis sarani dhèu pake dhoka èi di, te ngaa ladhe miu mate hari pèri-pèri lod'o, èèna na lamatua neo tao dhu kapai risi eele hia miu. nuka, na hia miu roh na dhu mola-mèci. '

source_text: if then god gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the lord jesus christ, who was i, that i could withstand god?
target_text: te lamatua unu na ka dhu hia roh na mi dedha dhèu leo sèra, sama sèmi na pala-bagi mi èdhi se. de madhutu dad'èi miu, ja'a hud'i palab'a dènge ama lamatua, do tasamia? de ja'a peka ngaa hari?

source_text: when they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified god, saying, then god has also granted to the gentiles repentance to life!
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, petrus siri iisi na sèmi èèna, ka rèngu pasala heka ne. hèia ra koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, ira ii! nia kahèi, nga! lamatua bhoke le j'ara hia dhèu leo ho ra tèke eele j'ara mamuri rèngu dhu sala, ho lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo rèngu. sèna ka rèngu abhu mamuri taruu dènge ne.

source_text: they therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about stephen traveled as far as phoenicia, cyprus, and antioch, speaking the word to no one except to jews only.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ra pamadhe rare stefanus, ka ra paj'èra dhèu unu yesus. nèti èèna ka, dhèu se'e rai paj'ala asa mia-mia. cahag'e rai asa propensi finisia. cahag'e rai asa pulu siprus, aa cahag'e hari rai d'ai kota antiokia ètu propensi siria. dhèu dhu rai sèra, lole taruu lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus asa mia-mia. te ngaa ra lole dhoka dènge dhèu yahudi rèngu sèra. ra lole boe dènge dhèu leo.

source_text: but there were some of them, men of cyprus and cyrene, who, when they had come to antioch, spoke to the hellenists, preaching the lord jesus.
target_text: te ngaa abhu kahèi dhèu unu lamatua dhu mai nèti pulu siprus dènge kota kirene. rèngu cahag'e rai taruu lasi asa kota antiokia ètu propensi siria. rèngu se'e ka dhu lole lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus hia dhèu yahudi boe ètu era èèna.

source_text: the hand of the lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the lord.
target_text: lamatua hia si koasa na, nèti èèna ka, dhèu ae titu kèna parcaya lamatua yesus.

source_text: the report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in jerusalem. they sent out barnabas to go as far as antioch, who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of god, was glad. he exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the lord. for he was a good man, and full of the holy spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the lord.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu unu lamatua yesus ètu yerusalem tadèngi, na, dhèu leo ètu kota antiokia parcaya yesus kahèi. ka ra pua barnabas la'e ladhe si ètu nèi. barnabas ne, dhèu d'ara be'a, aa parcaya tare'a-re'a ama lamatua. aa roh lamatua dènge nèngu kahèi. ropa nèngu d'ai nèi, na nèdhi tare'a ama lamatua sab'a ètu d'ara mamuri dhèu leo sèra. ka d'ara nèngu karej'e. ka na pa'èra d'ara rèngu, sèna ka rèngu madhutu taruu j'ara mamuri lamatua dènge tare'a-re'a. dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu unu lamatua ètu èèna asa tabha ae.

source_text: barnabas went out to tarsus to look for saul.
target_text: èle èèna ka, barnabas la'e tenge saulus asa kota tarsus.

source_text: when he had found him, he brought him to antioch. for a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. the disciples were first called christians in antioch.
target_text: lod'o paraga dènge ne, ka na pamako saulus ho lasi pea ètu antiokia. ka dua ra pea ètu nèi ca tèu, pa'èci dènge dhèu unu lamatua sèra. bèli-bèli èèna, rèngu dua ra aj'a-nori j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus mi dhèu ae. ètu kota antiokia ne'e ka, dhèu mulai pangare dhèu parcaya lamatua yesus, ‘dhèu kristen'.

source_text: now in these days, prophets came down from jerusalem to antioch.
target_text: lod'o rèngu dua ra pea ètu antiokia era, pèri-pèri dhèu mai nèti yerusalem. ama lamatua tema le pake dhèu se'e ho rèti lii padhai na.

source_text: one of them named agabus stood up and indicated by the spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of claudius.
target_text: nèti rèngu se, dhèu èci, ngara na agabus. roh lamatua peka dènge ne, aku nèngu na, bèli-camèd'a abhu lod'o manganga-mad'èu lèke palème toke d'ai suu-suu rai-haha. hèia la'e peka hari dènge dhèu-dhèu. lii dhu na padhai na, mema j'aj'i tare'a, lod'o dhèu aae kapai risi ètu roma, ngara na klaudius, nèd'u paredha. ra paroa dhèu aae kapai risi ne, keser.

source_text: as any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in judea;
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare lii agabus ne, dhèu unu lamatua yesus ètu antiokia sèra, rare lii èci ho pa'oru doi, sèna ka ra hia mi a'ari dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, dhu abhu j'aj'èra ètu propensi yudea. èci-èci hia madhutu a'abhu ra.

source_text: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of barnabas and saul.
target_text: ropa ra pa'oru rare, ka ra pua barnabas dènge saulus rèti doi sèra asa dhèu j'èra sèi.

source_text: now about that time, king herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu aae herodes mulai paj'èra dhèu unu lamatua yesus cahag'e.

source_text: he killed james, the brother of john, with the sword.
target_text: nèngu paredha dhèu lasi pare pamadhe yakobis pake samala. yakobis ne, a'a yohanis.

source_text: when he saw that it pleased the jews, he proceeded to seize peter also. this was during the days of unleavened bread.
target_text: ropa herodes ne'a, na, d'ara dhèu kapai yahudi sèra karej'e nèti mamadhe yakobis, ka asa na hino. lèke lod'o hua iia dhèu yahudi dhu ra pangare na, pesta roti dhu pake boe ragi, ka na pua dhèu lasi kèpe petrus.

source_text: when he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the passover.
target_text: kèpe rare ne, ka ra pamaso asa d'ara bèdho. ka ra pua sordad'u èpa kaboko ho j'aga petrus pagati-gati mèu-mèda. ca kaboko sordad'u èèna, dhèu èpa. ladhe èle lod'o hua iia, heka herodes neo pama'ète lii petrus ètu madha dhèu ae.

source_text: peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to god for him.
target_text: lod'o ra pamaso petrus asa d'ara bèdho, dhèu unu lamatua yesus sèra sabaj'a ma'ète boe manèngi ho lamatua ladhe-leru petrus.

source_text: the same night when herod was about to bring him out, peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. guards in front of the door kept the prison.
target_text: bèli èèna, herodes neo pama'ète lii langu petrus ètu madha dhèu ae. te ngaa mèda èèna, ra èki petrus pake rate dua ètu d'ara èmu bèdho. na j'unu ètu talora sordad'u dhèu dua. aa sordad'u leo sèra j'aga ètu hèb'a babèdho.

source_text: and behold, an angel of the lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. he struck peter on the side and woke him up, saying, stand up quickly! his chains fell off his hands.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga, mai titu ètu èèna. ka d'ara kama na saraa bia. hèia ana pajuu èèna parèi petrus, peka na, petrus! kèd'i mèri! kaca'a laa, rate bèsi sèra bhoke eele unu na nèti kacui-aai petrus.

source_text: the angel said to him, get dressed and put on your sandals. he did so. he said to him, put on your cloak and follow me.
target_text: ka ana pajuu èèna pua ne, peka na, pake kodho dènge salapa èu! pake nare, ka ana pajuu èèna peka hari, aku nèngu na, pake kodho li'u èu, ho mai madhutu ja'a!

source_text: and he went out and followed him. he didn't know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.
target_text: hèia petrus madhutu ana pajuu ne lasi asa li'u. petrus ngee, na, nèngu nii di. te ngaa mema j'aj'i tare'a.

source_text: when they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. they went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.
target_text: ropa rèngu seli eele era j'aga partama dènge ka dua, hèia rèngu d'ai hèb'a babèdho bèsi. babèdho èèna bhoke unu na, ka dua ra kalua madhutu ka j'ara asa d'ara kota. cag'ag'a laa, ana pajuu lamatua ne ele, ka tèke eele petrus mesa na ètu era èèna.

source_text: when peter had come to himself, he said, now i truly know that the lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of herod, and from everything the jewish people were expecting.
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ne ele, hèia petrus heka mase'a kèna. ka na ngee, aku nèngu na, mema tare'a! ja'a heka ke'a kèna. lamatua pua ana pajuu na mai, ho patalale eele ja'a nèti kacui-aai herodes. lamatua tao j'ara ne'e, sèna ka kahadhu karehe dhèu yahudi sèra, lèke boe ja'a.

source_text: thinking about that, he came to the house of mary, the mother of john who was called mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.
target_text: èle èèna ka, petrus la'e asa èmu maria. maria ne, ina yohanis. ngara leo yohanis ne, markus. ètu èmu èèna, dhèu ae pakaboko ho sabaj'a manèngi ama lamatua ladhe-leru petrus ètu d'ara lii langu èèna.

source_text: when peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named rhoda came to answer.
target_text: ropa petrus d'ai madha hèb'a oka èmu èèna, ka na paroa dènge d'eu hèb'a oka. ka ana bhèni sab'a èci, ngara na rode, neo ne'a dhèu cee ka dhu mai.

source_text: when she recognized peter's voice, she didn't open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that peter was standing in front of the gate.
target_text: ropa na tadèngi lii petrus, na tadhe dènge. na karej'e bia. ka rai asa d'ara èmu la'e, peka dènge dhèu ètu sèra, aku nèngu na, nanene ku! petrus nuka li'u! te ngaa lula nèngu bingu, ka na bhèlu eele bhoke hèb'a oka hia petrus.

source_text: they said to her, you are crazy! but she insisted that it was so. they said, it is his angel.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu ae sèra dhaa, peka na, aad'o, sina ma! baku paleko! te ngaa bhèni ne peka hari, aku nèngu na, tare'a! èèna lii petrus! nuka li'u nèi. ka dhèu se'e lèka boe, aku rèngu na, ele boe, dhèu nèi ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga, dhu mai madhenge petrus.

source_text: but peter continued knocking. when they had opened, they saw him and were amazed.
target_text: rèngu patule-pajuku taruu, te ngaa petrus loe boe paroa, toke lasi bhoke hèb'a oka hia ne. ropa ra bhoke rare, ka rèngu malaa, lula petrus tare'a-re'a di.

source_text: but he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the lord had brought him out of the prison. he said, tell these things to james and to the brothers. then he departed and went to another place.
target_text: hèia na hia tadha dènge kacui-aai na, sèna ka rèngu mau-mau. ka na lole tasa mera mia ama lamatua kalua eele nèngu nèti d'ara èmu bèdho. hèia na pua si, aku nèngu na, lami lole lii ne'e aa'i-aa'i mi yakobis dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua leo sèra. èle èèna ka, petrus la'e asa era leo.

source_text: now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of peter.
target_text: asa bèli mad'ae aae èèna, ropa sordad'u j'aga sèra ladhe, na, petrus aad'o heka, ka rèngu ele ngangee dènge madha'u titu kèna, lula rèngu re'a boe ngaa dhu j'aj'i mi dedha rèngu.

source_text: when herod had sought for him and didn't find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. he went down from judea to caesarea, and stayed there.
target_text: ropa herodes tadèngi lii ne'e, ka na paredha si lasi tenge petrus. te ngaa rèdhi boe ne. ka herodes hia paredha ho parisa sordad'u j'aga sèra. parisa rare, ka herodes pua pamadhe aa'i sordad'u j'aga sèra. èle èèna ka, herodes pakèd'i nèti propensi yudea, ka la'e pea ètu kota kaisarea.

source_text: now herod was very angry with the people of tyre and sidon. they came with one accord to him and, having made blastus, the king's personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king's country for food.
target_text: lod'o èèna, dhèu-dhèu nèti dua kota, èci ngara na tirus, aa èci ngara na sidon, biasa hèli nganga'a nèti rai dhèu aae herodes. te ngaa nèbhu aae le, dhèu aae musu dènge rèngu. hèia ra padhue ho tenge j'ara padame dènge ne. ka ra pili dhèu canau ho lasi paraga dènge herodes. d'ai kota kaisarea, rèngu pa'angalai dènge dhèu herodes èci, ngara na blastus. nèngu ne, dhèu kapai ètu d'ara èmu dhèu aae. rèngu pare'a dènge blastus ho nèngu bhoke j'ara sèna ka rèngu paraga dènge dhèu aae herodes.

source_text: on an appointed day, herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.
target_text: hèia herodes dhaa kahèi ho sèmi rare rèngu. ka ra pare'a lod'o paraga. lod'o èèna, rèngu tao tatao kapai. herodes pake mèdha-papake dhèu aae, ka na madhèdi ètu kadera paredha na. hèia na padhai lii dènge rèngu.

source_text: the people shouted, the voice of a god, and not of a man!
target_text: ropa rèngu tadèngi lii na, hèia dhèu se'e koa ne, peka na, nanene ku lii na laa! ne'e lii boe nèti dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa lii nèti dhèu dedha-liru!

source_text: immediately an angel of the lord struck him, because he didn't give god the glory. then he was eaten by worms and died.
target_text: kaca'a laa, ana pajuu ama lamatua ca dhèu nèti sorga hia èi-papèd'a èci mi herodes, lula nèngu sèmi lii koa rèngu, aa na seti eele ama lamatua. ka kalati ra'e aa'i ngi'u herodes, ka na madhe aapa.

source_text: but the word of god grew and multiplied.
target_text: dènge j'ara dhu j'aj'i sèra, dhèu palolo lii lolo be'a ama lamatua d'ai asa mia-mia. aa dhèu dhu madhutu j'ara mamuri lamatua yesus tabha ae kahèi.

source_text: barnabas and saul returned to jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them john who was called mark.
target_text: ropa barnabas dènge saulus hia rare doi pa'oru nèti dhèu antiokia mi dhèu yerusalem, ka ra lèpa hari asa antiokia. rèngu gale rèti dènge ana ngèru èci, ngara na yohanis. ngara leo na, markus.

source_text: now in the assembly that was at antioch there were some prophets and teachers: barnabas, simeon who was called niger, lucius of cyrene, manaen the foster brother of herod the tetrarch, and saul.
target_text: ètu kota antiokia, dhèu ae parcaya le lamatua yesus. lamatua pake pèri-pèri dhèu ho j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai na ètu èèna. cahag'e hari, na pake ho aj'a-nori dhèu. rèngu se, nuka: barnabas, simeon, dhu ra biasa pangare ne, ‘mone mèdhi', lukius, nèti kota kirene, menahem, dhu ra piara sama-sama dènge dhèu aae herodes nèti ana iiki ka mai, aa dènge saulus.

source_text: as they served the lord and fasted, the holy spirit said, separate barnabas and saul for me, for the work to which i have called them.
target_text: ca lod'o, rèngu puasa, ka ra pakaboko ho manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua. hèia roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka dènge ra, sasab'a ja'a ae titu kèna. de hag'e mere barnabas dènge saulus, sèna ka rèngu pakako sasab'a ja'a.

source_text: then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.
target_text: ropa ra puasa dènge sabaj'a èle, hèia ra bane ai mi dedha barnabas dènge saulus, ho ra j'aj'i ana pua-paleha lamatua. èle èèna ka, ra pua rèngu dua ra ho lasi sab'a sasab'a-la'a lamatua.

source_text: so, being sent out by the holy spirit, they went down to seleucia. from there they sailed to cyprus. when they were at salamis, they proclaimed god's word in the jewish synagogues. they also had john as their attendant.
target_text: ropa roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci pua barnabas dènge saulus lasi palème rai, ka ra dhuli uru asa kota èci ètu nebhe dhasi, ngara na seleukia. yohanis dhu ngara leo na, markus la'e sama-sama dènge si. d'ai nèi ka, rèngu ca'e kapa asa pulu siprus, ka ra puru ètu kota èci, ngara na salamis. ètu èèna, rèngu biasa maso asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi, ho aj'a-nori lii holo-nori ama lamatua mi dhèu ètu sèra.

source_text: when they had gone through the island to paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a jew whose name was bar jesus, who was with the proconsul, sergius paulus, a man of understanding. this man summoned barnabas and saul, and sought to hear the word of god. but elymas the sorcerer for so is his name by interpretation withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.
target_text: hèia rèngu lasi dhuli rae-rae, toke ra d'ai kota èci ètu suu haa pulu èèna, ngara na pafos. gubernur pea ètu kota èèna. ngara gubernur èèna, sergius paulus. nèngu ne, dhèu kahadhu mèu. ropa na tadèngi barnabas si d'ai d'ara kota, ka na hia dhèu lasi paroa si, te d'ara na neo nanene lii holo-nori lamatua. te ngaa ètu era èèna, abhu dhèu yahudi èci, ngara na bar yesus, ngara leo na ètu d'ara lii yunani, ‘elimas'. nèngu dhèu suagi. na tema le kapod'e-kabèli dhèu, peka na, nèngu ne dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua. aa na pa'angalai dènge gubernur. ka ropa barnabas si mai, na kakèj'i gubernur, sèna ka baku sèmi nare si. aa na dadugu gubernur, sèna ka gubernur baku parcaya yesus.

source_text: but saul, who is also called paul, filled with the holy spirit, fastened his eyes on him
target_text: te ngaa roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci hia koasa mi dedha saulus dhu ra paroa kahèi paulus, ka na ladhe kaloo dhèu suagi ne, hèia na peka,

source_text: and said, you son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the lord?
target_text: eeh, elimas! èu ne, ana nidhu! tuka kapod'e-kabèli! toke d'ai pèri lod'o hari èu kapod'e dhèu? èu lab'a j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. nèti èèna ka, ji'i nge'a, na, èu madhutu dhèu aae nidhu. tao ia ka sèmi èèna! bhabhae ia ka j'ara mola ama lamatua!

source_text: now, behold, the hand of the lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season! immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. he went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.
target_text: de mu nanene! nèbhu heka, lamatua huku èu. èèna na, èu bèdhu pèri-pèri lod'o! ropa paulus padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, dhèu èèna bèdhu dènge. ka na kako kèpe leli, hia dhèu kadhèi ai, ho pakako ne.

source_text: then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the lord.
target_text: ropa gubernur ladhe nèdhi unu na, aa na tadèngi lii holo-nori yesus nèti barnabas si, ka na malaa-maloha, aa na parcaya yesus.

source_text: now paul and his company set sail from paphos and came to perga in pamphylia. john departed from them and returned to jerusalem.
target_text: nèti kota pafos ètu pulu siprus, paulus si ca'e kapa, pakèd'i asa kota perga ètu propensi pamfilia. ropa ra puru nèti dedha kapa, yohanis markus tèke eele rèngu, ka lèpa asa yerusalem.

source_text: but they, passing on from perga, came to antioch of pisidia. they went into the synagogue on the sabbath day and sat down.
target_text: nèti perga, rèngu kako haga lasi asa kota antiokia ètu propensi pisidia. rèngu d'ai era èèna, lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a dhèu yahudi. ka rèngu madhutu sabaj'a ètu èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi.

source_text: after the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ra baca ètu sasuri musa, dènge sasuri dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua dhu leo kahèi. èle èèna ka, ama-ama èmu sabaj'a èèna, manèngi paulus si, peka na, ama-ama! ladhe miu dènge lii haholo ho pa'èra d'ara ji'i, na, ji'i manèngi sèna ka miu peka laa.

source_text: paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, men of israel, and you who fear god, listen.
target_text: hèia paulus kako asa madha la'e. ka na hia tadha dènge kacui-aai na, sèna ka rèngu mau-mau. èle èèna ka, na padhai lii, peka na, a'ari dhèu isra'el ti! dènge ina-ama dhèu leo dhu maso agama yahudi, lula d'ara miu d'èi padètu dènge ama lamatua dhèu isra'el. de ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu nanene paie lii padhai ja'a.

source_text: the god of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.
target_text: ama lamatua hag'e nare le bèi-baki èdhi dhèu isra'el nèti uru ka mai. lod'o rèngu pea ètu rai masir, kabarai dhèu, lamatua hia rèngu mamuri hua iia. ana-èpu rèngu tabha ae ètu era èèna. limuri mai, ka lamatua pake koasa kapai na, ho na kalua eele rèngu nèti rai masir.

source_text: for a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.
target_text: èle èèna ka, rèngu mamuri pidha-pidha ètu d'ara mamoo toke d'ai èpa nguru tèu. masi ka rèngu kètu hadhu, te ngaa lamatua lere si dènge d'ara dhu taleo.

source_text: when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua palaho aa'i pidhu suku ètu rai kana'an. ka na pabagi rai rèngu mi bèi-baki èdhi ho j'aj'i rai pusaka ra.

source_text: after these things, he gave them judges until samuel the prophet.
target_text: bèi-baki èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna toke d'ai èpa ngasu lèmi nguru tèu. ka ama lamatua padhèdi dhèu pama'ète lii langu, sèna ka paj'uj'u j'ara hia si, toke d'ai na padhèdi hia si dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua èci, ngara na samuel.

source_text: afterward they asked for a king, and god gave to them saul the son of kish, a man of the tribe of benjamin, for forty years.
target_text: lod'o samuel j'aj'i dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua, bèi-baki èdhi neo abhu dhèu aae. ka lamatua padhèdi saul, ana kis, nèti suku benyamin. saul j'aj'i dhèu aae d'ai èpa nguru tèu.

source_text: when he had removed him, he raised up david to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘i have found david the son of jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will. '
target_text: èle èèna ka, lamatua gao eele saul. ka na padhèdi daud, ana isai, ho j'aj'i dhèu aae hiu. lamatua ne'a tare'a d'ara daud, ka na peka na, ‘daud, ana isai ne, lèke d'ara ja'a. limuri mai, tatu nèngu mamuri madhutu dad'èi ja'a aa'i-aa'i. '

source_text: from this man's offspring, god has brought salvation to israel according to his promise,
target_text: lod'o èèna, lamatua moa tèke le, ho na hag'e nare ana-èpu daud èci, sèna ka na patabuli eele dhèu isra'el nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. ja'a peka mi miu, ana-èpu daud dhu lamatua moa tèke èèna, nuka yesus.

source_text: before his coming, when john had first preached the baptism of repentance to israel.
target_text: paulus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, lod'o lamatua yesus pakako mèka sab'a na, abhu dhèu èci ngara na yohanis, dhu la'e lole dènge dhèu isra'el, sèna ka rèngu ele-ho'a nèti sasala-sasigo rèngu. na peka kahèi, na, rèngu hud'i sarani ku, ho j'aj'i mi tadha, na, rèngu pabe'a le dènge lamatua.

source_text: as john was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘what do you suppose that i am? i am not he. but behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet i am not worthy to untie. '
target_text: te ngaa lod'o sasab'a yohanis oe èle, na peka mi dhèu ae, aku nèngu na, ‘baku pangee, na, ja'a ne dhèu dhu lamatua moa nèti uru ka mai. ngee paie! miu hud'i mate hari ku dhèu èci, dhu mai limuri. nèngu kapai risi nèti ja'a. ja'a haha d'ai seli. de j'aj'i ana pua-paleha nèngu kahèi, ja'a nia boe. '

source_text: brothers, children of the stock of abraham, and those among you who fear god, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i ti! miu dhu ana-èpu abraham, aa miu dhèu leo, dhu neo padètu dènge lamatua. mi nanene ku ja'a! ama lamatua peka le j'ara ne dènge èdhi, sèna ka èdhi te'a j'ara mamuri na. nèngu patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: for those who dwell in jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn't know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.
target_text: nèti uru ka mai, ama lamatua pake le dhèu rèti lii padhai na, ho suri lula-nèti dhèu dhu lamatua moa neo hia mai. te ama-ama agama èdhi, dènge dhèu leo ètu yerusalem sèra baca pahari-pahari le, ngaa dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua suri tèke sèra. d'ai lod'o a'oro sasab'a, ra maso asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, ho ra baca ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua. te ngaa rèngu re'a boe dhèu dhu lamatua paj'uj'u mema èèna, nuka yesus. ka ra tenge j'ara ho pamadhe ne. te ngaa tatao rèngu sèra kahèi, lèke nuka sèmi dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua sèra suri tèke le.

source_text: though they found no cause for death, they still asked pilate to have him killed.
target_text: ra tenge j'ara, neo pamanahu yesus. te ngaa rèngu abhu boe sasala na. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa rèngu kakèj'i gubernur pilatus ho pamadhe ne.

source_text: when they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.
target_text: ka gubernur sèmi nare lii rèngu, hèia ra paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ngaa tatao rèngu sèra kahèi, lèke sèmi dhu dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua sèra suri tèke le. hèia ra papuru ngi'u aae yesus nèti aj'u palolo-palèbha, ka nedhe rèti tao asa d'ara ro'a.

source_text: but god raised him from the dead,
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua pake koasa na, ka pamamuri hari yesus.

source_text: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from galilee to jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.
target_text: lod'o yesus mamuri hari, na pad'elo iisi na pèri-pèri hari mi dhèu ae. dhèu sèra nuka dhu mai sama-sama dènge ne nèti propensi galilea asa kota yerusalem. rèngu se ka lèpa limuri na, j'aj'i sakasii mi dhèu isra'el.

source_text: we bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers, that god has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up jesus. as it is also written in the second psalm, ‘you are my son. today i have become your father. '
target_text: paulus tuhu hari lii padhai na, peka na, de sèmi ne'e! ji'i dua mi dènge barnabas, mai nèti era kaj'èu ho lole dènge miu, sèna ka miu me'a ngaa dhu lamatua moa mi bèi-baki èdhi sèra, limuri ne j'aj'i aa'i le. lamatua pamamuri hari le yesus nèti mamadhe na. ètu sasuri lii sod'a koa-kio nomer dua, lamatua pake dhèu ho suri lula-nèti yesus, dhèu dhu na moa tèke ho na mai. na suri, peka na: ‘èu ne'e, ana ja'a, doe ne'e, ja'a ded'e èu ho mèd'u paredha. '

source_text: concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘i will give you the holy and sure blessings of david. '
target_text: nèti uru èèna ka, ama lamatua moa le, peka na, nèngu neo pamamuri hari dhèu dhu na moa tèke ho na mai. aa dhèu èèna, madhe heka. nèti èèna ka, lamatua pake le dhèu nèti lii padhai na ho na suri, peka na, ‘nèti uru ka mai, ja'a èki lii padhadha dènge dhèu aae daud, sèna ka ja'a hia ne berkat. de limuri ne, ja'a neo pa'èki dènge èu, lii padhadha èèna kahèi, lula èu ne, ana-èpu daud. '

source_text: therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘you will not allow your holy one to see decay. '
target_text: aa lii sod'a koa-kio leo, peka na, ‘lamatua, èu tèke eele boe ngi'u aae dhèu mola-mèci èu, ho ele iie ètu d'ara ro'a na! '

source_text: for david, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of god, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay. but he whom god raised up saw no decay.
target_text: dhu lèke sèmi ne'e ka: lii sod'a koa-kio ne'e, peka boe dhoka daud di! èdhi te'a sèmi èèna, lula dhèu aae daud tao le j'ara be'a ae hia kabarai na, toke na madhe. ropa na madhe, ka ra padhane ne. ngi'u aae na ele iie le. de èdhi te'a, na, lii sod'a koa-kio èèna, peka boe dhoka daud di, te ngaa dhèu leo kahèi. ladhe èèna na dhèu dhu na paj'uj'u èèna madhe, pe ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. nèti èèna ka, ngi'u aae na ele iie boe ciki sa.

source_text: be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins; and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of moses.
target_text: de a'ari, nanene paie! dhèu èèna, nuka yesus! ladhe èdhi parcaya ne, heka na dui sasala-sasigo èdhi sèra, dhu madhutu iia-iia na, èdhi ka dhu dui. dènge j'ara ne'e, ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo èdhi. te ngaa èdhi te'a le, masi ka èdhi madhutu atora ad'a musa aa'i-aa'i ra, èèna d'ai mèka ho pamola èdhi ètu madha lamatua.

source_text: beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets: ‘behold, you scoffers! wonder and perish, for i work a work in your days, a work which you will in no way believe, if one declares it to you. '
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pangee paie. mage dhoka ngaa dhu dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua peka uru sèra, lèka miu. ra suri le, peka na, ‘tuka lalangu dhèu, mate unu miu! lula ja'a, ama lamatua, tao j'ara-j'ara dhu pamalaa dhèu. te ngaa limuri mai, mate unu miu! èèna na, miu madhe aapa! ja'a tao j'ara èci, te ngaa miu sèmi mere boe. masi ka dhèu pasaraa le, te ngaa miu me'a boe. be'a risi miu ngee paie, sèna ka miu bisa malaa kahèi tatao lamatua! ' de a'ari sèra! pangee paie ngaa dhu ja'a lole ne. baku core eele ngaa dhu miu tadèngi le. miu baku sama sèmi tuka lalangu dhèu. d'ai sange ne'e ka, lii padhai ja'a. makasi!

source_text: so when the jews went out of the synagogue, the gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next sabbath.
target_text: padhai lii nare, hèia paulus dènge barnabas kèd'i titu neo kalua nèti èmu manèngi-mangaj'i èèna. ka dhèu ètu sèra manèngi rèngu lèpa migu mai nèi, ho lole pamèu ngaa dhu ra lole deo na.

source_text: now when the synagogue broke up, many of the jews and of the devout proselytes followed paul and barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of god.
target_text: ropa ra kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i èèna, dhèu ae ètu èèna lasi madhutu paulus dènge barnabas. ka dua ra holo si, peka na, èdhi te'a, na, lamatua d'ara be'a d'ai seli mi dedha èdhi. de miu hud'i madhutu taruu ne.

source_text: the next sabbath, almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of god.
target_text: d'ara migu mai nèi, lèke lod'o a'oro sasab'a dhèu yahudi, dhèu nèti d'ara kota èèna oe mai aa'i ho ra neo nanene lii holo-nori lamatua.

source_text: but when the jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by paul, and blasphemed.
target_text: te ngaa ropa ama-ama dhèu yahudi re'a, na, dhèu ae mai nanene lii padhai lii paulus si, ka rèngu tèka d'ara. hèia ropa paulus padhai lii, rèngu pahaka-palab'a dènge padhai lii pamanahu ne.

source_text: paul and barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, it was necessary that god's word should be spoken to you first. since indeed you thrust it from yourselves, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the gentiles.
target_text: te ngaa paulus si hari boe, aa ra padhai lii pa'abhe heka, peka na, mema tare'a ama lamatua bhoke uru j'ara hia èdhi dhèu yahudi, aa na pangèd'u èdhi lii lolo be'a. èèna na lèke! te ngaa miu sèmi mere boe. nèti èèna ka, miu nia boe abhu mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua. de limuri ne, ji'i neo ngèti lii lolo be'a ne asa dhèu rai-rai leo sèra, lula miu dhèu yahudi tule eele ne.

source_text: for so has the lord commanded us, saying, ‘i have set you as a light for the gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth. '
target_text: te lamatua pua le ji'i, sama sèmi dhu yesaya suri tèke, peka na, ‘ja'a ded'e le miu ho j'aj'i sama sèmi labhu, ho mèti saraa mi dedha dhèu rai-rai leo sèra, dhu dhèu yahudi boe, sena ka miu tao paheo j'ara dhu mai asa ja'a, ho ja'a patalale si nèti koasa sasala-sasigo rèngu. de miu hud'i pad'elo j'ara èèna ètu rai-haha ne, nèti suu èci toke d'ai suu leo la'e! '

source_text: as the gentiles heard this, they were glad and glorified the word of god. as many as were appointed to eternal life believed.
target_text: ropa dhèu leo dhu dhèu yahudi boe sèra tadèngi lii ne'e, rèngu karej'e titu kèna. hèia ra koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, koa-kio kolongara lamatua! lii holo-nori lamatua be'a d'ai seli! aa ètu èèna, abhu dhèu dhu ama lamatua pili nare le ho ra mamuri taruu dènge ne. ka ra parcaya aa'i-aa'i ra mi lamatua yesus.

source_text: the lord's word was spread abroad throughout all the region.
target_text: ka dhèu palolo lème lii holo-nori ama lamatua ne asa rai aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: but the jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against paul and barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.
target_text: ètu d'ara kota èèna, abhu dhèu kapai, bhèni-mone. cahag'e d'èi padètu lamatua. te ngaa ama-ama dhèu yahudi sèra mai dadugu-rariu dhèu kapai sèra. hèia rèngu babège eele paulus dènge barnabas nèti rai rèngu.

source_text: but they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to iconium.
target_text: lod'o dua ra kalua nèti d'ara kota èèna, ka ra caro eele ahu nèti haga ra, ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, dhèu-dhèu ètu d'ara kota èèna ro'o boe nanene rèngu dua ra. èle èèna ka, dua ra kabèli kabodho ho tèke eele kota èèna, lasi asa kota ikonium.

source_text: the disciples were filled with joy and with the holy spirit.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu parcaya lamatua yesus ètu kota antiokia sèra, d'ara ra karej'e, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci pa'èra d'ara rèngu.

source_text: in iconium, they entered together into the synagogue of the jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of jews and of greeks believed.
target_text: lod'o paulus dènge barnabas d'ai kota ikonium, ka lasi asa d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i dhèu yahudi. ètu èèna, dua ra lole aa'i mèu-mèu lii holo-nori ama lamatua. ka dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu rai leo, ae ka dhu parcaya lamatua yesus.

source_text: but the disbelieving jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the gentiles against the brothers.
target_text: te ngaa ètu èèna, abhu kahèi pèri-pèri dhèu yahudi dhu kèpe pa'èra atora agama rèngu. ka rèngu sèmi rare boe lii padhai lii paulus si. rèngu kakèj'i dhèu leo, sèna ka ra d'èi boe dènge dhèu dhu parcaya yesus sèra.

source_text: therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
target_text: te ngaa paulus si madha'u boe. dua ra peka-padhai taruu lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus, mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra. ra peka, aku rèngu na, lamatua yesus sue dhèu aa'i-aa'i. lamatua hia paulus si koasa kahèi, ho ra tao tadha-tadha malaa, sèna ka dhèu ae re'a lamatua ka dhu pua rèngu. lod'o èèna, paulus si pea nèbhu ètu d'ara kota èèna.

source_text: but the multitude of the city was divided. part sided with the jews and part with the apostles.
