target_text: èdhi hud'i mamuri mola ku, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa rèdhi, na, èdhi dhu tao j'ara be'a. be'a boe ladhe èdhi mamuri dhoka ètu d'ara tao pesta, dènge tinu mahu di. be'a boe ladhe èdhi tao j'ara makae. be'a boe ladhe bau lii langu g'ana-kariu. aa be'a boe ladhe èdhi tèka d'ara, lula èdhi d'èi boe dhèu risi èdhi.

source_text: but put on the lord jesus christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.
target_text: te ngaa dhu be'a risi ka, miu ub'a d'ara miu, ho j'aj'i sama sèmi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, dhu lamatua pua mai. aa ladhe èu neo ad'u-ue j'ara dhu lèke boe, na, taha d'ara mu! mage soro tèke ho madhutu dad'èi mu dhu lèke boe j'ara.

source_text: now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.
target_text: abhu dhu parcaya lamatua, te ngaa parcaya na èra mèka, aa j'ara ae ka dhu ne'a mèka. pakabhèle ai èu ho sèmi more ne dènge d'ara kateme. baku sisu ngaa dhu na peka-padhai. hud'i laa nèngu pa'angalai dènge miu.

source_text: one man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.
target_text: abhu dhu parcaya lamatua, dhu pangee na, dhèu sarani bisa ra'a ngaa sa, nuka sèmi sisi, do ngaa èèna ka. te ngaa abhu dhèu sarani leo, dhu parcaya ra èra mèka, dhu ra'a dhoka sayur di. te ra luri sisi.

source_text: don't let him who eats despise him who doesn't eat. don't let him who doesn't eat judge him who eats, for god has accepted him.
target_text: te ngaa nanene, ee! dhèu sarani dhu bisa ra'a ngaa èèna ka, baku pahahe dhèu dhu neo boe ra'a sisi. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu sarani dhu neo boe ra'a sisi, baku peka dènge dhèu dhu bisa ra'a sisi, na, weh! mu'a sisi, sala! lula ama lamatua sèmi nare le dua ra ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na!

source_text: who are you who judge another's servant? to his own lord he stands or falls. yes, he will be made to stand, for god has power to make him stand.
target_text: ladhe èu me'a dhoka karitik a'ari mu dhèu parcaya sèra, te èu ngee na, èu ne cee? èu dènge hak ngaa, ho pèci sasala mi dhèu leo? dhèu ne ènu èu boe, si! aa èu ne, lamatua boe nèngu, si. te dhodhoka lamatua nèngu di dhu unu hak, sèna ka peka paled'a, tatao na èèna lèke, do sala. te ngaa baku bhèlu, bèli-camèd'a lamatua na sèmi nare dhèu ne'e dènge be'a, lula lamatua na bisa pa'èra ne, sèna ka na bisa titu èra.

source_text: one man esteems one day as more important. another esteems every day alike. let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
target_text: abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu pama'ète rare, peka na, lod'o èci be'a risi nèti lod'o leo. abhu kahèi cahag'e dhu peka na, lod'o aa'i-aa'i ra èci èèna ka, lod'o èci sa risi boe nèti lod'o leo. dhèu èci-èci ka pama'ète unu na j'ara ne'e.

source_text: he who observes the day, observes it to the lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the lord he does not observe it. he who eats, eats to the lord, for he gives god thanks. he who doesn't eat, to the lord he doesn't eat, and gives god thanks.
target_text: ladhe dhèu pangee, na, abhu lod'o dhu be'a risi nèti lod'o leo, nèngu tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka pakab'ua kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. dhèu dhu na'a sisi dènge nganga'a dhu leo, bisa na'a ho pakab'ua kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, lula na manèngi makasi mi lamatua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu na'a boe sisi. nèngu neo pakab'ua kahèi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, aa nèngu manèngi makasi mi lamatua kahèi.

source_text: for none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.
target_text: lod'o èdhi mamuri, èdhi mamuri boe dhoka hia ngi'u èdhi mesa ti. aa ladhe èdhi madhe, madhe boe dhoka pala ngi'u mesa ti.

source_text: for if we live, we live to the lord. or if we die, we die to the lord. if therefore we live or die, we are the lord's.
target_text: te ladhe èdhi mamuri era, èdhi pa'èki dènge lamatua èdhi. sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe èdhi madhe, èdhi pa'èki era dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. de masi ka èdhi mamuri, do madhe, èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu na era.

source_text: for to this end christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be lord of both the dead and the living.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, kristus madhe, hèia mamuri hari. na tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka na bisa j'aj'i kètu bagi mi dhèu dhu madhe le, dènge dhèu dhu mamuri era kahèi.

source_text: but you, why do you judge your brother? or you again, why do you despise your brother? for we will all stand before the judgment seat of christ.
target_text: de, nga tao ka èu ded'e iisi mu, tao sèmi dhèu pama'ète lii langu, ho karitik leli lii padhai a'ari mu dhèu sarani? nga tao ka èu pahahe ne? te bèli-camèd'a èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti hud'i lati asa madha ama lamatua, ho na parisa mamuri èdhi èci-èci.

source_text: for it is written, ‘as i live, ' says the lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. every tongue will confess to god. '
target_text: abhu dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua, dhu peka na, ama èdhi mesa na dhu peka, na, ‘dhèu aa'i-aa'i pe patitu kètu urutuu, ho pahaha iisi mi ja'a, dènge pakab'ua ja'a. bèli-camèd'a, nèti d'ara hèb'a dhèu èci-èci, ra mangaku, na, ja'a j'aj'i kètu rèngu, lula ja'a ne, ama lamatua. '

source_text: so then each one of us will give account of himself to god.
target_text: de èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, bèli-camèd'a hud'i dhaa ètu madha lamatua, ho peka na, èdhi tao tasamia, aa nga tao ka èdhi tao sèmi èèna.

source_text: therefore let's not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother's way, or an occasion for falling.
target_text: uru èèna, miu ètu roma pèci sasala taruu mi a'ari miu dhèu sarani sèra. tao ia ka sèmi èèna! be'a risi èdhi pama'ète sèmi ne'e: èdhi baku tao sèna ka a'ari èdhi kadhunu. èdhi baku tenge j'ara ho sii pamanahu si, sèna ka ra tao sasala.

source_text: i know and am persuaded in the lord jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
target_text: lula ja'a dhu pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, ja'a ke'a mèu, sèmi ne'e: abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu bisa pakaj'alu dhèu, toke na bisa boe sabaj'a mi lamatua. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu èci dhu pangee, na, mèdha èci tao ne kaj'alu, toke nèngu ngee na, bisa heka dènge hak sèna ka sabaj'a, na, hud'i laa mèdha ne j'aj'i mèdha luri hia nèngu.

source_text: yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. don't destroy with your food him for whom christ died.
target_text: conto sèmi èu mu'a sisi, aa papèd'a d'ara a'ari mu, na, èu pad'elo boe sasue èu mi nèngu, si? ladhe sèmi èèna, baku mu'a! baku pa'ele iie a'ari mu, lula èu neo mu'a nganga'a èci! te kristus madhe pala mi dhèu ne'e kahèi.

source_text: then don't let your good be slandered,
target_text: be'a boe ladhe èu ad'u-ue j'ara èci dhu madhutu a'abhu èu, be'a, te ngaa dhèu leo padhai kakoli kolongara èu, lula ra pangee na, tatao èu deo na, karehe.

source_text: for god's kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the holy spirit.
target_text: ngee paie-iie! te ama lamatua ka, dhèu aae èdhi. te ngaa èdhi j'aj'i boe dhèu unu nèti dhèu aae, lula èdhi ta'a-tinu madhutu dhoka atora di. aad'o! ladhe èdhi neo j'aj'i dhèu unu nèti dhèu aae, èdhi hud'i tao dhu lèke, d'ara mola-mèci, mamuri mola dènge mera-milu, aa d'ara dhu karej'e-karae. aa'i-aa'i se bisa j'aj'i, ladhe èdhi pa'èki taruu dènge roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: for he who serves christ in these things is acceptable to god and approved by men.
target_text: dhèu dhu lalau-lalo'o hia kristus sèmi èèna, pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua. aa dhèu leo lee kahèi mamuri dhèu ne'e, hèia padedha kolongara dhèu ne'e, peka na, nèngu ne, be'a!

source_text: so then, let's follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
target_text: de èdhi hud'i pa'èra ètu d'ara mamuri padame, aa maj'èni pa'èra èci dènge èci.

source_text: don't overthrow god's work for food's sake. all things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.
target_text: baku pa'ele iie sasab'a lamatua ètu d'ara mamuri dhèu leo, lula dhoka nèti j'ara ta'a-tinu di. lamatua dhu peka le, èdhi bisa ta'a ngaa èèna ka, te aa'i-aa'i dhu mola-mèci. te ngaa ladhe èu patao-palaha dènge a'ari mu lula j'ara nganga'a-nganginu di, èu sala le. baku sèmi èèna!

source_text: it is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.
target_text: hua iia taha iisi mu. mu'a ia ka sisi, do minu ia ka èi anggor, do baku mu'a-minu ngaa dhu leo, dhu tao a'ari mu kadhunu.

source_text: do you have faith? have it to yourself before god. happy is he who doesn't judge himself in that which he approves.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe èu more lii èci dènge lamatua, hèia èu pama'ète, na, èu neo parcaya ne lula-nèti nganga'a-nganginu, na, èu oto aa dènge heka lii langu. pangee ia ka ngaa-ngaa dhu peka na, èu tao sala, do aad'o. te èu dhu pama'ète more le sèmi èèna.

source_text: but he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn't of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe d'ara èu kajari, ka mu'a mèdha èci dhu èu ngee na pakaj'alu èu, lamatua pasala èu, lula èu madhutu boe ngaa dhu èu parcaya lod'o dhu èu mu'a. te ladhe èu neo ad'u-ue ngaa sa èci, te ngaa èu parcaya, peka na, èèna lèke boe ètu madha lamatua, na, èèna èu sala le.

source_text: now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
target_text: èdhi dhu parcaya èra, hud'i dènge d'ara maho'o ho bara dhèu dhu parcaya èra mèka, sèna ka rèngu taha ètu d'ara sasusa. be'a boe, ladhe èdhi dhoka pakarej'e ngi'u èdhi mesa ti.

source_text: let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.
target_text: madhutu a'abhu ja'a hud'i sèmi ne'e ku: èdhi èci-èci ka tenge j'ara, sèna ka tao dhu be'a hia a'ari èdhi dhèu sarani, ho parcaya ra asa tabha èra. dènge j'ara ne'e, rèngu bisa karej'e dènge èdhi.

source_text: for even christ didn't please himself. but, as it is written, the reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.
target_text: te yesus kristus mesa na, pakako boe sasab'a na ho pakarej'e d'ara nèngu unu na, te ngaa na neo pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua kahèi. èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua lula-nèti ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i mi dedha yesus, dhu peka na, lii pa-aape rèngu hia mi èu, noto mi dedha ja'a kahèi.

source_text: for whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the scriptures we might have hope.
target_text: aa'i-aa'i dhu uru èèna dhèu suri ètu d'ara sasuri lamatua, sèna ka nori èdhi. nèngu pad'elo j'ara sèna ka asa pa'èra èdhi, taha pa'èra-èra, aa lii holo-nori na pa'èra d'ara èdhi kahèi. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna ka, èdhi bisa taha ètu d'ara tatae neo tèdhi lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi.

source_text: now the god of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to christ jesus,
target_text: lamatua ka dhu hia dhèu a'èra, sèna ka ra bisa taha ètu d'ara j'aj'èra. aa nèngu ka dhu pa'èra d'ara èdhi kahèi. ja'a sabaj'a, manèngi lamatua pad'elo j'ara, ho miu mamuri d'ara èci madhutu dad'èi yesus kristus.

source_text: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the god and father of our lord jesus christ.
target_text: te ladhe miu mamuri d'ara èci, miu bisa sama-sama koa-kio ama lamatua. nèngu èèna, ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: therefore accept one another, even as christ also accepted you, to the glory of god.
target_text: de miu isi-aanga mi hud'i sèmi mere èci dènge èci, sama sèmi kristus sèmi nare le miu. te ladhe miu mamuri sèmi èèna, pe dhèu ae j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua.

source_text: now i say that christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of god, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,
target_text: ja'a peka sèmi ne'e: kristus tao iisi na nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha, sèna ka hia dhèu yahudi re'a mèu, peka na, ama lamatua padhai lii lèke mola-mola. aa kristus tao iisi na nuka sèmi ana pua-paleha kahèi, ho pamèci aa'i mèu ngaa-ngaa dhu lamatua padhadha neo tao, hia mi bèi-baki èdhi sèra.

source_text: and that the gentiles might glorify god for his mercy. as it is written, therefore i will give praise to you among the gentiles and sing to your name.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, dhèu yahudi boe aa'i-aa'i koa-kio ama lamatua. te rèngu re'a, na, nèngu dhu rasa kasia mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. sèra nuka sèmi dhu daud suri uru èèna ètu sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara èu, mi suku dhu leo sèra. ja'a neo sod'a lii koa-kio kolongara èu ètu katanga madha udhu rasa dhu leo sèra.

source_text: again he says, rejoice, you gentiles, with his people.
target_text: ètu era leo, d'ara sasuri mola-mèci suri kahèi, na, we! miu dhèu leo rai kara dhu nèti rai leo. tao d'ara miu karej'e kea rae-rae, palere-lere dènge dhèu unu lamatua sèra.

source_text: again, praise the lord, all you gentiles! let all the peoples praise him.
target_text: ètu era leo, d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, daud suri, peka na, miu dhu nèti suku leo sèra. lami peka palème mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti dadedha lamatua, sèna ka rèngu koa-kio kètu èdhi, yesus kristus kahèi.

source_text: again, isaiah says, there will be the root of jesse, he who arises to rule over the gentiles; in him the gentiles will hope.
target_text: ètu era leo hari, d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, yesaya suri, peka na, nèti dhèu aae daud, ana isai, bèli-camèd'a cèu mai ana-èpu na ca dhèu. nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha mi suku leo sèra. rèngu dhu re'a le, naneo mamai nèngu èèna. hèia rèngu mate tatae ne, te rèngu re'a mèu, na, nèngu ne, cee.

source_text: now may the god of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the holy spirit.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i mi kapua nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi sanao-maena. ladhe miu parcaya ne, nèngu ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara miu aa pamau d'ara miu. hud'i laa sèna ka koasa nèti roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci, tao miu asa me'a mèu lula-nèti ngaa dhu nèngu neo tao.

source_text: i myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a ke'a tare'a, na, d'ara miu pènu dènge madha j'ara-madha j'ara dhu be'a, j'ara ae-ae dhu miu me'a mèu le, aa me'a holo èci dènge èci.

source_text: but i write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by god,
target_text: ja'a suri paled'a-led'a ètu d'ara sasuri ne'e, ho pasanèd'e miu catèka hari nèti rupa-rupa madha j'ara. ja'a suri sèmi ne'e, lula lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a,

source_text: that i should be a servant of christ jesus to the gentiles, serving as a priest of the good news of god, that the offering up of the gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the holy spirit.
target_text: ropa na ded'e ja'a j'aj'i mi dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus, ho laku peka-padhai lii lolo be'a nèngu asa dhèu yahudi boe sèra. ja'a pakako sasab'a ja'a èèna, nuka sèmi ama agama èci dhu neo pa'èra dhèu ae-ae dhu j'aj'i mi persembahan èci dhu pamaho'o d'ara lamatua. te roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci ka dhu tao si j'aj'i mola-mèci, sèna ka ama lamatua sèmi nare si.

source_text: i have therefore my boasting in christ jesus in things pertaining to god.
target_text: lula ja'a dhu pa'èki le dènge yesus kristus, nèti èèna ka ja'a bisa boti kètu ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: for i will not dare to speak of any things except those which christ worked through me for the obedience of the gentiles, by word and deed,
target_text: ja'a bani boe padhai lii j'ara leo. ja'a dhoka lole tatao dhu kristus ad'u-ue, aa dènge j'ara sèmi ngaa na pake ja'a. limuri ne, abhu dhèu yahudi boe dhu madhutu kristus, lula lamatua pake ja'a ho pad'elo j'ara pake lii padhai dènge tatao ja'a.

source_text: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of god's spirit; so that from jerusalem and around as far as to illyricum, i have fully preached the good news of christ;
target_text: kristus pangèd'u le mi ja'a koasa nèti roh lamatua, sèna ka bisa tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa. na pangèd'u koasa èèna mi ja'a, sèna ka neo pad'elo, peka na, kristus ne cee. dènge j'ara ne'e, ja'a peka-padhai le aa'i-aa'i lula-nèti lii lolo be'a kristus dènge dhèu ètu mia-mia. nèti èèna ka, ja'a lole nèti kota yerusalem, pale-lème toke d'ai rai ilirikum dètu dènge italia.

source_text: yes, making it my aim to preach the good news, not where christ was already named, that i might not build on another's foundation.
target_text: karèi nèti uru ka, ja'a dhu pangee, na, ja'a d'èi titu kèna lole lula-nèti kristus mi dhèu-dhèu dhu tadèngi rèdhi mèka lii lolo be'a na! te ja'a d'èi boe aj'a-nori ètu era dhu dhèu leo aj'a le.

source_text: but, as it is written, they will see, to whom no news of him came. they who haven't heard will understand.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, dhu suri, peka na, suku dhu tadèngi rèdhi mèka lula lamatua, rèngu sèra ka dhu bèli-camèd'a ladhe rèdhi ne. dhèu dhu tadèngi rèdhi mèka ngaa-ngaa, rèngu sèra ka dhu pe re'a mèu lula nèngu.

source_text: therefore also i was hindered these many times from coming to you,
target_text: lula sasab'a ja'a ae sèmi èèna, ka lake kore mèka dhiu pa'asu-pareo dènge miu.

source_text: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, sasab'a ja'a ètu ne'e èla aa'i le. aa ja'a nelu nèbhu ae le pèri-pèri tèu kèna, dhiu paraga dènge miu.

source_text: whenever i travel to spain, i will come to you. for i hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first i may enjoy your company for a while.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a laku asa spanyol, ja'a neo dhuli miu. aa ladhe ja'a dhuli taha ètu era miu, miu bisa ogo ja'a kahèi laku asa spanyol.

source_text: but now, i say, i am going to jerusalem, serving the saints.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne ja'a neo laku uru asa yerusalem, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu parcaya lamatua ètu nèi.

source_text: for it has been the good pleasure of macedonia and achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at jerusalem.
target_text: te a'ari èdhi ètu propensi makedonia dènge propensi akaya, hia le doi kolete, sèna ka soru-bara dhèu dhu dènge boe ngaa-ngaa dhu parcaya lamatua ètu yerusalem.

source_text: yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. for if the gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.
target_text: rèngu neo tao sèmi ne'e, lula ra pangee, na, rèngu oe sèmi pakèlu sa, mi a'ari èdhi ètu yerusalem. te dhèu-dhèu nèti suku leo ètu mia-mia, rèngu abhu le j'ara hua iia kahèi dhu uru èèna roh lamatua hia le mi dhèu yahudi sèra. de lèke mola-mola ladhe dhèu sarani dhu dhèu yahudi boe, pake mèdha-panyau ra ho soru-bara a'ari ra dhèu yahudi sèra.

source_text: when therefore i have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, i will go on by way of you to spain.
target_text: de ladhe ja'a pabagi kore ka doi se'e mi a'ari èdhi ètu yerusalem, ja'a neo dhuli pangad'o dènge miu, ropa laku asa spanyol.

source_text: i know that when i come to you, i will come in the fullness of the blessing of the good news of christ.
target_text: ladhe ja'a dhiu, kèti dènge mèngi-nale ae-ae nèti kristus.

source_text: now i beg you, brothers, by our lord jesus christ and by the love of the spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to god for me,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! lula yesus kristus j'aj'i kètu miu, aa lula roh lamatua ka tao miu pasue èci dènge èci, nèti èèna ka ja'a manèngi ho miu sabaj'a patare'a-re'a, sèna ka lamatua soru-bara ja'a.

source_text: that i may be delivered from those who are disobedient in judea, and that my service which i have for jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,
target_text: manèngi sèna ka lamatua bhiri-sarobho ja'a ètu propensi yudea, ho dhèu dhu ro'o boe parcaya lamatua baku tao bhelu mi dedha ja'a. aa manèngi ho ladhe ja'a lalau-lalo'o dhèu sarani ètu yerusalem, rèngu sèmi rare ja'a dènge be'a.

source_text: that i may come to you in joy through the will of god, and together with you, find rest.
target_text: èle èèna, ladhe madhutu dad'èi lamatua, ja'a bisa dhiu asa miu dènge d'ara karej'e, lula ja'a neo ae kore ciki dènge miu.

source_text: now the god of peace be with you all. amen.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka lamatua bera-bera dènge miu. te nèngu ka dhu bisa tao ho dhèu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. lèke tare'a!

source_text: i commend to you phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at cenchreae,
target_text: dènge sasuri ne'e, ja'a neo patadha miu dènge ana hèni èdhi febe, aa manèngi ho miu sèmi mere ne. nèngu ka dhu ra ded'e ho ladhe-leru juma'at ètu kota kengkrea.

source_text: that you receive her in the lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho miu sèmi mere ne dènge be'a. tao dhu pantas mi nèngu, nuka sèmi hia dhèu sarani sèra, lula nèngu ne pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ladhe na parluu ngaa, soru-bara ne. te nèngu biasa soru-bara le ja'a dènge dhèu ae-ae, karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: greet prisca and aquila, my fellow workers in christ jesus,
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ana hèni èdhi, priskila dènge dhèu èmu na, akila. ji'i ka dhu sama-sama pakako sasab'a ae-ae nèti yesus kristus.

source_text: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only i give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the gentiles.
target_text: dua ra oe madhe sad'i neo pamamuri ja'a. te ngaa mesa boe ja'a di dhu manèngi makasi mi dua ra. te dhèu yahudi boe dhu j'aj'i le dhèu sarani, nèti juma'at aa'i-aa'i buli mia-mia, manèngi makasi kahèi, lula tatao ra dhu be'a.

source_text: greet the assembly that is in their house. greet epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of achaia to christ.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakaboko ho manèngi-mangaj'i ètu d'ara èmu priskila dènge akila. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi angalai ja'a, epenetus. nèngu ka, dhèu uru tèka parcaya kristus ètu propensi asia.

source_text: greet mary, who labored much for us.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ana hèni èdhi, maria. nèngu dhu sab'a ne'a boe j'èra ètu talora aae miu.

source_text: greet andronicus and junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in christ before me.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi andronikus dènge ana hèni èdhi, yunia. dua ra dhèu yahudi, sama sèmi ja'a kahèi. dua ra parcaya uuru kristus nèti ja'a. uru èèna, rèngu sama-sama dènge ja'a ètu d'ara bèdho. dua ra j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua, aa dhèu ae tadhe si.

source_text: greet amplias, my beloved in the lord.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi ampliatus. ja'a sue ne, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: greet urbanus, our fellow worker in christ, and stachys, my beloved.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi urbanus. nèngu kahèi pakako sasab'a kristus sama-sama dènge èdhi. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi stakis, dhu ja'a sue.

source_text: greet apelles, the approved in christ. greet those who are of the household of aristobulus.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi apeles. masi ka nèngu lèke dadugu-rariu, te ngaa na segi ka nare li'u, lula lèka èra kristus. hia lii maho'o mi a'ari aa'i-aa'i nèti aristobulus.

source_text: greet herodion, my kinsman. greet them of the household of narcissus, who are in the lord.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi a'a herodion. nèngu dhèu yahudi kahèi, sama sèmi ja'a. hia lii maho'o ja'a mi isi èmu narkisus dhu parcaya kristus.

source_text: greet tryphaena and tryphosa, who labor in the lord. greet persis, the beloved, who labored much in the lord.
target_text: hia lii maho'o mi ana hèni èdhi, trifena dènge trifosa. rèngu pakako kahèi sasab'a nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. hia lii maho'o mi angalai ja'a, ana hèni èdhi, persis. te nèngu kahèi sab'a bia hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: greet rufus, the chosen in the lord, and his mother and mine.
target_text: hia lii maho'o mi rufus. kètu èdhi, yesus kristus ka dhu hag'e nare ne. hia lii maho'o mi ina na kahèi. te nèngu ne, nuka sèmi ina d'èlu ja'a.

source_text: greet asyncritus, phlegon, hermes, patrobas, hermas, and the brothers who are with them.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi asinkritus, flegon, hermes, patrobas, hermas dènge a'ari aa'i-aa'i dhu pea dènge rèngu.

source_text: greet philologus and julia, nereus and his sister, and olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
target_text: hia lii maho'o ja'a mi filologus, ana hèni èdhi, yulia, olimpas, nereus dènge ana hèni na, dènge dhèu-dhèu sarani aa'i dhu sama-sama dènge rèngu.

source_text: greet one another with a holy kiss. the assemblies of christ greet you.
target_text: ladhe miu pakaboko, na, mi pa'uu èci dènge èci, dhu pantas mi dhèu parcaya. juma'at kristus aa'i-aa'i ètu se'e, hia lii maho'o mi miu kahèi.

source_text: now i beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a manèngi sèna ka miu mage-mage! j'aga paie-iie, te abhu dhèu dhu tao miu mae-manyèla, aa dhu neo sii pabèbhe miu. ngaa dhu rèngu peka dènge miu sèra, palab'a dènge ngaa dhu ji'i aj'a-nori le miu. de baku pa'angalai dènge dhèu sèmi sèra!

source_text: for those who are such don't serve our lord jesus christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.
target_text: dhèu sèra sab'a boe hia kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. rèngu sèra dhoka sab'a ho pa'oto ngi'u rèngu unu ra. dhèu sèra dhoka hèb'a mènyi mi dhèu dhu dhae re'a mèka mia ka dhu be'a, aa mia ka dhu karehe. rèngu hèb'a mènyi ho kapod'e-kabèli dhèu.

source_text: for your obedience has become known to all. i rejoice therefore over you. but i desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu tadèngi le, na, miu loe boe madhutu dad'èi lamatua. nèti èèna ka d'ara ja'a karej'e titu kèna lula miu. dad'èi ja'a ka, ladhe miu d'èlu-mèu ètu j'ara-j'ara be'a, aa baku pakihu kee dènge j'ara-j'ara karehe.

source_text: and the god of peace will quickly crush satan under your feet. the grace of our lord jesus christ be with you.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu bisa hia èdhi mamuri dame dènge mera-milu. nèngu ka dhu èèna na palaho koasa nèti dhèu aae nidhu, aa pad'elo, peka na, miu ka dhu segi. se'e se nèbhu heka j'aj'i. ja'a sabaj'a, manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu.

source_text: timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do lucius, jason, and sosipater, my relatives.
target_text: ari èdhi, timotius, dhu sab'a sama-sama dènge ja'a, hia lii maho'o mi miu kahèi. lukius, yason, dènge sosipater, hia lii maho'o kahèi. rèngu se dhèu yahudi, èci èèna ka dènge ja'a.

source_text: i, tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the lord.
target_text: ja'a ne, tertius, ka dhu suri sasuri ne'e madhutu ngaa dhu paulus pua ja'a suri. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, te ja'a ne dhèu unu kètu èdhi, yesus kristus kahèi.

source_text: gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does quartus, the brother.
target_text: ja'a, paulus, manubha ètu èmu gayus. dhèu sarani aa'i-aa'i tema pakaboko ètu èmu na ho manèngi-mangaj'i. nèngu hia lii maho'o kahèi. erastus, dhu j'aj'i bendahara kota, dènge a'ari èdhi kuartus, hia miu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: the grace of our lord jesus christ be with you all! amen.
target_text: ja'a manèngi, sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi! lèke tare'a!

source_text: paul, called to be an apostle of jesus christ through the will of god, and our brother sosthenes,
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus. ama lamatua hag'e nare le ja'a, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha yesus kristus. sostenes hia miu lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: to the assembly of god which is at corinth-those who are sanctified in christ jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our lord jesus christ in every place, both theirs and ours:
target_text: ja'a suri sasuri ne hia miu dhèu parcaya ama lamatua ètu kota korintus. na hag'e nare le miu ho j'aj'i dhèu mola-mèci nèngu, lula miu parcaya le yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua pajaji mema le karèi nèti uru ka ho na mai. ama lamatua tao miu mola-mèci kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu parcaya aa'i-aa'i ètu mia-mia. te rèngu manèngi le sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus soru-bara si. nèngu ne j'aj'i kètu mi dedha èdhi aa rèngu kahèi.

source_text: grace to you and peace from god our father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama èdhi, ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, ho miu mamuri dame dènge mera-milu.

source_text: i always thank my god concerning you for the grace of god which was given you in christ jesus,
target_text: lod'o-lod'o ja'a ngee kèdhi miu, ja'a padhai lii dènge lamatua ja'a, peka na, makasi ae-ae lula parcaya dhèu korintus sèra! te lamatua dhu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi miu, lula miu lèka taruu yesus kristus, dhu lamatua pua na mai.

source_text: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge-
target_text: hèia na hia miu a'èra, ka miu bisa pakako sasab'a-la'a aa'i-aa'i, lula miu pa'èki dènge ne. èèna ka dhu tao d'ara miu kaja-su'i dènge j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a. nèti èèna ka miu me'a mèu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu hua iia risi, lula-nèti j'ara mamuri nèngu. miu me'a kahèi j'ara mia dhu be'a risi, ladhe miu lole mi dhèu lula-nèti yesus kristus.

source_text: even as the testimony of christ was confirmed in you-
target_text: j'ara aa'i-aa'i ne'e ka dhu padelo, na, j'ara-j'ara dhu ji'i peka le dènge miu lula-nèti kristus èèna, dhu amo le ètu d'ara miu. nèti èèna ka, miu me'a tare'a-re'a, na, j'ara sèra lèke.

source_text: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our lord jesus christ,
target_text: de miu abhu le j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a, dhu roh lamatua pala-bagi hia dhèu unu na. kura boe ciki sa. hèia miu tatae lod'o dhu bèli-camèd'a lamatua bhoke ho pad'elo kètu èdhi, yesus kristus mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our lord jesus christ.
target_text: kristus èèna ka dhu neo pa'èra miu sèna ka miu taha taruu, toke na mai hari asa rai-haha ne. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu manahu boe, aa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pèci sasala mi dedha miu.

source_text: god is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his son, jesus christ our lord.
target_text: èdhi bisa parcaya lii holo-nori ama lamatua, lula ngaa dhu nèngu peka, èèna ka dhu j'aj'i. tatu nèngu neo tao j'ara se aa'i-aa'i hia miu. te nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa tadhe ana na, nuka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus èèna.

source_text: now i beg you, brothers, through the name of our lord, jesus christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.
target_text: a'ari dhu pasue! ètu d'ara aa'i-aa'i se, ja'a padhai lii pake kolongara kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. de ja'a manèngi tare'a-re'a, sèna ka miu loe ka nèti padhèto ètu d'ara lii padhai. te ngaa miu hud'i tenge j'ara sèna ka mamuri d'ara èci, aa baku mae-manyèla. miu hud'i pake ngangee madhera, ho me'a, na, miu neo d'ai too-lane dhu èci èèna ka di.

source_text: for it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from chloe's household, that there are contentions among you.
target_text: te abhu dhèu nèti isi èmu ana hèni èdhi kloe dhu mai peka dènge ja'a, na, ètu talora miu abhu dhèu cahag'e dhu patao-palaha taruu.

source_text: now i mean this, that each one of you says, i follow paul, i follow apollos, i follow cephas, and, i follow christ.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a sèmi ne'e: miu cahag'e peka na, ja'a re paulus! aa cahag'e peka na, ja'a re apolos! aa abhu kahèi dhu paka'uu, na, ja'a re petrus! aa dhu leo hari peka na, ja'a ne, nanene dhoka kristus di!

source_text: is christ divided? was paul crucified for you? or were you baptized into the name of paul?
target_text: miu pangee tasamia, ee? dhèu unu kristus bisa boe mae-manyèla. do, miu pangee, na, ja'a ka dhu madhe pala miu ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha? aad'o! do, lod'o ra sarani miu, rèngu pake ngara ja'a, ho miu j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a, do? bisa boe, si?

source_text: i thank god that i baptized none of you except crispus and gaius,
target_text: ja'a manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua, te lod'o ja'a ètu èèna dènge miu, ja'a sarani boe dhèu ae. dhu ja'a sarani ètu nèi dhoka krispus dènge gayus di.

source_text: so that no one should say that i had baptized you into my own name.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, abhu boe dhèu dhu bisa peka na, ra sarani ja'a pake ngara paulus, ka ja'a j'aj'i dhèu unu paulus.

source_text: i also baptized the household of stephanas; besides them, i don't know whether i baptized any other.
target_text: ee, ja'a heka sanèd'e kèna. ja'a sarani isi èmu stefanus cahag'e kahèi. te ngaa ja'a sanèd'e heka, abhu dhèu era dhu ja'a sarani, do aad'o.

source_text: for christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the good news-not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of christ wouldn't be made void.
target_text: te kristus pua boe ja'a ho laku sarani dhèu. kapua sasab'a ja'a, nuka peka-padhai dènge j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti lii lolo be'a na. te ngaa ladhe ja'a lole mi dhèu, nèngu d'èi boe ja'a peka mamèu ja'a, do, pad'elo j'ara-j'ara dhu kapai. te ladhe ja'a padhai lii sèmi èèna, èèna pakura koasa nèti lii lolo mamadhe kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: for the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of god.
target_text: abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu èdhi peka-padhai lula-nèti mamadhe kristus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha èèna, goa titu kèna. te ngaa dhèu sèmi sèra, bèli-camèd'a cèri eele nèti ama lamatua. aa te ngaa, bagi mi èdhi, mamadhe kristus ne, sèna ka pad'elo koasa lamatua ho patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: for it is written, i will destroy the wisdom of the wise. i will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.
target_text: j'ara ne'e nuka sèmi dhèu nèti lii padhai ama lamatua, ngara na yesaya, suri tèke, peka na, ama lamatua peka na, ‘madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu re'a, bèli-camèd'a ja'a pa'ele iie aa'i si, sèna ka j'aj'i mi mèdha dhu dènge boe kab'ua. rupa-rupa mamèu rèngu, bèli-camèd'a ja'a core eele aa'i si, sèna ka j'aj'i mi mèdha dhu guna boe. '

source_text: where is the wise? where is the scribe? where is the debater of this age? hasn't god made foolish the wisdom of this world?
target_text: uru èèna, mema lamatua padhai lii sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa limuri ne, tasamia hari? dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra, sèmi ngaa sa? mese agama sèra, j'aj'i sèmi ngaa? aa tuka tao lii langu sèra, tasa mera mia? miu nanene sèku! lamatua tao si nuka sèmi dhèu goa! nèngu bete eele aa'i le mamèu dhu amo ètu d'ara kahadhu dhèu rai-haha ne, aa tao mamèu sèra nuka sèmi mèdha dhu dènge boe kab'ua.

source_text: for seeing that in the wisdom of god, the world through its wisdom didn't know god, it was god's good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe. for jews ask for signs, greeks seek after wisdom,
target_text: mamèu ama lamatua lènge aa'i mèu-mèu. masi ka dhèu rai-haha ne pangee, na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu, te ngaa j'ara ngangee rèngu mesa ra d'ai mèka ho ra tadhe hua iia ama lamatua. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa lamatua pake le mamèu na ho bhoke j'ara hia dhèu rai-haha. te uru èèna, lamatua pangee, peka na, masi ka dhèu rai-haha pangee, na, dhèu pajuu-paleha ja'a sèra goa, te ngaa tasamia èèna ka, hud'i ja'a pua ku dhèu lasi lole dènge ra j'ara dhu lèke nèti ja'a. te lamatua pua dhèu rèti lii padhai na ho lasi lole dènge dhèu. na pama'ète nare le neo pake lii moa èèna, sèna ka dhèu bisa parcaya ne. nèngu pake j'ara ne, ho patabuli dhèu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. te ngaa dhèu rai-haha ne pangee, na, j'ara ama lamatua ne, goa. nèti èèna ka, rèngu pusi-pahae boe dhèu pajuu-paleha na. te dhèu yahudi neo manèngi dhoka tadha-tadha malaa di, sèna ka bisa rèdhi koasa lamatua. aa dhèu yunani neo nanene dhoka j'ara-j'ara hua iia dhu maso asa d'ara kahadhu ra, madhutu ngangee rèngu mesa ra.

source_text: but we preach christ crucified, a stumbling block to jews and foolishness to greeks,
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa èdhi dhu j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha lamatua lati peka dènge dhèu, na, lamatua pua le kristus, nuka dhèu dhu nèngu pajaji mema karèi nèti uru ka, mai asa rai-haha ne. ka dhèu leo paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. ropa dhèu yahudi tadèngi lii lolo ne'e, rèngu sisu, te madhutu a'abhu ra, dhèu dhu lamatua neo pua mai èèna, bisa boe madhe sèmi èèna. ropa dhèu yunani tadèngi lii lolo ne, ra pangee na, lii lolo dhèu goa!

source_text: but to those who are called, both jews and greeks, christ is the power of god and the wisdom of god;
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. rèngu sèra cahag'e nèti dhèu yahudi, aa cahag'e nèti dhèu yahudi boe. madhutu a'abhu rèngu, mamadhe kristus dhu pad'elo le mi rèngu, na, koasa ama lamatua dènge boe too-lane, aa mamèu na risi aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: because the foolishness of god is wiser than men, and the weakness of god is stronger than men.
target_text: masi ka dhèu rai-haha pangee, na, j'ara lamatua ne unu dhèu goa, te ngaa nèngu mèu risi eele rèngu. aa masi ka ra pangee, na, lamatua dènge boe koasa, te ngaa koasa na dedha risi eele nèti rèngu.

source_text: for you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;
target_text: a'ari pasue! sèna ka miu bisa me'a mèu lii padhai ja'a ne, sanèd'e mamuri miu, lod'o lamatua hag'e nare miu, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. madhutu a'abhu dhèu rai-haha, ètu talora aae miu, abhu boe dhèu ae dhu d'èlu-mèu, abhu boe dhèu ae dhu dènge pangaru kapai, aa abhu boe dhèu ae dhu a'ari ra dhu dènge kolongara kapai.

source_text: but god chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. god chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua hag'e nare dhèu dhu madhutu ngangee dhèu rai-haha, na, tabhènga ana liku, sèna ka pamakae dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu d'èlu-mèu. aa na hag'e nare dhèu dhu madhutu dhèu rai-haha, dhèu dhu dènge boe koasa, sèna ka pamakae dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu dènge koasa.

source_text: god chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don't exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,
target_text: hèia na hag'e nare dhèu haha dhu dènge boe kolongara, aa dhu biasa dhèu pahaha si. te lamatua neo pake si, sèna ka dhèu dhu pangee, na, rèngu dhèu kapai, j'aj'i sèmi dhèu dènge boe pangaru ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: that no flesh should boast before god.
target_text: dènge j'ara èèna, bèli-camèd'a abhu boe dhèu èci sa dhu bisa tèb'a kakara ètu madha ama lamatua, peka na, nèngu dhèu kapai.

source_text: because of him, you are in christ jesus, who was made to us wisdom from god, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,
target_text: te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu bhoke pataleo j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa maso j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. lamatua ka pake yesus j'aj'i dhèu dhu pala-bagi mamèu na mi dedha èdhi. yesus èèna ka dhu oti j'ara ho èdhi bisa padame dènge ama lamatua. yesus èèna ka dhu tao èdhi ho bisa mamuri mola dènge mèci. aa nèngu ka dhu patabuli èdhi nèti koasa sasala.

source_text: that, as it is written, he who boasts, let him boast in the lord.
target_text: èèna nuka sèmi dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, peka na, cee ka dhu d'èi pakapai kolongara dhèu, be'a risi pakapai kolongara lamatua èdhi. baku pakapai iisi!

source_text: when i came to you, brothers, i didn't come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of god.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! uru èèna, lod'o ja'a dhiu asa miu, ja'a bhoke paled'a j'ara-j'ara lamatua dhu uru èèna dhèu rai-haha ne re'a mèka. te ngaa ja'a kèti boe lii sèra ho padedha iisi. aa ja'a padhai boe pake lii dhu carui, sèna ka pad'elo mamèu ja'a unu ku.

source_text: for i determined not to know anything among you except jesus christ and him crucified.
target_text: lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ja'a pangee sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a pad'elo dhoka ca j'ara di, nuka yesus kristus. nèngu ne, dhèu dhu ama lamatua pajaji mema karèi nèti uru ka, ho hia mai. te ngaa ropa yesus mai, dhèu paku pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. dhoka j'ara ne'e di, dhu ja'a ke'a mèu.

source_text: i was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ja'a bera-bera dènge miu, ja'a rasa mamèu ja'a d'ai boe, aa ja'a madha'u ka isi karèbha.

source_text: my speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the spirit and of power,
target_text: j'ara lii padhai ja'a, aa ngaa dhu ja'a lole, mud'a di. te ja'a ko'o boe pake lii dhu karisi sèna ka pamako miu. aad'o! te ngaa ropa ja'a peka-padhai, na, lii padhai ja'a j'aj'i led'a, lula roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci ka dhu ator ja'a, aa koasa na sab'a ètu ja'a kahèi.

source_text: that your faith wouldn't stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of god.
target_text: te ja'a pangee, na, be'a boe ladhe miu parcaya ama lamatua, lula miu nanene lii padhai dhèu d'èlu-mèu di. dhu be'a risi, ladhe miu parcaya lamatua, lula na pad'elo koasa na mi dedha miu.

source_text: we speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.
target_text: aa te ngaa, ladhe ji'i padhai lii dènge dhèu dhu parcaya èra le, ji'i aj'a rèngu pake lii padhai dhu dhèu bisa re'a mèu. te ngaa dhu re'a mèu èèna, madhutu boe ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne, do, madhutu ngaa dhu dhèu paredha sèra aj'a limuri ne. te sèra sa, bèli-camèd'a ele iie aa'i si.

source_text: but we speak god's wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which god foreordained before the worlds for our glory,
target_text: te ngaa ji'i aj'a dhoka j'ara mamèu dhu mai nèti ama lamatua. lula uru-uru sèra, lod'o rai-haha j'aj'i mèka, lamatua pahuni j'ara sèra. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu pama'ète le, sèna ka neo bhoke patalele lii pahuni èèna hia èdhi, ho èdhi kahèi abhu pala ètu d'ara kolongara na dhu kapai risi eele.

source_text: which none of the rulers of this world has known. for had they known it, they wouldn't have crucified the lord of glory.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu paredha limuri ne, re'a mèu iia boe mamèu lamatua. te ladhe re'a tare'a, tatu ra paku pamadhe boe kètu èdhi dhu dedha risi èèna, ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha.

source_text: but as it is written, things which an eye didn't see, and an ear didn't hear, which didn't enter into the heart of man, these god has prepared for those who love him.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua dhu suri lula-nèti rahasia lamatua dhu uru èèna pahuni tèke, peka na, abhu j'ara dhu dhèu rai-haha dhae rèdhi mèka dènge musi madha ra, aa abhu j'ara dhu dhèu rai-haha dhae tadèngi rèdhi mèka dènge ro'a dhilu ra, dhu dhèu rai-haha bisa ngee rèdhi boe. aa te ngaa, madhutu iia-iia na lamatua sadia tèke le j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i, bagi mi dhèu dhu sue nèngu.

source_text: but to us, god revealed them through the spirit. for the spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of god.
target_text: uru èèna, mema dhèu re'a boe j'ara sèra, te ngaa limuri ne ama lamatua pake roh na ho bhoke paled'a hia èdhi. roh lamatua èèna ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu. te nèngu parisa toke lutu d'ara iiki lamatua kahèi.

source_text: for who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? even so, no one knows the things of god except god's spirit.
target_text: èdhi èci-èci ka dènge roh ètu d'ara èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi dhèu rai-haha, èci-èci ka dènge ngangee aa tatao na. aa abhu boe dhèu leo èci sa dhu ne'a mèu d'ara iiki èdhi, dhoka roh èdhi unu ti dhu ne'a. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge ama lamatua. abhu boe ca dhèu sa kahèi dhu ne'a d'ara iiki lamatua. dhoka roh nèngu mesa na ka dhu ne'a mèu.

source_text: but we received not the spirit of the world, but the spirit which is from god, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by god.
target_text: èdhi dhu sèmi tare le roh lamatua, ka nèngu ka dhu ator èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi madhutu boe ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. lula roh lamatua ètu d'ara èdhi, nèti èèna ka èdhi tadhe aa'i j'ara dhu be'a, dhu nèngu tao le hia èdhi.

source_text: we also speak these things, not in words which man's wisdom teaches but which the holy spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.
target_text: j'ara sèra ka dhu èdhi tema padhue-padhai. te ji'i lole j'ara-j'ara dhu roh lamatua aj'a-nori ji'i. ka ji'i se aj'a boe pake lii dhu nèti mamèu madhutu a'abhu dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa ji'i aj'a-nori pake lii dhu mai nèti roh lamatua mi dhèu dhu tadhe nèngu.

source_text: now the natural man doesn't receive the things of god's spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can't know them, because they are spiritually discerned.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu tadhe boe roh lamatua, ropa na nanene lii padhai ji'i, nèngu d'èi boe sèmi. lula nèngu ngee, na, ngaa kèna? maso boe d'ara kahadhu! aa te ngaa, masi ka tasamia èèna ka, dhèu ne bisa boe ne'a j'ara sèra, te nèngu dhu mamuri pa'èki boe dènge roh lamatua.

source_text: but he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.
target_text: dhèu dhu mamuri pa'èki dènge roh lamatua, heka re'a j'ara sèra aa'i-aa'i, aa bisa re'a mia ka dhu lèke. te ngaa dhèu leo pajiko rare boe ngangee dhèu sèmi sèra.

source_text: for who has known the mind of the lord that he should instruct him? but we have christ's mind.
target_text: bisa tasamia? te abhu dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci lamatua, peka na: cee ka dhu bisa re'a ngangee ama lamatua? do, cee ka dhu bisa ator lamatua, ho ama lamatua tao madhutu lii holo-nori dhèu èèna? abhu boe ca dhèu sa! madhutu iia-iia na, èdhi te'a j'ara se'e, lula kristus ka dhu soru-bara sèna ka èdhi bisa pangee madhutu ngangee nèngu.

source_text: brothers, i couldn't speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in christ.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! lod'o ja'a ètu èèna era, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dhae pa'èki èra mèka dènge roh lamatua. lula miu madhutu dhodhoka dad'èi d'ara miu dhoo-dhoo di, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu rai-haha dhu leo sèra. nèti èèna ka, ja'a bisa boe padhai lii dènge miu, nuka sèmi padhai lii dènge dhèu ee'a, te miu nuka sèmi ana iiki sa.

source_text: i fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren't yet ready. indeed, you aren't ready even now,
target_text: ja'a hud'i aj'a miu j'ara-j'ara dhu carui boe, lula miu bisa mèka sèmi mere j'ara dhu carui, nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu bisa mèka ra'a sisi. miu hud'i kadhii ku, sama sèmi dhèu ee'a dhu tema ra'a sisi. te ngaa limuri ne, miu nuka sèmi ana rara iisi hiu era, dhu me'a dhoka minu susu di.

source_text: for you are still fleshly. for insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren't you fleshly, and don't you walk in the ways of men?
target_text: lula ngangee miu cakaraa dhèu dhu neo dhoka madhutu dad'èi d'ara di. ladhe abhu dhèu dhu risi nèti miu, miu tèka d'ara aa patao-palaha leli! nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka na, miu me'a dhoka madhutu dad'èi miu dhoo-dhoo. de sèmi èèna na, miu sama sèmi dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: for when one says, i follow paul, and another, i follow apollos, aren't you fleshly?
target_text: lula miu cahag'e peka na, ja'a ne, re paulus! aa cahag'e dhu peka na, ja'a ne, re apolos! lod'o-lod'o miu padhai lii sèmi èèna, miu pad'elo, na, miu èci èèna ka dènge dhèu leo ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: who then is apollos, and who is paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the lord gave to him?
target_text: madhutu iia-iia na, apolos èèna, cee? aa ja'a, paulus ne, cee? te ji'i dua mi se, dhoka ana pua-paleha di. ji'i dhoka pad'elo j'ara ho miu bisa parcaya kristus. apolos pakako sasab'a madhutu paredha kètu èdhi. aa ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi!

source_text: i planted. apollos watered. but god gave the increase.
target_text: ja'a ka dhu uru tèka lole dènge miu lula-nèti kristus. èèna nuka sèmi ja'a ka dhu sèle hini. hèia apolos mai aj'a-nori miu. èèna nuka sèmi nèngu ka dhu bui-tatee hini dhu ja'a sèle kore sèra. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu tao hini sèra muri j'aj'i kapai aae.

source_text: so then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but god who gives the increase.
target_text: de dhèu dhu sèle hini sèra dènge boe kab'ua. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu dhu bui. dhodhoka èci di dhu dènge kab'ua, nuka ama lamatua. lula nèngu ka tao hini sèra muri, ka sub'u dènge sega.

source_text: now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.
target_text: dhèu dhu sèle, aa dhèu dhu bui-tatee, sab'a sama-sama, te sasab'a rèngu èci èèna ka. aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu pakako sasab'a lamatua, bèli-camèd'a na b'ae rui-j'aj'èra ra.

source_text: for we are god's fellow workers. you are god's farming, god's building.
target_text: te ji'i sama-sama dhèu sab'a nèti lamatua. aa miu nuka sèmi oka lamatua, dhu nèngu neo uri. sèmi èèna kahèi, miu nuka sèmi èmu dhu ama lamatua patitu.

source_text: according to the grace of god which was given to me, as a wise master builder i laid a foundation, and another builds on it. but let each man be careful how he builds on it.
target_text: de lamatua pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi ja'a. nèti èèna ka ja'a sama sèmi dholu. ka lamatua soru-bara ja'a ho ke'a mèu j'ara-j'ara nèti kapua, sèna ka ja'a tao era padhèdi dhu èra ètu d'ara mamuri miu. hèia dhèu leo aj'a-nori miu kahèi, ho rèngu patitu mi era padhèdi dhu ja'a tao kore èèna. te ngaa tuka èci-èci hud'i sab'a ku dènge d'ara kateme, ho rèngu patitu èmu dhu èra.

source_text: for no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is jesus christ.
target_text: era padhèdi dhu èra èèna, abhu le. nuka yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka, dhèu leo bisa boe tao era padhèdi leo ètu d'ara miu, te lamatua dhu tao tèke le era padhèdi dhu lèke.

source_text: but if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,
target_text: tatu abhu dhèu dhu neo patitu kahèi ètu era padhèdi èèna pake rupa-rupa nèu. abhu dhu neo pake nèu dhu kab'ua, sèmi hualaa, doi pudhi do hadhu kale'e. abhu dhu pake nèu biasa, nuka sèmi aj'u, j'u'u do rèu hidhu.

source_text: each man's work will be revealed. for the day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man's work is.
target_text: te ngaa sasab'a tuka èci-èci ka bisa te'a, aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra bisa re'a sasab'a rèngu èèna, be'a do aad'o. te lod'o èle rai-haha, lamatua neo sèku ne, sama sèmi na pake ai ho pad'elo, na, sasab'a dhèu sèra, bisa taha do aad'o.

source_text: if any man's work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.
target_text: ladhe uji nare sasab'a nèti ca dhèu pake ai, aa nèu dhu na pake bisa taha, bèli-camèd'a lamatua b'ae rui-j'aj'èra na ètu sorga.

source_text: if any man's work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe uji nare sasab'a dhèu pake ai, aa ai na'e aa'i nèu dhu nèngu pake patitu ètu era padhèdi èèna, na, lamatua hia boe dhèu ne ngaa-ngaa. te ngaa tuka ne abhu mamuri era, masi ka sèmi dhèu dhu rai kalua nèti d'ara èmu ai na'e.

source_text: don't you know that you are god's temple and that god's spirit lives in you?
target_text: miu hud'i me'a ku, dhu peka na, miu sama sèmi èmu sabaj'a lamatua, aa roh na dhu pea ètu d'ara.

source_text: if anyone destroys god's temple, god will destroy him; for god's temple is holy, which you are.
target_text: aa ladhe abhu dhèu dhu pa'ele iie èmu sabaj'a lamatua, nuka era pea na, na mage-mage! bèli-camèd'a lamatua pa'ele iie ne kahèi! te èmu sabaj'a lamatua èèna mola-mèci. de miu hud'i mola-mèci ku kahèi.

source_text: let no one deceive himself. if anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.
target_text: miu baku tipu ngi'u miu unu mi! ladhe abhu ca dhèu dhu pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu aa ne'a aa'i madhutu mamèu dhèu ètu rai-haha lod'o limuri ne, èèna peka na, nèngu ne'a boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa. ladhe èu mase'a le, peka na, èu me'a boe ngaa-ngaa èci sa, heka èu mulai me'a kèna.

source_text: for the wisdom of this world is foolishness with god. for it is written, he has taken the wise in their craftiness.
target_text: ngangee dhèu ètu rai-haha taa limuri ne, ama lamatua peka na, goa. te ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci dhu suri tèke, peka na: abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, nèngu d'èlu-mèu, te ngaa èèna na lamatua pake hari ngangee na dhu karehe sèra, j'aj'i mi sasii, ho sii pa'ele iie hari nèngu!

source_text: and again, the lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.
target_text: ètu era leo dhu suri kahèi, peka na, lamatua èdhi dhu ne'a le ngaa dhu dhèu d'èlu-mèu sèra pangee, aa dhèu dhu hud'i re'a ku neo tao ne tasa mere mia, nèngu dhu ne'a nare le, na, rèngu dhoka ngee iia d'ara di.

source_text: therefore let no one boast in men. for all things are yours, whether paul, or apollos, or cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. all are yours,
target_text: de miu baku padedha dhèu èci sa, dhu peka na, nèngu èèna lènge aa'i dhèu. te lamatua ka dhu ded'e dhèu, ho ator miu. aa'i-aa'i sèra j'aj'i le unu miu. de dhèu dhu ator miu sèra, sama sèmi: ja'a, apolos, dènge petrus, ji'i se j'aj'i unu miu. aa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne unu miu kahèi, masi ka miu mamuri do miu madhe, masi ka deo ne'e do lod'o dhu mai, aa'i-aa'i j'aj'i unu miu kateme aae.

source_text: and you are christ's, and christ is god's.
target_text: aa miu j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. aa kristus unu ama lamatua!

source_text: so let a man think of us as christ's servants and stewards of god's mysteries.
target_text: de miu baku koa-kad'iri ji'i, te ji'i dhoka ana pua-paleha kristus di. aa ama lamatua lèka ji'i, sèna ka j'aga paie-iie j'ara-j'ara dhu uru èèna pahuni tèke.

source_text: here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.
target_text: dhèu dhu madhenga mèdha-panyau lamatua na, nèngu hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu dhu tao madhutu ngaa dhu lèke.

source_text: but with me it is a very small thing that i should be judged by you, or by a human court. yes, i don't even judge my own self.
target_text: tasamia dènge ja'a? ja'a sab'e madhutu ngaa dhu lèke, do aad'o? ja'a ko'o boe ke'a, miu nile ja'a tasa mera mia. aa ja'a pusi-pahae boe kahèi dhèu leo nile ja'a sèmi ngaa sa. ja'a ke'a boe nile ngi'u ja'a unu ku kahèi.

source_text: for i know nothing against myself. yet i am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the lord.
target_text: te masi ka d'ara iiki ja'a peka na, ja'a be'a le, tatu boe sasoa na, ja'a be'a. dhu mèci ka, lamatua ka dhu nile ja'a tasa mera mia.

source_text: therefore judge nothing before the time, until the lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. then each man will get his praise from god.
target_text: de miu baku tao ngi'u sèmi dhèu pama'ète lii langu ho nile dhèu leo sèra. mate mamai hari lamatua, te nèngu ka dhu èèna na bhoke patalele aa'i mèu-mèu. nèngu ka pasabhoka aa'i bhabhelu-katub'a dhu dhèu tao pahuni ètu d'ara maroga. nèngu neo bhoke paled'a j'ara-j'ara dhu dhèu ngee ètu d'ara ra. hèia ama lamatua neo peka aa'i j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu dhèu tao le.

source_text: now these things, brothers, i have in a figure transferred to myself and apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a dhu padhai lii lula-nèti ja'a dènge apolos, nuka sèmi ja'a j'aj'i mi conto ho miu bisa aj'a nèti ji'i, nuka: tao madhutu j'ara-j'ara dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua. baku tao dhu leo. ladhe miu madhutu ka j'ara se'e, miu baku bia re èci sa, aa padedha iisi lula madhutu ca dhèu, aa pahahe dhèu leo.

source_text: for who makes you different? and what do you have that you didn't receive? but if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?
target_text: de tasamia? miu pangee, na, miu risi nèti dhèu leo, do? baku! te aa'i-aa'i dhu miu unu, miu abhu nèti ama lamatua. de ladhe sèmi èèna, nga tao ka miu nged'e ej'a ai, nuka sèmi miu ad'u-ue unu mi?

source_text: you are already filled. you have already become rich. you have come to reign without us. yes, and i wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!
target_text: nuka sèmi aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu, miu abhu le. nuka sèmi miu kaja le! miu tao ngi'u mi, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu kapai sama sèmi dhèu aae sa, aa ji'i soru-bara boe ciki sa. madhutu iia-iia na, lamatua ka dhu hia aa'i-aa'i dhu miu parluu. te ngaa ladhe miu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i dhèu aae, ele boe ji'i ngèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge miu, si?

source_text: for i think that god has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. for we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.
target_text: ama lamatua ka dhu pua-paleha ji'i, ho la'a asa mia-mia ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka lole dènge dhèu j'ara-j'ara kristus. te ngaa ca tèka-ca tèka sa ja'a pangee, na, lamatua pua ji'i titu re limuri tèka, sama sèmi ana bèdho dhu tatae abhu huku madhe. hèia na hia dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, aa dènge ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga mai laladhe ji'i.

source_text: we are fools for christ's sake, but you are wise in christ. we are weak, but you are strong. you have honor, but we have dishonor.
target_text: miu kapai titu kèna, nga! te abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, miu d'èlu-mèu, lula pa'èki dènge kristus. te ngaa rèngu pangee, na, ji'i goa titu kèna, lula ji'i j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus. ele boe rèngu ngee, na, miu èra risi, aa ji'i se roe aala-aala. ele boe ra ded'e miu padedha-dedha, te ngaa ro'o boe pusi-pahae ji'i ciki sa hèi. seli-kolane, nga!

source_text: even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.
target_text: toke d'ai deo ne'e, ji'i manganga dènge koko-kamango. mèdha-papake ji'i kaha'i-kaheru. dhèu loe boe game ji'i. ji'i nuka sèmi dhèu dhu dènge boe era pea.

source_text: we toil, working with our own hands. when people curse us, we bless. being persecuted, we endure.
target_text: ji'i sab'a dènge kacui-aai ji'i unu mi toke d'ai èi kabhèsu hae. ladhe dhèu padhai-kakoli ji'i, ji'i dhoka b'ala, peka na, ji'i manèngi, sèna ka ama lamatua tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a hia miu. ladhe dhèu paj'èra ji'i, na, ji'i b'ala boe, dhoka mau-mau di.

source_text: being defamed, we entreat. we are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.
target_text: ladhe dhèu padhai pa'ele iie kolongara ji'i, ji'i dhoka dhaa dènge rèhu mare di. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu dhèu dhu pangee, na, ji'i se nuka sèmi kaj'alu do mamumu dhu core eele.

source_text: i don't write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.
target_text: ja'a suri j'ara se'e, neo boe pamakae miu. te ngaa ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu, lula ja'a sue miu nuka sèmi ana matana ja'a sa. nèti èèna ka, ja'a peka dènge miu, ho lèpa asa j'ara dhu mola.

source_text: for though you have ten thousand tutors in christ, you don't have many fathers. for in christ jesus, i became your father through the good news.
target_text: masi ka dhèu riho-riho dhu bisa pad'elo j'ara hia miu lula-nèti kristus, te ngaa dhoka ja'a mesa ku dhu j'aj'i ama miu. te ja'a ka dhèu uru j'ara dhu peka-padhai dènge miu lii lolo be'a nèti yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka, miu parcaya ne. ja'a tao j'ara èèna, lula ja'a dhu pa'èki mèno dènge ne.

source_text: i beg you therefore, be imitators of me.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi, sèna ka miu madhutu j'ara mamuri ja'a ne.

source_text: because of this i have sent timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in christ, even as i teach everywhere in every assembly.
target_text: nèti èèna ka ja'a pua timotius dhiu soru-bara miu. ja'a sue ne, sama sèmi ana matana ja'a. ja'a lèka ne, te nèngu kahèi mamuri pa'èki dènge lamatua èdhi. èèna na nèngu soru-bara miu ho pasanèd'e miu nèti mamuri ja'a. j'ara mamuri ja'a sèmi èèna, lula ja'a pa'èki dènge yesus kristus, dhu ama lamatua hia mai. èèna ka dhu ja'a aj'a-nori dènge dhèu sarani dhu pakaboko ètu mia-mia.

source_text: now some are puffed up, as though i were not coming to you.
target_text: abhu nèti miu dhu pangee, na, ja'a lake kore boe dhiu dènge miu. nèti èèna ka rèngu nged'e titu kèna.

source_text: but i will come to you shortly, if the lord is willing. and i will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe lamatua èdhi d'èi, nèbhu boe ja'a d'ai kota korintus. ho èèna na ja'a ke'a mèu, na, dhèu sèra padhai lii padedha iisi, do, rèngu tare'a dènge koasa!

source_text: for god's kingdom is not in word, but in power.
target_text: te ama lamatua èèna dhèu aae dhu unu koasa. ka dhèu nèngu hèb'a mènyi boe, ho pa'èra dhèu ètu d'ara lalèka ra, te ngaa rèngu pake koasa dhu lèke.

source_text: what do you want? shall i come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?
target_text: de dad'èi miu tasamia? ladhe ja'a dhiu, na, ja'a tao lii sakaa aa huku miu? do, ja'a dhiu pad'elo sasue dènge d'ara be'a?

source_text: you are arrogant, and didn't mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

source_text: in the name of our lord jesus christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our lord jesus christ,
target_text: ja'a dènge hak ho pama'ète sèmi èèna, lula yesus j'aj'i kètu èdhi, aa ja'a dhèu pajuu-paleha na. de miu hud'i madhèdi pa'èci ku ho pama'ète lii langu èèna pake kolongara kètu èdhi. aa d'ara ja'a sama-sama dènge miu kahèi.

source_text: you are to deliver such a one to satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the lord jesus.

source_text: your boasting is not good. don't you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?
target_text: be'a boe ladhe miu nged'e! baku bhèlu, na, èdhi pakihu bibit roti ciki di ho bisa pakapai adonan aa'i-aa'i. bibit roti, nuka sèmi bhabhelu dhèu. de ladhe soro tèke dhèu ad'u-ue bhabhelu ètu talora aae miu, bèli-camèd'a dhèu sarani leo sèra madhutu tao bhelu kahèi!

source_text: purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. for indeed christ, our passover, has been sacrificed in our place.
target_text: babège eele dhèu bhelu èèna nèti juma'at miu, sèmi uru èèna dhèu yahudi sèra core eele ragi aa'i-aa'i nèti èmu rèngu sèra ho neo ra'a kalela paska. dènge j'ara ne, miu bisa j'aj'i hari nuka sèmi dhèu dhu d'ara na abhu heka bhelu-katub'a. miu hud'i j'aj'i ku sèmi èèna. uru èèna, dhèu roro ana kahib'i-kalèbho sèna ka tao badha korban kalela paska. d'ai limuri ku, rèngu pamadhe dhèu mola-mèci ama lamatua, sèna ka j'aj'i korban dhu pamèu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: therefore let's keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
target_text: uru èèna, dhèu yahudi ra'a gee-j'ara nèti roti dhu pake boe ragi ètu d'ara lod'o kalela paska. limuri ne, èdhi nuka sèmi roti dhu pake boe ragi èèna. nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i j'aga paie mamuri èdhi sèna ka baku tao ia ka j'ara-j'ara dhu bhelu, aa baku papèd'a d'ara dhèu leo. èdhi hud'i padhai lii dhu lèke taruu. hèia ropa dhèu ladhe rèdhi mamuri èdhi, ra peka na, tatao èdhi madhutu d'ara mola.

source_text: i wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;
target_text: ca hari ni, ja'a suri kèdhi le sasuri dhu peka na, baku pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe.

source_text: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.
target_text: a'abhu ja'a ne peka boe, na, miu baku pa'èci dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, dhu pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua, do dhèu manga'a, do dhèu kapod'e-kabèli dhu mana'u rare mèdha-panyau dhèu, do dènge dhèu sogo-tagu nidhu. te ladhe sèmi èèna, miu hud'i tao iisi mi pakaj'èu nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: but as it is, i wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. don't even eat with such a person.
target_text: te ngaa dhu ja'a peka ne nuka: miu baku pa'èci dènge dhèu dhu peka na, nèngu dhèu sarani, aa te ngaa nèngu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe, do dhu manga'a, do dhu sogo-tagu nidhu, do dhu pahahe kolongara dhèu, do dhu mahu, do dhu kapod'e mèdha-panyau dhèu. èdhi baku pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi sèra. aa loe eele ka madhèdi mi'a-minu pa'èci dènge dhèu sèmi sèra!

source_text: for what do i have to do with also judging those who are outside? don't you judge those who are within?
target_text: miu dènge hak ho lee mamuri dhèu sarani. te ngaa ja'a dènge boe hak, sèna ka pama'ète lii langu dhèu dhu parcaya boe ama lamatua.

source_text: but those who are outside, god judges. put away the wicked man from among yourselves.
target_text: te ama lamatua mesa na ka bèli-camèd'a pama'ète hia dhèu dhu parcaya boe ne. de miu baku bhèlu, ètu d'ara sasuri ama lamatua dhu suri, peka na, dhèu dhu peka na, nèngu dhèu unu lamatua, te ngaa loe boe tao bhabhelu, na, babège eele ne!

source_text: dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?
target_text: ladhe ca dhèu sarani pagalaa dènge a'ari na dhèu sarani, nga tao ka lami asa pengadilan ètu madha hakim dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua? tasamia ka j'aj'i sèmi èèna? be'a risi lami asa madha dhèu-dhèu parcaya, sèna ka rèngu uri lii langu miu!

source_text: don't you know that the saints will judge the world? and if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?
target_text: nuka sèmi dhu dhae me'a mèka, peka na, dhèu-dhèu parcaya, bèli-camèd'a rèngu ka dhu pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. de tasamia ka miu mesa mi bisa boe uri lii langu dhu ana iiki-iiki?

source_text: don't you know that we will judge angels? how much more, things that pertain to this life?
target_text: dhu mola-mola ka, ladhe bèli-camèd'a èdhi ka dhu uri lii langu ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga. de tatu hud'i miu ku dhu uri lii langu dhu bèli-bèli j'aj'i ètu talora aae miu.

source_text: if then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?
target_text: risi-risi hari, ladhe miu dhèu parcaya pagalaa lula-nèti j'ara dhu ana iiki-iiki sèra, nga tao ka miu pake dhèu pama'ète lii dhu dhèu-dhèu sarani pakab'ua boe si?

source_text: i say this to move you to shame. isn't there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?
target_text: de ja'a neo peka ca j'ara dhu pamakae miu. sèmi ngaa? nuka sèmi ètu talora aae miu abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu d'èlu-mèu uri lii langu dhu ana iiki-iiki sèra, sèmi lii langu dhu cèu nèti a'ari èdhi.

source_text: but brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!
target_text: te ngaa nèti talora miu abhu dhèu parcaya dhu ère nèti a'ari na dhèu parcaya asa madha dhèu pama'ète lii langu! aa te ngaa dhèu pama'ète lii langu ne dhu parcaya boe lamatua!

source_text: therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. why not rather be wronged? why not rather be defrauded?
target_text: lèke boe, sina ma? miu dhu segi boe le èèna, ladhe miu èci dènge èci lami pagalaa asa era pama'ète lii langu. be'a risi, a'ari èu èèna soro tèke ne, ladhe na tao sala mi dedha èu. aa ladhe a'ari èu dhèu parcaya mana'u nare mèdha-panyau èu, be'a risi hud'i laa nare!

source_text: no, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.
target_text: te ngaa miu dhèu parcaya èci tao sala mi a'ari miu. aa èci mana'u èci. aa te ngaa miu sama-sama dhèu parcaya!

source_text: or don't you know that the unrighteous will not inherit god's kingdom? don't be deceived. neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,
target_text: miu nuka sèmi me'a boe j'ara se'e aa'i-aa'i! te dhèu dhu ro'o boe tao dhu lèke, tatu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. mage soro tèke dhèu tipu miu, sèna ka miu ad'u-ue sasala! dhèu dhu tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu nèngu boe, dhu sogo-tagu nidhu, dhu bersina, mone dhèu dua dhu pa'èci nuka sèmi dhèu èmu-kamali,

source_text: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit god's kingdom.
target_text: dhèu mana'u, dhèu manga'a, dhèu rinu mahu, dhu padhai lii pakarehe kolongara dhèu, dhu pakapod'e ho rare mèdha-panyau dhèu, te dhèu aa'i-aa'i sèmi se'e se, tatu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua!

source_text: some of you were such, but you were washed. you were sanctified. you were justified in the name of the lord jesus, and in the spirit of our god.
target_text: mema, uru èèna miu cahag'e sèmi èèna kahèi! te ngaa ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo miu, hèia pamèu miu. aa nèngu bhoke le j'ara kahèi, sèna ka miu bisa pabe'a hari dènge ne. na tao j'ara se'e, lula miu pa'èki dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, aa lula miu pa'èki dènge roh lamatua kahèi.

source_text: all things are lawful for me, but not all things are expedient. all things are lawful for me, but i will not be brought under the power of anything.
target_text: ja'a dènge hak sèna ka tao aa'i mèu-mèu. te ngaa aa'i-aa'i dhu ja'a neo tao sèra, tatu boe be'a hia ja'a. de masi ka ja'a dènge hak sèna ka tao aa'i mèu-mèu, te ngaa ja'a ko'o boe j'ara dhu karehe koasa nare ja'a.

source_text: foods for the belly, and the belly for foods, but god will bring to nothing both it and them. but the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the lord, and the lord for the body.
target_text: conto sèmi, dhèu peka na, nganga'a parluu kabake, aa kabake parluu nganga'a. te ngaa sanèd'e, te bèli-camèd'a lamatua palaho aa'i dua-dua ra. conto dhu leo hari, èdhi bisa boe soro ngi'u èdhi sèna ka bisa tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu-kamali èdhi boe. èdhi unu ngi'u ne, sèna ka sab'a hia lamatua èdhi. aa lamatua èdhi ladhe-leru ngi'u èdhi.

source_text: now god raised up the lord, and will also raise us up by his power.
target_text: ropa kètu èdhi, yesus kristus madhe, ama lamatua ka pamamuri hari ne. de ladhe èdhi madhe, nèngu dènge koasa kahèi ho pamamuri hari èdhi.

source_text: don't you know that your bodies are members of christ? shall i then take the members of christ and make them members of a prostitute? may it never be!
target_text: ngi'u miu j'aj'i mi unu kristus, nuka sèmi miu bagian nèti ngi'u kristus. tatu j'ara ne, miu me'a le! de ladhe ja'a pake bagian nèti ngi'u kristus, ho laku pa'èci dènge ngi'u nèti bhèni kajeo, na tasamia? baku sèmi èèna! te èèna na lèke boe!

source_text: or don't you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? for, the two, he says, will become one flesh.
target_text: tatu miu me'a le, ladhe dhèu tao j'ara makae ho j'unu pa'èci dènge bhèni kajeo, na, dua-dua pakihu kee j'aj'i mi èci. te dhu suri tèke ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci, peka na, rèngu dua ra pa'èki le j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: but he who is joined to the lord is one spirit.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu mamuri d'ara èci dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, j'aj'i le èci dènge nèngu, sama sèmi dua ra dhu pa'èki ètu d'ara roh èci.

source_text: flee sexual immorality! every sin that a man does is outside the body, but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.
target_text: ladhe èu abhu tebho tao j'ara makae dènge dhèu dhu dhèu èmu èu boe, na, rai pakaj'èu! dhèu ad'u-ue sasala rupa-rupa dhu pa'ele iie rèngu unu ra, aa pa'ele iie dhèu leo kahèi. te dhèu dhu karihu kaj'alu pa'ele iie ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: or don't you know that your body is a temple of the holy spirit who is in you, whom you have from god? you are not your own,
target_text: ngi'u èu èèna, nuka sèmi èmu sabaj'a roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci. roh nèngu èèna ka, dhu pea ètu d'ara miu, te ama lamatua mesa na ka hia roh na mi dedha miu. nèti èèna ka, miu dènge boe hak ciki sa hèi, ho j'aj'i lamatua dhu ator ngi'u miu unu mi. te ngaa, nga tao ka miu mamuri sèmi pame'a boe sa dènge j'ara se'e?

source_text: for you were bought with a price. therefore glorify god in your body and in your spirit, which are god's.
target_text: kristus sui nare le miu dènge kab'ua titu kèna. de miu hud'i mamuri ku dènge pakab'ua ngi'u miu unu mi, ho pad'elo, na, miu pakab'ua ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.
target_text: ja'a neo suri j'ara-j'ara dhu miu pakarèi ètu d'ara sasuri miu èèna, dhu peka na, tasamia? dhu be'a ka, dhèu mone baku leo-èmu, do?

source_text: but, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.
target_text: sèmi ne'e: lula abhu lod'o taleo ae, dhu dhèu bisa manahu asa d'ara tatao dhu sala ètu d'ara pa'èci mone dènge bhèni, nèti èèna ka be'a risi dhèu mone èci hud'i dènge ku dhèu èmu nèngu mesa na. sèmi èèna kahèi, dhèu bhèni hud'i pa'èci ku dènge dhèu èmu nèngu mesa na.

source_text: let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.
target_text: mone dhu dènge le dhèu èmu! mage mo'o boe j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu èmu èu. aa dhèu bhèni dhu dènge le dhèu èmu! mage mo'o boe j'unu pa'èci dènge dhèu èmu èu.

source_text: the wife doesn't have authority over her own body, but the husband does. likewise also the husband doesn't have authority over his own body, but the wife does.
target_text: te bhèni dhu leo le èmu, hia le ngi'u na sèna ka j'aj'i unu dhèu èmu na. aa mone dhu leo le èmu, hia le ngi'u na ho j'aj'i unu dhèu èmu na.

source_text: don't deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that satan doesn't tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
target_text: de miu baku patula-pajuku, lula dua-dua mi dhu dènge hak hua! te ngaa ladhe miu neo sabaj'a di, ho mo'o boe ngee j'ara dhu leo-leo, na, j'unu pa'èci boe d'ara ciki oo'e èèna ka, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. sad'i dua mi mere lii èci ku. aa ladhe sabaj'a mere, na, be'a risi pakaboko hari dènge ka. te ladhe aad'o, na, bisa j'aj'i be'a boe! te dhèu aae nidhu bisa dadugu-rariu dhèu dhu taha rare boe d'ara.

source_text: but this i say by way of concession, not of commandment.
target_text: j'ara ne mai nèti a'abhu ja'a di, nèti boe atora lamatua.

source_text: yet i wish that all men were like me. however, each man has his own gift from god, one of this kind, and another of that kind.
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, be'a risi dhèu baku leo-èmu, nuka sèmi ja'a dhu dènge boe dhèu èmu. te ngaa ama lamatua hia dhèu karunya pamèci dènge nèngu. nèti èèna ka, abhu dhèu dhu ama lamatua hia si leo-èmu, aa abhu cahag'e dhu na hia si leo boe èmu.

source_text: but i say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as i am.
target_text: ja'a neo peka dènge dhèu mone do dhèu bhèni dhu leo mèka èmu, aa dènge bhèni balu, na, be'a risi miu baku leo-èmu, nuka sèmi ja'a ne.

source_text: but if they don't have self-control, let them marry. for it's better to marry than to burn with passion.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe taha mere boe, hua iia leo èmu ka. dhu hua iia risi ladhe dhèu leo-èmu, te aad'o na, dad'èi d'ara na pa'ele iie ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: but to the married i command-not i, but the lord-that the wife not leave her husband
target_text: ne'e ne mai boe nèti ngangee ja'a mesa ku. te ja'a neo peka ngaa dhu lamatua èdhi paredha le mi dhèu dhu leo le èmu, na, bhèni bisa boe pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na.

source_text: but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband, and that the husband not leave his wife.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe nèngu tèke eele dhèu èmu na, be'a risi leo ia ka èmu. hua iia nèngu la'e padame dènge mone dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. sèmi èèna kahèi mone, bisa boe pa'ia-pa'ela dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na.

source_text: but to the rest i-not the lord-say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.
target_text: ne'e ne madhutu ngangee ja'a, mai boe nèti lamatua èdhi. aa mi dhèu leo, ja'a neo padhai lii sèmi ne'e: ladhe abhu mone dhèu sarani dhu dhèu èmu na parcaya boe kristus, na, baku ia eele ne, ladhe dhèu èmu na neo mamuri taruu dènge nèngu.

source_text: the woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge bhèni dhu dhèu èmu na parcaya boe kristus, na, baku ia eele ne, ladhe mone ne d'èi era sèna ka dua ra mamuri pa'èci taruu.

source_text: for the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.
target_text: te mone dhu parcaya boe kristus, bisa mola-mèci, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki le dènge bhèni dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. aa bhèni dhu parcaya boe kristus, bisa j'aj'i mola-mèci kahèi, lula nèngu dhu pa'èki dènge mone dhu j'aj'i dhèu èmu na. te ladhe aad'o, na, ana-ana rèngu bisa boe mola-mèci. te ngaa dènge j'ara ne, rèngu bisa mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. the brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but god has called us in peace.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe dhèu bhèni do dhèu mone dhu parcaya boe kristus, dhu la'e tèke eele dhèu èmu-kamali na dhu parcaya, na hud'i nèngu sène. ka dhèu èmu dhu parcaya, pa'èki heka dènge ne. te ama lamatua paroa miu sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na, ho miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: for how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
target_text: dhèu bhèni dhu parcaya, dhu leo le èmu aa'i-aa'i! ele boe miu bisa hia mamuri mi dhèu èmu miu. aa bisa aad'o kahèi. sèmi èèna kahèi dhèu mone dhu parcaya dhu leo le èmu sèra! ele boe miu bisa hia mamuri mi dhèu èmu miu. aa bisa aad'o kahèi. miu me'a iia mèka.

source_text: only, as the lord has distributed to each man, as god has called each, so let him walk. so i command in all the assemblies.
