target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu sèmi nare le lii holo-nori lamatua, nèngu hud'i pabagi ku rui-j'aj'èra na, ho soru-bara dhèu dhu aj'a-nori nèngu.

source_text: don't be deceived. god is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ama lamatua ne'a aa'i mèu-mèu. de baku tipu ngi'u miu unu mi, aa baku neo tipu lamatua. lula, ngaa dhu dhèu sèle ètu d'ara oka-tedhe, pe nèngu abhu hari hua-hela na.

source_text: for he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. but he who sows to the spirit will from the spirit reap eternal life.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe dhèu ad'u-ue j'ara bhelu-katub'a madhutu dad'èi na, pe na dui nare hari mamuri dhu ele iie. te ngaa ladhe dhèu tao j'ara be'a madhutu dad'èi roh mola-mèci, pe nèngu abhu hari mamuri dhu lèke toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: let's not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don't give up.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu baku roca tao j'ara dhu be'a. te ropa d'ai lod'o na, èdhi abhu hari j'ara dhu be'a, sad'i èdhi taha taruu.

source_text: so then, as we have opportunity, let's do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.
target_text: de ropa èdhi abhu lod'o dhu taleo, na, èdhi tao mema ka j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra, risi-risi mi a'ari èdhi dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: see with what large letters i write to you with my own hand.
target_text: sasuri ne'e, ja'a ka suri unu ku, pake huruf dhu kapai aae hua.

source_text: as many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of christ.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! dhèu kapod'e-kabèli sèra lèka kahèi mi yesus kristus dhu madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te ngaa rèngu laka-seti miu ho suna, lula ra madha'u dènge dhèu yahudi leo, rèngu mage dhèu se paj'èra si, ladhe rèngu aj'a, peka na, ama lamatua sèmi nare kahèi dhèu dhu madhutu boe atora suna. nèti èèna ka, rèngu se d'èi solo-mako dhèu yahudi sèra.

source_text: for even they who receive circumcision don't keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.
target_text: masi ka rèngu dhu suna le, te ngaa rèngu unu ra madhutu aa'i boe atora agama sèra. rèngu d'èi ho miu madhutu suna, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu rèngu. dènge j'ara ne'e, partei ra ded'e padedha-dedha rèngu.

source_text: but far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our lord jesus christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and i to the world.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a ne d'èi dhoka ded'e padedha-dedha kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. nèngu madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, sèna ka pamadhe aa'i bhabhelu-katub'a dhu dhèu ad'u-ue madhutu dad'èi rai-haha ne. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pusi-pahae heka dènge dad'èi rai-haha. aa dad'èi rai-haha ne èki heka ja'a.

source_text: for in christ jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.
target_text: suna, do aad'o, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. te ngaa dhu karisi, nuka èdhi abhu mamuri hiu nèti lamatua.

source_text: as many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on god's israel.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua pad'elo sasue na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhutu a'aj'a ja'a ne, ho rèngu mamuri padame, aa pad'elo rasa kasia èci dènge èci. te rèngu j'aj'i le suku dhu hiu nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: from now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for i bear the marks of the lord jesus branded on my body.
target_text: ja'a peka mola-mola kèna, na, ja'a d'èi sèna ka dhèu sèku ia ka ja'a dènge lii langu suna ne. te ètu ngi'u ja'a ne dènge tadha nu'a era, lula ja'a sab'a hia yesus kristus.

source_text: the grace of our lord jesus christ be with your spirit, brothers. amen.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a manèngi sèna ka kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia na asa miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka. lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus

source_text: paul, an apostle of christ jesus through the will of god, to the saints who are at ephesus, and the faithful in christ jesus:
target_text: lii maho'o nèti ja'a, paulus. ja'a suri sasuri ne, hia miu aa'i-aa'i mi, dhu j'aj'i le dhèu unu yesus kristus ètu kota epesus, aa dhu taha ètu d'ara mamuri mola-mèci madhutu dad'èi na. nèngu mesa na ka dhu pua-paleha ja'a madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: grace to you and peace from god our father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ama lamatua ne, ama èdhi. aa yesus kristus, kètu èdhi. ja'a manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra ho miu mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: blessed be the god and father of our lord jesus christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in christ,
target_text: koa-kio mi ama lamatua! nèngu ka ama nèti kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. te ama lamatua pala-bagi le mi èdhi mèngi-nale aa'i-aa'i nèti sorga, lula èdhi j'aj'i le dhèu unu yesus kristus.

source_text: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,
target_text: te lod'o rai-haha dhae j'aj'i mèka, ama lamatua sue aa hag'e nare le èdhi, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu yesus kristus. na d'èi sèna ka èdhi mamuri mola-mèci. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa boe pasala èdhi.

source_text: having predestined us for adoption as children through jesus christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,
target_text: nèngu ka dhu pama'ète mema karèi nèti uru ka, ho ded'e èdhi j'aj'i ana na, lula yesus kristus. ne'e ne ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the beloved.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi koa-kio ne. te nèngu pad'elo le d'ara hua iia na mi èdhi, ho èdhi bisa mamuri pa'èci dènge ana pasue na.

source_text: in him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace
target_text: masi ka èdhi uru èèna mamuri mola-mèci boe madhutu j'ara mamuri ama lamatua, te ngaa na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa hia ana na mai, sèna ka pasuti raa na toke madhe. dènge j'ara ne'e, ana na sui nare èdhi nèti sasala-sasigo èdhi.

source_text: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,
target_text: lula na dutu-bhori sasue na mi èdhi, nèngu pasaraa d'ara èdhi kahèi, ka bisa te'a mèu dad'èi d'ara na.

source_text: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him
target_text: uru èèna, ama lamatua dhae peka aa'i mèka dad'èi d'ara na mi dhèu rai-haha ne. te ngaa limuri ne, madhutu dad'èi na, na hia le èdhi te'a, peka na, karèi nèti uru ka, na pama'ète nare le ho neo pake yesus kristus sèna ka padame dhèu rai-haha dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.
target_text: aa, pe d'ai lod'o na, yesus kristus j'aj'i kètu ho uri aa'i ngaa-ngaa ètu rai-haha dènge ètu sorga.

source_text: we were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will, to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in christ.
target_text: lula èdhi dhu pa'èki le dènge kristus, nèti èèna ka èdhi abhu pusaka kahèi nèti ama lamatua. te karèi nèti uru j'ara ka, na hag'e nare ji'i dhèu yahudi, ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na. dad'èi nèngu ka, neo pake ji'i ho bhoke j'ara hia dhèu-dhèu leo, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i bisa parcaya kristus. aa'i-aa'i se j'aj'i, madhutu ngaa dhu na pama'ète nare le. dènge j'ara ne, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti bisa ded'e padedha-dedha risi hari, kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: in him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the good news of your salvation-in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised holy spirit,
target_text: lula ji'i bhoke le j'ara, nèti èèna ka miu nèti suku leo bisa mai j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, sad'i miu parcaya lii lolo be'a na dhu mola. te lii lolo be'a èèna ka dhu pamamuri miu. ladhe miu parcaya sèmi èèna, miu sèmi mere kahèi roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci dhu na moa mema le. te roh lamatua mola-mèci ne, nuka sèmi cap ho patadha, peka na, miu tare'a-re'a j'aj'i le dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of god's own possession, to the praise of his glory.
target_text: roh mola-mèci ne'e j'aj'i mi jaminan kahèi, dhu peka na, pe ama lamatua hia aa'i mèu-mèu dhu na moa mema sèra, toke na sui nare èdhi, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na. nèti èèna ka, èdhi koa-kio dadedha na.

source_text: for this cause i also, having heard of the faith in the lord jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,
target_text: ja'a tadèngi ae le, j'ara-j'ara lalèka miu mi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, aa nèti sasue miu mi dhèu parcaya sèra. nèti èèna ka,

source_text: don't cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,
target_text: ja'a loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: that the god of our lord jesus christ, the father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a, peka na, ama pasue! ama ku, ama lamatua nèti kètu ja'a, yesus kristus. aa ama ku ka dhu kapai risi aa'i. ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama hia roh ama mi dhèu epesus, ho re'a j'ara-j'ara dhu lèke, aa bisa tadhe ama mèu risi hari.

source_text: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho ama lamatua bhoke ngangee dènge pasaraa d'ara ra, sèna ka bisa re'a aa'i ngaa dhu ama padhadha neo hia si. ja'a neo kahèi sèna ka rèngu re'a pusaka dhu ama moa neo hia si bèli-camèd'a. te pusaka èèna kab'ua titu kèna.

source_text: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might
target_text: ja'a manèngi kahèi, ho ama bhoke j'ara hia si, sèna ka bisa re'a mèu koasa ama dhu dedha risi èèna. te ama pake koasa èèna, ho soru-bara dhèu parcaya dhu unu ama sèra.

source_text: which he worked in christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,
target_text: te koasa ama lamatua èèna, risi aa'i mèu-mèu. nèti koasa ne'e ka na pamamuri kristus nèti mamadhe na. hèia ama lamatua ded'e kristus asa sorga, ka hia ne madhèdi ètu era dhu kab'ua risi eele, ètu baboa g'ana na.

source_text: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.
target_text: nèngu dedha risi nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu rai-haha dènge ètu sorga. te nèngu dedha risi nèti koasa aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge dhu rèd'u paredha aa'i-aa'i ra. na kèpe koasa na dhu risi nèti aa'i-aa'i sèra, mesa boe doe ne'e ne di. te na nèd'u koasa ne taruu toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: he put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,
target_text: ama lamatua unu na ka dhu tao sèna ka aa'i-aa'i se pahaha iisi mi kristus. aa nèngu kahèi ded'e kristus j'aj'i kètu, sèna ka uri aa'i-aa'i dhu pa'èki dènge dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.
target_text: de ladhe na j'aj'i kètu, èdhi dhèu parcaya j'aj'i nuka sèmi ngi'u na. bèli-camèd'a èdhi ka dhu sab'a pa'èle aa'i mèu sasab'a dhu na pakako lod'o na ètu rai-haha ne era. te nèngu ka dènge koasa ho paj'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. lii sabaj'a ja'a sèmi ne'e ka hia miu.

source_text: you were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,
target_text: uru èèna, miu sisu paredha ama lamatua, aa ad'u-ue rupa-rupa sasala. nèti èèna ka lamatua peka na, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu madhe le.

source_text: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.
target_text: uru èèna, mamuri miu madhutu dad'èi rai-haha ne, dènge dad'èi dhèu aae nidhu. toke d'ai sange ne'e, nidhu loe boe dadugu-rariu dhèu rai-haha, sèna ka palab'a dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: we also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.
target_text: uru èèna, èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna kahèi, ka ngaa dhu èdhi rasa do, pangee do, èdhi tao madhutu dad'èi d'ara di. te èdhi dhèu bhelu, èci èèna ka dènge dhèu rai-haha aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka ama lamatua nasa titu kèna dènge èdhi,

source_text: but god, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us, even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with christ-by grace you have been saved-
target_text: aa pangee na, èdhi nuka sèmi dhèu madhe kahèi dhu cèri eele nèti nèngu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa d'ara na la'e boe lula na sue èdhi titu kèna. nèti èèna ka, na pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, aa pua yesus kristus mai sèna ka pala-bagi mamuri hiu hia èdhi. de lamatua ka dhu hia mamuri mi èdhi lula d'ara hua iia na.

source_text: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in christ jesus,
target_text: yesus kristus madhe, te ngaa ama lamatua pamamuri hari ne. hèia lamatua ded'e ne ho nèd'u paredha ètu sorga. lamatua tao sèmi èèna kahèi mi dedha èdhi, na pala-bagi mamuri hiu mi èdhi, hèia na ded'e èdhi, ka tèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge kristus ètu sorga.

source_text: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in christ jesus;
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mulai nèti doe ne'e, d'ai mia-mia la'e, ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara sasue na ae-ae, dènge d'ara hua iia na dhu risi aa'i èèna, lula èdhi parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of god, not of works, that no one would boast.
target_text: ropa miu parcaya kristus, ama lamatua hia miu mamuri, lula d'ara hua iia na. na hia mamuri sèmi èèna, baku pangee, na, nèngu b'ala ngaa dhu miu tao. lula mamuri èèna j'aj'i hadia dhu na hia iia d'ara mi miu. nèti èèna ka, miu baku padedha iisi nèti ngaa dhu miu tao.

source_text: for we are his workmanship, created in christ jesus for good works, which god prepared before that we would walk in them.
target_text: èdhi mamuri, lula ama lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i èdhi. hèia yesus kristus hia èdhi mamuri hiu, sèna ka èdhi tao j'ara-j'ara dhu be'a, dhu lamatua pama'ète nare le karèi nèti uru ka.

source_text: therefore remember that once you, the gentiles in the flesh, who are called uncircumcision by that which is called circumcision in the flesh, made by hands,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu me'a le, na, dhèu yahudi kèpe pa'èra-èra atora suna rèngu, aa ra pusi-pahae boe miu dhèu yahudi boe, lula mo'o boe madhutu atora èèna! madhutu iia-iia na, atora suna ne dhoka nèti ngi'u aae di, nèti boe d'ara dhèu.

source_text: that you were at that time separate from christ, alienated from the commonwealth of israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without god in the world.
target_text: lod'o miu dhae parcaya mèka yesus kristus, miu dènge mèka hak ho j'aj'i dhèu unu ama lamatua. te uru èèna, miu dhae maso mèka asa d'ara lii pajaji ama lamatua dhu na pa'èki tèke mi abraham, aa dènge ana-èpu na. lod'o èèna, miu mamuri ètu rai-haha, te ngaa bisa boe maena mi ama lamatua, lula miu j'aj'i dhèu leo rai kara era,

source_text: but now in christ jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of christ.
target_text: dhu cèri nèti lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, yesus kristus bhoke nare le j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa pa'èki dènge ama lamatua. te kristus madhe sèna ka cuhi d'ara lamatua, ho miu bisa padame dènge ne, aa bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: for he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,
target_text: uru èèna, ji'i dhèu yahudi ngo'o boe mamuri dame dènge miu dhèu leo rai kara. nuka sèmi kadidhi dhu hag'e eele èdhi. te ngaa lula mamadhe yesus ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, ka na paguri eele le kadidhi èèna, sèna ka èdhi dhu uru èèna pamusu, bisa padame hari ho j'aj'i mi ca suku.

source_text: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,
target_text: te uru èèna, dhèu yahudi tenge j'ara ho pake atora agama rèngu sèna ka pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. te ngaa ropa yesus kristus madhe, na pa'ele iie le j'ara dhui, aa bhoke j'ara hiu, sèna ka dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu leo kara, dua-dua ra bisa mamuri pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pa'èki j'aj'i mi ca suku dhu hiu, dhu mamuri mera-milu.

source_text: and might reconcile them both in one body to god through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.
target_text: de kristus madhe ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha sèna ka tao dua suku sèra j'aj'i mi èci, aa nèti hari si asa ama lamatua. te kristus palaho eele aa'i le ngaa dhu uru èèna tao rèngu ho pamusu.

source_text: he came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.
target_text: nèngu mai asa rai-haha ne, nèti lii lolo be'a hia dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu leo kara sèra, dhu lole na, uru èèna miu mamuri pamusu, te ngaa limuri ne abhu le j'ara sèna ka miu bisa mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: for through him we both have our access in one spirit to the father.
target_text: de ji'i dhèu yahudi dènge miu dhèu yahudi boe, aa'i-aa'i ti abhu j'ara ho lati asa ama lamatua èdhi, lula yesus bhoke le j'ara hia èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. aa roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci pad'elo j'ara mi èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti kahèi.

source_text: so then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of god,
target_text: lula pa'ue-ai yesus kristus, nèti èèna ka miu dhèu yahudi boe j'aj'i heka dhèu leo rai kara dhu dènge boe hak ngaa-ngaa. te limuri ne, miu unu le hak ho j'aj'i ana kabarai sorga, lula ama lamatua ded'e le miu j'aj'i ana-èpu na.

source_text: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, christ jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;
target_text: ne'e ne, nuka sèmi ama lamatua neo patitu èmu cue. na patitu hadhu dhu padhèdi uru, nuka yesus kristus. hèia na tao fanderen, nuka dhèu rèti lii padhai na dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha na. ka na padhèdi hadhu se pagod'o-god'o ètu dedha sèra aa'i-aa'i. hadhu se, nuka èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti dhu j'aj'i le ana-èpu na.

source_text: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the lord;
target_text: èmu ne titu èra bia, lula hadhu se dhu pagod'o si dènge be'a ètu dedha hadhu dhu padhèdi uru sèra. aa èmu èèna nèbhu-nèbhu asa kapai, ka dhèu lasi asa d'ara èmu èèna, sèna ka manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua.

source_text: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of god in the spirit.
target_text: de limuri ne, ama lamatua tao sèna ka miu dhèu yahudi boe kahèi j'aj'i nuka sèmi hadhu, sama-sama dènge ji'i dhèu yahudi. ama lamatua padhèdi pagod'o-god'o èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti, ho j'aj'i era pea roh na.

source_text: for this cause i, paul, am the prisoner of christ jesus on behalf of you gentiles,
target_text: lula ama lamatua hag'e boe dhèu yahudi dènge dhèu yahudi boe, nèti èèna ka na pua ja'a, paulus, ho lole lii lolo be'a yesus kristus dènge miu dhèu yahudi boe ètu d'ara kota epesus. ja'a pakako le sasab'a ja'a, toke ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho.

source_text: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of god which was given me toward you,
target_text: tatu miu me'a kahèi, na, ama lamatua pua-paleha ja'a mai, lula na neo pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu.

source_text: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as i wrote before in few words,
target_text: uru èèna, mema ama lamatua dhae peka mèka dènge dhèu rai-haha ne, lula-nèti ngaa dhu na pama'ète hia mi dhèu dhu yahudi boe. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu peka le dènge ja'a, j'ara ne aa'i-aa'i ra. aa ne'e ne, ja'a dhu suri pabab'a-bab'a le ètu sasuri ne hia miu.

source_text: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of christ,
target_text: ladhe miu baca mere, tatu miu bisa me'a kahèi dad'èi ama lamatua mi yesus kristus, dhu na bhoke hia ja'a.

source_text: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the spirit,
target_text: te uru èèna, dhèu rai-haha re'a mèka dad'èi na. te ngaa limuri ne, na pake le roh na, sèna ka peka dad'èi na mi dhèu rèti lii padhai na, dènge dhèu pajuu-paleha na.

source_text: that the gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in christ jesus through the good news,
target_text: te karèi nèti uru ka, ama lamatua pama'ète le sèmi ne'e: ladhe dhèu yahudi boe parcaya lii lolo be'a yesus kristus, rèngu bisa j'aj'i kahèi ana-ana ama lamatua, sama sèmi dhèu yahudi sèra. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti pa'a'ari le, aa èdhi sama-sama bisa abhu mèngi-nale nèti ama èdhi, ama lamatua.

source_text: of which i was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of god which was given me according to the working of his power.
target_text: ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na, ka hag'e nare ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na. aa na pangèd'u koasa na mi ja'a kahèi, sèna ka pakako sasab'a na.

source_text: to me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the gentiles the unsearchable riches of christ,
target_text: nèti dhèu unu lamatua aa'i-aa'i, ja'a ne haha d'ai seli. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa lamatua hag'e nare ja'a, ho pakako sasab'a na dhu kapai risi eele èèna. dad'èi na sèna ka ja'a lole dènge dhèu yahudi boe, lula-nèti d'ara hua iia yesus kristus dhu dènge boe too-lane.

source_text: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in god, who created all things through jesus christ,
target_text: te karèi nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i rai-haha ne, dad'èi na neo hia kristus mai èèna, dhu pahuni era. te ngaa limuri ne, nèngu neo, sèna ka ja'a lole dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i, ho ra re'a mèu dad'èi na èèna.

source_text: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of god might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,
target_text: te dad'èi na èèna, d'èlu-mèu risi eele. hèia nèngu neo pake dhèu unu na, ho pad'elo mamèu na mi koasa-koasa dhu leo, aa mi aa'i-aa'i dhu rèd'u paredha ètu dedha-liru.

source_text: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in christ jesus our lord.
target_text: lod'o dhu na paj'aj'i mèka rai-haha ne, nèngu pama'ète nare le neo bhoke j'ara ho patabuli eele dhèu rai-haha nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. nèti èèna ka, na pake kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, sèna ka tao madhutu sèmi èèna.

source_text: in him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi dhu parcaya yesus kristus, parluu heka madha'u padhai lii dènge ama lamatua. te nèngu dhu pakabhèle mema ai na, sèna ka sèmi nare èdhi lod'o mia èèna ka.

source_text: therefore i ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.
target_text: sanèd'e, ee! ja'a j'èra lula lalau-lalo'o miu dhèu yahudi boe. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa d'ara miu mage èra boe kahèi. ja'a pasae kore j'aj'èra ne, lula neo pa'èra miu ho sèmi mere babe'a na.

source_text: for this cause, i bow my knees to the father of our lord jesus christ,
target_text: lod'o dhu ja'a ngee kèdhi d'ara hua iia ama lamatua dhu risi eele èèna, hèia ja'a patitu kètu urutuu ho manèngi makasi.

source_text: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,
target_text: te a'ari aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha dènge ètu sorga unu dhoka ama èci di, nuka ama lamatua.

source_text: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his spirit in the inner person,
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a sèna ka na hia mèngi-nale ae-ae mi dedha miu, madhutu dad'èi d'ara na dhu hua iia risi èèna. aa ja'a manèngi kahèi ho na hia roh na, dènge koasa na, sèna ka pa'èra d'ara miu.

source_text: that christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,
target_text: ja'a manèngi ho yesus kristus pea ètu d'ara miu, lula miu parcaya ne taruu. aa ja'a sabaj'a kahèi sèna ka miu mamuri pa'èki dènge sasue na, nuka sèmi ana aaj'u asa èra, lula amo na maso marèma asa d'ara rai.

source_text: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth, and to know christ's love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of god.
target_text: ja'a sabaj'a kahèi ho miu dènge dhèu unu lamatua aa'i-aa'i bisa me'a mèu sasue kristus dhu dhèu rai-haha ne d'èu rare boe. te sasue ne, kapai titu kèna, taleo titu kèna, marèma titu kèna, aa ae titu kèna! ja'a sabaj'a kahèi sèna ka miu rasa sasue na, toke sasue ne maso papènu d'ara dènge mamuri miu.

source_text: now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,
target_text: koasa ama lamatua kapai titu kèna, risi aa'i nèti dhu èdhi manèngi dènge dhu èdhi bisa ngee. aa na pake koasa na dhu kapai aae èèna, ho sab'a ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: to him be the glory in the assembly and in christ jesus to all generations, forever and ever. amen.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi dhu pa'èki le dènge kristus, ti ded'e ne padedha-dedha! koa-kio ne taruu, mulai nèti doe ne'e, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. ne'e ka dhu lèke!

source_text: i therefore, the prisoner in the lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,
target_text: ja'a pakako le sasab'a lamatua ja'a, toke ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho. de limuri ne ja'a pamako miu, sèna ka mamuri mola madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, lula na paroa nare le miu, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i mamuri dènge pahaha iisi, aa pamaho'o èci dènge èci. miu hud'i taha mere d'ara, aa tadhe mèu èci dènge èci, ho mamuri pasue dhu tare'a. ladhe nèti miu, abhu dhu tenge lii langu dènge angalai na, baku tèka d'ara dènge ne kahèi.

source_text: being eager to keep the unity of the spirit in the bond of peace.
target_text: tenge j'ara ho muri dame èci dènge èci, lula roh ama lamatua dhu èki le miu j'aj'i mi èci.

source_text: there is one body and one spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,
target_text: te dhèu unu yesus kristus dhu j'aj'i le èci, nuka sèmi ngi'u kristus unu na. aa rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sèmi rare le roh lamatua dhu dhoka èci èèna di. aa rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sanao-maena dhoka mi ama lamatua di, lula nèngu ka dhu paroa nare si ho j'aj'i dhèu unu na.

source_text: one lord, one faith, one baptism,
target_text: lamatua èdhi, dhoka èci di; parcaya èdhi, dhoka ca j'ara di, sèna ka bisa padame dènge ne. aa èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti abhu sarani, sèna ka pa'èki dènge ne.

source_text: one god and father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.
target_text: ama lamatua, dhoka èci di, aa ama èdhi, dhoka nèngu di. dhoka nèngu di dhu paredha èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti. dhoka nèngu di dhu bera-bera dènge èdhi. aa nèngu mesa na di dhu mamuri ètu d'ara èdhi.

source_text: but to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of christ.
target_text: te ngaa yesus kristus pala-bagi le koasa na mi èdhi, sèna ka èdhi èci-èci ka pakako sasab'a na.

source_text: therefore he says, when he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.
target_text: nèti èèna ka sasuri ama lamatua, peka na, nèngu ca'e la'e asa era dedha, sèna ka na pamusu ètu èèna toke segi. hèia ère nèti dhèu ae-ae dhu lèke taha, aa papala hadia mi dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: now this, he ascended, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?
target_text: sanèd'e lii-lii dhu peka na, nèngu ca'e la'e. ladhe na ca'e la'e, sasoa na, uru èèna na puru nèdhi le asa rai-haha ne.

source_text: he who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.
target_text: de dhèu dhu puru mai èèna, nuka kristus. te nèngu ca'e hari asa sorga, sèna ka bisa uri aa'i dhu ètu dedha-liru dènge ètu rai-haha.

source_text: he gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;
target_text: kristus dhu pangèd'u koasa mi dhèu unu na, sèna ka ra pakako sasab'a-la'a dhu na pala-bagi hia rèngu. abhu cahag'e dhu na hia si koasa ho j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha na; cahag'e j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai na; cahag'e j'aj'i sèmi ca dhèu ama sa, ho lalau-lalo'o dhèu unu kristus; cahag'e j'aj'i dhèu d'èlu-mèu ho aj'a dhèu unu na; aa cahag'e hari j'aj'i dhèu dhu tema rèti lii lolo be'a asa era-era dhu hiu.

source_text: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of christ,
target_text: ca dhèu-dhèu ka sèmi rare sasab'a ra, sèna ka pa'èra dhèu-dhèu parcaya ho aa'i-aa'i ra bisa pakako sasab'a lamatua. dènge j'ara ne'e, èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti dhu parcaya yesus kristus asa tabha èra,

source_text: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the son of god, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of christ, that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;
target_text: toke èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti parcaya d'ara èci. aa èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti tadhe tare'a-re'a ana ama lamatua. èdhi sèmi heka ana iiki, lula èdhi madhutu mola-mola le j'ara nèngu, aa j'aj'i le dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu dad'èi na. ladhe èdhi mamuri ka sèmi èèna, èdhi sèmi heka koha dhu dènge boe uli, ka madhutu dhoka rii di. te ladhe dhèu kapod'e-kabèli mai aj'a pagoa èdhi, ra tao rare boe.

source_text: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, christ,
target_text: te ngaa èdhi dènge lii mako lole dhoka ngaa dhu lèke hia mi a'ari èdhi sèra, lula èdhi sue rèngu. aa ladhe èdhi mamuri sèmi èèna ètu d'ara ngaa èèna ka, èdhi j'aj'i ca ropa dènge kristus. te nèngu ne kètu èdhi dhu uri èdhi.

source_text: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.
target_text: aa èdhi j'aj'i nuka sèmi ngi'u na. sama sèmi ngi'u dhèu èci, dhu dènge musi madha, hèb'a, kacui-aai, aa haga, ladhe sab'a sama-sama madhutu sasab'a ra èci-èci, na, ngi'u na asa tabha èra. sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu unu yesus kristus sèra. ladhe èdhi pasue aa soru-bara èci dènge èci, tatu èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti asa tabha èra kahèi.

source_text: this i say therefore, and testify in the lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,
target_text: nanene paie-iie, ngaa dhu ja'a neo peka, lula kètu ja'a, yesus kristus ka dhu nori ja'a. miu mamuri ia ka sèmi dhèu dhu tadhe boe ama lamatua. lula ngaa dhu ra tao sèra madhutu dhoka gagoa ra.

source_text: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of god because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.
target_text: rèngu raga leli, nuka sèmi dhèu kako ètu d'ara maroga. ra mamuri pacèri nèti ama lamatua, lula ra kètu hadhu, aa pusi-pahae boe ne.

source_text: they, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.
target_text: rèngu re'a heka makae. nèti èèna ka, ra madhutu dhoka dad'èi d'ara ho ad'u-ue j'ara makae dènge mamuri kaj'alu. te ngaa re'a boe roca kahèi.

source_text: but you didn't learn christ that way,
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aj'a-nori boe miu j'ara mamuri kristus sèmi èèna!

source_text: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in jesus:
target_text: te, ngaa dhu miu me'a le lula-nèti yesus kristus, a'aj'a èèna ka dhu mola. tatu miu tadèngi le!

source_text: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,
target_text: de tèke eele j'ara mamuri miu dhu dhui èèna! te ladhe miu mamuri kaj'alu madhutu dad'èi dhèu rai-haha, na, miu dhu lèke le tipu. miu dènge heka hak mamuri sèmi uru èèna.

source_text: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,
target_text: te ngaa hud'i laa ama lamatua tao d'ara dènge ngangee miu j'aj'i hiu,

source_text: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of god has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.
target_text: ho miu j'aj'i dhèu hiu, madhutu ropa na. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pad'elo ku d'ara hiu miu, dhu mola-mèci dènge mera-milu.

source_text: therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.
target_text: de limuri ne, loe eele ka nèti kapod'e-kabèli! padhai lii èci dènge èci dhu mola, te èdhi dhu pa'èki le j'aj'i mi èci, nuka sèmi ngi'u èci dhu dènge musi madha, hèb'a, kacui-aai, aa dènge haga.

source_text: be angry, and don't sin. don't let the sun go down on your wrath,
target_text: ladhe nasa, baku ad'u sasala kahèi. hua iia miu pabe'a hari! baku tèke nanasa toke lod'o cèna!

source_text: and don't give place to the devil.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne, dhèu aae nidhu bisa boe dadugu-rariu miu. baku golo ne!

source_text: let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.
target_text: dhèu dhu d'èi mana'u, ae eele ka! be'a risi dhèu sèmi sèra sab'a pake kacui-aai unu ra, sèna ka rui-j'aj'èra na soru-bara dhèu dhu unu aad'o sèra.

source_text: let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
target_text: ladhe padhai lii, na, baku hia lii karehe, masi ka ca hèb'a doko-doko di! hua iia risi padhai lii dhu be'a di. aa holo dhèu sèna ka ra soru-bara dènge be'a, aa pa'èra d'ara si.

source_text: don't grieve the holy spirit of god, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.
target_text: baku papèd'a d'ara roh ama lamatua, te nèngu pea ètu d'ara miu. aa na cap nare miu, peka na, miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu ama lamatua. roh na j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, toke d'ai èle rai-haha ne, ama lamatua sui nare miu, sèna ka mamuri taruu dènge ne.

source_text: let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.
target_text: de baku tèka d'ara dènge dhèu leo! bqku kadhi ngutu dènge dhèu! baku panasa! baku patao-palaha! baku padhai kakoli pa'ele iie kolongara dhèu! aa baku ad'u-ue j'ara bhabhelu dhu leo-leo hèi!

source_text: and be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as god also in christ forgave you.
target_text: te ngaa be'a risi mi pasue, aa tao j'ara dhu be'a èci dènge èci. miu hud'i pabhèlu eele ku sasala dhèu, aa hia si abho, sama sèmi ama lamatua saku eele sasala miu, lula miu pa'èki le dènge kristus.

source_text: be therefore imitators of god, as beloved children.
target_text: miu ana pasue ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i madhutu ku dad'èi na.

source_text: walk in love, even as christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to god for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
target_text: aa miu hud'i mamuri pasue ku èci dènge èci, sama sèmi kristus sue miu. te na soro le ngi'u na, ho madhe gati èdhi. dènge j'ara ne'e, nèngu j'aj'i nuka sèmi badha sogo-tagu dhu ra tunu ka hèu mèngi, sèna ka pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua.

source_text: but sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;
target_text: miu dhèu mola-mèci unu ama lamatua kahèi. de baku mamuri dènge d'ara kaj'alu! baku ngee madha j'ara kaj'alu kahèi! de baku tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali èu! baku manga'a dèu ngara!

source_text: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.
target_text: baku padhai lii kaj'alu! aa baku padhai lii leli! te dhèu unu ama lamatua, ladhe padhai lii sèmi sèra, lèke boe. hua iia risi miu padhai lii be'a aa manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the kingdom of christ and god.
target_text: sanèd'e paie-iie! te ama lamatua nare boe dhèu dhu mamuri kaj'alu, aa dhèu dhu tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali nèngu! rèngu bisa boe j'aj'i dhèu unu kristus, aa ama lamatua j'aj'i boe dhèu aae rèngu. ama lamatua sèmi nare boe kahèi dhèu dhu manga'a dèu ngara, lula rèngu seti eele ne, ka ra pakab'ua risi j'ara dhu leo sèra.

source_text: let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of god comes on the children of disobedience.
target_text: mage dhèu pagoa miu dènge padhai lii hèb'a hua, peka na, mamuri kaj'alu ciki di, ngaa-ngaa tao boe, we! te tatu ama lamatua nasa mi dhèu dhu mamuri madhutu boe dad'èi na.

source_text: therefore don't be partakers with them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, baku pa'èki ngi'u dènge dhèu sèmi sèra.

source_text: for you were once darkness, but are now light in the lord. walk as children of light,
target_text: uru èèna, miu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga, lula miu tadhe mèka ama lamatua. te ngaa limuri ne, na hia le saraa, sèna ka tao miu j'aj'i ana-ana na. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i mamuri ètu d'ara saraa na.

source_text: for the fruit of the spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,
target_text: te dhèu dhu mamuri taruu ètu d'ara saraa, dhèu ne tao j'ara dhu be'a, mamuri mola, aa leko-monya boe.

source_text: proving what is well pleasing to the lord.
target_text: tenge taruu j'ara ho pakarej'e d'ara ama lamatua, lula nèngu ne dhèu aae èdhi.

source_text: have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
target_text: baku pa'èki ngi'u dènge dhèu dhu mamuri ètu d'ara maroga. te tatao ra, gaguna aad'o. de mi pasanèd'e si, aa bhoke paled'a sasala-sasigo ra.

source_text: for it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.
target_text: te, ngaa dhu ra ad'u-ue pahuni-pacub'i, kaj'alu titu kèna, toke èdhi makae, ladhe neo padhai lii j'ara-j'ara sèra.

source_text: but all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.
target_text: ja'a pakasame sèmi ne'e: ladhe dhèu d'elo mèdha èci ètu d'ara maroga, tatu dhèu bisa rèdhi mèu.

source_text: therefore he says, awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and christ will shine on you.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ladhe èdhi peka paled'a j'ara bhelu dhu dhèu ad'u-ue, nèngu bisa ne'a, na, j'ara dhu na ad'u-ue ne, karehe. abhu lii sod'a èci, peka na, wee! miu dhu bhèj'i, kèd'i ka! miu dhu madhe, mamuri hari ka! te kristus neo hia saraa mi miu.

source_text: therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu èci-èci parisa paie mamuri mi, sèna ka baku sèmi dhèu goa. be'a risi pake ngangee dhu be'a nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
target_text: limuri ne dhèu loe boe tao j'ara-j'ara bhabhelu. de ladhe abhu lod'o tao j'ara dhu be'a, na baku pamata!

source_text: therefore, don't be foolish, but understand what the will of the lord is.
target_text: pangee paie-iie, ho me'a mèu dad'èi lamatua èdhi, sèna ka baku mi goa.

source_text: don't be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the spirit,
target_text: baku mahu, te, ngaa dhu miu minu èèna ka dhu uli miu, sèna ka tao j'ara dhu karehe. te ngaa bhoke d'ara miu, sèna ka roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci èèna ka dhu uli miu.

source_text: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the lord;
target_text: de padhai lii èci dènge èci pake lii holo-nori ama lamatua, mèti lii koa-kio mi nèngu, aa mèti lii sod'a dhu miu abhu nèti roh mola-mèci na. aa ladhe sod'a, baku dhoka ètu hèb'a di, te ngaa koa-kio ama lamatua dènge d'ara kateme.

source_text: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our lord jesus christ to god, even the father;
target_text: te yesus kristus j'aj'i le kètu èdhi, aa ama lamatua dhu tao le j'ara-j'ara ae titu kèna hia èdhi. nèti èèna ka, èdhi baku loe manèngi makasi mi lamatua.

source_text: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of christ.
target_text: miu aa'i-aa'i mi, hud'i mamuri èci nanene èci. dènge j'ara ne'e, miu pakab'ua yesus kristus.

source_text: wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the lord.
target_text: bhèni dhu dènge dhèu èmu! miu hud'i mamuri nanene dhèu èmu mi, sama sèmi miu nanene yesus kristus, kètu miu.

source_text: for the husband is the head of the wife, as christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.
target_text: te dhèu èmu miu èèna, nuka sèmi kètu nèti miu bhèni se. aa yesus kristus kahèi j'aj'i kètu nèti dhèu unu na. te nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara ho dhèu abhu mamuri.

source_text: but as the assembly is subject to christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, dhèu unu kristus hud'i mamuri nanene paie-iie nèngu. de sèmi èèna kahèi, bhèni dhu dènge dhèu èmu, hud'i nanene pabe'a-be'a ku dhèu èmu na, ètu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: husbands, love your wives, even as christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,
target_text: mone dhu dènge le dhèu èmu, sèmi èèna kahèi! miu hud'i sue dhèu èmu miu, èci èèna ka dènge kristus sue dhèu unu na, toke na soro ngi'u na, sèna ka madhe gati rèngu.

source_text: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,
target_text: nèngu tao sèmi èèna ka, ho rèngu j'aj'i mola-mèci ètu madha ama lamatua, lula rèngu madhutu le lii holo-nori na, aa sarani le.

source_text: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.
target_text: dhèu unu yesus kristus èci èèna ka dènge bhèni dhu neo kab'i dhu pagaa iisi na, te dhèu mone dhu neo kab'i èèna neo mai nare ne. sama sèmi èèna kahèi, kristus neo mai nare dhèu unu na sèra. nèti èèna ka, rèngu hud'i mamuri dènge be'a aa mola-mèci, toke abhu boe sasala ciki sa.

source_text: even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. he who loves his own wife loves himself.
target_text: èci èèna kahèi dènge mone dhu dènge dhèu èmu! miu hud'i sue ku dhèu èmu mi, nuka sèmi miu sue ngi'u miu mesa mi. te ladhe dhèu mone sue dhèu èmu na, sasoa na, nèngu sue ngi'u nèngu unu na.

source_text: for no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the lord also does the assembly,
target_text: abhu boe dhèu dhu sue boe ngi'u na. te ngaa na lalau-lalo'o ngi'u na pabe'a-be'a, sèmi yesus ladhe-leru dhèu unu na paie-iie,

source_text: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.
target_text: lula èdhi nuka sèmi ngi'u nèngu.

source_text: for this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. then the two will become one flesh.
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci suri, peka na, nèti èèna ka, dhèu mone hud'i tèke eele ku ina-ama na, ho la'e mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu èmu-kamali na, te dua ra j'aj'i le èci.

source_text: this mystery is great, but i speak concerning christ and the assembly.
target_text: te mamuri pasue dhèu èmu-kamali ne, lamatua bhoke le ètu d'ara lii holo-nori na nèti uru ka mai. j'ara ne'e ne, ka dhu kapai. te ngaa limuri ne, èdhi te'a kahèi, na, lii holo-nori ne pad'elo sasue kristus mi dhèu unu na sèra.

source_text: nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.
target_text: de dhèu mone hud'i sue ku dhèu èmu na, nuka sèmi sue ngi'u nèngu unu na. aa dhèu bhèni hud'i pakab'ua ku dhèu èmu na.

source_text: children, obey your parents in the lord, for this is right.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi ana-ana! miu hud'i mamuri nanene ku ina-ama mi, te èèna ka dhu pamèci dènge dad'èi d'ara lamatua èdhi.

source_text: honor your father and mother, which is the first commandment with a promise:
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, suri tèke le, peka na, èu hud'i pakab'ua ku ina dènge ama mu. ne'e ne lii paredha ama lamatua dhu uru tèka, dhu dènge lii pajaji.

source_text: that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.
target_text: te lod'o lamatua hia paredha èèna, nèngu moa kahèi, peka na, ladhe èu tao madhutu sèmi èèna, pe èu abhu mèngi-nale ae-ae, aa mamuri èu madhii-manèro.

source_text: you fathers, don't provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the lord.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, ina-ama sèra! miu baku ènyi aa lii taka leli ana-ana miu, te aad'o na, ra nasa ka ra parui. be'a risi miu lalau-lalo'o si paie-iie, aa nori si nèti ana iiki mai ho madhutu j'ara lamatua. ladhe ra tao sala, nori si dènge be'a madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to christ,
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge dhèu-dhèu sab'a! miu hud'i madha'u ku dènge lamatua dhu paredha miu ètu rai-haha ne, aa nanene ne. baku sab'a dènge d'ara cabèka, te ngaa madhutu dad'èi lamatua dènge d'ara kateme, nuka sèmi miu madhutu dad'èi kristus dènge be'a.

source_text: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of christ, doing the will of god from the heart,
target_text: te miu dhèu sab'a unu kristus. de ètu rai-haha ne miu baku sad'i sab'a di, lula lamatua dhu ladhe miu. te ngaa sab'a dènge d'ara maj'èni hia lamatua mi, masi ka nèngu aad'o ètu madha. te èèna ka dhu madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: with good will doing service as to the lord and not to men,
target_text: de sab'a sasab'a miu dènge d'ara kateme hia lamatua miu ètu rai-haha ne, nuka sèmi miu sab'a hia ama lamatua, kètu èdhi.

source_text: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the lord, whether he is bound or free.
target_text: lula èdhi te'a, na, bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua b'ala hia dhèu dhu tao j'ara be'a. masi ka rèngu dhèu sab'a do, lamatua do, ènu do, ènu boe do, nèngu b'ala aa'i mèu-mèu si.

source_text: you masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua sèra! baku miu j'ege pamadha'u leli dhèu dhu sab'a hia miu sèra. te rèngu dènge lamatua ètu sorga kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge miu. ama lamatua ladhe boe rèhu dhèu, te ngaa na nanene dhèu cee èèna ka. masi ka lamatua do, dhèu sab'a do, na nanene si aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: finally, be strong in the lord and in the strength of his might.
target_text: nanene pabe'a-be'a lii padhai ja'a dhu limuri tèka ne. miu hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra ku parcaya miu mi ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka kètu miu, aa koasa na dhu dedha risi eele aa'i si. èèna na dhu bisa pa'èra miu!

source_text: put on the whole armor of god, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
target_text: sordad'u dènge rèka ho lab'a musu ra. sèmi èèna kahèi, lamatua neo pake miu sèmi sordad'u. te nèngu neo miu lab'a aa'i j'ara-j'ara bhelu-katub'a dhu dhèu aae nidhu ad'u-ue. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pa'èra ku, sèna ka pake aa'i rèka nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: for our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world's rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.
target_text: te èdhi ètu d'ara pamusu! èdhi lab'a boe musu dhèu rai-haha, te ngaa èdhi lab'a koasa bhabhelu dhu èdhi tèdhi boe, lab'a dhu rèd'u paredha, lab'a koasa maroga, aa lab'a j'ara-j'ara bhelu-katub'a.

source_text: therefore put on the whole armor of god, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.
target_text: de miu hud'i pa'èra pake rèka aa'i-aa'i nèti ama lamatua sèna ka bèli-camèd'a, ropa d'ai lod'o-lod'o bhabhelu-katub'a, miu bisa lab'a taruu. te ladhe miu taha, miu bisa segi.

source_text: stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,
target_text: de miu hud'i titu pa'èra-èra! parcaya dhoka lii holo-nori lamatua dhu lèke, te èèna nuka sèmi miu dhu bori dhari hake sordad'u. mamuri mola, te èèna sama sèmi miu silu kodho bèsi pa'abhe kakara.

source_text: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the good news of peace,
target_text: pa'èra ho lami peka-padhai lii lolo be'a dhu pad'elo j'ara, sèna ka dhèu bisa mamuri padame dènge ama lamatua, te èci èèna ka dènge miu pake salapa sordad'u.

source_text: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.
target_text: parcaya taruu mi lamatua, te parcaya èèna sama sèmi mèdha èci dhu sordad'u pake ho sili iisi nèti rèka musu. dènge parcaya sèmi èèna, miu bisa pamadhe ai ètu isi kataki nidhu bhelu, dhu ra siri mi miu.

source_text: and take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the spirit, which is the word of god;
target_text: kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka miu dhu peka na, miu unu le mamuri nèti ama lamatua, te èèna sèmi sordad'u pake solo bèsi. kèpe pa'èra-èra lii holo-nori ama lamatua nèti roh na dhu mola-mèci, te èèna sama sèmi sordad'u dhu kèpe samala.

source_text: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.
target_text: ladhe miu neo titu èra, na, miu baku loe sabaj'a pake koasa nèti roh mola-mèci ama lamatua. j'aga taruu aa baku bhèlu sabaj'a hia dhèu unu lamatua buli mia-mia.

source_text: pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the good news,
target_text: aa baku bhèlu kahèi sabaj'a hia ja'a. manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua hia kahèi lii holo-nori na, sèna ka ja'a bisa peka mola-mola naneo na mi dhèu leo.

source_text: for which i am an ambassador in chains; that in it i may speak boldly, as i ought to speak.
target_text: masi ka ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho, te ngaa lamatua yesus pua-paleha ja'a, sèna ka j'aj'i mi ai g'ana nèngu. de sabaj'a hia ja'a, ho ja'a baku madha'u padhai dhu lèke, te èèna ka dhu j'aj'i sasab'a-la'a ja'a!

source_text: but that you also may know my affairs, how i am doing, tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the lord, will make known to you all things.
target_text: ja'a d'èi sèna ka miu me'a mèu mamuri ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pua tikikus dhiu asa miu. nèngu ne, a'ari pasue ja'a, aa na maj'èni pakako sasab'a kètu èdhi, yesus kristus.

source_text: i have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.
target_text: hud'i laa na lole j'ara-j'ara mamuri èdhi ètu ne'e. aa ja'a neo, sèna ka na pa'èra d'ara miu kahèi.

source_text: peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from god the father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a manèngi ama èdhi, ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, ho tao miu mamuri padame èci dènge èci, aa pasue èci dènge èci, lula miu parcaya mi rèngu.

source_text: grace be with all those who love our lord jesus christ with incorruptible love. amen.
target_text: ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i kahèi, sèna ka kètu èdhi, kristus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sue ne taruu. sasuri ja'a, d'ai sange ne'e ka. saloom, paulus

source_text: paul and timothy, servants of jesus christ, to all the saints in christ jesus who are at philippi, with the overseers and servants:
target_text: sasuri ne, nèti ja'a, paulus. aa angalai ja'a, timotius pa'adhu hia miu lii maho'o kahèi. ji'i dua mi se, ana sab'a nèti yesus kristus. ji'i pa'adhu sasuri ne, hia mi dhèu unu ama lamatua dhu parcaya yesus kristus ètu kota pilipi. ji'i neo kahèi, ho dhèu dhu j'aj'i kètu juma'at dènge dhèu dhu soru-bara kètu juma'at sèra, re'a mèu isi sasuri ne'e.

source_text: grace to you and peace from god our father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ama lamatua èèna, ama èdhi. aa yesus kristus èèna, kètu èdhi. ji'i manèngi sèna ka rèngu pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi miu, ho bisa mamuri dènge mera-milu.

source_text: i thank my god whenever i remember you,
target_text: masi ka nèbhu le ja'a paraga heka dènge miu, te ngaa ja'a bhèlu boe miu! lod'o-lod'o ja'a sanèd'e miu, ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula miu parcaya ne taruu.

source_text: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,
target_text: lod'o ja'a sabaj'a hia miu, d'ara ja'a karej'e-karae,

source_text: for your partnership in furtherance of the good news from the first day until now;
target_text: lula karèi nèti hiu-hiu miu sèmi mere lii lolo be'a lamatua, miu pakako taruu sasab'a na, sama-sama dènge ja'a.

source_text: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of jesus christ.
target_text: èèna j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, ama lamatua mulai sab'a ètu d'ara miu kèna. aa ja'a ke'a tare'a, na, lamatua pakako taruu sasab'a na dhu be'a èèna, toke pamèci aa'i mèu-mèu, toke d'ai lod'o yesus kristus mai hari.

source_text: it is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because i have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the good news, you all are partakers with me of grace.
target_text: mema lèke tare'a ladhe ja'a sue miu, lula d'ara ja'a dhu pa'èki le dènge miu karèi nèti uru ka. ca hari nèi, miu sab'a le bera-bera dènge ja'a, lod'o ja'a lole dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a lamatua, aa ropa ja'a dhaa mi dhèu dhu lab'a lii lolo be'a èèna. masi ka ja'a maso bui, te ngaa miu hari boe nèti baboa ja'a.

source_text: for god is my witness, how i long after all of you in the tender mercies of christ jesus.
target_text: ama lamatua dhu ne'a, na, d'ara ja'a neo taruu paraga dènge miu. te sasue ja'a mi dedha miu, èci èèna ka dènge sasue yesus kristus.

source_text: this i pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment, so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of christ,
target_text: de ja'a sabaj'a hia miu sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a manèngi ho miu asa tabha pasue èci dènge èci. ja'a manèngi kahèi sèna ka ama lamatua hia miu me'a mèu, mia dhu be'a, sèna ka miu mamuri mola-mèci. pe d'ai lod'o kristus pama'ète lii langu dhèu aa'i-aa'i, na peka na, miu sala boe ngaa-ngaa,

source_text: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through jesus christ, to the glory and praise of god.
target_text: lula nèngu mesa na ka dhu tao d'ara miu mola-mèci, ho bisa mamuri mola. dènge mamuri mola sèmi èèna ka, dhèu leo ded'e padedha-dedha aa koa-kio kolongara ama lamatua.

source_text: now i desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the good news,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! ja'a d'èi sèna ka miu me'a, na, abhu dhèu dhu pasusa ja'a, toke pamaso ja'a asa d'ara bèdho. te ngaa te'a boe, na, lii lolo be'a lamatua pale-lème le ètu mia-mia,

source_text: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in christ,
target_text: toke sordad'u dhu madhenga èmu dhèu aae, dènge dhèu leo aa'i-aa'i re'a, na, ja'a maso bui lula madhutu yesus kristus.

source_text: and that most of the brothers in the lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of god without fear.
target_text: ka dhèu unu ama lamatua ètu se'e se rèdhi, na, lamatua ka dhu tao j'ara èèna lod'o ja'a ètu d'ara bui ne. nèti èèna ka, rèngu asa tabha bani, toke re'a heka madha'u. hèia ra padhai paled'a-led'a lii holo-nori lamatua ètu mia-mia.

source_text: some indeed preach christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will. the former insincerely preach christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains; but the latter out of love, knowing that i am appointed for the defense of the good news.
target_text: ètu ne'e abhu dua rupa dhèu dhu maj'èni aj'a j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti kristus. nèti èèna ka, abhu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara mola, aa abhu dhu sab'a dènge d'ara koe-kapengo. dhu sab'a dènge d'ara mola, rèngu be'a dènge ja'a. dhèu se re'a mèu, na, ja'a dui sasusa ne, lula pakako sasab'a ja'a, dhu hari boe kabodho ciki sa. te ngaa dhu sab'a dènge d'ara koe-kapengo, d'èi boe dhèu risi nèti rèngu aa tenge kolongara di. rèngu pamae-pamanyèla dhèu-dhèu parcaya, sad'i abhu dhèu dhu madhutu ra. te ra tenge j'ara ho bisa padedha iisi ra, peka na, rèngu risi ja'a. rèngu pangee, na, ladhe abhu dhèu dhu madhutu rèngu, èèna na asa tabha paj'èra ja'a ètu d'ara bui.

source_text: what does it matter? only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, christ is proclaimed. i rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.
target_text: te ngaa hud'i rèngu sène! ja'a pusi-pahae boe, ladhe dhèu aj'a dènge d'ara mola, do aad'o. sad'i dhu rèngu aj'a, dhoka lula-nèti yesus kristus di! èèna ka dhu pakarej'e d'ara ja'a. aa ja'a karej'e tare'a-re'a,

source_text: for i know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the spirit of jesus christ,
target_text: lula ja'a ke'a, na, miu sabaj'a hia ja'a, aa roh yesus kristus dhu soru-bara ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a ke'a, na, lèpa lod'o limuri, aa'i-aa'i se èle dènge sod'a-mole!

source_text: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that i will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.
target_text: masi ka ja'a muri do, madhe do, ngaa-ngaa tao boe. sad'i ama lamatua pake ja'a, sèna ka ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara yesus kristus, aa aj'a mola-mola lula-nèti nèngu, toke abhu boe ngaa èci sa dhu pamakae ja'a. se'e se ka dhu ja'a sanao karèi nèti uru, toke doe ne'e ne.

source_text: for to me to live is christ, and to die is gain. but if i live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet i don't know what i will choose. but i am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with christ, which is far better.
target_text: te ja'a pangee sèmi ne'e ka: ladhe ja'a mamuri, na, hud'i laa pa'èki dènge kristus, aa pakako taruu sasab'a-la'a na. èèna ka dhu be'a. te ngaa ladhe ja'a madhe, ja'a oto risi hari, lula ja'a tèke eele rai-haha ne, aa mamuri hari ho pea pa'èci dènge kristus ètu sorga. nèti èèna ka, d'ara ja'a kajari, aa ke'a boe mia ka dhu be'a risi eele!

source_text: yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e ka laa! lula miu parluu ja'a era ètu ne'e, be'a risi ja'a pea pa'èci dènge miu ètu rai-haha ne.

source_text: having this confidence, i know that i will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
target_text: ja'a ke'a, na, mamuri ja'a madhera era, sèna ka paraga hari dènge miu. te lamatua neo ho ja'a pa'èra d'ara miu, hèia miu asa lèka ne dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: that your boasting may abound in christ jesus in me through my presence with you again.
target_text: de bèli-camèd'a miu ded'e padedha-dedha kolongara yesus kristus, lula na bhoke le j'ara sèna ka ja'a lèpa pa'asu-pareo hari dènge miu.

source_text: only let your way of life be worthy of the good news of christ, that whether i come and see you or am absent, i may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the good news; and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from god.
target_text: masi ka tasa mera mia, mamuri miu hud'i lèke ku, te miu dhèu unu lamatua. de miu hud'i mamuri dhu mèci ku, aa tao madhutu lii lolo be'a yesus kristus dhu peka le dènge miu. aa ladhe bèli-camèd'a ja'a lèpa hari dhiu pangad'o dènge miu, do tadèngi dhoka lii nèti dhèu di, peka na, miu mamuri mola, na, d'ara ja'a karej'e. te ja'a bisa ke'a, na, miu dhu mamuri d'ara èci, lula pa'èki dènge roh èci di. aa bisa ke'a, na, miu pa'èra ho pakako sama-sama lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus, sèna ka dhèu leo parcaya kahèi. aa miu me'a boe madha'u kahèi, masi ka abhu dhèu dhu lab'a miu. ne'e ne j'aj'i mi tadha hia musu, na, ama lamatua neo lalèta eele si. te ngaa ama lamatua hia miu mamuri, ho bèli-camèd'a miu mamuri taruu dènge nèngu.

source_text: because it has been granted to you on behalf of christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,
target_text: te, lula ama lamatua d'ara hua iia risi, nèti èèna ka na bhoke le j'ara, sèna ka miu bisa parcaya kristus, aa j'aj'i dhèu unu na. mesa boe parcaya di, te ngaa lamatua soro tèke miu abhu sasusa kahèi, lula miu madhutu nèngu.

source_text: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.
target_text: te dhu ja'a tadèngi, abhu dhèu ètu sèra dhu lab'a miu, lula miu pakako lii lolo be'a kristus. sanèd'e, te ca hari ni rèngu lab'a le ja'a kahèi, toke d'ai doe ne'e ne.

source_text: if therefore there is any exhortation in christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i, unu yesus kristus! na pangèd'u le miu j'ara be'a ae-ae. de miu bisa pa'èra d'ara èci dènge èci. miu bisa holo dhu mai nèti sasue miu. miu bisa mamuri pabe'a èci dènge èci, lula roh lamatua dhu sab'a ètu talora aae miu. aa miu bisa pad'elo rasa kasia miu dènge d'ara be'a èci dènge èci.

source_text: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;
target_text: ladhe miu tao sèmi èèna, na, d'ara ja'a karej'e kea rae-rae. risi-risi hari, ladhe miu pasue dènge d'ara èci, mamuri ètu ca j'ara, aa mere lii èci ètu d'ara sasab'a-la'a.

source_text: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;
target_text: baku tao ngaa-ngaa dhu tenge dhoka pa'oto ngi'u èu risi nèti dhèu leo. aa baku pangee, na, èu risi nèti dhèu leo. te pamone do pabhèni èu èèna, dènge boe kolo-kapua. te ngaa èdhi hud'i pahaha iisi ku, sèna ka te'a, na, dhèu leo risi nèti èdhi.

source_text: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.
target_text: aa baku dhoka uri mamuri miu mesa-mesa mi. te ngaa èdhi hud'i ladhe kahèi, ngaa dhu dhèu leo parluu.

source_text: have this in your mind, which was also in christ jesus,
target_text: te d'ara èdhi hud'i sama ku sèmi d'ara yesus kristus.

source_text: who, existing in the form of god, didn't consider equality with god a thing to be grasped,
target_text: masi ka nèngu ca ropa dènge ama lamatua, aa nèngu kètu èdhi kahèi, èci èèna ka dènge ama lamatua, te ngaa na tèke eele hak na, aa pake boe dadedha dènge kapai na.

source_text: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.
target_text: hèia na puru mai asa rai-haha ne, ca ropa dènge dhèu rai-haha. na tèke eele hak na aa'i-aa'i, sèna ka tao iisi na j'aj'i nuka sèmi ènu sa.

source_text: and being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.
target_text: mesa boe j'aj'i dhèu haha d'ai seli di, te ngaa na tao ngi'u na j'aj'i dhèu dhu laku-laku boe kahèi, sèna ka tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. masi ka ra pamadhe ne ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, na sèmi nare kahèi, aa madhe, nuka sèmi dhèu bhelu.

source_text: therefore god also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,
target_text: lula nèngu pahaha iisi sèmi èèna, nèti èèna ka ama lamatua ded'e ne padedha-dedha. aa pangèd'u ne ngara dhu kapai aae. te abhu boe ngara èci sa dhu kapai aae risi nèti nèngu.

source_text: that at the name of jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,
target_text: ama lamatua ded'e padedha-dedha ngara na èèna, sèna ka dhèu aa'i-aa'i pakab'ua ne. nuka: dhèu ètu dedha-liru, dènge dhèu ètu rai-haha ne. dhèu mamuri dènge dhèu madhe. bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i patitu kètu urutuu, ho pahaha iisi mi nèngu.

source_text: and that every tongue should confess that jesus christ is lord, to the glory of god the father.
target_text: aa bèli-camèd'a dhèu aa'i-aa'i peka na, yesus kristus èèna, tare'a-re'a lamatua! dènge sèmi èèna, rèngu koa-kio ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: so then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
target_text: a'ari pasue aa'i-aa'i! nanene paie-iie! uru èèna, lod'o ja'a pea ètu kota pilipi era, miu nanene lii padhai ja'a, ka miu madhutu j'ara mola ama lamatua. limuri ne, èdhi pahag'a, te ngaa ja'a manèngi ho miu titu èra ètu d'ara mamuri mola. sanèd'e, te ladhe miu nanene boe nèngu, bèli-camèd'a pe mèdhi unu mi! lula nèngu ka dhu patalale miu nèti koasa sasala-sasigo mi. hèia miu mamuri dhu mèci, te miu j'aj'i le dhèu unu na.

source_text: for it is god who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.
target_text: te ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu sab'a ètu d'ara miu. nèngu ka dhu bhoke j'ara, sèna ka miu neo nanene ne. aa nèngu ka dhu hia koasa kahèi, ho miu d'èi sab'a pakarej'e d'ara na.

source_text: do all things without complaining and arguing,
target_text: de ladhe sad'i miu tao ngaa èèna ka, na, baku ka'uu-kamuki, aa baku pasibha d'ara lii.

source_text: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of god without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,
target_text: tao sèmi èèna, sèna ka miu j'aj'i dhèu dhu d'ara mola-mèci, aa dhèu dhu dènge boe sasala. miu mamuri ètu d'ara talora aae dhèu bhelu dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli. te ngaa baku madhutu si! te mamuri miu hud'i mola-mèci ku, lula miu ana-ana lamatua. hèia mamuri miu hud'i heo ku, ho pad'elo j'ara hia rèngu, nuka sèmi hua-hètu dhu pasaraa ètu d'ara maroga.

source_text: holding up the word of life, that i may have something to boast in the day of christ that i didn't run in vain nor labor in vain.
target_text: hèia miu mamuri mola dènge pakako lii holo-nori lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, bèli-camèd'a miu tao d'ara ja'a kea rae-rae, lod'o yesus kristus lèpa hari mai. aa rui-j'aj'èra ja'a core eele boe iia d'ara, te ngaa dènge kab'ua.

source_text: yes, and if i am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, i am glad and rejoice with you all. in the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe sèmi ja'a dutu pa'èle aa'i mèu-mèu mamuri ja'a, ho j'aj'i nuka sèmi korban èi anggor, sèna ka miu bisa parcaya asa èra, aa pakako sasab'a lamatua, ja'a sèmi kore mamadhe dènge karej'e. èèna nuka sèmi ama agama tiko èi anggor ètu mei korban, ho pahaha iisi mi lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, èdhi bisa sama-sama karej'e, lula korban ne, iia d'ara boe.

source_text: but i hope in the lord jesus to send timothy to you soon, that i also may be cheered up when i know how you are doing.
target_text: ja'a sanao, nèbhu heka, lamatua yesus bhoke j'ara, ho ja'a pua timotius dhiu, sèna ka na pa'èra d'ara miu. èle èèna, na lèpa hari mai sa ne'e, ho na lolo dènge ja'a kakako miu, aa pakarej'e d'ara ja'a.

source_text: for i have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.
target_text: ja'a pua boe dhèu leo, dhoka timotius di, lula nèngu ne d'ara èci dènge ja'a. aa na sue tare'a-re'a miu.

source_text: for they all seek their own, not the things of jesus christ.
target_text: nèngu ne, sama boe dènge a'ari dhu leo sèra. te rèngu sèra pangee dhoka ngi'u rèngu unu ra, te ngaa uri boe ngaa-ngaa dhu pamèci hia yesus kristus.

source_text: but you know that he has proved himself. as a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the good news.
target_text: te ngaa miu me'a le, na, timotius sab'a d'ai madhe, pakako sasab'a ama lamatua. na sab'a dènge ja'a nuka sèmi ana dhu sab'a hia ama na. ji'i dua mi la'a peka-padhai lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus ètu mia-mia.

source_text: therefore i hope to send him at once, as soon as i see how it will go with me.
target_text: ladhe rèngu pama'ète rare ku lii langu ja'a, ja'a heka pua timotius dhiu asa miu kèna.

source_text: but i trust in the lord that i myself also will come shortly.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, lamatua pa'èra d'ara ja'a, na, nèbhu heka ja'a bisa dhiu paraga dènge miu.

source_text: but i thought it necessary to send to you epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ja'a ètu d'ara j'aj'èra era, miu pua a'ari èdhi epaproditus mai ladhe-leru ja'a. na pakako sasab'a lamatua sama-sama dènge ja'a, nuka sèmi ca dhèu sordad'u dhu maj'èni madhutu paredha komedhaa na. te ngaa ne'e ne, ja'a neo pua na lèpa hari asa miu.

source_text: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.
target_text: te d'ara na neo ae le nèdhi miu. aa na ngee miu, lula ne'a, na, miu tadèngi le nèngu dhu pèd'a.

source_text: for indeed he was sick nearly to death, but god had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that i might not have sorrow on sorrow.
target_text: mema lèke tare'a. ca hari ni, na pèd'a aae oe madhe. te ngaa ama lamatua sue ne, aa lamatua sue ja'a kahèi, ka na puri-pa'èle epaproditus, sèna ka ja'a baku asa susa.

source_text: i have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that i may be the less sorrowful.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, ja'a neo pua hari na lèpa, ho bisa paraga hari dènge miu dènge d'ara karej'e-karae. ladhe sèmi èèna, d'ara ja'a heka mau kèna.

source_text: receive him therefore in the lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor, because for the work of christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.
target_text: de miu hud'i sèmi mere ne dènge be'a, te nèngu ne dhèu unu lamatua. aa miu hud'i pakab'ua ku dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra dhu ca ropa dènge ne. te nèngu pakako sasab'a kristus, toke oe madhe. aa nèngu hari boe kabodho ciki sa, lula na neo soru-bara ja'a, gati miu. de sèmi mere hari ne dènge d'ara karej'e.

source_text: finally, my brothers, rejoice in the lord! to write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! nanene paie-iie! d'ara miu hud'i karej'e ku, lula miu pa'èki dènge kristus. masi ka ja'a suri pahari-pahari, te ngaa ja'a roca boe pasanèd'e miu sèna ka baku lèke tipu!

source_text: beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge dhèu kapod'e-kabèli, dhu laka-seti dhèu, peka na, miu hud'i suna ku, ho j'aj'i tadha, na, miu se dhèu unu lamatua. madhutu iia-iia na, lamatua paredha boe sèmi èèna! rèngu sala le èèna! te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, ra bata-magèla dhèu nuka sèmi busa pakadhi sa.

source_text: for we are the circumcision, who worship god in the spirit, and rejoice in christ jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;
target_text: te rèngu peka, na, lamatua sèmi nare dhèu lula rèngu suna. te ngaa èèna sala! èdhi te'a le, na, lamatua sèmi nare dhèu lula ra parcaya yesus. ka dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a unu lamatua, nuka èdhi dhu parcaya yesus! èdhi dhu pahaha iisi mi nèngu, madhutu roh na dhu mola-mèci. èdhi ka dhu ded'e padedha-dedha yesus kristus, lula na bhoke nare le j'ara, ho èdhi bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. te èdhi bisa boe abhu mamuri, lula madhutu tatao dhèu rai-haha di.

source_text: though i myself might have confidence even in the flesh. if any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, i yet more:
target_text: uru èèna, ja'a pangee dhu èci èèna ka dènge rèngu kahèi, peka na, dhèu bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua, sad'i ra suna. madhutu iia-iia na, sèra sa sasab'a dhèu rai-haha di! ladhe neo padhue sasab'a dhèu rai-haha, na, ja'a bisa padhai lii padedha iisi risi nèti dhèu aa'i-aa'i, lula uru èèna sasab'a ja'a lèke mola-mola dènge atora agama dhèu yahudi aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of israel, of the tribe of benjamin, a hebrew of hebrews; concerning the law, a pharisee; concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.
target_text: madhutu atora agama, ina-ama ja'a suna ja'a, ropa ja'a d'ai aru lod'o. ja'a ne dhèu yahudi tare'a-re'a, lula j'aj'aj'i ja'a nèti suku benyamin, ana-èpu nèti baki isra'el. ja'a maj'èni titu kèna, madhutu mola-mola atora aa'i-aa'i nèti partei agama parisi, toke abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa pasala ja'a. risi-risi hari, ja'a d'èi titu kèna, paj'èra dhèu-dhèu dhu madhutu kristus, lula madhutu a'abhu ja'a, na, dhèu se rai eele le atora agama èdhi.

source_text: however, i consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for christ. yes most certainly, and i count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of christ jesus, my lord, for whom i suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that i may gain christ
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, ka ngangee ja'a kabèli, ropa ja'a madhutu kristus. de limuri ne, ja'a padedha heka iisi dènge j'ara mamuri dhu uru sèra, lula dènge heka sasoa ngaa-ngaa hia mi mamuri ja'a. madhutu a'abhu ja'a, na, dhu dedha risi nuka: ja'a tadhe kristus, kètu ja'a èèna. j'ara leo aa'i-aa'i ra, nuka sèmi mamumu di.

source_text: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in christ, the righteousness which is from god by faith,
target_text: ja'a neo mamuri pa'èki dènge yesus kristus. te masi ka ja'a madhutu aa'i atora agama yahudi, tatu mèka ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a. aa masi ka ja'a pangee, na, ngi'u ja'a mola, tatu boe lamatua sèmi nare ja'a kahèi. te ngaa ja'a hud'i parcaya ku kristus, heka ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a kèna, peka na, lula kristus saku eele le sasala èu, nèti èèna ka èu j'aj'i mola-mèci.

source_text: that i may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,
target_text: ka dad'èi ja'a sèmi ne'e: ja'a neo tadhe pamèu-mèu kristus. ja'a neo ke'a mèu kahèi koasa ama lamatua dhu na pake ho pamamuri hari yesus kristus nèti mamadhe na. ladhe sèmi abhu dhèu dhu neo paj'èra ja'a, lula ja'a madhutu kristus, na, hud'i nèngu sène. te dhèu paj'èra kristus kahèi. aa ladhe abhu dhèu neo pamadhe ja'a, lula ja'a lalau-lalo'o dhèu leo, na, ja'a sèmi kore kahèi. te kristus madhe hia ja'a sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: if by any means i may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
target_text: aa ladhe ja'a madhe, pe nèngu pamamuri hari ja'a kahèi.

source_text: not that i have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but i press on, that i may take hold of that for which also i was taken hold of by christ jesus. brothers, i don't regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing i do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! ja'a neo titu kèna madhutu j'ara mamuri kristus dènge dad'èi na aa'i-aa'i. te ngaa ladhe peka dhu mola-mola, ja'a tao lèke mèka sèmi èèna. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pa'èra ngi'u, lula yesus kristus hag'e nare le ja'a ho madhutu ne. ja'a nuka sèmi dhèu dhu rai pa'èra-èra, sèna ka bisa d'ai lane. de ja'a rai mola-mola asa madha, dhu kabib'a boe kabodho, ho ngee j'ara uru sèra. ja'a pabhèlu eele aa'i si.

source_text: i press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of god in christ jesus.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a rai pamèdhu-mèdhu toke d'ai lane, sèna ka abhu piala. hadia ja'a èèna nuka: bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua sèmi nare ja'a ètu sorga, lula ja'a parcaya yesus kristus.

source_text: let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. if in anything you think otherwise, god will also reveal that to you.
target_text: de ja'a manèngi ho miu aa'i-aa'i mi dhu mamuri sega dènge amo dhu èra ètu d'ara kristus, bisa d'ara èci dènge j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra. te ngaa ladhe abhu dhu ngee leo, na, hud'i laa ama lamatua paj'uj'u j'ara dhu hua iia hia nèngu.

source_text: nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let's walk by the same rule. let's be of the same mind.
target_text: te ngaa masi ka sèmi èèna, èdhi hud'i kèpe pa'èra-èra ku, aa tao palèke j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu lamatua aj'a le èdhi.

source_text: brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.
target_text: a'ari aa'i-aa'i! miu hud'i laladhe ku j'ara mamuri ja'a sèna ka tao madhutu. miu cahag'e ètu sèra, j'ara mamuri èci èèna ka dènge ja'a. te ngaa miu dhu leo bisa laladhe nèti rèngu, sèna ka tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi.

source_text: for many walk, of whom i told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of christ,
target_text: baku pamud'e dènge dhèu ae dhu lab'a kristus aa dhu sèmi boe dènge be'a mamadhe na ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. j'ara mamuri unu ra ka dhu peka na, rèngu lab'a kristus. ja'a peka kèdhi le miu lula-nèti dhèu dhu ca ropa dènge rèngu, te ngaa limuri ne ja'a pasanèd'e hari miu dènge pahaa èi madha.

source_text: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.
target_text: te bèli-camèd'a lamatua tule eele si, hèia pèci si asa d'ara ai naraka, lula d'ara rèngu dhu pa'èki boe dènge ne. rèngu mamuri dhoka ètu d'ara bhabhelu-katub'a di, aa tenge j'ara sèna ka pakasee d'ara iisi unu ra, toke ra padedha iisi dènge bhabhelu rèngu sèra. dhèu sèra dhu re'a heka makae. ngangee rèngu nuka sèmi dhèu dhu tadhe boe lamatua.

source_text: for our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a savior, the lord jesus christ,
target_text: miu baku madhutu si, te ngaa madhutu la ji'i. lula èdhi j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua, dhu dènge hak j'aj'i ana-ana kabarai sorga. limuri ne èdhi tatae kètu èdhi, yesus kristus. te bèli-camèd'a na lèpa hari mai nèti sorga, ho pakaj'èu èdhi nèti nanasa ama lamatua.

source_text: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.
target_text: èèna na, kristus ub'a ngi'u èdhi dhu roe dhu bisa madhe ne, j'aj'i mi ngi'u hiu dhu madhe boe nuka sèmi ngi'u na dhu èra aae èèna. na ub'a ngi'u aae èdhi ne, pake koasa na dhu kapai seli eele èèna. aa na pake kahèi koasa èèna, sèna ka tao aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu mia-mia, ho madhutu paredha na.

source_text: therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the lord in this way, my beloved.
