target_text: te uru èèna, lod'o èdhi tadhe mèka lamatua yesus, èdhi te'a boe ngaa-ngaa, aa dènge mud'a lèke tipu. èdhi to'o boe nanene dhèu leo. èdhi dhoka mamuri madhutu d'ara bhelu di, ka èki ngi'u èdhi dènge rupa-rupa dad'èi d'ara ti. èdhi d'ara karehe dènge dhèu leo. èdhi mamuri dhoka dènge jeluus. èdhi d'èi tèka d'ara mi dhèu leo, hèia ra kab'èli tèka d'ara dènge èdhi.

source_text: but when the kindness of god our savior and his love toward mankind appeared,
target_text: masi ka mamuri èdhi ne ele iie le, te ngaa ama lamatua dhu hia mamuri mi èdhi, pad'elo le sasue dènge d'ara hua iia na mi dedha èdhi.

source_text: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the holy spirit,
target_text: na hia èdhi mamuri lula boe nèti tatao èdhi dhu be'a, te ngaa lula sasue na mi èdhi. nèngu rase pamèu-mèu sasala èdhi sèra pake roh na dhu mola-mèci, sèna ka pahiu mamuri èdhi, nuka sèmi rara iisi hari èdhi.

source_text: whom he poured out on us richly through jesus christ our savior;
target_text: lula yesus kristus madhe le ho pakaj'èu èdhi nèti koasa sasala sèra, nèti èèna ka ama lamatua hia dènge boe too-lane roh na dhu mola-mèci mi èdhi.

source_text: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
target_text: lula d'ara hua iia yesus, ka na pabe'a pa'èci èdhi dènge ama lamatua, nuka sèmi ana na. hèia èdhi te'a, na, bèli-camèd'a èdhi mamuri taa-taa dènge ne. se'e se j'aj'i mi pusaka èdhi!

source_text: this saying is faithful, and concerning these things i desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed god may be careful to maintain good works. these things are good and profitable to men;
target_text: dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke tare'a. ngaa dhu ja'a aj'a ne, dènge kab'ua hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, èu hud'i pasanèd'e dhèu ho madhutu lii aj'a dhu mola. dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya lamatua, loe boe tenge j'ara sèna ka tao j'ara dhu be'a.

source_text: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
target_text: baku soro iisi asa d'ara lii langu dhu leko-monya, nuka sèmi: pasibha d'ara lii langu dhu dènge boe kolo-kapua, patao iia d'ara dènge dhèu leo, patula-pajuku nèti j'aj'aj'i mia dhu dedha risi, aa patao nèti atora ad'a yahudi. tao ngaa? sèra sa aa'i-aa'i, èci sa gaguna na aad'o. pèci eele lod'o iia d'ara!

source_text: avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,
target_text: lamu holo dhèu dhu tema pamae juma'at sèra. ladhe nèngu tao taruu, kai ne. aa ladhe na loe boe, soro tèke ne sène.

source_text: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.
target_text: dhèu sèmi èèna, ngangee na mola heka. nèti tatao unu na ka, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra re'a mèu sasala na.

source_text: when i send artemas to you, or tychicus, be diligent to come to me to nicopolis, for i have determined to winter there.
target_text: ja'a neo hia artemas do tikikus, dhiu paraga dènge èu asa pulu kreta. ladhe na d'ai, èu tenge j'ara sèna ka mai lai-lai paraga dènge ja'a ètu kota nikopolis. te ja'a neo pea ètu nèi d'ara hèru pacuhi ne.

source_text: send zenas the lawyer and apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.
target_text: èu tadhe le dhèu dhu d'èlu-mèu hukum, ngara na senas, aa angalai na apolos, do? ra neo lasi asa era kaj'èu. de mu bara si, sèna ka ra baku kura ngaa-ngaa ètu talora j'ara.

source_text: let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.
target_text: te dhèu dhu madhutu lamatua yesus baku madhèdi iia d'ara di. rèngu hud'i maj'èni tao dhu be'a, aa bara dhèu dhu tare'a-re'a parluu. dènge sèmi èèna, mamuri ra dènge kab'ua.

source_text: all who are with me greet you. greet those who love us in faith. grace be with you all. amen.
target_text: titus. ji'i aa'i-aa'i ètu ne'e pa'adhu lii maho'o hia èu. aa hia kahèi mi angalai ji'i dhu sama-sama parcaya lamatua yesus. ja'a sabaj'a manèngi sèna ka lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dedha miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka, paulus

source_text: paul, a prisoner of christ jesus, and timothy our brother, to philemon, our beloved fellow worker,
target_text: sasuri ne nèti ja'a, paulus. angalai ja'a, timotius, hia lii maho'o kahèi. sèna ka èu me'a, ra taha ja'a ètu d'ara èmu bèdho ne, lula ja'a peka-padhai dènge dhèu lula-nèti yesus kristus. ja'a suri sasuri ne hia èu, pilmon, dhu ji'i sue, aa dhu j'aj'i angalai ètu d'ara sasab'a;

source_text: to the beloved apphia, to archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:
target_text: hia ina apfia, dhu ji'i tadhe nuka sèmi ana hèni ji'i; hia arkipus, dhu sab'a sama-sama dènge ji'i ètu d'ara sasab'a ne'e; dènge hia juma'at dhu tema sabaj'a sama-sama ètu d'ara èmu èu.

source_text: grace to you and peace from god our father and the lord jesus christ.
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka ama lamatua, dènge kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, pad'elo d'ara hua iia ra mi dedha miu, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri padame èci dènge èci.

source_text: i thank my god always, making mention of you in my prayers,
target_text: pilmon! lod'o-lod'o dhu ja'a sabaj'a hia èu, ja'a manèngi makasi mi lamatua, lula mamuri èu.

source_text: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the lord jesus and toward all the saints,
target_text: te ja'a tadèngi ae le nèti parcaya èu mi lamatua yesus, dènge sasue èu mi dhèu-dhèu parcaya.

source_text: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in christ jesus.
target_text: lula lalèka èu, èu bisa mamuri d'ara èci dènge dhèu parcaya dhu leo sèra. ja'a manèngi-mangaj'i ho ladhe miu pad'elo d'ara be'a miu èci dènge èci, miu bisa me'a mèu madha j'ara aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a, dhu èdhi bisa tao hia lamatua yesus.

source_text: for we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.
target_text: sasue èu èèna ka pakarej'e d'ara ja'a, aa pa'èra d'ara ja'a kahèi. aa sasue èu èèna ka, pa'èra kahèi d'ara dhèu parcaya sèra.

source_text: therefore though i have all boldness in christ to command you that which is appropriate, yet for love's sake i rather appeal to you, being such a one as paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of jesus christ.
target_text: a'a, ee! ja'a parluu ciki, sèmi ne'e: ja'a j'aj'i dhèu pajuu-paleha kristus. nèti èèna ka, ja'a dènge hak kahèi ho paredha èu, sèna ka tao j'ara ne'e. te ngaa ja'a ko'o boe tao paredha di, dhoka neo manèngi èu bantu di, nuka sèmi dhèu heka dhu to'a mi dedha èu. ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho lula madhutu yesus kristus. nèti èèna ka ja'a bani manèngi èu soru-bara ja'a, lula ja'a ke'a sasue èu mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: i appeal to you for my child onesimus, whom i have become the father of in my chains,
target_text: ja'a manèngi sèna ka èu pad'elo sasue èu mi ana ja'a, onesimus. nèngu èèna, nuka sèmi ana d'èlu ja'a, te nèngu parcaya yesus nèti sasab'a ja'a, ropa ja'a ètu d'ara bui ne.

source_text: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.
target_text: ja'a ke'a, onesimus ne, ènu èu dhu rai nèti èu. ja'a ke'a, na, uru èèna nèngu dhu laku boe ètu katanga madha èu. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a parcaya nèngu nèti gaguna ae-ae hia èdhi dua ti.

source_text: i am sending him back. therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,
target_text: ja'a sue ne titu kèna. te ngaa hud'i laa, ja'a pua na lèpa hari asa èu.

source_text: whom i desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the good news.
target_text: madhutu ngangee ja'a, na, ja'a taha onesimus sèna ka gati èu, ho nèngu ladhe-leru ja'a ètu ne'e. te ja'a bisa boe tao ngaa-ngaa ètu d'ara bèdho ne. ja'a j'aj'i ana bèdho, lula peka-padhai dènge dhèu lii lolo be'a lamatua yesus.

source_text: but i was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.
target_text: ja'a ko'o boe sèna ka èu sad'i madhutu di, ladhe èu rasa dhèu laka-seti èu. dad'èi ja'a, na, èu tao dhu be'a madhutu dad'èi èu unu mu. de ladhe èu mo'o mèka sèmi dènge be'a lii manèngi ja'a, na, ja'a ko'o boe tao ngaa ciki sa mi onesimus ne, lula dhu hak dhoka èu di.

source_text: for perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,
target_text: ele boe èu pangee sèmi ne'e: lamatua soro tèke onesimus ele nèti èu d'ara ciki oo'e ne, sèna ka na mai hari ho pea taruu dènge èu.

source_text: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother-especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the lord.
target_text: lod'o na rai èèna, nèngu dhoka j'aj'i dhèu ènu èu di. te ngaa ladhe nèngu lèpa hari dhiu, nèngu j'aj'i mi ari pasue èu. ja'a sue ne titu kèna kahèi. de ne'e ne, gaguna na hia mi èu asa tabha. te nèngu ne mesa boe j'aj'i ènu èu di, te ngaa nèngu j'aj'i kahèi ari dhu sama-sama parcaya kristus.

source_text: if then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
target_text: de sèmi ne'e ka. ladhe èu tadhe ja'a ne angalai èu ètu d'ara sasab'a èci, na, ja'a manèngi ho èu sèmi more nèngu, nuka sèmi ja'a ka dhu dhiu èèna.

source_text: but if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe onesimus tao nèdhi sala mi dedha èu, do, na pakèlu era, hud'i laa pe ja'a ka tago kore.

source_text: i, paul, write this with my own hand: i will repay it not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides.
target_text: ladhe laa! sasuri pakèlu ne, ja'a suri unu ku. ja'a, paulus, èèna na b'ae pama'ète kèlu onesimus mi pilmon. d'ai le, sina ma? de ja'a parluu heka pasanèd'e, na, èu pakèlu ja'a ae risi. te èu j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua, lula ja'a.

source_text: yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the lord. refresh my heart in the lord.
target_text: lèke kèna! hud'i laa sèna ka èu bantu ja'a ètu j'ara ne'e, lula èdhi pa'a'ari ètu d'ara lamatua. pakarej'e d'ara ja'a sèmi èèna, lula èdhi aa'i-aa'i ti sama-sama dhèu unu kristus.

source_text: having confidence in your obedience, i write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what i say.
target_text: pilmon! ja'a suri sasuri ne hia èu, lula ja'a parcaya èu bisa taru kira mi ja'a dènge be'a. ja'a rasa, èèna na èu tao risi nèti ngaa dhu ja'a sanao.

source_text: also, prepare a guest room for me, for i hope that through your prayers i will be restored to you.
target_text: j'ara èci era. sadia ku kama èci hia ja'a. te ja'a parcaya lamatua tadèngi lii sabaj'a miu, aa pe na bhoke j'ara ho kalua eele ja'a nèti d'ara bui, sèna ka dhiu hari pa'asu-pareo dènge miu ètu nèi.

source_text: epaphras, my fellow prisoner in christ jesus, greets you,
target_text: epapras ètu ne'e. nèngu j'aj'i dhèu bui kahèi, lula nèngu lole j'ara-j'ara lula-nèti yesus kristus sèmi ja'a kahèi. na pa'adhu lii maho'o kahèi hia èu.

source_text: as do mark, aristarchus, demas, and luke, my fellow workers.
target_text: markus, aristarkus, demas, dènge lukas ètu ne'e kahèi. sasab'a rèngu èci èèna ka dènge ja'a. rèngu hia lii maho'o kahèi.

source_text: the grace of our lord jesus christ be with your spirit. amen.
target_text: ja'a manèngi kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, sèna ka pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi miu aa'i-aa'i mi. d'ai sange ne'e ka! saloom, paulus

source_text: god, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,
target_text: uru èèna, ama lamatua pake dhèu rèti lii padhai na, ho padhai lii dènge bèi-baki èdhi dhèu ibrani. nèngu pake rupa-rupa j'ara, sèna ka peka pahari-pahari dènge rèngu.

source_text: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, na pua le ana na mai, sèna ka padhai lii dènge èdhi. karèi nèti uru-uru j'ara ka, ama lamatua hag'e nare le ana na, ho nèd'u paredha sama-sama dènge nèngu. te lod'o na paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha dènge isi ra aa'i-aa'i, ana na dhu sab'a sama-sama dènge ne kahèi.

source_text: his son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the majesty on high,
target_text: ana lamatua ne, pad'elo dadedha ama na, nuka sèmi saraa madha lod'o dhu lèke tèru. te nèngu ne, ca ropa dènge ama na. aa nèti lii holo-nori na dhu èra titu kèna, na pakako aa'i-aa'i ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha. nèngu bhoke j'ara kahèi, ho saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu, sèna ka ra j'aj'i mola-mèci. hèia na lèpa hari asa sorga, ho madhèdi ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua, ètu era dhu kab'ua aae.

source_text: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.
target_text: ana-ana pajuu ama lamatua ètu sorga mema kapai. te ngaa ana na kapai risi eele nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra. kapai dènge dadedha ama lamatua risi eele nèti aa'i-aa'i ra. aa kapai dènge dadedha èèna, na pangèd'u le mi ana na. nèti èèna ka, ana na kapai risi eele nèti ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga.

source_text: for to which of the angels did he say at any time, you are my son. today i have become your father? and again, i will be to him a father, and he will be to me a son?
target_text: ama lamatua peka nèdhi mi ana na, aku nèngu na, doe ne'e, ja'a ded'e èu ho mèd'u paredha. ama lamatua, peka kahèi, na, ja'a ne, ama na. aa nèngu ne, ana ja'a. ama lamatua peka dènge ana na sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua peka nèdhi boe sèmi èèna, mi ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga.

source_text: when he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, let all the angels of god worship him.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua pua mai ana na dhu kapai risi eele èèna, na paredha ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga, aku nèngu na, miu ana pajuu aa'i-aa'i! lami ho pakab'ua, aa pahaha iisi mi ana ja'a!

source_text: of the angels he says, he makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.
target_text: ama lamatua padhai lii kahèi mi ana pajuu na ètu sorga, peka na, ja'a tao ana-ana pajuu ja'a ètu sorga, j'aj'i malai sama sèmi lai ngèlu. ja'a tao ènu-ènu ja'a, j'aj'i nuka sèmi ai. ama lamatua peka dènge ra sèmi èèna, lula rèngu dhoka ana pua-paleha na di.

source_text: but of the son he says, your throne, o god, is forever and ever. the scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your kingdom.
target_text: te ngaa mi ana d'èlu na, nèngu peka dhu leo, na, èu ne, ama lamatua. èu, èèna na madhèdi ètu kadera paredha toke d'ai mia-mia. èu èèna na mèd'u koasa, ho paredha dènge d'ara mola.

source_text: you have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore god, your god, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.
target_text: d'ara èu karej'e, ladhe mèdhi dhèu dhu mamuri mola. te ngaa d'ara mu susa, ladhe mèdhi dhèu dhu mamuri koe-kapengo. nèti èèna ka, d'ara èu karej'e, ka ja'a pasuti èi lèngi mi kètu èu, ho ded'e èu j'aj'i dhèu aae, dhu risi nèti dhèu aae leo sèra.

source_text: and, you, lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. the heavens are the works of your hands.
target_text: ama lamatua peka mi ana na kahèi, na, ana, ee! èu ne, kètu dhu mèd'u paredha karèi nèti uru ka. èu ne'e ka dhu pua liru j'aj'i, hèia na j'aj'i dènge. èu ne'e ka dhu paredha rai-haha, hèia na j'aj'i dènge.

source_text: they will perish, but you continue. they all will grow old like a garment does. you will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. your years won't fail.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a liru dènge rai-haha laho aa'i si. bèli-camèd'a liru dènge rai-haha ele aa'i si. te ngaa èu mesa mu, mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia. èèna na èu core eele liru dènge rai-haha, nuka sèmi dhèu core eele kaha'i soho dhasi. bèli-camèd'a èu gati eele liru aa rai-haha, nuka sèmi dhèu silu mèdha-papake hiu. te ngaa èu mesa mu sèmi boe èèna. lula èu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: but which of the angels has he told at any time, sit at my right hand, until i make your enemies the footstool of your feet?
target_text: ama lamatua peka kahèi dènge ana na, aku nèngu na, ana, ee! mai madhèdi asa era dhu kab'ua titu kèna, ètu baboa g'ana ja'a ne. pe ja'a tao musu èu sèra, toke ra pahaha iisi mi èu. ama lamatua peka-padhai mi ana na sèmi èèna, te ngaa na padhai lii nèdhi boe sèmi èèna mi ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga.

source_text: aren't they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?
target_text: ana pajuu na sèra mema panting. te nèngu paleha si lasi lalau-lalo'o dhèu unu na aa'i-aa'i dhu èèna na nèngu patabuli eele si nèti koasa sasala-sasigo ra. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ana ama lamatua risi nèti rèngu era.

source_text: therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, èdhi hud'i kèpe ku pa'èra-èra ngaa dhu èdhi tadèngi le nèti j'ara-j'ara ana ama lamatua, sèna ka èdhi baku bhèlu eele.

source_text: for if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,
target_text: lod'o uru-uru sèra, lamatua pake ana pajuu na nèti sorga, ho lole lii moa na mi bèi-baki èdhi. te'a boe na, lii moa sèra aa'i-aa'i ra lèke. ladhe ra sisu paredha na, rèngu tatu abhu huku dhu palèke dènge tatao ra.

source_text: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation-which at the first having been spoken through the lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,
target_text: mema uru èèna, sèmi èèna ka. te ngaa limuri ne, ana ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara hiu, sèna ka hia mamuri mi dhèu rai-haha. na peka le j'ara mamuri dhu be'a aae ne mi dhèu unu na dhu pakako sasab'a na ètu rai-haha ne. hèia ra peka dènge èdhi, sèna ka èdhi parcaya. te ngaa ladhe èdhi pusi-pahae boe, dui tare pala ti!

source_text: god also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the holy spirit, according to his own will?
target_text: te ama lamatua pangèd'u si koasa kahèi, sèna ka ra tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa. na papuru roh na mi rèngu kahèi, ho ra ad'u-ue j'ara-j'ara leo dhu madhutu dad'èi na. nèti èèna ka èdhi te'a, na, aa'i-aa'i se j'ara mamuri dhu lèke tare'a-re'a.

source_text: for he didn't subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.
target_text: ja'a lole lula-nèti rai-haha rupa hiu dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i. te ngaa ama lamatua peka nèdhi boe dènge ana-ana pajuu na ètu sorga, na, pe rèngu ka dhu ator rai-haha hiu èèna. te dhu lalau ka, dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: but one has somewhere testified, saying, what is man, that you think of him? or the son of man, that you care for him?
target_text: ètu d'ara sasuri mola-mèci ama lamatua, na, daud dhu karèi nèdhi le kab'ua nèti dhèu rai-haha, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua! nga tao ka ama tao madha-dhilu mi dhèu rai-haha? nga tao ka ama sue si? te rèngu dhoka dhèu rai-haha biasa di!

source_text: you made him a little lower than the angels. you crowned him with glory and honor.
target_text: te ngaa lamatua pangèd'u si koasa, ka rèngu oe sèmi ana pajuu ètu sorga. lamatua pakab'ua si hèi, aa ded'e si,

source_text: you have put all things in subjection under his feet. for in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. but now we don't yet see all things subjected to him.
target_text: ho ra paredha aa'i dhu lamatua paj'aj'i. de madhutu sasuri daud, ama lamatua ded'e dhèu rai-haha j'aj'i kètu, sèna ka ra uri aa'i-aa'i dhu na paj'aj'i. te ngaa èdhi tèdhi mèka na, dhèu rai-haha èci sa dhu paredha aa'i-aa'i sèmi èèna.

source_text: but we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of god he should taste of death for everyone.
target_text: te ngaa abhu ca dhèu dhu bisa paredha aa'i-aa'i se. nèngu èèna, nuka yesus. na mai pea taha ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha dhu pasae j'aj'èra, ka na madhe hia mi èdhi. nèti mamadhe na, ama lamatua pad'elo d'ara hua iia na mi dhèu rai-haha. èle èèna ka, ama lamatua koa-kad'iri ne, aa ded'e ne padedha-dedha, sèna ka na paredha aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paj'aj'i nare sèra.

source_text: for it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
target_text: de lèke, ladhe ama lamatua hia yesus pasae j'aj'èra, ho yesus bisa bhoke j'ara mamuri pala mi dhèu rai-haha. te ama lamatua neo sèna ka dhèu ae bisa mamuri bera-bera dènge nèngu ètu sorga. ama lamatua ka dhu paj'aj'i aa'i mèu-mèu. aa aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri, mamuri lula nèngu ka.

source_text: for both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,
target_text: ama lamatua tatu sèmi nare si dènge be'a dhèu dhu yesus tao mola-mèci, ho j'aj'i ana-ana na. ama lamatua èèna, ama nèti yesus. dènge sèmi èèna, yesus dènge rèngu, ca ama. nèti èèna ka, yesus makae boe paroa mi dhèu se'e, na, miu se, a'ari ja'a.

source_text: saying, i will declare your name to my brothers. among the congregation i will sing your praise.
target_text: te yesus peka le dènge ama na, ja'a neo peka dènge a'ari ja'a, lula-nèti babe'a ama! ja'a neo sod'a ètu talora aae rèngu, lula-nèti dadedha ama!

source_text: again, i will put my trust in him. again, behold, here i am with the children whom god has given me.
target_text: yesus tuhu hari lii padhai na, aku nèngu na, ja'a sarai-maena mi ama lamatua toke d'ai mia-mia. hèia yesus peka hari, na, ladhe ku! ja'a ka ne'e, sama-sama dènge ana-ana ama lamatua, dhu na pangèd'u le mi ja'a, ho uri si.

source_text: since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,
target_text: lula ana-ana lamatua se, dhèu rai-haha biasa, nèti èèna ka yesus hud'i j'aj'i ku dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi rèngu kahèi. te nèngu hud'i j'aj'i uuru ku dhèu rai-haha, heka na bisa madhe. ho nèti mamadhe na, heka nèngu bisa parame nare koasa nèti dhèu aae nidhu. te dhèu aae bhabhelu-katub'a ne'e ka dhu nèd'u koasa, ho uri j'ara-j'ara dhu pa'èki dènge mamadhe.

source_text: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
target_text: aa nèngu kahèi tao dhèu rai-haha madha'u dènge mamadhe, toke ra madhutu dad'èi na, nuka sèmi ènu sa. te ngaa limuri ne, yesus bisa patalale le dhèu rai-haha nèti d'ara madha'u.

source_text: for most certainly, he doesn't give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of abraham.
target_text: te dhu lèke, nuka yesus mai boe ho soru-bara ana-ana pajuu ètu sorga. te ngaa na mai sèna ka soru nare èdhi, nuka ana-èpu abraham.

source_text: therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to god, to make atonement for the sins of the people.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus j'aj'i sama sèmi èdhi, dhu j'aj'i le a'ari na. dènge j'ara ne'e nèngu j'aj'i mi kètu agama èdhi dhu kapai risi eele, ho soru-bara èdhi sèna ka madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua. yesus pad'elo d'ara hua iia na kahèi mi èdhi. aa ladhe na peka ngaa, na tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi. uru èèna, bèi-baki èdhi manèngi kètu kapai risi agama yahudi, sèna ka tao korban, ho lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo rèngu. limuri ne, yesus mesa na ka dhu j'aj'i korban, sèna ka lamatua saku eele sasala èdhi.

source_text: for in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.
target_text: lod'o yesus mamuri ètu rai-haha ne, na abhu j'aj'èra ae-ae. abhu kahèi dhu dadugu ne, sèna ka ad'u-ue sasala. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa nèngu manahu boe. nèti èèna ka, ladhe abhu dhu dadugu-rariu èdhi, sèna ka tao sasala, yesus ka dhu bisa soru-bara èdhi ho baku manahu.

source_text: therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the apostle and high priest of our confession: jesus,
target_text: de sèmi ne'e, a'ari! ama lamatua hag'e nare le miu, aa cap miu dhèu d'ara mola, sèna ka èèna na miu mamuri bera-bera dènge ne ètu sorga. nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pangee ku pabe'a-be'a lula-nèti yesus ne. te èdhi dhu mangaku le, na, nèngu ne dhèu pajuu-paleha ama lamatua, aa nèngu kahèi kètu kapai risi agama èdhi.

source_text: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also moses was in all his house.
target_text: lod'o ama lamatua pua yesus mai, yesus tao madhutu aa'i dad'èi lamatua. dènge j'ara ne, nèngu nuka sèmi musa. te musa tao madhutu dad'èi lamatua kahèi, lod'o na ladhe-leru bèi-baki èdhi uru sèra.

source_text: for he has been counted worthy of more glory than moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.
target_text: masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa yesus kapai risi nèti musa. te yesus sama sèmi lamatua èmu. aa mema lèke, lula lamatua èmu kapai risi nèti ana pua-paleha ètu d'ara èmu.

source_text: for every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is god.
target_text: dhèu èci-èci ka pa'uri d'ara èmu na. te ngaa ama lamatua ka dhu uri aa'i mèu-mèu.

source_text: moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,
target_text: de musa tao madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua, lod'o na j'aj'i ana pua-paleha nèti isi èmu lamatua. te lod'o èèna, na peka mema le ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a ama lamatua neo tao.

source_text: but christ is faithful as a son over his house. we are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.
target_text: masi ka yesus madhutu kahèi dad'èi ama lamatua, te ngaa nèngu ana pua-paleha dhu sama boe sèmi musa. lula nèngu ne, kristus, ana ama lamatua dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le karèi nèti uru ka, sèna ka pua mai asa rai-haha ne. aa kristus ne'a mèu uri isi èmu ama na. de ladhe èdhi kèpe pa'èra-èra lalèka èdhi, aa ma'ète boe sanao-maena èdhi mi kristus, èdhi bisa j'aj'i isi èmu na kahèi.

source_text: therefore, even as the holy spirit says, today if you will hear his voice,
target_text: nèti èèna ka, miu hud'i pasa dhilu paie-iie, ho nanene pabe'a ngaa dhu roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci peka, na, doe ne'e, ropa miu tadèngi lii ama lamatua,

source_text: don't harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
target_text: mage miu kètu hadhu, sama sèmi dhèu sèra, dhu lasi-mai èpa nguru tèu ètu pad'a sod'a. te rèngu ro'o heka puai-pahae musa, toke ama lamatua mesa na oe taha nare heka d'ara na.

source_text: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years. therefore i was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘they always err in their heart, but they didn't know my ways. '
target_text: pangee ku laa! èpa nguru tèu kateme ja'a tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa ètu katanga madha ra! te ngaa ra loe boe sèku ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a nasa dènge ra, peka na, ‘miu se, seli-kolane! te miu soro kabodho tèke eele j'ara ja'a, ho madhutu j'ara miu dhu koe-kapengo! '

source_text: as i swore in my wrath, ‘they will not enter into my rest. '
target_text: ropa kèdhi bhabhelu miu, ja'a ru'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a dhoo miu, peka na, ‘miu bisa boe mai ho ae mere d'ara mi, sama-sama dènge ja'a. '

source_text: beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living god;
target_text: de a'ari aa'i-aa'i! mage nèti miu abhu ca dhèu dhu tao bhelu, toke nèngu parcaya heka, hèia na soro kabodho mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called today, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.
target_text: be'a risi bèli-bèli miu pa'èra d'ara, èci dènge èci. baku pamata ia ka! lula miu dhu malai lèke tipu ka tao sasala, toke miu kètu hadhu aa pusi-pahae boe ama lamatua.

source_text: for we have become partakers of christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,
target_text: èdhi bisa pa'angalai dènge yesus kristus, sad'i baku pama'ète sanao mi nèngu, nuka sèmi ropa èdhi heka parcaya nèngu.

source_text: while it is said, today if you will hear his voice, don't harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.
target_text: te roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci, peka le kahèi, na, doe ne'e, ladhe miu tadèngi lii ama lamatua, miu baku kètu hadhu sama sèmi dhèu se'e se, dhu lasi-mai toke èpa nguru tèu ètu pad'a sod'a, te rèngu lab'a musa.

source_text: for who, when they heard, rebelled? wasn't it all those who came out of egypt led by moses?
target_text: de ja'a neo karèi sèmi ne'e: cee ka dhu uru èèna nanene musa, hèia ra pusi-pahae heka ne? dhèu sèra nuka bèi-baki èdhi dhu musa lere si nèti rai masir.

source_text: with whom was he displeased forty years? wasn't it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?
target_text: aa dhèu cee ka dhu tao d'ara ama lamatua pana magoro d'ai èpa nguru tèu èèna? dhèu sèra nuka bèi-baki èdhi. te mamuri ra koe-kapengo ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a, toke ra madhe, ka padhane si ètu nèi.

source_text: to whom did he swear that they wouldn't enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?
target_text: aa cee ka dhu lèke kutuk nèti ama lamatua, toke bisa boe maso asa rai èèna, sèna ka ae rare d'ara ra sama-sama dènge lamatua? dhèu sèra nuka bèi-baki èdhi. te rèngu se ro'o boe nanene ama lamatua.

source_text: we see that they weren't able to enter in because of unbelief.
target_text: de me'a le, si? bèi-baki èdhi bisa boe maso asa d'ara rai èèna, ho ae rare d'ara ra sama-sama dènge ama lamatua, lula ra parcaya boe ne.

source_text: let's fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.
target_text: te ngaa èdhi hud'i pangee madhera ku, lula lamatua dhu pajaji era, na, dhèu unu na bisa ae rare d'ara ra sama-sama dènge nèngu. de mage dhoka abhu nèti miu dhu tule eele lii pajaji lamatua ne.

source_text: for indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn't profit them, because it wasn't mixed with faith by those who heard.
target_text: te èdhi dhu tadèngi le lii lolo be'a, sama sèmi bèi-baki èdhi uru sèra tadèngi. te ngaa, lula rèngu lèka boe lii èèna, rèngu abhu boe oto ngaa-ngaa.

source_text: for we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, as i swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest; although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe èdhi parcaya, èdhi bisa ae tare d'ara bera-bera dènge ama lamatua. te uru èèna, nèngu dhu pajaji le dènge bèi-baki èdhi, te ngaa lula na nasa, hèia na peka dènge ra, na, ja'a taha heka ladhe kèdhi tatao bhabhelu miu ne. nèti èèna ka, ja'a dhoo miu, peka na, ‘miu bisa boe maso, ho ae mere d'ara sama-sama dènge ja'a. ' aa te ngaa èdhi te'a le, na, lod'o ama lamatua paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha, nèngu ator nare le, sèna ka dhèu-dhèu unu na bisa ae rare d'ara, ho mamuri bera-bera dènge ne.

source_text: for he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, god rested on the seventh day from all his works;
target_text: ètu lii lolo nèti ama lamatua paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha, dhu suri, ama lamatua ae nare d'ara, peka na, lamatua sab'a nare aa'i le, hèia asa bèli èèna, lèke dènge lod'o ka pidhu, na ae nare d'ara.

source_text: and in this place again, they will not enter into my rest.
target_text: aa dhu suri ètu era leo hari, ama lamatua peka dènge bèi-baki èdhi, na, miu bisa heka maso, ho ae mere d'ara mi sama-sama dènge ja'a.

source_text: seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,
target_text: de dad'èi ama lamatua ka, dhèu unu na ae rare d'ara ra sèna ka mamuri sama-sama dènge ne. te ngaa bèi-baki èdhi dhu tadèngi uuru lii lolo be'a ne, rèngu bisa boe maso, lula rèngu tao boe madhutu dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: he again defines a certain day, today, saying through david so long a time afterward just as has been said, today if you will hear his voice, don't harden your hearts.
target_text: te ngaa nèbhu-nèbhu, lamatua hag'e nare lod'o èci, sèna ka dhèu unu na bisa ae rare d'ara ra sama-sama dènge nèngu. te na pake daud ho padhai lii, peka na, doe ne'e, ladhe miu tadèngi lii ama lamatua, mage miu tao d'ara mi adhu sèmi hadhu, te ngaa nanene paie-iie.

source_text: for if joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.
target_text: lod'o daud peka na, doe ne'e, nèngu paj'uj'u boe asa lod'o dhu yosua lere ana-èpu nèti bèi-baki se asa rai kana'an. te lod'o daud padhai lii ne, rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu madhe nèbhu le.

source_text: there remains therefore a sabbath rest for the people of god.
target_text: nèti èèna ka èdhi te'a, na, lamatua ator le lod'o dhu leo èci, sèna ka dhèu-dhèu unu na bisa ae rare d'ara ra, ho mamuri pa'èci dènge ne.

source_text: for he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as god did from his.
target_text: aa dhèu dhu maso le sèna ka ae nare d'ara na sama-sama dènge ama lamatua, nèngu dhu ae nare le nèti sasab'a-la'a na, sama sèmi lamatua kahèi ae nèti sasab'a-la'a na, lèke dènge lod'o ka pidhu.

source_text: let's therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.
target_text: de bori pa'èra ho miu bisa maso ae mere d'ara, sèna ka mamuri sama-sama dènge ama lamatua. mage dhoka abhu dhu j'aj'i boe maso, lula nèngu nanene boe lii holo-nori lamatua, cakaraa bèi-baki èdhi sèra.

source_text: for the word of god is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.
target_text: te lii holo-nori ama lamatua ka dhu paj'uj'u j'ara mamuri dhu lèke. lii se'e dhu dènge koasa ho maso asa d'ara èdhi, sèna ka pasoro ngangee dènge dad'èi èdhi aa'i-aa'i. te lii holo-nori se, dhu madèka titu kèna, risi nèti hela madèka dhu bisa sabhi eele isi, aa j'ue eele kalua dènge sèg'i rui, sèna ka pasabhoka aa'i.

source_text: there is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.
target_text: ètu dedha-liru dènge rai-haha, abhu boe èci sa dhu pahuni nèti ama lamatua, te nèngu bisa nèdhi aa'i mèu-mèu. aa bèli-camèd'a èdhi hud'i lati asa katanga madha na, sèna ka ti dhaa aa'i, ngaa dhu èdhi ad'u-ue.

source_text: having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, jesus, the son of god, let's hold tightly to our confession.
target_text: èdhi hud'i kèpe ku pa'èra-èra lalèka èdhi, lula ana ama lamatua, yesus, dhu j'aj'i le kètu kapai risi agama èdhi. te nèngu ètu le madha ama lamatua ètu sorga, sèna ka sarii èdhi.

source_text: for we don't have a high priest who can't be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
target_text: na bisa sarii èdhi dènge be'a, lula ne'a, èdhi dhèu rai-haha biasa. ladhe abhu dhu dadugu-rariu èdhi ho tao sala, na, èdhi manahu malai. yesus abhu dadugu-rariu kahèi sama sèmi èdhi, te ngaa na manahu nèdhi boe.

source_text: let's therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, mai ti pabani d'ara ho ara lati asa madha ama lamatua dhu ètu kadera paredha na. te nèngu ne, d'ara hua iia. de ladhe èdhi sabaj'a mi nèngu, tatu na neo pad'elo rasa kasia na, ho soru-bara èdhi lèke dènge lod'o na.

source_text: for every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to god, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.
target_text: dhèu dhu ded'e rare j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama, sasab'a na, hud'i soru-bara dhèu, sèna ka rèngu pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. nèngu hud'i sèmi nare ku mèdha persembahan dènge badha korban, ho saraka asa lamatua. nèngu kahèi hia badha korban, sèna ka lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu.

source_text: the high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.
target_text: ladhe abhu dhèu dhu re'a boe j'ara mamuri dhu lèke, do dhèu dhu rai eele nèti j'ara èèna, kètu agama ne pasusa boe rèngu. nèti d'ara hua iia na, nèngu lii mako dènge ra, lula nèngu kahèi dhèu rai-haha dhu mud'a manahu, sama sèmi rèngu.

source_text: because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.
target_text: lula nèngu kahèi dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi rèngu, nèti èèna ka kètu agama ne hud'i hia badha korban, ho lamatua saku pamèu sasala nèngu mesa na.

source_text: nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by god, just like aaron was.
target_text: dhèu bisa boe ded'e iisi na, sèna ka j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama. te dhoka ama lamatua di dhu dènge hak, sèna ka hag'e nare dhèu sèmi èèna, nuka sèmi uru-uru sèra na ded'e harun, a'a musa.

source_text: so also christ didn't glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, you are my son. today i have become your father.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi dènge kristus. na ded'e boe iisi na, ho j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama. te uru èèna, ama lamatua mesa na ka dhu ded'e ne, peka na, èu ne, ana ja'a, doe ne'e, ja'a ded'e èu ho mèd'u paredha.

source_text: as he says also in another place, you are a priest forever, after the order of melchizedek.
target_text: ètu era leo nèti sasuri lamatua dhu mola-mèci, dhu suri kahèi, peka na, èu j'aj'i kètu agama dhu ca ropa dènge ca dhèu dhu mamuri uru èèna, nuka melkisedek, te ngaa èu j'aj'i kètu agama toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: he, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,
target_text: ètu lod'o oe èle mamuri yesus ètu rai-haha ne, na loe boe sabaj'a dènge tangi d'ara pèd'a, manèngi ama lamatua sèna ka hia ne a'èra. te ne'a, na, koasa lamatua bisa hia ne mamuri. hèia ama lamatua sèmi nare lii manèngi yesus, lula na madhutu mola-mola dad'èi lamatua.

source_text: though he was a son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.
target_text: te yesus ne, ana ama lamatua. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa nèngu hud'i pasae ku j'aj'èra, ho ne'a madhutu dad'èi ama lamatua.

source_text: having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,
target_text: èle èèna ka, na tao madhutu mola-mola dad'èi lamatua aa'i-aa'i. nèti èèna ka, nèngu j'aj'i le kapua mamuri bagi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu parcaya ne, ho mamuri taruu dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: named by god a high priest after the order of melchizedek.
target_text: te lamatua ded'e nare le yesus j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama, ca ropa dènge melkisedek, dhu j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama uru sèra.

source_text: about him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
target_text: j'ara ae era dhu ja'a neo lole dènge miu lula-nèti kristus dènge melkisedek, te ngaa ako carui paled'a j'ara se'e, lula miu nuka sèmi ana iiki dhu me'a mèu mèka dènge be'a.

source_text: for although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of god. you have come to need milk, and not solid food.
target_text: aa te ngaa, miu dhu parcaya nèbhu le. madhutu iia-iia na, miu j'aj'i le mese ho aj'a-nori dhèu leo. te ngaa te'a boe na, miu cakaraa ana rara iisi hiu, dhu ne'a mèka na'a, te ne'a dhoka ninu susu di. miu parluu dhèu era ho aj'a miu lula-nèti j'ara-j'ara dhu carui mèka nèti sasuri lamatua dhu mola-mèci.

source_text: for everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.
target_text: ja'a pakasame miu dènge ana rara iisi hiu, lula miu me'a mèka j'ara-j'ara dhu carui boe nèti kristus, sèna ka miu bisa mamuri mola.

source_text: but solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.
target_text: te ngaa lod'o ana iiki ne kapai, nèngu ninu heka susu, te ngaa na'a nganga'a dhu sakaa. èèna èci èèna ka, dènge dhèu aj'a ne toke ne'a mèu a'aj'a lamatua, sèna ka ne'a mia ka dhu be'a, aa mia ka dhu karehe.

source_text: therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of christ, let's press on to perfection-not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward god,
target_text: de miu hud'i aj'a paie-iie ku a'aj'a dhu carui risi, lula miu dhu aj'a nèbhu ae le a'aj'a dhu carui mèka lula-nèti kristus. nèti èèna ka limuri ne, baku dhoka aj'a pahari-pahari a'aj'a dhu carui mèka sèra, nuka sèmi: dhèu hud'i tèke eele ku sasala rèngu aa'i-aa'i; a'aj'a lula-nèti dhèu hud'i parcaya ku ama lamatua;

source_text: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
target_text: a'aj'a lula-nèti sarani; a'aj'a lula-nèti bane ai mi dhèu sèna ka dhèu èèna sèmi nare roh lamatua dhu mola-mèci; a'aj'a lula-nèti ama lamatua pamamuri hari dhèu nèti mamadhe ra; aa a'aj'a dhu èèna na dhèu lasi asa katanga madha lamatua, ho sèmi rare lii pama'ète, dhu peka na, cee ka dhu bisa mamuri taa-taa dènge ne, aa cee ka dhu bisa boe.

source_text: this will we do, if god permits.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe lamatua hia ijin, na, èdhi j'aj'i heka ana iiki dhu te'a dhoka tinu susu di. te ja'a neo aj'a j'ara-j'ara dhu carui risi hari.

source_text: for concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the holy spirit, and tasted the good word of god and the powers of the age to come, and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the son of god for themselves again, and put him to open shame.
target_text: aa te ngaa, abhu le dhèu dhu re'a mèu lii a'aj'a kristus, aa dhu rasa le d'ara hua iia lamatua kahèi, toke na hia si roh na dhu mola-mèci. rèngu re'a le lii holo-nori lamatua, aa rasa le koasa na dhu na neo pake lod'o èle rai-haha ne. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu se tèke eele le parcaya ra, aa ra soro kabodho mi kristus. nèti èèna ka, bisa heka abhu j'ara ho rèngu bisa lèpa hari manèngi abho, sèna ka mamuri pabe'a hari dènge ama lamatua. te ladhe dhèu ro'o boe ele-ho'a, èèna sama sèmi rèngu ka dhu paku pamadhe hari ana ama lamatua ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha, hèia ra nyanyèi ne ètu madha dhèu ae-ae.

source_text: for the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from god;
target_text: dhèu sèmi sèra, èci èèna ka dènge rai dhu hèu mèngi boe, nèti èèna ka abhu boe hua-hela dhu be'a. te ngaa ladhe abhu ka èj'i, rai dhu hèu mèngi bisa hia hua-hela dhu dènge guna mi lamatua oka. hèia ama lamatua papuru mamèngi-nale, sèna ka hua-hela nèti rai ne asa tabha ae.

source_text: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu dhu soro kabodho mi kristus, nuka sèmi rai dhu pènu dènge dhudhu dènge sete di. aa dhudhu-sete se guna boe mi ngaa-ngaa èci sa. nèbhu boe, ama lamatua mai ho huku rai èèna. hèia na labhu pakèpu aa'i dhudhu dènge sete se, dhu gaguna ra aad'o.

source_text: but, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.
target_text: a'ari pasue! masi ka ja'a ako padhai lii bia ciki, te ngaa ja'a ke'a kahèi, na, miu rai eele boe kristus. te miu parcaya ne kahèi, aa mamuri miu kahèi abhu hua-hela dhu be'a.

source_text: for god is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.
target_text: de sanèd'e, te d'ara ama lamatua mola, aa na bhèlu boe èi kabhèsu miu. te miu sab'a bia le, sèna ka soru-bara dhèu unu na sèra, aa mi sue si. mema karèi nèti uru ka, miu pakako le sasab'a na. aa miu pakako taruu sasab'a na era.

source_text: we desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,
target_text: te limuri ne, ja'a d'èi ladhe miu sab'a èra risi hari, sèna ka tao madhutu taruu toke pa'èle. dènge sèmi èèna, miu bèli-camèd'a sèmi mere babe'a aa'i-aa'i dhu miu sanao nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: that you won't be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.
target_text: sad'i miu baku bai-eed'a! miu hud'i laladhe nèti dhèu dhu parcaya nèbhu le mi ama lamatua. te rèngu tino sanao-maena mi nèngu, toke ra sèmi rare aa'i dhu lamatua pajaji le.

source_text: for when god made a promise to abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself, saying, surely blessing i will bless you, and multiplying i will multiply you. thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise. for men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.
target_text: conto nuka sèmi abraham. uru èèna, ama lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge ne pake lii subha. ladhe dhèu rai-haha ded'e subha, nèngu tema pake kolongara ama lamatua, sèna ka lamatua j'aj'i sakasii na, lula lamatua risi nèti nèngu. aa ladhe paraga dènge lii langu, dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a, na, lii dhu dhèu ne peka èèna lèke tare'a, lula na subha pake kolongara ama lamatua. èèna mema j'ara dhèu rai-haha kèna. te ngaa lod'o ama lamatua ded'e subha dènge abraham, lamatua pake kolongara nèngu unu na, lula abhu boe dhu risi nèti nèngu. na jaji, peka na, èèna na, ja'a hia mèngi-nale ae-ae, mi èu dènge ana-èpu mu, bèli-camèd'a rèngu bèba-kacanga, toke dhèu bisa boe ige rare si. ama lamatua padadha nare sèmi èèna, hèia abraham parcaya, aa sanao-maena taruu mi lamatua, masi ka d'ai nèbhu ae ku, heka sèmi nare ngaa dhu lamatua pajaji sèra.

source_text: in this way god, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne, èdhi te'a, ladhe lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dènge dhèu unu na, nèngu pa'èki lii pajaji ne pake subha, ho j'aj'i mi tate'a, ngaa dhu na moa èèna, mema lèke aa ub'a boe.

source_text: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for god to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.
target_text: te abhu dua j'ara dhu bisa boe ub'a. ka èci, nuka lii pajaji ama lamatua. aa èci hari, nuka lii subha lamatua, dhu na pake j'aj'i mi tate'a nèti lii pajaji na. de ladhe ama lamatua dhu moa le j'ara èci, tatu na tao madhutu, lula nèngu bisa boe omo koso. nèti èèna ka, èdhi baku pangee rupa-rupa dènge lii pajaji na. èdhi dhu rai lati le, sèna ka tenge mamuri nèti nèngu, de limuri ne, èdhi dhoka mate di, ho sanao dhoka mi nèngu di.

source_text: this hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, d'ara èdhi taleo nuka sèmi koha dhu rai eele nèti d'ara rii, ho la'e panahu ètu hèb'a-namo. te era maena èdhi dhoka kristus di, dhu j'aj'i le kètu kapai risi agama èdhi. uru èèna, lèke dènge lod'o kalela dhèu yahudi, kètu kapai risi agama rèngu maso asa kama luri mola-mèci re bèla gorden, sèna ka paraga dènge ama lamatua ètu èèna.

source_text: where as a forerunner jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of melchizedek.
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne, yesus dhu la'e uuru le, ho bhoke j'ara hia èdhi. te nèngu kètu kapai risi agama kahèi, dhu ca ropa dènge melkisedek, dhu uru èèna. te ngaa yesus kapai risi nèti kètu agama uru èèna, lula na ae nèdhi boe pakako sasab'a-la'a na.

source_text: for this melchizedek, king of salem, priest of god most high, who met abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him, to whom also abraham divided a tenth part of all being first, by interpretation, king of righteousness, and then also king of salem, which means king of peace, without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the son of god, remains a priest continually.
target_text: uru èèna, melkisedek j'aj'i dhèu aae kota salem. nèngu kahèi kètu agama nèti dhèu-dhèu dhu pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele èèna. ngara melkisedek ne, sasoa na, dhèu aae d'ara mola. aa dhèu aae salem, sasoa na, dhèu aae dame. èci sa re'a boe j'aj'aj'i melkisedek ne nèti mia. èci sa re'a boe kahèi ina dènge ama na, aa bèi-baki na. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu re'a lod'o rara iisi na, aa lod'o mamadhe na. dhèu re'a dhoka, nèngu dhèu aae kota salem, aa kètu agama nèti ama lamatua. te ngaa nèngu ne, nuka sèmi ana ama lamatua, lula nèngu ama agama dhu pakako taruu sasab'a na kahèi. ca tèka, pèri-pèri dhèu aae dènge sordad'u ra mai parame rèti mèdha-panyau angalai abraham. ka abraham dènge angalai na lasi pamusu dènge dhèu aae se, toke abraham segi si. hèia mèdha-panyau nèti angalai na sèra, abraham nèti aa'i hari. ropa abraham lèpa asa rai na, hèia melkisedek kalua nèti kota salem, ho la'e soru ne. ka na hia abraham berkat, peka na, hud'i laa ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele èèna, hia èu mèngi-nale. èle ka abraham hia melkisedek ca pala nèti canguru pala, nèti mèdha aa'i-aa'i dhu na parame nare hari sèra. abraham pabagi hia ne, lula melkisedek ne kètu agama nèti ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele.

source_text: now consider how great this man was, to whom even abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.
target_text: de pangee paie-iie melkisedek ne! abraham bagi hia ne ca pala nèti canguru pala, nèti mèdha aa'i-aa'i dhu be'a risi dhu na parame nare hari. de dhu lèke, nuka melkisedek ne dhèu kapai.

source_text: they indeed of the sons of levi who receive the priest's office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of abraham,
target_text: aa te ngaa lod'o sèra, ama lamatua ded'e mèka dhèu j'aj'i ama agama. toke d'ai ku lod'o lewi, ana-èpu èci nèti abraham, heka ama lamatua ded'e ne dènge ana-èpu na, sèna ka j'aj'i ama agama hia mi ana-èpu abraham aa'i-aa'i ra. èle èèna ka, ama lamatua papuru atora na dhu peka na, dhèu nèti suku lewi dènge hak ho abhu ca pala nèti canguru pala nèti rui-j'aj'èra a'ari ra suku leo sèra ètu isra'el.

source_text: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.
target_text: te ngaa melkisedek ne, ana-èpu boe nèti lewi. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abraham bagi hia ne ca pala nèti canguru pala, lula na pangee, na, melkisedek ne dhèu kapai. lod'o èèna abraham dhu sèmi nare le lii pajaji nèti ama lamatua ho hia ne berkat. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa melkisedek peka kahèi, na, hud'i laa ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele èèna, hia èu mèngi-nale.

source_text: but without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.
target_text: ne'e ne ka j'aj'i mi tadha, na, melkisedek ne, dhèu kapai. lula dhèu dhu hia berkat tatu kapai risi nèti dhèu dhu sèmi nare berkat.

source_text: here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.
target_text: ama agama aa'i-aa'i ra dènge hak abhu ca pala nèti canguru pala. te ngaa, lula rèngu dhèu rai-haha biasa, nèbhu-nèbhu ra madhe kahèi. kètu agama melkisedek abhu kahèi ca pala nèti canguru pala. te ngaa na mamuri taruu, lula sasuri mola-mèci lamatua peka boe na, nèngu madhe.

source_text: we can say that through abraham even levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes, for he was yet in the body of his father when melchizedek met him.
target_text: lula abraham bagi hia melkisedek ca pala nèti canguru pala nèti mèdha na sèra, dhèu bisa pangee, na, abraham tago nare kahèi ana-èpu na dhu rara iisi mèka. dènge j'ara sèmi èèna, èdhi bisa pangee, na, nèngu b'ae mema le unu ana-èpu na lewi, ca pala nèti canguru pala.

source_text: now if perfection was through the levitical priesthood for under it the people have received the law, what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of melchizedek, and not be called after the order of aaron?
target_text: lod'o ana-èpu lewi sèra j'aj'i ama agama, lamatua pili nare harun, a'a musa, ho j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama dhu partama. sasab'a nèti ama agama sèra, nuka soru-bara dhèu, sèna ka mamuri mola, pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. masi ka rèngu mamuri madhutu atora agama aa'i-aa'i sèra, te ngaa kètu agama ca ropa dènge harun, lake nare boe tao dhèu se mola-mèci. nèti èèna ka, rèngu parluu kètu agama leo, dhu ca ropa dènge melkisedek.

source_text: for the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.
target_text: te ngaa ladhe kètu agama rupa hiu gati eele kètu agama rupa dhui, tatu atora dhui hud'i gati eele kahèi.

source_text: for he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.
target_text: de te'a mèu le, kètu agama rupa hiu èèna, nuka yesus. te rara iisi ne, nèti boe suku lewi, te ngaa nèti suku leo. madhutu atora musa, kètu agama ca ropa dènge harun, dhoka mai nèti suku lewi di, bisa boe nèti suku leo.

source_text: for it is evident that our lord has sprung out of judah, about which tribe moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.
target_text: te ngaa dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu re'a, na, kètu èdhi, yesus kristus, j'aj'i nèti suku yahuda. madhutu atora musa, abhu mèka dhu j'aj'i kètu agama nèti suku ne'e.

source_text: this is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of melchizedek there arises another priest,
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua pake heka atora dhui, lula abhu le yesus dhu j'aj'i kètu agama rupa hiu, nuka sèmi melkisedek.

source_text: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;
target_text: te madhutu atora musa, kètu agama rupa dhui hud'i mai ku nèti suku lewi. te ngaa yesus mai boe nèti suku èèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa ama lamatua ded'e ne, sèna ka j'aj'i kètu agama rupa hiu, lula nèngu dènge koasa ho mamuri toke d'ai mia-mia, aa abhu boe dhu bisa palaho ne.

source_text: for it is testified, you are a priest forever, according to the order of melchizedek.
target_text: te sasuri lamatua suri, peka na, èu j'aj'i kètu agama ca ropa dènge melkisedek, dhu uru èèna, te ngaa èu j'aj'i kètu agama toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: for there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness
target_text: sasoa na, atora dhui dènge boe koasa, sèna ka soru-bara dhèu rai-haha. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua pake heka atora dhui, dhu uru èèna na pangèd'u mi musa.

source_text: for the law made nothing perfect, and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to god.
target_text: te masi ka dhèu mamuri madhutu atora dhui sèra, te ngaa sasala ra era. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne, ama lamatua bhoke le j'ara dhu be'a risi, ho èdhi bisa mamuri padame dènge ne.

source_text: inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath for they indeed have been made priests without an oath, but he with an oath by him that says of him, the lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘you are a priest forever, according to the order of melchizedek. '
target_text: uru èèna, lod'o ama lamatua ded'e ana-èpu lewi ho j'aj'i ama agama, lamatua pajaji boe, aa subha boe ngaa-ngaa dènge rèngu. te ngaa lod'o ama lamatua ded'e yesus j'aj'i kètu agama, na pajaji, peka na, ja'a ne, lamatua! ja'a subha, ja'a ub'a boe ngaa-ngaa dhu ja'a pajaji le. ja'a ded'e èu j'aj'i kètu agama, sèna ka èu pakako taruu sasab'a-la'a mu.

source_text: by so much, jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.
target_text: dènge lii pajaji sèmi èèna, ama lamatua pake yesus j'aj'i mi tate'a hia èdhi, dhu peka na, nèngu neo pa'èki lii pajaji dhu be'a risi dènge èdhi.

source_text: many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.
target_text: uru èèna, kètu agama rupa dhui gati taruu, lula ra madhe. nèti èèna ka, hud'i abhu ku kètu agama ae-ae.

source_text: but he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.
target_text: te ngaa yesus, kètu agama rupa hiu dhu mamuri taa-taa, aa na loe boe pakako sasab'a-la'a na. nèti èèna ka, parluu boe dhèu gati ne.

source_text: therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to god through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus bisa hia mamuri mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu neo mai re nèngu asa madha ama lamatua. nèngu bisa tao sèmi èèna, toke d'ai mia-mia la'e. aa nèngu j'aj'i dhèu d'ara, dhu loe boe manèngi ama lamatua ho soru-bara rèngu.

source_text: for such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
target_text: yesus kètu kapai risi agama dhu lalau-lalo'o èdhi. te nèngu ne, dhèu mola-mèci dhu dènge boe sasala ngaa-ngaa. nèngu ne, sama boe dènge dhèu rai-haha biasa, dhu re'a dhoka ad'u-ue sasala di. te ama lamatua dhu nedhe ne padedha-dedha, risi nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu ètu sorga dènge rai-haha.

source_text: who doesn't need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. for he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, yesus be'a risi nèti kètu agama rupa dhui aa'i-aa'i ra. uru sèra, rèngu bèli-bèli hud'i roro badha tao korban, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo rèngu unu ra. èle ku, heka ra tao korban hia dhèu biasa kèna. te ngaa yesus parluu boe tao korban pahari-pahari sèmi èèna, lula na saraka ngi'u na ca tèka èèna ka di, sèna ka j'aj'i korban. ne'e ne d'ai aa'i kèna, ho lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: for the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a son forever who has been perfected.
target_text: madhutu atora musa, rèngu ded'e dhèu rai-haha biasa ho j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama. te ngaa sasala ra era. nèti èèna ka, ama lamatua tao lii pajaji hiu, peka na, nèngu ded'e ana na j'aj'i kètu kapai risi agama. te ana na, madhutu taruu dad'èi na.

source_text: now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the majesty in the heavens,
target_text: de lii padhai ja'a dhu kab'ua, sèmi ne'e ka: limuri ne, èdhi dènge le kètu kapai risi agama dhu be'a risi nèti uru sèra. nèngu ne'e, nuka yesus. nèngu dhu madhèdi nèd'u paredha ètu sorga, ètu baboa g'ana ama lamatua dhu dedha risi eele.

source_text: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the lord pitched, not man.
target_text: aa na pakako sasab'a na ètu era sabaj'a dhu asli ètu sorga. era ne'e ne, pa'ue-ai ama lamatua mesa na, nèti boe dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: for every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.
target_text: kètu kapai risi agama tema nèti mèdha persembahan dènge korban hia ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, yesus hud'i nèti korban kahèi.

source_text: for if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,
target_text: te ngaa yesus pakako boe sasab'a na ètu rai-haha. lula ètu rai-haha ne, abhu le ama agama dhu hia mèdha persembahan dènge korban asa ama lamatua madhutu atora musa.

source_text: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as moses was warned by god when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, see, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.
target_text: ra pakako sasab'a ra ètu d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i, dhu ca ropa dènge era sabaj'a dhu asli ètu sorga. te lod'o musa neo tao paleo ne, ama lamatua pasanèd'e ne, peka na, sanèd'e paie-iie! èu hud'i tao ku palèke mola-mola dènge rupa dhu ja'a pad'elo dènge èu ètu kolo ledhe nèi!

source_text: but now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.
target_text: te ngaa sasab'a yesus ne, kapai risi nèti ama agama rupa dhui aa'i-aa'i ra. te limuri ne, ama lamatua pa'èki le lii pajaji dhu be'a risi, lula na pake yesus j'aj'i kalete kahèi, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha bisa padame dènge ama lamatua.

source_text: for if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.
target_text: uru èèna, na pa'èki lii pajaji dènge musa, ropa na papuru atora sèra. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa dhèu rai-haha bisa boe mamuri mola-mèci madhutu atora ne. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bisa boe pabe'a dènge ama lamatua. nèti èèna ka, limuri ne, parluu abhu lii pajaji dhu be'a risi hari.

source_text: for finding fault with them, he said, behold, the days are coming, says the lord, that i will make a new covenant with the house of israel and with the house of judah;
target_text: te lod'o uru sèra, ama lamatua dhu kai le dhèu unu na, lula rèngu sisu pahari-pahari atora na. ropa na taha nare heka d'ara, hèia na nasa, ka peka, aku nèngu na, nanene paie-iie, te ja'a ne lamatua! tatu ja'a neo pa'èki hari lii pajaji hiu dènge dhèu isra'el sèra, aa dènge suku yahuda.

source_text: not according to the covenant that i made with their fathers in the day that i took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of egypt; for they didn't continue in my covenant, and i disregarded them, says the lord.
target_text: lii pajaji dhu ja'a neo pa'èki dènge rèngu èèna, sama boe dènge lii pajaji uru èèna dhu hia mi bèi-baki ra. te uru èèna, ja'a kadhèi kacui-aai ra, ho lere si kalua nèti rai masir. te ngaa rèngu tao boe madhutu ngaa dhu ra pajaji dènge ja'a. nèti èèna ka, ja'a pusi-pahae heka si.

source_text: for this is the covenant that i will make with the house of israel after those days, says the lord: i will put my laws into their mind; i will also write them on their heart. i will be their god, and they will be my people.
target_text: lii pajaji dhu èèna na ja'a pa'èki dènge suku isra'el, isi na sèmi ne'e ka: pe ja'a tao atora ja'a ètu d'ara ngangee ra. pe ja'a suri paredha ja'a, ètu d'ara rèngu. hèia ja'a j'aj'i lamatua ra, aa rèngu j'aj'i dhèu unu ja'a.

source_text: they will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘know the lord, ' for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.
target_text: bèli-camèd'a rèngu parluu heka aj'a-nori angalai ra, dènge a'ari ra, peka na, ‘miu hud'i tadhe ku lamatua! ' te rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra tadhe mèu ja'a, mulai nèti ana iiki-iiki toke d'ai kapai aae.

source_text: for i will be merciful to their unrighteousness. i will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.
target_text: lula ja'a neo pad'elo rasa kasia ja'a mi rèngu, nèti èèna ka ja'a pabhèlu eele sasala-sasigo ra aa'i-aa'i.

source_text: in that he says, a new covenant, he has made the first obsolete. but that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.
target_text: lod'o lamatua padhai lii nare, na neo pa'èki lii pajaji hiu dènge ra, sasoa na, lii pajaji dhui pake heka. nèbhu heka, na ele.

source_text: now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.
target_text: ja'a neo pasanèd'e miu sèmi ne'e: lod'o ama lamatua pa'èki hiu-hiu lii pajaji dènge bèi-baki èdhi, nèngu papuru atora kahèi, sèna ka ra tao era manèngi-mangaj'i, ho ra bisa pahaha iisi mi nèngu madhutu dad'èi atora sèra.

source_text: for a tabernacle was prepared. in the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the holy place.
target_text: ètu era manèngi-mangaj'i ne, abhu madha èmu dènge paleo aae cue. ètu d'ara kama re madha nèti paleo ne, abhu era tatèka labhu dènge mei èci dhu ama agama tèke roti dhu rèngu neo hia ama lamatua. kama re madha ne, ra peka na, kama mola-mèci ama lamatua.

source_text: after the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the holy of holies,
target_text: abhu kahèi bèla bhabhiri kapai ca bèla dhu pa'abhe kama leo èci, dhu ra peka na, kama luri mola-mèci ama lamatua.

source_text: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, aaron's rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;
target_text: re madha bèla bhabhiri ne, abhu mei hualaa cue, era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi hia ama lamatua. aa ètu d'ara kama luri mola-mèci èèna, abhu boaraka hualaa èci, dhu ra peka na, boaraka pajaji. ètu d'ara boaraka ne, rèngu tao mèdha uuru sèra, sèna ka pasanèd'e dhèu lula-nèti j'ara lii pajaji ama lamatua dhu na pa'èki dènge rèngu. ètu era ne'e, abhu kahèi toples hualaa cue dhu isi roti manna. roti ne'e ka dhu uru èèna ama lamatua papuru mai nèti dedha-liru hia mi bèi-baki èdhi, lod'o rèngu manganga ètu d'ara pad'a sod'a. ètu d'ara boaraka ne, abhu kahèi tatea unu harun, dhu uru èèna sub'u dadana hiu. abhu kahèi hadhu kabela, dhu uru èèna ama lamatua pake ho dule atora na dhu pangèd'u mi musa.

source_text: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can't speak now in detail.
target_text: ètu katanga boaraka ne, abhu dhu dule rupa dua ana dhèu dhu saraga titu kèna. ana dhèu se, rupa ra nuka sèmi ana pajuu nèti sorga dhu dènge èla, dhu titu baa èla, ho bhiri boaraka ne, lula era ne j'aj'i mi tadha, ho pad'elo rasa kasia ama lamatua mi dhèu rai-haha. te ngaa limuri ne, ja'a pamadhera heka lii lole nèti mèdha-panyau se.

source_text: now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,
target_text: rèngu pangèci mèdha-panyau ètu d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua mema sèmi èèna ka. bèli-bèli, ama agama sèra maso-kalua kama re madha ne, sèna ka ra pakako sasab'a ra ètu èèna.

source_text: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.
target_text: te ngaa dhodhoka kètu kapai risi agama yahudi di, dhu bisa maso la'e asa d'ara kama luri mola-mèci èèna. aa nèngu maso leli boe, te ngaa maso sa d'ara dhoka ca tèu ca tèka. aa ladhe na maso, nèngu hud'i nèti dènge raa badha korban, ho pici asa katanga boaraka pajaji ne. sasoa nèti raa ne, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala-sasigo nèti kètu agama dènge dhèu-dhèu unu na aa'i-aa'i, masi ka sasala dhu rèngu ad'u-ue dènge boe d'ara mase'a.

source_text: the holy spirit is indicating this, that the way into the holy place wasn't yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.
target_text: ama lamatua pake le roh mola-mèci na, sèna ka hia èdhi te'a, na, ladhe bèla bhabhiri abhu era ètu j'ara maso asa d'ara kama luri mola-mèci èèna, sasoa na, dhèu rai-haha bisa mèka maso asa madha ama lamatua, ladhe pake atora dhui era.

source_text: this is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,
target_text: se'e se j'aj'i mi conto dhu roh lamatua pake, sèna ka aj'a-nori èdhi dhu mamuri limuri ne. uru èèna, bèi-baki èdhi rèti mèdha persembahan dènge badha korban rèngu asa ama agama, sèna ka ama lamatua saku eele sasala ra. masi ka rèti korban ae-ae sèmi èèna, te ngaa korban sèra bisa boe pamèu d'ara ra, aa bisa boe pa'ele rasa sala ètu d'ara rèngu.

source_text: being only with foods and drinks and various washings fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.
target_text: de, ngaa dhu rèngu tao sèra, dhoka madhutu atora agama di. abhu atora dhu paredha, peka na, rèngu bisa boe ra'a ne'e, aa bisa boe rinu èèna. abhu atora dhu leo peka na, rèngu hud'i pamèu ku ngi'u ra dènge mèdha dhu ra pake madhutu dad'èi atora. aa te ngaa, madhutu iia-iia na, atora aa'i-aa'i sèra, ator dhoka ngi'u re li'u di, te ngaa ator boe d'ara dhèu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa atora sèra hud'i pakako taruu, toke ama lamatua gati dènge atora dhu hiu.

source_text: but christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,
target_text: te ngaa limuri ne abhu le dhèu dhu uru èèna ama lamatua padhadha tèke, nuka kristus. na mai le sèna ka j'aj'i kètu agama kapai risi èdhi, aa na tao le j'ara dhu be'a hia èdhi. na pakako sasab'a-la'a na, sama sèmi kètu agama rupa dhui, te ngaa na sab'a ètu era sabaj'a dhu be'a risi eele. era manèngi-mangaj'i na, ètu boe rai-haha ne, te j'aj'i boe nèti pa'ue-ai dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption.
target_text: kristus maso asa d'ara kama luri mola-mèci èèna kahèi, ho paraga dènge ama lamatua, sama sèmi dhu kètu kapai risi agama dhu rupa dhui se tao ca tèu ca tèka. aa lod'o na maso la'e, na nèti raa hia ama lamatua kahèi. te ngaa raa ne leko-leo. te kristus nèti boe raa badha korban. dhu nèti, nuka raa nèngu unu na, lula nèngu madhe le j'aj'i korban hia èdhi. te ngaa kristus maso, nèti raa na dhoka ca tèka di, sèna ka patabuli eele èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo èdhi toke d'ai mia-mia la'e.

source_text: for if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,
target_text: de raa kristus èèna, mema kab'ua risi nèti raa badha. te madhutu atora musa, dhèu dhu tao sala sèra, kaj'alu, ka nia boe maso ho manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua. rèngu hud'i lasi ku asa kètu agama ho tao korban, sèna ka raa korban se pamèu hari rèngu. nèti korban sèra, ae ka dhu pake raa kahib'i dènge raa sapi. abhu kahèi atora èci, dhu peka na, ladhe dhèu goi lèke dhèu madhe, nèngu kaj'alu ètu madha lamatua. ladhe na neo hari j'aj'i mola-mèci, kètu agama hud'i nare ku ahu sisa nèti sapi èni dhu ra tunu. èle, na nèti ahu èèna, ho la'e ceb'e asa dhèu dhu kaj'alu èèna, ho sèna ka na mola-mèci hari.

source_text: how much more will the blood of christ, who through the eternal spirit offered himself without defect to god, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living god?
target_text: de ladhe raa badha bisa tao dhèu j'aj'i mola-mèci, risi-risi hari dènge raa kristus! te raa kristus èèna ka dhu patalale èdhi nèti koasa sasala-sasigo, aa pamèu d'ara èdhi kahèi. te sasala èdhi ka dhu cèri eele èdhi nèti ama lamatua. lod'o yesus kristus madhe sèmi èèna, roh ama lamatua dhu mamuri taa-taa, soru-bara ne, sèna ka na soro iisi na asa lamatua, nuka sèmi badha korban dhu dènge boe tadha karehe ciki sa hèi ètu ngi'u na. de limuri ne èdhi bisa le pahaha iisi dènge d'ara kateme mi ama lamatua dhu mamuri dènge boe too-lane.

source_text: for this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.
target_text: lula raa kristus dhu kab'ua risi eele èèna, ka ama lamatua pake ne, ho ator lii pajaji hiu hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu ama lamatua paroa nare si, j'aj'i dhèu unu na. te lod'o kristus madhe ho hia mamuri mi dhèu, nèngu sui nare kahèi bèi-baki èdhi nèti sasala dhu ra ad'u-ue uru-uru sèra, lod'o ama lamatua pa'èki lii pajaji dhui dènge ra. nèti èèna ka, rèngu bisa mamuri taa-taa dènge ama lamatua kahèi.

source_text: for where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.
target_text: ja'a pakasame dènge dhèu abhu pusaka, nuka sèmi ca dhèu ama dhu tao sasuri pajaji, ho hia ana na pusaka. te ngaa ladhe ama na madhe, heka ana èèna abhu pusaka sèra.

source_text: for a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.
target_text: te ladhe ama na dhae madhe mèka, ana na bisa mèka abhu pusaka dhu ama na padhadha ètu d'ara sasuri pajaji èèna.

source_text: therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.
target_text: èci èèna ka dènge lii pajaji ama lamatua dhu partama, dhu na pa'èki dènge bèi-baki èdhi sèra. ladhe abhu dhu madhe uuru, heka rèngu abhu ngaa dhu lamatua jaji. nèti èèna ka, korban rèngu pake raa badha ho j'aj'i mi tadha, peka na, abhu dhu madhe le.

source_text: for when every commandment had been spoken by moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,
target_text: uru èèna, musa oru nare bèi-baki èdhi, ka na peka aa'i paredha dhu abhu ètu d'ara atora dhu lamatua papuru mai. èle èèna ka, musa roro sapi dènge kahib'i sèna ka nare raa, ka na pab'ali dènge èi. musa nare dhari mea kahèi, ka na pa'èki dènge pèri-pèri ana aaj'u dhu rèu lutu. hèia na cèb'u asa d'ara raa èèna, ka pici mi sasuri lamatua, aa mi dhèu unu na aa'i-aa'i si.

source_text: saying, this is the blood of the covenant which god has commanded you.
target_text: lod'o musa pici raa ne, na padhai lii kahèi, peka na, raa ne'e ne j'aj'i mi tadha, dhu peka na, ama lamatua dhu pa'èki lii pajaji dènge miu. ladhe miu madhutu aa'i paredha na, bèli-camèd'a nèngu hia aa'i dhu na pajaji le sèra.

source_text: he sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.
target_text: musa pici raa asa paleo manèngi-mangaj'i kahèi, dènge asa mèdha aa'i-aa'i ètu sèra, dhu ra pake ho pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua.

source_text: according to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.
target_text: te madhutu atora lamatua, aa'i-aa'i dhu kaj'alu hud'i pamèu ku pake raa. nèti èèna ka, ladhe dhèu rai-haha neo j'aj'i mola-mèci nèti sasala ra, hud'i dènge ku raa korban.

source_text: it was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
target_text: ngaa dhu ja'a lole nèti j'ara bèi-baki èdhi dènge paleo manèngi-mangaj'i, se'e se dhoka conto di, sèna ka èdhi bisa te'a mèu, era manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua dhu asli ètu sorga. te ladhe kètu agama rupa dhui neo lasi asa d'ara paleo èèna ho manèngi-mangaj'i mi ama lamatua, rèngu hud'i pamèu aa'i-aa'i ku pake raa badha korban. era manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua ètu sorga kahèi hud'i mèu taruu-taruu. te ngaa hud'i pake ku raa korban dhu kab'ua risi eele nèti raa badha.

source_text: for christ hasn't entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of god for us;
target_text: kama luri mola-mèci dhu kristus maso èèna, ètu boe d'ara paleo manèngi-mangaj'i dhu dhèu rai-haha tao. te paleo dhu ètu rai-haha èèna, dhoka conto di nèti dhu asli. te ngaa kristus la'e unu na asa sorga ho sarii èdhi ètu madha ama lamatua.

source_text: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,
target_text: uru èèna, kètu kapai risi agama hud'i maso ku la'e asa d'ara kama luri mola-mèci èèna ca tèu ca tèka, aa nèti dènge raa badha hia ama lamatua. te ngaa kristus aad'o sèmi èèna. te nèngu parluu maso dhoka ca tèka di, nèti dènge raa nèngu unu na.

source_text: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. but now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
target_text: te ladhe tèu mai-tèu mai, hud'i na maso sama sèmi kètu agama dhu uru sèra, sasoa na, nèngu hud'i madhe ku pahari-pahari karèi nèti j'aj'aj'i rai-haha toke deo ne'e, sèna ka saku eele aa'i sasala nèti dhèu èci-èci. te ngaa na tao boe sèmi èèna. te ropa d'ai lod'o na, nèngu madhe j'aj'i korban dhoka ca tèka èèna di, ho core eele aa'i sasala dhu dhèu ad'u-ue.

source_text: inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,
target_text: dhu lèke ka, dhèu rai-haha madhe dhoka ca tèka di. èle èèna, nèngu hud'i la'e asa madha ama lamatua ho ama lamatua parisa ne.

source_text: so christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.
target_text: sèmi èèna kahèi kristus. nèngu madhe, aa saraka ngi'u na ho j'aj'i korban ca tèka èèna ka. aa bèli-camèd'a na lèpa hari mai. te ngaa na mai uri heka sasala dhèu, lula na tao pa'èle aa'i le sasab'a èèna. te ngaa dhu na uri, nuka pala mamuri hia mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sanao-maena mi nèngu.

source_text: for the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.
target_text: ladhe tare'a-re'a dhèu neo re'a mèu dad'èi ama lamatua, atora dhu na pangèd'u asa bèi-baki èdhi sèra, dhae led'a iia mèka. te aa'i-aa'i se nuka sèmi sanabhu nèti j'ara-j'ara hua iia dhu lamatua neo hia èdhi. de masi ka dhèu madhutu aa'i atora, aa rèti dènge badha korban taruu-taruu, te ngaa bisa boe saku pamèu sasala rèngu.

source_text: or else wouldn't they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?
target_text: te ladhe atora ne bisa tao eele sasala dhèu, na, rèngu rèti heka badha korban, lula rèngu rasa heka sala. te ngaa sèmi boe èèna.

source_text: but in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.
target_text: te tèu mai-tèu mai rèngu manèngi pahari-pahari ho ama lamatua saku eele sasala ra,

source_text: for it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.
target_text: lula, tatu boe raa badha dènge koasa, sèna ka saku eele sasala dhèu toke d'ai mia-mia.

source_text: therefore when he comes into the world, he says, you didn't desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me. you had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, kristus peka sèmi ne'e, lod'o na mai asa rai-haha ne, aku nèngu na, ama lamatua! ama d'èi boe badha korban dènge mèdha persembahan dhu rèngu rèti. rèngu roro pamadhe badha ae-ae, sèna ka j'aj'i korban. ka rèngu tunu badha sèra, ho manèngi abho. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa d'ara ama karej'e boe. nèti èèna ka, ama pua ja'a mai asa rai-haha ne, sèna ka j'aj'i dhèu rai-haha sama sèmi rèngu.

source_text: then i said, ‘behold, i have come in the scroll of the book it is written of me to do your will, o god. '
target_text: hèia kristus tuhu hari lii, aku nèngu na, ama! ja'a ka ne'e le! ja'a mai sèna ka tao madhutu dad'èi ama, nuka sèmi dhèu rèti lii padhai ama dhu suri mema lula-nèti ja'a.

source_text: previously saying, sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn't desire, neither had pleasure in them those which are offered according to the law,
