target_text: ka rèngu aa'i-aa'i sod'a lii sod'a hiu èci, peka na: ana kalèbho ne'e ka dhu nia sèmi nare sasuri ne. ana kalèbho ne'e ka dhu dènge hak ho bisa bhoke segel sèra. te nèngu ne'e ka dhu ra pamadhe le. hèia ama lamatua pake raa na, ho sui nare dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne, sèna ka dhèu cahag'e bisa j'aj'i dhèu unu lamatua. dènge sèmi èèna, dhèu rai-haha nèti lii aa'i-aa'i dènge rai aa'i-aa'i, bisa j'aj'i ana-ana lamatua.

source_text: and made us kings and priests to our god; and we will reign on the earth.
target_text: ana kalèbho ne'e ka, oru nare si aa'i-aa'i, j'aj'i mi ca rae-ca nadha. ana kalèbho ne'e ka, hag'e nare si, j'aj'i dhèu sab'a lamatua. bèli-camèd'a rèngu se'e ka dhu rèd'u paredha ètu rai-haha. pe rèngu sab'a hia lamatua ètu rai-haha.

source_text: i looked, and i heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. the number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,
target_text: èle ka, ja'a boti kètu, hèia tadèngi lii mèdhu aae èci. hèia ja'a ladhe badha aae èpa ngi'u, dènge dua nguru èpa katua se, tabha hari dènge ana pajuu nèti sorga ae titu kèna. ana pajuu se d'ai juta-kehi.

source_text: saying with a loud voice, worthy is the lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!
target_text: rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sod'a dènge lii mèdhu, peka na, ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha ana kalèbho dhu ra pamadhe le, lula nèngu ka dhu nia sèmi nare lii koa-kio ji'i! koasa na, kapai risi eele. kakaja na, lale-kabèle. ngangee lii padhai na, lèke mola-mola. a'èra na, èci sa risi boe. ji'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na. ji'i pakab'ua ne. ji'i koa-kio ne.

source_text: i heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, to him who sits on the throne and to the lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! amen!
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a tadèngi hari lii sod'a dhu leo èci. lii sod'a ne, mai nèti aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu: sorga, dedha-liru, rai-haha, dènge d'ara dhasi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra sod'a. nèti era dhèu madhe kahèi, ra madhutu sod'a. aa'i-aa'i ra sod'a, peka na, ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha. ji'i nedhe padedha-dedha kahèi ana kalèbho ne. ji'i pakab'ua rèngu. ji'i pahaha iisi mi rèngu. lula rèngu ka dhu rèd'u paredha taa-taa! aa koasa ra dhu dènge boe too-lane!

source_text: the four living creatures said, amen! then the elders fell down and worshiped.
target_text: hèia èpa badha aae se, loe boe dènge lii dhaa, peka na, tare'a-re'a! lèke kèna! ka dua nguru èpa katua se'e pabèbha hari iisi ra, hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu, ho ra pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua, dènge ana kalèbho èèna.

source_text: i saw that the lamb opened one of the seven seals, and i heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, come and see!
target_text: èle ka, ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana kalèbho bhoke segel ka èci nèti lalulu sasuri èèna. hèia ja'a tadèngi, na, èci nèti èpa badha aae sèra parodha dènge lii mèdhu, nuka sèmi lii d'oro. na paredha, peka na, lamu dènge ka!

source_text: then a white horse appeared, and he who sat on it had a bow. a crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.
target_text: cag'ag'a laa, ja'a kèdhi jara pudhi ci'u. dhèu èci dhu manya'e pake dènge solo kapala musu, lula nèngu ka dhu segi taruu ètu d'ara pamusu. limuri ne na kèpe le kataki-hahusu, la'e ho segi hari musu na ètu rai-haha.

source_text: when he opened the second seal, i heard the second living creature saying, come!
target_text: hèia ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka dua. ka ja'a tadèngi badha aae ka dua paredha, peka na, lamu dènge ka!

source_text: another came out, a red horse. to him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. there was given to him a great sword.
target_text: ka jara ci'u dhu mea gèu-gèu kalua mai. dhèu dhu manya'e jara ne sèmi nare samala aae èci. ra hia ne koasa ho la'e pamaruru ètu rai-haha, sèna ka dhèu rai-haha èci pamadhe èci.

source_text: when he opened the third seal, i heard the third living creature saying, come and see! and behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.
target_text: ka ana kalèbho bhoke segel ka tèlu. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii paredha nèti badha aae ka tèlu, peka na, lamu dènge ka! kaca'a laa, ja'a kèdhi jara mèdhi ci'u. dhèu dhu manya'e jara ne nèd'u dènge kabatai cue, sèna ka tai nganga'a dhu oe kura kèna.

source_text: i heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, a choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! don't damage the oil and the wine!
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi hari, nuka sèmi lii èci mai nèti talora aae badha èpa ngi'u se, peka na, bèli-camèd'a, abhu manganga-mad'èu dhu kapai titu kèna ètu rai-haha. gaji dhèu ca lod'o nia dhoka hèli laludhu tèlu moo di; te ngaa neo laludhu be'a, abhu dhoka ca moo di. masi ka sèmi èèna, dhèu bisa boe pa'ele iie aj'u saitun dènge aj'u anggor ètu d'ara oka ra.

source_text: when he opened the fourth seal, i heard the fourth living creature saying, come and see!
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka èpa. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii nèti badha aae ka èpa hia paredha, peka na, lamu dènge ka!

source_text: and behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was death. hades followed with him. authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.
target_text: kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi jara ci'u dhu rèu na sanama karara. dhèu dhu manya'e jara ne, ngara na ‘mamadhe'. aa abhu dhu madhutu ne re limuri, ngara na ‘era pea samanga dhèu madhe'. rèngu dua ra abhu koasa ho lasi pamadhe dhèu ètu rai-haha pake samala, tèu manganga-madèu, papèd'a-tarègu, dènge pasoku badha hui dhu bhelu. ladhe ige aa'i dhèu dhu madhe, aa'i-aa'i ra ca kaboko nèti èpa kaboko nèti dhèu dhu pea ètu rai-haha.

source_text: when he opened the fifth seal, i saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the word of god, and for the testimony of the lamb which they had.
target_text: hèia ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka lèmi. ka ja'a kèdhi samanga dhèu dhu ra pamadhe uru sèra ètu ro'a mei korban. ra pamadhe rèngu lula parcaya ama lamatua, aa aj'a-nori dhèu taruu lula-nèti lii holo-nori na.

source_text: they cried with a loud voice, saying, how long, master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?
target_text: ra pa'oo-parodha, peka na, oo lamatua, ama dhu kapai risi! ama dhu mola-mèci! ji'i parcaya ngaa dhu lamatua peka-padhai. te ngaa ji'i hud'i tatae d'ai pèri lod'o hari, heka lamatua pama'ète lii langu, sèna ka huku dhèu dhu pamadhe ji'i ètu rai-haha nèi?

source_text: a long white robe was given to each of them. they were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.
target_text: ropa rèngu karèi rare sèmi èèna, hèia rèngu èci-èci ka abhu kodho pudhi robho d'ai rai. abhu dhu peka dènge ra, tatae hari ku ciki oo'e, toke miu tesa aa'i. te abhu anga miu era dhu ra pamadhe sèmi miu kahèi.

source_text: i saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. the sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.
target_text: ka ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka èna. kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi rai-haha ne opo kapai titu kèna. hèia madha lod'o maroga kiu-kiu, nuka sèmi bèla mèdhi, aa hèru mea sama sèmi raa.

source_text: the stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.
target_text: hua hètu-hua hètu nèti dedha-liru bèbhe mai asa rai-haha, nuka sèmi hua aj'u hoa dhu kabhui, lula lèke ngèlu aae.

source_text: the sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. every mountain and island was moved out of its place.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe, na, liru mae bagi mi dua, ka lulu nuka sèmi dhèpi, toke ele. aa ledhe-ledhe dènge pulu aa'i-aa'i ra gaged'o, toke ele nèti era ra.

source_text: the kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.
target_text: ropa j'ara se j'aj'i, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, mulai nèti dhèu aae-dhèu kapai, komedhaa sordad'u, dhèu kaja-su'i, toke d'ai ènu sèra, aa'i-aa'i ra madha'u titu kèna. ka rai lasi lu'u ètu ro'a-ro'a loe, dènge sasanga-sasanga hadhu ètu ledhe.

source_text: they told the mountains and the rocks, fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the lamb,
target_text: dhèu sèra pua ledhe-ledhe aa hadhu aae sèra, peka na, saguru mere ka ji'i laa! pahuni ji'i sèna ka nèngu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha aae èèna, baku nèdhi ji'i. aa ana kalèbho èèna huku ia ka ji'i.

source_text: for the great day of his wrath has come, and who is able to stand?
target_text: ira ii! ji'i laho mae-mae le, te lod'o d'ai mamadhe-mamopo kèna! ama lamatua dènge ana kalèbho èèna, neo dutu nanasa rèngu mi dedha ji'i. te ngaa èci sa bisa boe sili rare, hèia tatu madhe aa'i mèu-mèu!

source_text: after this, i saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu lamatua dhèu èpa puru mai nèti sorga, titu ètu èpa madha ngèlu ètu rai-haha ne, ho taha ngèlu. ka ngèlu bisa boe tiu asa d'ara dhasi, rai-dedha, dènge aj'u-aj'u.

source_text: i saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living god. he cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,
target_text: lamatua hia si koasa, ho ra pa'ele iie rai-dedha dènge d'ara dhasi. ka ja'a kèdhi hari ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu nèti sorga, mai nèti dhimu. na mai nèti dènge cap ama lamatua dhu mamuri taa-taa. hèia na rodhe mi ana pajuu dhèu èpa sèra, peka na,

source_text: saying, don't harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our god on their foreheads!
target_text: mate ku! baku pa'ele iie ku rai-dedha, do d'ara dhasi, do aj'u sèra. mate toke ji'i tao ngare ku cap mi katangarèi dhèu unu lamatua sèra.

source_text: i heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of israel:
target_text: èle èèna ka, rèngu peka dènge ja'a, na, ana pajuu ne tao le tadha mi dhèu unu lamatua sèra. dhèu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra 144. cangasu èpa nguru èpa riho dhèu, dhu mai nèti suku isra'el. nuka:

source_text: of the tribe of judah twelve thousand were sealed, of the tribe of reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of gad twelve thousand,
target_text: nèti suku yahuda, 12. canguru dua riho dhèu; suku ruben, 12. 000 dhèu; suku gad, 12. 000 dhèu;

source_text: of the tribe of asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of manasseh twelve thousand,
target_text: suku aser, 12. 000 dhèu; suku naftali, 12. 000 dhèu; suku manase, 12. 000 dhèu;

source_text: of the tribe of simeon twelve thousand, of the tribe of levi twelve thousand, of the tribe of issachar twelve thousand,
target_text: suku simeon, 12. 000 dhèu; suku lewi, 12. 000 dhèu; suku isaskar, 12. 000 dhèu;

source_text: of the tribe of zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of joseph twelve thousand, and of the tribe of benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.
target_text: suku sebulon, 12. 000 dhèu; suku yusuf, 12. 000 dhèu; aa nèti suku benyamin, 12. 000 dhèu.

source_text: after these things i looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a kèdhi dhèu ae titu kèna, dhu ige kore boe. rèngu mai nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, nèti udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, nèti kabarai aa'i-aa'i, aa nèti lii aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha. rèngu pakaboko tangara asa kadera paredha, aa asa ana kalèbho kahèi. dhèu sèra pake kodho pudhi, aa ra kèpe dènge rèu palam.

source_text: they cried with a loud voice, saying, salvation be to our god, who sits on the throne, and to the lamb!
target_text: ka aa'i-aa'i ra koa-kio, aku rèngu na, ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua ji'i, dhu madhèdi ètu kadera paredha na. ji'i ded'e padedha-dedha ana kalèbho ne kahèi! rèngu se'e ka dhu pala mamuri hia ji'i. rèngu se'e ka dhu bhoke j'ara mamuri hia ji'i.

source_text: all the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped god,
target_text: ropa padhai lii rare sèmi èèna, ana pajuu lamatua nèti sorga dhu rai-reo rare kadera paredha ne, patitu kètu urutuu ra, toke rèhu d'ai rai, tangare asa kadera paredha aae ne. katua-katua dènge èpa badha aae sèra, tao madhutu sèmi èèna kahèi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i ra pahaha iisi mi ama lamatua,

source_text: saying, amen! blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our god forever and ever! amen.
target_text: aa ra peka na, tare'a! èèna tare'a-re'a! ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua kahèi! ji'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua kahèi! ngangee dènge lii padhai lamatua, dhu lèke mola-mola. koasa lamatua dhu kapai risi eele. a'èra lamatua seli eele. ji'i loe boe manèngi makasi mi ama lamatua. ji'i loe boe pakab'ua lamatua. lèke! tare'a sèmi èèna!

source_text: one of the elders answered, saying to me, these who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?
target_text: ropa rèngu koa-kio rare sèmi èèna, hèia nèti dua nguru èpa katua se, èci karèi ja'a, aku nèngu na, dhèu ae-ae dhu pake kodho pudhi se, èu tadha si, do? rèngu se mai nèti mia?

source_text: i told him, my lord, you know. he said to me, these are those who came out of the great suffering. they washed their robes and made them white in the lamb's blood.
target_text: te ngaa ja'a dhaa, peka na, aad'o, ama. ja'a tadhe boe rèngu se, cee. ama ka dhu tadhe risi. ka na peka dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, rèngu se, dhèu dhu bhodho nèti d'ara j'aj'èra aae. rèngu se, dhèu dhu pake le raa ana kalèbho ne, sèna ka rase mèdha-papake ra, aa tao papudhi kodho ra.

source_text: therefore they are before the throne of god, and they serve him day and night in his temple. he who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.
target_text: nèti èèna ka, rèngu titu ètu madha kadera paredha ama lamatua. mèu-mèda rèngu lalau-lalo'o lamatua ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i na. lamatua dènge si taa-taa. lamatua madhenge si taa-taa.

source_text: they will never be hungry or thirsty any more. the sun won't beat on them, nor any heat;
target_text: pe rèngu re'a heka manganga. pe rèngu koko-kamango heka. pe madha lod'o pakèpu heka si. pe ka'uri rèngu carici heka lèke lod'o pana.

source_text: for the lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. and god will wipe away every tear from their eyes.
target_text: ana kalèbho dhu padètu dènge kadera paredha èèna, pe nèngu ka j'aj'i dhèu bata-magee kètu rèngu. èèna na nèngu ka eo nèti si, lasi rinu asa madha èi dhu nèti mamuri hia dhèu. pe lamatua saku eele sasusa ra, sèna ka ra tangi ia ka.

source_text: when he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
target_text: hèia ana kalèbho ne bhoke segel ka pidhu. kabèdhi laa, aa'i-aa'i ètu sorga kalau-karèto boe. abhu boe lii èci sa, pe d'ai catenga jam sa.

source_text: i saw the seven angels who stand before god, and seven trumpets were given to them.
target_text: ka ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga, titu taruu ètu madha ama lamatua, dhu pa'èra lalau ne. rèngu èci-èci ka sèmi rare tèbhe ra.

source_text: another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu leo ca dhèu, titu ètu madha mei era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi. nèngu dhu nèd'u dènge mago hualaa cue, era isi raa aj'u hèu mèngi. hèia ra hia ne raa aj'u hèu mèngi ae-ae, sèna ka na pab'ali dènge lii manèngi-mangaj'i nèti dhèu unu ama lamatua. ka na nèti mago hualaa, ho tao sèmi korban dhu hèu mèngi, sèna ka la'e tèke asa dedha mei hualaa ètu madha kadera paredha aae.

source_text: the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before god out of the angel's hand.
target_text: ka na tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi ne. hèia hèu mèngi na ca'e asa madha ama lamatua, palere-lere dènge lii manèngi-mangaj'i nèti dhèu unu lamatua.

source_text: the angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, then threw it on the earth. thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake followed.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu ne nare ai nèti dedha mei ne, la'e tao asa d'ara mago hualaa èèna. hèia na pèci mago ne asa rai-haha. kaca'a laa, ja'a ladhe kèdhi bela kacèb'a lolo aae nèti g'ana-kariu ètu rai-haha. ka lii tea ma'ète boe, aa rai opo kapai titu kèna.

source_text: the seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.
target_text: èle ka, ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga sèra, pa'èra ho tiu tèbhe ra.

source_text: the first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. one third of the earth was burned up, and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ka èci tiu tèbhe na, hèia èj'i es aa ai pab'ali dènge raa, sabhori mai asa rai-haha. j'u'u aa'i-aa'i ètu mia-mia kèpu-ladhu ai. ca era nèti tèlu era ètu rai-haha ne, kèpu-ladhu ai. aa ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko ana aaj'u ètu rai-haha ne, dhu kèpu-ladhu ai kahèi.

source_text: the second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. one third of the sea became blood,
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ka dua tiu tèbhe na, ka mèdha èci sama sèmi ledhe aae cue dhu heo robhe-robhe, pèci la'e asa d'ara dhasi, toke ca era nèti tèlu era ètu d'ara dhasi j'aj'i raa.

source_text: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. one third of the ships were destroyed.
target_text: hèia ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko badha ètu d'ara dhasi, madhe aa'i mèu-mèu. ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko kapa aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara dhasi, laho eele aa'i si.

source_text: the third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of water. the name of the star is wormwood. one third of the waters became wormwood. many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.
target_text: ropa ana pajuu ka tèlu tiu tèbhe na, hèia nèti dedha-liru hua-hètu aae cue bèbhe mai, nuka sèmi ob'o kapai aae èci dhu heo. hua-hètu ne, ngara na ‘pèd'u'. ropa na bèbhe mai, èi loko dènge madha èi, j'aj'i pèd'u. hèia nèti dhèu dhu rinu, ae ka dhu madhe. ladhe sèmi loko dènge èi madha ètu rai-haha ne hag'e mi tèlu, na, ca hag'e j'aj'i pèd'u.

source_text: the fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars, so that one third of them would be darkened; and the day wouldn't shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka èpa tiu tèbhe na. kaca'a laa, madha lod'o, hèru dènge hua-hètu lèke hake, hèia maroga. ladhe re mèu, maroga èpa jam, lula madha lod'o heo iia heka. aa ladhe re mèda, maroga kiu-kiu èpa jam kahèi, lula hèru dènge hua-hètu heo iia heka kahèi.

source_text: i saw, and i heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, woe! woe! woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the other blasts of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!
target_text: èle ka, ja'a doa kètu, ka ladhe kèdhi manea luji ci'u dhu lela dedha titu kèna. na parodha, peka na, kasian! kasian! bèli-camèd'a j'aj'èra kapai lèke dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu rai-haha. te ana pajuu dhèu tèlu era, dhu tiu mèka tèbhe ra.

source_text: the fifth angel sounded, and i saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. the key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu ka lèmi tiu tèbhe na. hèia ja'a kèdhi hua-hètu cue bèbhe asa rai-haha. ra pangèd'u hua-hètu ne gagoe èci, ho na bhoke babèdho ro'a j'aj'èra dhu marèma na dènge boe too.

source_text: he opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. the sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.
target_text: lod'o na bhoke nare babèdho ro'a ne, kaca'a laa sèb'u dhu mèdhi guru-guru kalua mai, nuka sèmi sèb'u ai na'e j'ami. sèb'u ne kalua mai dhu kahore-kahore, ca'e la'e asa dedha, ka dedha-liru dènge madha lod'o maroga.

source_text: then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.
target_text: hèia kabara ae titu kèna, lela nèti d'ara sèb'u ai ne, ka bèbhe asa rai-haha. ama lamatua dhu pangèd'u le koasa mi rèngu, sama sèmi karakarai.

source_text: they were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don't have god's seal on their foreheads.
target_text: te ngaa ama lamatua peka dènge si, ho baku pa'ele iie j'u'u, aj'u-aj'u, dènge ana aaj'u ètu rai-haha. te ngaa ra hud'i paj'èra ku dhèu dhu dènge boe tadha lamatua ètu katangarèi ra.

source_text: they were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.
target_text: lamatua soro tèke kabara se paj'èra dhèu sèra toke d'ai lèmi hèru, te ngaa bisa boe pamadhe si. dhodhoka tao papèd'a di, sama sèmi karakarai tèpu.

source_text: in those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. they will desire to die, and death will flee from them.
target_text: ètu d'ara lèmi hèru èèna, rarii aa j'èra titu kèna, toke ra manèngi madhe. masi ka sèmi èèna, ra madhe boe.

source_text: the shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. on their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people's faces.
target_text: ja'a ladhe rupa kabara se sama sèmi jara pamusu. rèngu pake solo kapala musu dhu tao nèti hualaa. rèhu ra sama sèmi rèhu dhèu.

source_text: they had hair like women's hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.
target_text: rèu kètu ra madhera èci èèna ka dènge rèu kètu dhèu bhèni. ngutu ra mariu sèmi ngutu singa.

source_text: they had breastplates like breastplates of iron. the sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.
target_text: rèngu se oe sèmi pake kodho bèsi ètu sangasa ra. lii kahaku èla ra mèdhu sama sèmi jara sordad'u ae titu kèna dhu ère kareta pamusu ra.

source_text: they have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. in their tails they have power to harm men for five months.
target_text: rèu lai ra èra titu kèna, aa dhu dènge raco nuka sèmi raco karakarai. rèngu se abhu koasa, ho paj'èra dhèu pake raco ra, toke d'ai lèmi hèru.

source_text: they have over them as king the angel of the abyss. his name in hebrew is abaddon, but in greek, he has the name apollyon.
target_text: dhèu aae kabara se, nuka kètu nèti rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu ra babège si nèti d'ara ro'a j'aj'èra dhu dènge boe too-lane. ngara na ètu d'ara lii ibrani, abadon, aa madhutu lii yunani, apolion. sasoa na, dhu d'èi pa'ele iie.

source_text: the first woe is past. behold, there are still two woes coming after this.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, seli le j'aj'èra ka èci. te ngaa baku pamud'e! te dua j'aj'èra dhu leo era, dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i hari.

source_text: the sixth angel sounded. i heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before god,
target_text: ka ana pajuu ka èna tiu tèbhe na. hèia ja'a kèdhi mei hualaa, era dhu pake tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi, dhu patangara dènge lamatua. ka lii èci kalua nèti èpa tadhu ètu kabicu mei èèna,

source_text: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, free the four angels who are bound at the great river euphrates!
target_text: ho peka dènge ana pajuu dhu heka tiu nare tèbhe na, abhu ana pajuu dhèu èpa, dhu nèbhu nare sange ne'e lèke èki ètu d'ara loko aae èci, dhu ngara na efrat. lamu patabuli eele si!

source_text: the four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.
target_text: hèia la'e patabuli si, sèna ka ana pajuu èpa se lasi pamadhe dhèu, dhu lèke dènge tèu na, hèru na, lod'o na, dènge jam na, dhu lamatua pama'ète nare le. ladhe èdhi bagi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne mi tèlu kaboko, na, dhu madhe, ca kaboko.

source_text: the number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. i heard the number of them.
target_text: rèngu peka dènge ja'a, na, sordad'u ana pajuu dhu ca'e jara pamusu sèra aa'i-aa'i ra, dua ngasu juta dhèu.

source_text: thus i saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses' heads resembled lions' heads. out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi sordad'u dènge jara ra. sordad'u se dhu pake kodho bèsi pa'abhe sangasa ra. kodho se nuka, dhu mea gèu-gèu, mangèru kale'e, dènge karara oe sèmi èi nasu. rupa kètu jara se, sama sèmi kètu singa. nèti hèb'a jara se, kalua ai, sèb'u, aa èi nasu,

source_text: by these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.
target_text: ho hia j'aj'èra tèlu rupa asa rai-haha, toke dhèu ètu rai-haha ne madhe aa'i ca kaboko nèti tèlu kaboko.

source_text: for the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. for their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.
target_text: èle èèna, hèia jara se lasi paj'èra dhèu pake hèb'a dènge rèu lai ra. ètu rèu lai ra, abhu kètu sèmi kètu mege.

source_text: the rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn't repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn't worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can't see, hear, or walk.
target_text: te ngaa abhu dhèu cahag'e ètu rai-haha, dhu ra pamadhe boe nèti j'aj'èra se'e. masi ka sèmi èèna, rèngu neo boe tèke eele bhabhelu-katub'a ra. rèngu sogo-tagu taruu nidhu aa mèdha-panyau dhu ra tao nèti hualaa, doi pudhi, tabaga, hadhu, dènge aj'u. masi ka mèdha se bisa boe rèdhi ngaa-ngaa, bisa boe tadèngi ngaa-ngaa, aa bisa boe kako, te ngaa ra loe boe sogo-tagu si.

source_text: they didn't repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.
target_text: dhèu se'e ro'o boe loe kahèi nèti sasala dhu leo, nuka sèmi pamadhe dhèu, pake na'i nidhu, tao j'ara karehe dènge dhèu dhu j'aj'i boe dhèu èmu-kamali ra, aa mana'u pagogo-pagero.

source_text: i saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. a rainbow was on his head. his face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi ana pajuu lamatua dhu kapai èci puru mai nèti sorga. ra'i-liru sarimu nare ngi'u na. kètu na dhu poi dènge saroo. rèhu na heo sama sèmi madha lod'o, aa haga na heo èci èèna ka dènge heo ai.

source_text: he had in his hand a little open book. he set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.
target_text: nèngu ne kèpe dènge lalulu sasuri iiki, dhu bhoke tèke. na titu, haga g'ana na ètu d'ara dhasi, haga kariu na ètu dedha-rai.

source_text: he cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. when he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.
target_text: hèia na pa'oo-parodha, sèmi lii taraa singa. ropa na pa'oo-parodha nare, hèia d'oro lii pagod'o-god'o pidhu hari.

source_text: when the seven thunders sounded, i was about to write; but i heard a voice from the sky saying, seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don't write them.
target_text: ropa d'oro lii, ka ja'a neo suri lii padhai ra. te ngaa ja'a tadèngi lii èci nèti sorga, peka na, èu baku lolo dènge dhèu lii padhai lula-nèti pidhu d'oro se'e! mage mu suri ngaa-ngaa kahèi.

source_text: the angel whom i saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu titu haga calaa ètu dedha-rai, aa haga calaa ètu d'ara dhasi èèna, j'oka ai g'ana na asa dedha-liru,

source_text: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,
target_text: hèia na subha, peka na, lii dhu ja'a peka ne, lèke tare'a! ja'a subha dènge kolongara ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka dhu taa-taa! nèngu ka dhu paj'aj'i liru dènge rai-haha, aa isi ra aa'i-aa'i. nanene paie-iie! lod'o dhu èdhi tatae èèna, mamai na oe dètu le.

source_text: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of god is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.
target_text: te ladhe ana pajuu lamatua ka pidhu èèna neo tiu tèbhe na, pe lamatua tao madhutu ngaa dhu uru èèna dhèu dhae re'a mèka. te ngaa, ngaa dhu na neo tao ne, na peka le dènge dhèu rèti lii padhai na dhu lalau-lalo'o ne. de nanene paie-iie, te lii padhai ja'a ne lèke tare'a.

source_text: the voice which i heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.
target_text: ka lii dhu ja'a tadèngi nèti dedha-liru èèna, peka hari dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, yohanis, lamu ka asa ana pajuu nèti sorga nèi, dhu titu haga na calaa ètu rai-dedha, aa calaa ètu d'ara dhasi. more nèti kacui-aai na, lalulu sasuri iiki dhu bhoke tèke èèna.

source_text: i went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. he said to me, take it and eat it. it will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.
target_text: hèia ja'a laku dènge ka asa ana pajuu ne, manèngi kore sasuri iiki èèna. ka na lii dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, more ho mu'a ka! èèna na d'ara hèb'a èu, rasa kee nuka sèmi dhua nasu oni, te ngaa ètu d'ara kabake èu, rasa pèd'u.

source_text: i took the little book out of the angel's hand, and ate it. it was as sweet as honey in my mouth. when i had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.
target_text: ropa na padhai lii nare sèmi èèna, ka ja'a sèmi kore sasuri iiki èèna nèti kacui-aai na. hèia ja'a ku'e dènge ka. ètu d'ara hèb'a ja'a ne kee sèmi dhua nasu oni. te ngaa ropa ja'a dhèle, ja'a rasa na ètu d'ara kabake ja'a pèd'u.

source_text: they told me, you must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.
target_text: ka abhu dhu pua ja'a, peka na, èu hud'i lamu hari ku, ho peka dènge ka ngaa dhu bèli-camèd'a lamatua neo tao ètu rai-haha. peka j'ara-j'ara dhu bèli-camèd'a j'aj'i mi dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i, mi dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, nèti udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge nèti lii aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha.

source_text: a reed like a rod was given to me. someone said, rise and measure god's temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.
target_text: hèia ra j'ole hia ja'a aj'u a'uku calaa dhu madhera nuka sèmi tatea. ka ama lamatua paredha ja'a, peka na, yohanis, lamu ho uku èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ja'a dènge mei sogo-tagu na ètu kota yerusalem. aa ige dhèu-dhèu dhu sabaj'a ètu d'ara èmu èèna.

source_text: leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don't measure it, for it has been given to the nations. they will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.
target_text: te ngaa madha èmu manèngi-mangaj'i èèna, mage mu uku, te era èèna dhu hag'e eele le hia suku-suku leo dhu tadhe boe ja'a. èèna na rèngu mai j'aj'èli leli ho pakaj'alu kota ja'a ne, d'ai tèlu tèu dènge cabèka nuka, 1. 260 ca riho dua ngasu èna nguru lod'o.

source_text: i will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.
target_text: pe ja'a pua dhèu ja'a dhèu dua lasi asa era èèna, sèna ka rèti lii padhai ja'a. dhèu dua se pake mèdha sasusa, aa ra lole lii moa nèti ja'a, toke èle 1. ca riho dua ngasu èna nguru lod'o èèna.

source_text: these are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the lord of the earth.
target_text: sakaria, ca dhèu nèti lii padhai lamatua, dhu suri mema le nèti uru ka, lula-nèti dhèu dua se. na pakasame sèmi aj'u saitun dua kapua, aa era tatèke labhu dua, dhu patitu tangare asa ama lamatua, dhu j'aj'i kètu mi dhèu aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha.

source_text: if anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. if anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.
target_text: ladhe dhèu neo paj'èra dhèu dua dhu rèti lii padhai lamatua, èèna na ai bhodho nèti d'ara hèb'a ra, ho pakèpu aa'i musu ra. dènge j'ara sèmi ne'e, dhèu dhu neo paj'èra si, tatu madhe.

source_text: these have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. they have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.
target_text: lod'o dua ra j'aj'i dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua ètu rai-haha ne, lamatua pangèd'u ra koasa ho ra bisa taha èj'i, koasa sèna ka tao madha èi j'aj'i raa, aa koasa ho ad'u-ue rupa-rupa mamadhe-mamopo ètu rai-haha, madhutu dad'èi ra.

source_text: when they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.
target_text: lod'o d'ai èle sasab'a-la'a ra, èèna na badha bhelu ci'u bhodho mai nèti ro'a j'aj'èra dhu dènge boe too-lane. badha ne'e lab'a rèngu dua ra, toke na segi si, aa na pamadhe dua ra.

source_text: their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called sodom and egypt, where also their lord was crucified. from among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations, people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.
target_text: dènge j'ara ne'e, dua ra madhe ètu kota kapai, dhu uru èèna era dhèu paku pamadhe lamatua rèngu ètu aj'u palolo-palèbha. te kota ne'e j'aj'i le kota bhelu, sèmi kota sodom dènge rai masir uru èèna. èèna na, dhèu core eele ngi'u aae dua ra, toke d'ai tèlu lod'o dènge ca èta. ka dhèu-dhèu nèti suku aa'i-aa'i, nèti udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i, aa dènge nèti kabarai aa'i-aa'i ra, mai lingu. dhèu se ro'o boe hia ijin ho padhane si,

source_text: those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, and they will be glad. they will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.
target_text: lula ra karej'e laladhe ngi'u aae dhèu dua se, dhu mai lalai ngangee dhèu ae ètu rai-haha ne. ka dhèu se aa'i-aa'i ra tao pesta, aa ra pa'adhu hadia èci dènge èci.

source_text: after the three and a half days, the breath of life from god entered into them, and they stood on their feet. great fear fell on those who saw them.
target_text: te ngaa ropa èle tèlu lod'o dènge ca èta, hèia ama lamatua hia si a'ae, ka dua ra mamuri hari. hèia dhèu-dhèu dhu ladhe rèdhi si, madha'u toke isi ra rèbha-rèbha.

source_text: i heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, come up here! they went up into heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.
target_text: ka dhèu dua se tadèngi lii dhu mèdhu èci nèti dedha-liru pua ra, peka na, dua mi ca'e ka asa ne'e mai! hèia dua ra ca'e asa dedha-liru lasi dènge ra'i-liru dhu sarimu nare si. ropa rèdhi sèmi èèna, ka musu ra malaa ko'a-ko'a sène.

source_text: in that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the god of heaven.
target_text: kaca'a laa, rai opo dhu kapai titu kèna. ladhe ige èmu aa'i-aa'i ètu d'ara kota, nèti canguru èmu, dhu guri, cue. aa dhèu dhu madhe, pidhu riho dhèu. dhu madhe boe, ra madha'u bia. te ngaa rèngu èèna na pakab'ua kahèi kolongara ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka dhu nèd'u paredha ètu sorga.

source_text: the second woe is past. behold, the third woe comes quickly.
target_text: dènge sèmi ne'e, j'aj'èra ka dua seli le. te ngaa baku pamud'e! te calaka ka tèlu oe mai kèna.

source_text: the seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, the kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our lord and of his christ. he will reign forever and ever!
target_text: hèia ana pajuu lamatua ka pidhu tiu tèbhe na. kaca'a laa, ja'a tadèngi lii ae-ae nèti sorga, dhu peka na, limuri ne, dhu rèd'u paredha ètu rai-haha, dhodhoka ama lamatua dènge kristus, nuka dhèu dhu lamatua hag'e nare karèi nèti uru ka mai. èèna na lamatua nèd'u paredha taa-taa, sama sèmi dhèu aae.

source_text: the twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before god's throne, fell on their faces and worshiped god,
target_text: ka dua nguru èpa katua dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kadera paredha ètu madha ama lamatua, tadèngi lii èèna kahèi. hèia ra patitu kètu urutuu, toke rèhu ra d'ai rai, ka ra koa-kio ama lamatua,

source_text: saying: we give you thanks, lord god, the almighty, the one who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and reigned.

source_text: here is the perseverance of the saints, those who keep the commandments of god and the faith of jesus. i heard a voice from heaven saying, write, ‘blessed are the dead who die in the lord from now on. ' yes, says the spirit, that they may rest from their labors, for their works follow with them.
target_text: de se'e se, sasoa na, dhèu unu ama lamatua, hud'i nanene ku paie-iie lii paredha na, aa parcaya taruu mi yesus, aa baku hari kabodho. hèia ja'a tadèngi lii èci nèti dedha-liru, peka na, yohanis! èu hud'i suri ku sèmi ne'e: karèi nèti deo ne'e, dhèu dhu parcaya lamatua yesus, ladhe ra madhe, rèngu abhu oto. hèia roh ama lamatua dhu mola-mèci dhaa, peka na, tare'a! bèli-camèd'a rèngu sèra oto tare'a-re'a! lula rèngu j'èra le ètu rai-haha, te ngaa ra taha ho madhutu taruu lamatua. de èèna na, lamatua b'ala j'aj'èra rèngu, ka rèngu mamuri j'èra heka ètu sorga.

source_text: i looked, and saw a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ja'a padoa kètu. kaca'a laa, kèdhi ra'i-liru dhu pudhi lao-lao, aa ca dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha na. dhèu ne, oe sèmi dhèu rai-haha tare'a-re'a. na pake dènge solo juara dhu tao nèti hualaa, aa nèd'u dènge hela pare j'u'u madèka èci.

source_text: another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, send your sickle and reap, for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!
target_text: hèia ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu dhèu èci hari nèti sorga, kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. na rodhe dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha ra'i-liru èèna, peka na, pake hela èu èèna ho lamu puu-g'ètu ka! te d'ai le hèru pakaboko isi rai.

source_text: he who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.
target_text: ka dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha ra'i-liru ne, kèpe nare hela na, ka na la'e puu-g'ètu. hèia na oru kaboko isi rai nèti rai-haha.

source_text: another angel came out of the temple which is in heaven. he also had a sharp sickle.
target_text: ka ana pajuu dhu leo hari ca dhèu kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu sorga. nèngu nèd'u dènge hela pare j'u'u madèka èci, ho neo g'ètu hua aj'u.

source_text: another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, send your sharp sickle and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth's grapes are fully ripe!
target_text: hèia ana pajuu dhu leo hari èci kalua nèti era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ètu sorga. sasab'a ana pajuu ne, nuka j'aga ai ètu era tunu raa aj'u hèu mèngi. na pa'oo pua ana pajuu dhu nèd'u hela pare j'u'u deo na, aku nèngu na, pake ka hela èu èèna, ho lamu ka g'ètu hua aj'u ètu rai-haha! te ètu nèi, hua anggor dhu madhasa aa'i le.

source_text: the angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth and threw it into the great wine press of the wrath of god.
target_text: ka ana pajuu ne kèpe nare ka hela pare j'u'u na la'e asa rai-haha, ho na g'ètu hua anggor, j'ue dènge ii kateme. hèia na pamaso hua anggor se asa d'ara bak pacèli anggor. ka ra j'èli marèu anggor se, sèna ka rare èi. j'èli marèu hua anggor ètu d'ara bak pacèli ne, sasoa na, nanasa lamatua.

source_text: the wine press was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out of the wine press, up to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia.
target_text: bak pacèli ne ètu li'u kota. ropa ra j'èli marèu anggor se, hèia raa kalua ae-ae. raa ne hae sama sèmi loko cue, dhu madhera na tèlu ngasu kilo, aa marèma na d'ai ca meter ca èta.

source_text: i saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them god's wrath is finished.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi tadha èci ètu dedha-liru, dhu kapai titu kèna, toke ja'a malaa bia. abhu ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga, èci-èci ka dènge koasa ra, ho hia calaka kapai asa rai-haha. pidhu calaka se, nuka j'aj'èra dhu limuri tèka. ladhe j'ara se aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i ka, d'ara ama lamatua pacuhi, ka nasa heka dènge dhèu rai-haha.

source_text: i saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of god.
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi dhasi dhu ha'a-ha'a, nuka sèmi tèru dhu pab'ali dènge ai. ja'a kèdhi kahèi dhèu ae dhu titu ètu sebhe dhasi èèna. dhèu se'e ka dhu madhutu boe badha bhelu èèna, aa ra sogo-tagu boe mèdha sogo-tagu na, aa dhu sèmi boe cap na hèi. rèngu aa'i-aa'i dhu kèpe dènge mèdha lii sod'a èci nuka sèmi sasadhu, dhu ra abhu nèti ama lamatua.

source_text: they sang the song of moses, the servant of god, and the song of the lamb, saying, great and marvelous are your works, lord god, the almighty! righteous and true are your ways, you king of the nations.
target_text: ka ra sod'a lii sod'a èci dhu musa suri. musa ne, ana pua-paleha ama lamatua uru-uru sèra. dhèu se'e se sod'a kahèi lii sod'a èci dhu koa-kio yesus. te uru èèna, dhèu pamadhe ne, sama sèmi dhèu roro pamadhe ana kalèbho ètu d'ara èmu kapua manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua, sèna ka pamaringi d'ara na. dhèu se sod'a, peka na, ji'i koa-kio ama lamatua! ji'i j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara na! lula koasa lamatua kapai risi eele. dènge a'èra na kapai titu kèna. lamatua ka dhu nèd'u le paredha mi suku aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha. lamatua ka dhu j'aj'i dhèu aae mi udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha. tatao lamatua mola sèmi isi pupu. sasab'a lamatua be'a seli eele! j'ara lamatua mèu rèd'e-rèd'e. mamuri lamatua lèke mola-mola!

source_text: who wouldn't fear you, lord, and glorify your name? for you only are holy. for all the nations will come and worship before you. for your righteous acts have been revealed.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra j'oka padedha-dedha kolongara lamatua, dhèu aa'i-aa'i ra koa-kio babe'a lamatua. lula lamatua mesa na dhu mola-mèci. aa lamatua mesa na di, dènge boe sasala. pe suku aa'i-aa'i mai pahaha iisi mi lamatua. pe udhu-rasa aa'i-aa'i mai manèngi makasi mi lamatua. lula dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a rèdhi le tatao lamatua dhu be'a. aa dhèu aa'i-aa'i re'a le mamola d'ara lamatua.

source_text: after these things i looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.
target_text: ropa dhèu se èle sod'a, ja'a kèdhi kama luri mola-mèci ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i lamatua ètu sorga, dènge bhèla bhabhiri dhu bhoke pataleo tèke.

source_text: the seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their chests.
target_text: ka ja'a kèdhi ana pajuu dhèu pidhu nèti sorga dhu rèti dènge pidhu calaka sèra. rèngu kalua mai nèti èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ama lamatua. rèngu pake mèdha-papake dhu kale'e pudhi mèu, aa pake salalu dhu tao nèti poe dènge pai.

source_text: one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of god, who lives forever and ever.
target_text: hèia ja'a ladhe kèdhi badha aae èci nèti èpa ngi'u sèra ètu sebhe kadera paredha lamatua, dhu papala pidhu bokor hualaa mi ana pajuu dhèu pidhu sèra. pidhu bokor se, èci-èci ka dhu isi ra hahuku nèti ama lamatua dhu taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia. te na pa'èra le, ho sabhori nanasa na asa rai-haha.

source_text: the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of god and from his power. no one was able to enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.
target_text: nèbhu boe, hèia èmu manèngi-mangaj'i ne pènu dènge sèb'u dhu bodho mai nèti dadedha dènge koasa ama lamatua. abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu bisa maso asa era èèna. ana pajuu dhèu pidhu se hud'i sabhori pa'èle ku pidhu calaka asa rai-haha ne, heka dhèu bisa maso asa era èèna kèna.

source_text: i heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of god on the earth!
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi lii parodha èci kalua nèti d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, ho peka dènge ana pajuu dhèu pidhu se, na, lami ka! nedhe mèti ka bokor se'e, ho bhori ka nanasa lamatua asa rai-haha.

source_text: the first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and painful sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.
target_text: ropa tadèngi rare, hèia ana pajuu ka èci la'e bhori isi bokor na asa rai-haha. kaca'a laa, papèd'a-tarègu lèke dènge dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu uru sèra abhu cap nèti badha bhelu, dènge dhèu-dhèu dhu sogo-tagu mèdha sogo-tagu na. rèngu se lèke èi papèd'a hisu huu dhu rarii titu kèna.

source_text: the second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. every living thing in the sea died.
target_text: èle èèna ka, ana pajuu ka dua la'e bhori isi bokor na asa d'ara dhasi. kaca'a laa, èi ètu d'ara dhasi j'aj'i raa dhu hèu mau, cakaraa hèu raa dhèu madhe. ka aa'i-aa'i dhu mamuri ètu d'ara dhasi madhe aa'i si.

source_text: the third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka tèlu la'e bhori isi bokor na asa d'ara loko dènge madha èi. ka èi aa'i-aa'i ra j'aj'i raa.

source_text: i heard the angel of the waters saying, you are righteous, who are and who were, o holy one, because you have judged these things.
target_text: hèia ja'a tadèngi ana pajuu ca dhèu nèti sorga, dhu uri èi aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha ne. na koa-kio ama lamatua, peka na, oo lamatua! lamatua dhu mola-mèci! lamatua dhu sala nèdhi boe! lamatua mema-mema karèi nèti uru ka. aa lamatua taa-taa toke d'ai mia-mia. lamatua pama'ète lii langu dhu mola isi pupu. lamatua hia le huku dhu kasii-kasore boe.

source_text: for they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. they deserve this.
target_text: dhèu-dhèu pasuti le, raa nèti dhèu unu lamatua. dhèu-dhèu pamadhe le, dhèu rèti lii padhai lamatua. nèti èèna ka, lamatua laka-seti si, ho rinu raa kahèi. nèti èèna ka, lamatua b'ala si, dènge huku dhu lèke.

source_text: i heard the altar saying, yes, lord god, the almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.
target_text: èle ka, ja'a tadèngi lii èci kalua nèti mei sogo-tagu, peka na, tare'a! ama lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi eele. tare'a! ama lamatua dhu èra risi aa'i. lamatua dhu pama'ète lii langu dhu koe boe kapengo boe. lamatua dhu pamanahu huku dhu lèke mola-mola.

source_text: the fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka èpa la'e bhori isi bokor na asa madha lod'o. kaca'a laa, lod'o pana titu kèna, ka dhèu ètu rai-haha ne kèpu-ladhu ai.

source_text: people were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of god who has the power over these plagues. they didn't repent and give him glory.
target_text: dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu lèke tunu se, dhoo kolongara ama lamatua, lula nèngu ka dhu papuru calaka ne hia mai asa rèngu. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu ele-ho'a, ka lèpa asa lamatua ho koa-kio kolongara na.

source_text: the fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. they gnawed their tongues because of the pain,
target_text: ka ana pajuu ka lèmi la'e bhori isi bokor na asa kadera paredha badha bhelu se. kaca'a laa, maroga kiu-kiu saguru nare dhèu aa'i-aa'i dhu sogo-tagu ne, toke j'èra titu kèna hèia ra gègu-ria.

source_text: and they blasphemed the god of heaven because of their pains and their sores. they still didn't repent of their works.
target_text: dhèu se'e kahèi dhoo ama lamatua ètu sorga, lula hisu ra rarii titu kèna. masi ka sèmi èèna, te ngaa abhu boe ca dhèu sa dhu ae eele nèti bhabhelu ra, ka lèpa asa ama lamatua.

source_text: the sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the euphrates. its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka èna bhori isi bokor na asa loko aae, dhu ngara na efrat. ka loko ne mango-meto dènge ka. hèia ra tao j'ara ètu d'ara loko ne, hia dhèu aae-dhèu aae dènge sordad'u-sordad'u dhu bèli-camèd'a mai nèti cabèka dhimu.

source_text: i saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something like frogs;
target_text: ka ja'a ladhe kèdhi nidhu bhelu tèlu. rupa ra sama sèmi ana gaged'e. ci'u bhodho nèti d'ara hèb'a mege naga. ci'u kalua nèti d'ara hèb'a badha bhelu. aa ci'u hari bhodho nèti hèb'a dhèu kapod'e-kabèli, dhu nèti lii padhai mege naga èèna.

source_text: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs, which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather them together for the war of that great day of god the almighty.
target_text: nidhu tèlu se dènge koasa ho tao rupa-rupa tadha malaa. ra kalua, lasi paraga dènge dhèu aae aa'i-aa'i ètu rai-haha, ka ra pajaji ho ètu d'ara ca lod'o sa lasi pamusu, lab'a ama lamatua dhu koasa kapai risi eele èèna. te ngaa lod'o dhu ra pajaji èèna, lèke dènge lod'o dhu ama lamatua hag'e nare le, ho na segi musu na aa'i-aa'i ra.

source_text: behold, i come like a thief. blessed is he who watches, and keeps his clothes, so that he doesn't walk naked, and they see his shame. he gathered them together into the place which is called in hebrew, harmagedon.
target_text: era dhu ra pakaboko ho pamusu èèna, lii ibrani peka na, armagedon. yesus kristus peka kahèi, na, sanèd'e paie-iie! te kaca'a laa, ja'a mai nuka sèmi dhèu mana'u, dhu dhèu èci sa re'a boe. dhèu dhu oto, nuka rèngu dhu beke dènge dhu bori mema dhari. te ladhe ja'a mai, nèngu na'e boe makae, lula dhèu rèdhi boe era makae na.

source_text: the seventh poured out his bowl into the air. a loud voice came out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, it is done!
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ka pidhu la'e bhori isi bokor na asa madha ngèlu. ka ama lamatua padhai lii mèdhu nèti kadera paredha na ètu d'ara èmu manèngi-mangaj'i, peka na, èle le! nanasa ja'a bhori aa'i mèu-mèu le!

source_text: there were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake such as has not happened since there were men on the earth-so great an earthquake and so mighty.
target_text: hèia bela heo ha'a-ha'a, dènge d'oro lii gasi-gasi. aa rai opo dhu kapai titu kèna, dhu j'aj'i nèdhi mèka karèi nèti rai-haha ne j'aj'i.

source_text: the great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. babylon the great was remembered in the sight of god, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.
target_text: lod'o èèna, ama lamatua bhèlu boe bhabhelu dhèu ètu kota babel. ka na pake rai opo dhu kapai aae, sèna ka tao kota kapai ne masèke mi tèlu. ama lamatua ad'u-ue sèmi èèna, sèna ka dhèu babel re'a nanasa na. kota-kota leo ètu rai-haha ne, laho eele aa'i si kahèi.

source_text: every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.
target_text: lod'o èèna pulu-pulu cène aa'i si, aa ledhe-ledhe ela aa'i kahèi.

source_text: great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, came down out of the sky on people. people blasphemed god because of the plague of the hail, for this plague was exceedingly severe.
target_text: abhu kahèi èj'i es hadhu dhu kapai, bèbhe nèti dedha-liru, kabhie nare dhèu-dhèu ètu rai-haha. es hadhu se, babia ra abhu kahèi d'ai èpa nguru kilo. lula èj'i es ne dhu paj'èra dhèu, ka ra dhoo ama lamatua.

source_text: one of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, come here. i will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,
target_text: èle ka, ana pajuu èci nèti rèngu dhèu pidhu dhu rèd'u bokor dhu dènge heka isi, mai peka dènge ja'a, aku nèngu na, mai ku sa ne'e! ja'a neo pad'elo dènge èu, j'ara tasamia ama lamatua huku bhèni kajeo dhu bhelu aae èèna. nèngu ne, nuka kota kapai èèna, dhu ra patitu padètu dènge èi ae-ae.

source_text: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality. those who dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.
target_text: uru èèna, dhèu aae-dhèu aae nèti mia-mia, mai ad'u-ue j'ara makae dènge ana kabarai d'ara kota ne. dhèu leo kahèi mai rinu mahu, aa madhutu tatao j'ara makae ra.

source_text: he carried me away in the spirit into a wilderness. i saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored beast, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.
target_text: èle èèna ka, roh ama lamatua maso asa ja'a, hèia ana pajuu nèti sorga ded'e nèti ja'a asa d'ara mamoo èci. d'ai nèi, ja'a ladhe kèdhi dhèu bhèni ca dhèu dhu madhèdi ètu dedha kabodho badha bhelu mea ci'u. kètu badha ne pidhu, dènge tadhu na canguru. palème ètu ngi'u na dhu suri lii-lii dhu pakarehe ama lamatua.

source_text: the woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.
target_text: bhèni ne pake bèla manii mea dènge mea sanama mangèru. na pagaa ngi'u na dènge nèu mèdha hualaa, hadhu kale'e dhu kab'ua, dènge mutiara. ètu ai g'ana na, nèd'u dènge cangkir hualaa èci dhu pènu dènge èi anggor. anggor ne, sasoa na, j'ara makae, aa bhabhelu dènge tatao kaj'alu aa'i-aa'i dhu leo, dhu na ad'u-ue.

source_text: and on her forehead a name was written, mystery, babylon the great, the mother of the prostitutes and of the abominations of the earth.
target_text: ètu katangarèi na, dhu suri ngara èci, dhu dhèu re'a boe. lii dhu ra suri èèna, sèmi ne'e ka: ja'a ne, babel! ja'a ne, kota dhu kapai risi! rupa-rupa bhabhelu ètu rai-haha, j'aj'aj'i ra nèti ja'a ka. j'ara makae aa'i-aa'i dhu j'aj'i ètu rai-haha ne, kapua ra nèti ja'a.

source_text: i saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints and with the blood of the martyrs of jesus. when i saw her, i wondered with great amazement.
target_text: ja'a laladhe, na, bhèni ne dhu mahu bia, lula nèngu dhu ninu le raa dhèu unu ama lamatua sèra. sasoa na, na pamadhe le dhèu unu ama lamatua, lula rèngu loe boe peka j'ara mamuri yesus. ropa ja'a kèdhi tatao bhèni ne sèmi èèna, hèia hèb'a ja'a nganga-nganga sène, lula malaa bia.

source_text: the angel said to me, why do you wonder? i will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.
target_text: hèia ana pajuu ne karèi ja'a, peka na, nga tao ka èu naa-naa, aa malaa sèmi èèna? mai ho ja'a peka dènge èu sasoa na nèti bhèni kajeo ne. sèmi èèna kahèi, dènge sasoa nèti badha bhelu dhu nèngu manya'e èèna. badha ne'e ka dhu kètu pidhu dènge tadhu canguru.

source_text: the beast that you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. those who dwell on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see that the beast was, and is not, and shall be present.
